article.articleHeadline: تفشي المرض يفوق قدراتنا، "الصحة العالمية" تدعو إلى دعم وتمويل جهودها لمجابهة "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The outbreak is beyond our capabilities; WHO calls for support and funding for its efforts to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading beyond response capacity, prompting WHO to seek greater funding and support to scale surveillance, testing, treatment, and community protections. The outbreak has reached 3,748 confirmed cases and 1,657 deaths, with 708 recoveries and 227 suspected cases; about 17,000 contacts are being monitored. WHO spokesperson Tarik Jasarevic stated the outbreak continues to expand, while cases double in some hotspots within a week. Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting the DRC, urged intensified response and protection of healthcare workers, stressing ongoing vigilance due to population movement and cross-border transmission risk. The report underscores the need for sustained monitoring, preparedness, and international funding to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 感染拡大は我々の対応能力を超えている、WHOがエボラ対策への支援と資金提供を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が大規模拡大（確定3,748例、死亡1,657例）し、WHOが国際支援を要請するなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長がDRCを訪問し支援強化を要請。感染者数が一部ホットスポットで1週間で倍増との報告あり、国境を越えた感染拡大リスクも指摘されている。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: بعد تسجيل 1657 وفاة و3748 إصابة جهود أممية لمواجهة الإيبولا فى الكونغو.. الصحة العالمية: تطوير علاجات أكثر فعالية.. والأممى الإنسانى (أوتشا) يعتزم تخصيص 60 مليون ومفوضية اللاجئين تقوم بعمليات الكشف المبكر للمرض - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After recording 1,657 deaths and 3,748 infections, UN efforts to tackle Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... WHO: development of more effective treatments... and the UN humanitarian office (OCHA) plans to allocate 60 million, and UNHCR carries out early detection operations for the disease - The Seventh Day.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province’s Bunia, with 3,748 cases, 1,657 deaths, and 708 recoveries as of August 1, the largest Bundibugyo-strain outbreak to date. UN agencies warn of a growing humanitarian and health crisis while advancing therapies and vaccination efforts. UN OCHA plans up to $60 million from the Central Emergency Response Fund to support response and preparedness in DRC and neighboring countries. A new 100-bed treatment center opened in Bunia; clinical trials of therapeutics are under way in Ituri, including a post-exposure preventive oral drug study. Globally, the UK began a vaccine trial for Bundibugyo on July 24, with Canada to follow. A mobile lab at the Congo–Uganda border, supported by WHO and WFP, returns Ebola results in about one hour, aiding diagnostics for over 94,000 people. No proven safe or effective treatment yet; outcomes expected in months.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱による死者1,657人・感染者3,748人を記録、国連が対応強化…WHOはより効果的な治療法の開発を進め、国連人道問題調整事務所(OCHA)は6,000万ドルの拠出を計画、UNHCRは早期発見活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のブンディブギョ株エボラアウトブレイク（死者1,657人、感染者3,748人）が継続しており、国際機関による大規模対応・資金拠出・近隣国への波及懸念があるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、英国、カナダは近隣国支援・ワクチン治験実施国として言及されているが、実際の発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア）のみ。過去最大のブンディブギョ株アウトブレイクであり、致死率が非常に高い点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Satara: जिल्ह्यात १०३ जणांना डेंग्यूचा डंख; तापानेही फणफणले ३७ जण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Satara: 103 people in the district contracted dengue; fever also gripped 37 people.
article.articleSummary: Satara district in Maharashtra is grappling with rising typhus and dengue fever after recent viral illnesses. Weather changes have left many residents with fever. In recent days, 37 typhus cases and 103 dengue cases have been detected, with rural areas most affected. Health authorities, including the Typhus Department and the state health department, have issued alerts and intensified surveillance to curb transmission. The report notes a greater rural burden for these febrile illnesses. No information about imported or exported cases is provided. These figures are current as of 2026-08-06.

triage.headline_ja: サタラ:管内で103人がデング熱に感染;発熱により37人も体調不良
triage.triage_reason: インドのマハーラーシュトラ州サタラ県で季節性のデング熱・チフス様疾患が増加しているが、通常の季節的流行の範囲内とみられ、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 地方紙報道でありデングは同地域の季節性流行と考えられる。重症度や死亡者数などの詳細情報が不足しており、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Knap 4000 mennesker er smittet med ebola i DR Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 4,000 people have been infected with Ebola in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo has 3,973 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,801 deaths, due to the Bundibugyo variant, according to government data cited by Reuters. Declared May 15, this is DR Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak and it is spreading at an unusually fast pace, according to WHO. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo. The ongoing outbreak follows the deadliest episode from 2018–2020, which caused about 2,300 deaths among roughly 3,500 cases. The article emphasizes the lack of targeted therapeutics and vaccine availability, underscoring the need to intensify public health measures and international support to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で約4000人がエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例3,973例・死亡1,801例（致死率約45%）のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が急速に拡大しており、承認されたワクチン・治療薬が存在しないためIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: WHOにより異例の速さでの拡大が指摘されており、ブンディブギョ株には承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないため、国際的な支援強化が急務とされている。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情持續擴大　確診病例逼近4000大關 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to widen, with confirmed cases nearing the 4,000 mark - Ming Shi News Network.
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to widen, with government data reporting 3,973 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,801 deaths. The figures, released by DR Congo authorities and cited by Reuters, reflect ongoing, severe transmission in the region. The brief provides no additional details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or transmission sources. This update underscores the sustained public health challenge posed by Ebola in DR Congo and the need for continued surveillance, case management, and community interventions to curb transmission and reduce fatalities in affected provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が拡大継続、確定症例は4000人に迫る - 民視新聞網
triage.triage_reason: エボラ確定症例約4000例・死亡1801例という大規模な流行が継続しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを有するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 致死率約45%と高く、致死率・症例数から既に大規模流行段階にあると判断。続報や地理的拡大の有無を含めフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Closing the gaps in the fight against hepatitis
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis B and C screening expansion shows early progress under the StITCH project in the Philippines, where more than 24,000 people were screened for hepatitis B and many linked to care and started on treatment; in Vietnam, over 85,000 were screened for hepatitis B and about 69,000 for hepatitis C. Focus, launched in 2010 by Gilead, Harvard Medical School and partners, aims to close diagnostic and care gaps by embedding screening into routine care, prompting testing via electronic health records, and streamlining linkage to a medical appointment in HIV, hepatitis B and C services, especially in underserved communities. As of December 2025, Focus partners in the United States, Spain and Portugal conducted more than 24 million blood-borne virus tests in high-prevalence areas. With 2030 WHO elimination goals, Dr. Ong calls for diagnosing more people sooner and moving services closer to communities, supported by policy, financing and primary care delivery.

triage.headline_ja: 肝炎対策における課題解消に向けて
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はB型・C型肝炎のスクリーニング拡大プログラムに関する広報的内容であり、急性のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は慢性疾患（肝炎）のスクリーニング・治療プログラムの進捗報告であり、アウトブレイクや新興感染症のシグナルには該当しない。米国・スペイン・ポルトガルは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Un mosquito de la malaria 'urbanita' y resistente a insectida se expande por África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An urban malaria-carrying mosquito that is insecticide-resistant is spreading across Africa.
article.articleSummary: An urban malaria-carrying mosquito Anopheles stephensi, originally from Asia, is expanding across Africa and showing resistance to all known insecticides. It tolerates dry seasons and thrives in urban waters, contrasting with traditional rural vectors, raising malaria risk in megacities such as Lagos (Nigeria) and Kinshasa (DR Congo), each with about 20 million residents lacking prior malaria immunity. The spread has accelerated since first arriving in the Horn of Africa over a decade ago; genomic analyses confirm multi-country insecticide resistance, complicating control. In Djibouti, cases rose from 27 in 2012 to about 70,000 annually; Ethiopia reports a similar pattern. Globally, malaria causes about 600,000 deaths per year. The mosquito’s urban adaptability could transform transmission dynamics, demanding new interventions; climate warming could broaden distribution to Europe, though local surveillance mitigates large outbreaks, with isolated autochthonous dengue cases noted in France linked to urban vectors.

triage.headline_ja: 殺虫剤耐性を持つ都市型マラリア媒介蚊がアフリカ全域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大の3項目が該当し、殺虫剤耐性を持つ新規媒介蚊がメガシティに拡大する公衆衛生上の重大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事はAnopheles stephensi蚊のアフリカ全域への拡大を扱う科学記事。具体的な症例増加データはジブチ・エチオピアで報告されているが両国は対象国リスト外。DRC（キンシャサ）は今後のマラリアリスク上昇地域として言及されているため含めた。ナイジェリア（ラゴス）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola outbreak outpacing response, says WHO chief
article.articleSummary: Congo’s Ebola outbreak in Ituri province (Bunia) is the world’s fastest-spreading, with 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths as of Monday. The Bundibugyo virus behind the outbreak has no approved treatment or vaccine and local officials say it began in a remote area long before the mid-May declaration. The epidemic is spreading at an unprecedented pace, second only to the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak. Late case detection and weak contact tracing—60–70% of new cases occur outside monitored contacts—drive transmission, with 44 of 77 recent cases fatal in a 24-hour window. Strikes by health workers over pay compound access issues amid rebel conflict near borders with South Sudan, Uganda, and Rwanda. The U.S. has added $242 million in funding, reaching over $512 million in direct Ebola assistance. WHO chief Tedros urged rapid, scaled-up action and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、対応が追いついていないとWHO事務局長が発言
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ・イトゥリ州でのエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行が世界最速の拡大ペースを示し、致死率も高く、承認された治療薬・ワクチンがなく、周辺国への越境拡大リスクや国際支援の必要性が明確であるため。
triage.notes: 南スーダン、ウガンダ、ルワンダとの国境付近での紛争が対応を妨げているが、これらの国での症例発生は記載なし。米国は資金提供国であり発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Menkes ungkap temuan bakteri pada kasus keracunan MBG Papua & Semarang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister Reveals Bacterial Findings in MBG Poisoning Cases in Papua and Semarang
article.articleSummary: E. coli bacteria were detected in foods tied to Indonesia’s Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) program in Papua and Semarang, with lab results confirming multiple foods—not just watermelon—contaminated. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin stated the findings prompted recommendations to the National Nutrition Board (BGN) and a review of the Satuan Pelayanan Pemenuhan Gizi (SPPG) kitchens. The initiative aims for zero keracunan (poisoning) cases. Papua kitchen logs show food preparation began around 7–8 AM the day before serving at 11 AM; Semarang MBG kitchens started cooking at 9 PM the night before distribution. Authorities discussed potential criminal penalties for kitchens, while emphasizing presumption of innocence and possible police involvement if intent or sabotage is suspected. Going forward, BGN and the Health Ministry plan to strengthen education on food safety, nutrition content, and consumption guidelines to prevent future poisonings.

triage.headline_ja: 保健相、パプアおよびスマランのMBG食中毒事件で細菌検出を発表
triage.triage_reason: 国内の給食プログラムにおける食中毒事案であり、E.coli食品汚染は既知の食品衛生問題で国際的拡大リスクは低く、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも該当性が低い。
triage.notes: パプアニューギニアではなくインドネシアのパプア州（Indonesian Papua）とスマランでの事案であり、国は同一のインドネシア。国家学校給食プログラム（MBG）における食品衛生管理の問題であり、感染症の国際的拡大や渡航制限には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 인도서 '뇌염 유발' 바이러스 감염 어린이 22명 사망
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In India, 22 children die from an encephalitis-causing virus infection.
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus infection is spreading in India, with western Gujarat and Rajasthan affected. Of 184 suspected cases in Gujarat, 35 confirmed; 22 children under 15 have died. Rajasthan reports 3 infections. The central government dispatched support teams to curb spread. Chandipura virus, first detected in 1965 in Chandipur, Maharashtra, belongs to the rabies family. Transmission by hematophagous sandflies and ticks; illness progresses within 24-48 hours after infection. Infected children often develop seizures and coma; case fatality estimated at 56-75%; no established treatment. Outbreaks typically occur during the monsoon (June–September) in western, central, and southern India. Authorities are collecting vector samples for analysis and expanding livestock surveillance; about 70 samples from cattle, water buffalo, and goats have been collected and are under analysis. Results pending.

triage.headline_ja: インドで脳炎を引き起こすウイルス感染により子供22人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 西部インド(グジャラート州・ラジャスタン州)でチャンディプラウイルス感染が拡大し、致死率56-75%とされる中で子供22人が死亡しており、深刻性と異常性の両基準に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: Bluedotの疾患タグは『Rabies』となっているが、記事内容はチャンディプラウイルス（ラブドウイルス科、狂犬病ウイルスと同科）感染症の流行を報じている。ベクター媒介性(サシチョウバエ等)で、現時点でヒト-ヒト感染の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: 인도 '뇌염 유발' 바이러스에 어린이 22명 사망
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In India, 22 children died from an encephalitis-causing virus.
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus, an encephalitis-causing, Rhabdoviridae (rabies-related) virus, has re-emerged in India with 22 pediatric deaths. In western Gujarat, 184 suspected cases have been confirmed in 35 infections, including all 22 deaths of children under 15. In neighboring Rajasthan state, 3 additional infections have been reported. The outbreak tends to occur during the monsoon season (June–September) in western, central, and southern India and is transmitted by blood-feeding vectors such as sandflies and ticks. There is no established treatment, and the case fatality rate is reported to be 56–75%. Health authorities are collecting and analyzing multiple vector samples from affected areas to understand transmission and guide public health responses as of August 6, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: インド、『脳炎誘発』ウイルスで子ども22人死亡
triage.triage_reason: チャンディプラウイルスによる小児22人の死亡（致死率56-75%）が確認され、グジャラート州・ラジャスタン州で感染拡大中であり、IHR基準を2つ以上満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはモンスーン期（6-9月）にインド西部・中部・南部で再発する既知の疾患。サシチョウバエ・ダニ等の吸血性ベクターにより媒介され、ヒト-ヒト感染は報告されていない。治療法未確立で致死率が極めて高い（56-75%）点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: أطباء بلا حدود: فيروس إيبولا ينتشر بوتيرة مقلقة في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: The Ebola virus is spreading at an alarming rate in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing an Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak of unprecedented scale. As of August 1, 3,605 confirmed cases have been reported by the WHO, making it the largest outbreak in the country’s history, surpassing the 2018 event. About 1,500 deaths occurred within 11 weeks of the outbreak declaration, with new cases detected daily in areas not previously linked to known transmission. While testing and contact tracing have advanced, MSF warns these measures remain insufficient for containment and stresses the need for a intensified international medical response, removal of access barriers, and unimpeded delivery of patients and aid, especially in remote areas. MSF, with over 1,400 staff in eastern DRC, operates seven Ebola treatment centers and more than 15 isolation wards (over 480 beds), having treated over 1,362 patients (554 confirmed; 282 recovered). Ongoing support to the Ministry of Health includes surveillance, training, community engagement, and maintenance of essential health services.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団：エボラウイルスがコンゴで憂慮すべき速さで拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で史上最大規模のエボラ流行が発生し、死者約1,500人、新規感染が拡大地域にも波及しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: MSFが国際的な医療支援強化とアクセス障壁の除去を要請しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: 치사율 무려 74%...어린이 22명 목숨 앗아간 바이러스의 정체, 인도 발칵
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Staggering 74% fatality rate... The true identity of the virus that claimed the lives of 22 children, India in an uproar.
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus, a member of the rabies family (Rhabdoviridae), fuels an outbreak in India’s western, central, and southern regions during the monsoon (June–September). In Gujarat, 184 suspected cases have been reported, with 35 laboratory-confirmed; 22 of the confirmed cases are children under 15 who died. Rajasthan reports 3 infections. The federal government has dispatched rapid-response teams to both states to curb spread. The virus was first identified in 1965 in Chandipura village, Maharashtra, and is transmitted to humans by hematophagous sandflies and ticks. After infection, illness rapidly progresses within 24–48 hours, causing seizures and coma and potentially death. There is no established treatment; case-fatality rates are reported between 56% and 75%.

triage.headline_ja: 致死率74%…子ども22人の命を奪ったウイルスの正体、インドで衝撃
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「異常/予想外」の2基準に該当し、致死率50-75%のチャンディプラウイルスによる子どもの集団死亡例が報告されているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルス(狂犬病科)によるインド・グジャラート州(疑い184例、確定35例、うち小児22名死亡)およびラジャスタン州(3例)でのアウトブレイク。サシチョウバエ・ダニ媒介、モンスーン期に発生、治療法未確立で致死率56-75%と報告。マハラシュトラ州は1965年の発見地として言及されているのみで現在の発生地ではない可能性があるが、念のため主要発生地(グジャラート・ラジャスタン)を含むインド全体を対象とした。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تدعو لتعزيز مواجهة إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization calls for bolstering the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces its 17th Ebola outbreak, with 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths since the May 15 start. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which no licensed vaccine or approved treatment exists. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged rapid, intensified response, including reaching affected communities amid insecurity and displacement, protecting frontline health workers, accelerating patient care and follow-up, and ensuring safe, dignified burials. Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa for talks with President Félix Tshisekedi. Ituri Province has accounted for about 90% of known infections, highlighting the burden in the five eastern provinces with weak governance and health infrastructure. The pace outstrips current containment efforts, with some hotspots doubling in a week. The United States added more than $242 million in funding, bringing total U.S. support to over $500 million, and urged other donors to increase contributions.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行が拡大中（確定症例3,874人、死者1,751人）であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、WHO事務局長の訪問や米国の大規模資金投入など国際的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 米国はDRCのエボラ対応のみに関与しており発生国ではないため、United Statesはverified_locationsから除外した。イツリ州が感染の約90%を占め、治安悪化・住民避難により対応が困難化している。ワクチン・治療薬が未承認のブンディブギョウイルスによる流行である点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Сальмонеллу обнаружили в свинине приморского производителя
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Salmonella detected in pork from a Primorsky producer.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella detected in pork ham from a Primorsky Krai producer, Russia. Primorsky branch of the Federal Service for Veterinary and Phytosanitary Surveillance (Rosselkhoznadzor) found Salmonella in a ready-to-cook pork semi-finished product after a 1.3 kg sample taken during production control at the plant; the July 27 protocol confirmed microbiological non-compliance. Salmonella survives freezing and can proliferate during thawing, but is fully destroyed by proper thermal processing; its presence in finished product indicates manufacturing regime violations. Since the start of 2026, the laboratory has documented Salmonella in meat semi-finished products in 10 cases. Earlier, Salmonella was detected in a meat semi-finished product from a producer in Ussuriysk district, Primorsky Territory. The pathogen was also found in 27 tons of frozen chicken hearts imported into Primorsky Krai from China, underscoring ongoing import/export-related risks.

triage.headline_ja: 沿海地方の食肉加工業者の豚肉からサルモネラ菌検出
triage.triage_reason: ロシア沿海地方における食品検査でのサルモネラ菌検出事例であり、ヒト感染症の発生報告ではない。対象国（中国等）における実際の感染症発生も確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は食品安全検査（獣医・植物検疫監督局による製品検査）に関する内容で、ヒトの感染症症例報告ではない。中国からの輸入鶏肉についても言及があるが、中国国内での感染症発生事例ではなく輸出品の汚染検査結果であるため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Donald Trump News: Trump-Regierung plant Millionenhilfe für Kampf gegen Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Donald Trump News: Trump administration plans millions in aid to fight Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo remains the largest ever recorded in the country, with more than 3,600 lab-confirmed infections and about 1,500 deaths two and a half months after transmission began. Ebola is a highly contagious, life-threatening disease spread mainly through contact with body fluids. The U.S. government under President Donald Trump plans additional aid for the response, including $242 million for immediate actions, regional preparedness, and humanitarian relief, with discussions in Congress; total direct U.S. commitments cited at more than $512 million. An extra $350 million would support humanitarian aid in the DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda, as part of a previously announced $1.8 billion package for the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs. The move follows a period of retreat from international programs by the U.S., and funding decisions reference commitments made at the June G7 summit in Geneva.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ大統領のニュース：トランプ政権、エボラ対策に数百万ドル規模の支援を計画
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における同国史上最大規模のエボラ流行（感染確認3600例超、死者約1500人）が継続しており、米国が大規模な追加支援を計画するなど国際的関心・対応が高まっているため、フルRRAへの移行が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツ語で、主題は米国政府によるDRCエボラ流行への追加資金支援計画。スーダン・南スーダン・ウガンダへの人道支援も言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: From Hantavirus to Ebola: Rebuilding Trust in Health and Biosecurity Governance
article.articleSummary: April 2026 Andes hantavirus outbreak aboard MV Hondius: 13 cases and 3 deaths; more than 600 contacts across 32 countries and territories. Epidemiology and genomic data indicate a point-source event with limited secondary transmission, with the source under investigation and possible pre-embarkation exposures tied to travel, ecologies, and rodent habitats. Bundibugyo Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda have escalated to a regional emergency; no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists, so surveillance, clinical preparedness, community engagement, and cross-border coordination are essential. Governance challenges include transparent, timely risk communication and erosion of trust, illustrated by WHO briefings on May 7, 2026 and US trust in scientists at 36% in April 2025. The piece advocates a Planetary Health approach and ASEAN One Health coordination, integrating ACPHEED with environmental indicators, mobility data, and surveillance for early detection in Southeast Asia.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスからエボラへ：保健・バイオセキュリティ・ガバナンスにおける信頼の再構築
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのブンディブギョ・エボラ流行が地域的緊急事態に拡大しており、ワクチン・治療法が存在せず越境調整が必要とされているため、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当する。
triage.notes: 本記事はガバナンス論考だが、DRC・ウガンダでのブンディブギョ・エボラ流行が地域的緊急事態に達している実際の出来事を報告している。ハンタウイルス集団感染はMV Hondius号（クルーズ船）内で発生し、DRC/ウガンダとは無関係のため対象国に含めない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтвержденных случаев Эболы в ДР Конго почти достигло 4 тысяч
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the DR Congo has nearly reached 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surged toward 4,000 confirmed cases, with 3,874 infections and 1,751 deaths reported by the health ministry as of August 6, 2026. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo virus, and about 90% of cases are concentrated in Ituri province. Officials say 60–80% of new cases are identified outside known transmission chains, signaling accelerated spread. Ongoing conflict has disrupted healthcare access, preventing many communities from receiving medical aid. The article notes there are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo virus at present. Reuters provided the figures. The situation remains active, with rapid transmission and healthcare access challenges complicating containment in Ituri province, DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確定症例数がほぼ4000人に到達
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例3,874例・死亡1,751例と規模が大きく、既知感染連鎖外での新規症例が60-80%を占め急速な拡大を示している。ワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、紛争により医療アクセスが阻害されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoウイルス株による流行で承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在しない点、及び紛争による医療アクセス制限が拡大リスクを高めている。渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事内で言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : un bateau de transport de passagers intercepté aux portes de Kinshasa après un cas suspect (PAPIER GENERAL)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: a passenger ferry intercepted at the gates of Kinshasa after a suspected case (General article)
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies as health authorities intercept a passenger ferry about 65 km from Kinshasa after a former passenger developed Ebola-suspect symptoms and died. The vessel, from Tshopo province, was halted near Kinshasa; the deceased had fever and diarrhea after disembarking in Pimu, Mongala province. A mobile laboratory tested all on board; authorities reported no Ebola confirmation yet and no additional deaths among passengers or crew. Kinshasa has not been placed under Ebola restrictions and is not among the five affected provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uélé. As of May 15, the outbreak totals 3,973 confirmed cases, 1,801 deaths, and 776 recoveries, caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain with no approved vaccine or specific treatment. MSF warns the eastern DRC remains critical; leaders urged enhanced surveillance, community engagement, protection of health workers, and faster case detection.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ出血熱：疑い例発生後、キンシャサの入口で乗客輸送船が拘束される（総合記事）
triage.triage_reason: 進行中の大規模エボラ流行（3,973例、1,801死亡）が首都キンシャサに接近する事態であり、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: キンシャサ自体は現時点で規制対象province（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uélé）に含まれていないが、首都への接近事例として国際的拡大リスクが懸念される。エボラ確定はまだされていないため、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Menkes Tindak Lanjuti Temua Bakteri E. coli pada Kasus Keracunan MBG di Papua dan Semarang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minister of Health Follows Up on the Discovery of E. coli Bacteria in MBG Poisoning Case in Papua and Semarang
article.articleSummary: E. coli detected in poisoning cases linked to the Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) program in Papua and Semarang, Central Java. Lab results confirm E. coli in multiple foods, not only watermelon, prompting follow-up by Indonesia’s Ministry of Health. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin says the ministry has provided recommendations to the National Nutrition Agency (BGN) after reviewing lab reports and incident logs from the service units. BGN head Sudaryono warns that poisoning is fatal and emphasizes a zero-tolerance approach, noting that rapid cooking contributed to the incidents. In Papua, kitchen logs indicate a timeline from preparation to cooking, with meals prepared around 7–8 AM the previous day for service around 11 AM the next day. The article highlights ongoing investigation and swift government response, but does not specify case counts or deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 保健相、パプアとスマランの学校給食(MBG)食中毒事案における大腸菌検出への対応を指示
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア国内の学校給食プログラムにおける食中毒事案であり、政府がすでに対応中。国際的拡大リスクや渡航・貿易制限の可能性は認められず、死亡者数等の重大性も不明で優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にパプアニューギニアが含まれるが、記事本文のパプアはインドネシア領パプア州を指しており、パプアニューギニアの事案ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Menkes tindaklanjuti temuan bakteri dalam keracunan MBG di Papua dan Semarang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister Follows Up on Bacterial Findings in MBG Poisoning in Papua and Semarang.
article.articleSummary: E. coli bacteria were detected in poisoning cases linked to Indonesia's Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) program in Papua and Semarang (Central Java), prompting Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin to brief the National Nutrition Agency (BGN) and relay lab results. Lab findings indicate contamination across multiple foods, not only watermelon. Papua’s kitchen logs show cooking began the previous day around 7–8 AM to serve next day at about 11 AM; Semarang’s MBG kitchen started cooking at 9 PM the night before distribution. Authorities contemplate criminal liability and potential police involvement for suspected sabotage, while upholding the presumption of innocence. A case where a student’s meal was packed and caused illness in family members is noted. Going forward, BGN will strengthen education on food safety, nutrition content, and consumption guidelines to prevent further poisonings and will evaluate penalties and enforcement for MBG kitchen operators.

triage.headline_ja: 保健相、パプアとスマランでの給食プログラム食中毒における細菌検出を受けフォローアップ
triage.triage_reason: 国内の学校給食プログラムにおける食中毒（大腸菌汚染）事案であり、政府が対応中だが国際的拡大の懸念は低い。食品安全管理体制の不備が疑われるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: パプアニューギニアは発生地域として付与されているが、記事の主題はインドネシア（パプア州及びスマラン）の学校給食プログラムにおける食中毒事案であり、対象国リストにパプアニューギニアは含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 狂犬病暴露分三级，处置方式各不相同！女子被狗舔脚趾医生判定三级暴露
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies exposure is categorized into three levels, with different management approaches! A woman had her toes licked by a dog; the doctor deemed it a Category III exposure.
article.articleSummary: In Hangzhou, China, a park encounter ended with a stray dog licking a woman's toes. She sought care at Zhejiang Provincial People’s Hospital; examination revealed damaged skin around a toenail (paronychia). Clinicians classified the licking on broken skin as Category III rabies exposure, requiring both rabies vaccination and rabies immunoglobulin (RIG). The article outlines a three-tier exposure system, with Category III covering puncture wounds or scratches, licking of broken skin, or mucous membrane contamination—warranting wound care, passive immunization, and active vaccination. A practical assessment tip is to wipe the contact area with alcohol; pain indicates possible skin disruption. It cautions that even in the absence of a bite, any licking of broken skin or mucous membranes by cats or dogs should prompt prompt medical evaluation. The report emphasizes the importance of timely post-exposure rabies management.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病暴露は3段階に分類、対応方法もそれぞれ異なる！女性が犬に足の指を舐められ、医師がⅢ級暴露と判定
triage.triage_reason: 個別患者の暴露分類・対応手順を解説する啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病曝露後の対応に関する一般向け医療解説記事であり、単一事例に基づくもの。アウトブレイクや異常発生の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Zoonosis, Unisa Yogyakarta Dukung Larangan Perdagangan Hewan Penular Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Zoonoses, Unisa Yogyakarta Supports Ban on the Trade of Rabies-Transmitting Animals
article.articleSummary: Unisa Yogyakarta backs the DIY Regional Council’s ban on trading rabies-transmitting animals—dogs, cats, civets, monkeys, and bats—to curb zoonotic risk in the Yogyakarta Special Region. Its UPT Integrated Laboratory, with a Halal Center, now applies high-accuracy DNA testing to verify halal status and detect pig DNA in meat, enabling BPOM and MUI to require lab-backed results for halal certification. The lab can sample street foods such as bakso to test for pig or other non-halal DNA, strengthening food safety oversight. Academics urge stronger enforcement via police and local government, including raids and sanctions on urban processing sites and forest-fringe areas. The university also operates Animal House for ethically approved animal experiments, sourcing pathogen-free mice, rats, and rabbits, supporting molecular research (ELISA, DNA) for drug development and downstream translational research.

triage.headline_ja: 人獣共通感染症予防のため、ウニサ・ジョグジャカルタが狂犬病媒介動物の取引禁止を支持
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、大学による政策支持や検査体制に関する一般的な記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病媒介動物の取引禁止支持やハラール認証のためのDNA検査体制に関する内容で、具体的な狂犬病発生事例の報告ではない。地域council（DIY地方議会）の政策動向として言及されているのみで、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルとしての該当性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Bos BGN Ancam Tutup Dapur MBG Sebabkan Keracunan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BGN Boss Threatens to Shut Down MBG's Kitchen Over Poisoning
article.articleSummary: BGN chief Sudaryono vows to suspend MBG’s SPPG kitchens and open a full probe after poisoning cases, with foods tested by the Health Ministry and local health offices. For suspected MBG poisonings, zero tolerance is targeted, including possible criminal referrals if deliberate contamination is found. Outbreaks linked to MBG were reported in Papua and Semarang; in SMKN 6 Semarang hundreds of students were affected, while in Depapre District, Jayapura, dozens experienced illness. Laboratory results identified Escherichia coli in several MBG foods, not only watermelon. Investigations point to procedural lapses, especially late-night cooking times for next-day service in Papua and Semarang. Authorities will review SOP compliance and the food‑preparation chain, and may remove MBG production sites. Education efforts will be strengthened by teachers acting as program PICs to curb take-home meals. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin stated rapid investigations and shared corrective recommendations to BGN.

triage.headline_ja: BGN長官、食中毒を引き起こしたMBG厨房の閉鎖を警告
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの学校給食プログラム(MBG)においてE. coliによる集団食中毒がパプア州・スマランで発生し数百人が罹患、政府（保健省・BGN）が調査に乗り出し社会的関心も高いためフルRRAでの精査が妥当。
triage.notes: 本件は食品由来のE. coli集団食中毒であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大の可能性は低い。パプア州(Jayapura/Depapre)とスマラン(SMKN 6)の給食調理過程の衛生管理不備が原因とされる。発生地域にPapua New Guineaが含まれるが記事本文での言及はなく除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Why Congo's Record Ebola Outbreak Is Becoming Deadlier
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is intensifying, with more than 1,800 confirmed deaths. In Congo, over 70% of confirmed Ebola deaths occurred in the community rather than at treatment centers, and the case fatality among confirmed patients has risen to above 45% from 31% at the end of June. Bunia, the outbreak’s largest hotspot, sees about 90% of patients admitted to the MSF center not identified by contact tracing, showing ongoing transmission chains. Early treatment improves survival roughly three to four-fold, yet many patients arrive at care late or not at all, increasing risk to families and caregivers. The response faces conflict, weak health services, and mistrust. There is no specific antiviral for Bundibugyo; supportive care includes up to 5 liters of IV fluids daily to treat vomiting and diarrhea.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの過去最大規模のエボラ流行、なぜ致死率が上昇しているのか
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がDRC東部で記録的規模に拡大し、致死率が45%超に上昇、地域社会での感染連鎖も継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 紛争地域における弱い保健システムと不信感が対応を困難にしており、接触者追跡で捕捉できていない感染連鎖（Buniaで90%）が継続的な地域拡大リスクを示唆している。フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 치사율 최대 75% '공포'...어린이 사망자 속출 '비상'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fatality rate as high as 75% 'Fear'... Child deaths on the rise, 'Emergency'.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, Chandipura virus outbreak in western India intensifies; Gujarat reports 184 suspected cases, 35 confirmed, including 22 deaths among children under 15; Rajasthan records 3 infections. The federal government has dispatched support teams to Gujarat and Rajasthan to bolster surveillance and epidemiological investigations aimed at identifying transmission routes and vectors. Chandipura virus, first identified in Chandipura village, Maharashtra (1965), is a rhabdovirus transmitted by hematophagous vectors such as sandflies and ticks; infection can progress within 24–48 hours and causes encephalitis with seizures and coma, potentially fatal. Case fatality is reported at 56–75%, with no proven effective treatment. Outbreaks recur during the monsoon (June–September) in western, central, and southern India. In 2024, Gujarat and nearby regions saw about 70 deaths. Authorities are collecting vector samples and expanding livestock surveillance (cattle, buffalo, goats); results are pending.

triage.headline_ja: 致死率最大75%『恐怖』…子供の死者続出『非常事態』
triage.triage_reason: 西インドでChandipuraウイルスによる脳炎アウトブレイクが拡大し、致死率56-75%、子供の死亡が相次いでいるため、重症度・流行性の観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: Chandipuraウイルスは毎年モンスーン期（6-9月）にインド西部・中部・南部で再発するベクター媒介性疾患。2024年にはグジャラート州近隣で約70人が死亡しており、今回の規模拡大（グジャラート州で184疑い例、35確定例、22死亡）が例年より深刻かどうか確認が必要。国際的な人-人感染リスクは低いが、媒介動物対策・監視体制の強化状況について続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: LKC Dompet Dhuafa edukasi TBC di SMAN 4 Kupang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: LKC Dompet Dhuafa Educates About TB at SMAN 4 Kupang.
article.articleSummary: TB education event titled “Semangat Anak Muda untuk Eliminasi TBC” was held at SMAN 4 Kupang in Oesapa, Kupang City, East Nusa Tenggara, on July 15, 09:00–11:00 WITA. Organized by Layanan Kesehatan Cuma-Cuma (LKC) Dompet Dhuafa NTT as part of the Goes to School program, the session engaged 70 participants (students and teachers) with support from Puskesmas Oesapa. The program covered TB transmission, symptoms, prevention, and the importance of complete treatment, followed by an interactive discussion with a TB survivor mentored by LKC Dompet Dhuafa NTT. The survivor shared experiences from screening to cure to illustrate that TB is treatable and to combat stigma. A “Mitos atau Fakta” quiz addressed common myths. Ummi Kalsum Muhammad, head of LKC Dompet Dhuafa NTT, emphasized youth involvement to disseminate accurate TB information, encourage early testing, and ensure treatment adherence.

triage.headline_ja: LKCドンペット・ドゥアファ、クパンの第4国立高校でTBC(結核)教育を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核に関する教育啓発イベントの報告であり、アウトブレイクや症例急増等の公衆衛生事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 教育啓発活動の告知記事であり、疾患発生事例の報告ではないため対象国の発生地域としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Why Congo's Ebola outbreak is spreading faster than previous epidemics
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo is on track to surpass 4,000 cases this week, described as the fastest-spreading on record since its official May declaration. It has already become the world’s second-largest outbreak after West Africa’s 2014–16 epidemic in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, for which the World Health Organization recorded more than 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths. Contributing factors cited include delayed detection, overwhelmed surveillance, ongoing military conflict, and a lack of vaccines and treatments for the Ebola virus species involved, allowing transmission to outrun containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行はなぜ過去の流行より速く拡大しているのか
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ症例数が4000人に迫り史上最速の拡大ペースとされ、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはシエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ギニアが含まれるが、これらは2014-16年の過去の流行との比較で言及されているのみで、今回の主題はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）での流行であるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: 印度緊急派遣醫療隊，應對罕見病毒暴發
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India rushes to deploy medical teams to tackle a rare virus outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, India has urgently dispatched medical teams to Gujarat and Rajasthan to tackle an outbreak of the Kindipla virus, a rare infectious disease. A multidisciplinary team comprising epidemiologists, virologists, and veterinarians will bolster local authorities in disease research, patient treatment, and vector surveillance, while laboratories study virus samples to identify potential genetic variants. Sand flies are believed to be the primary transmission vector. Kindipla virus, first identified in India in 1965, mainly infects children under 15 and causes acute encephalitis with a high mortality rate. Outbreaks have occurred mainly in central and western India during the monsoon season. In 2024, a Gujarat outbreak led to dozens of child deaths. The current response targets enhanced surveillance, research, and clinical management to curb transmission and fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: インド、緊急に医療チームを派遣し、稀なウイルス感染症の発生に対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常・予想外」の2項目に該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当（重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ）するうえ、政府による緊急医療チーム派遣という社会的関心の高まりも確認されるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 「Kindipla virus」という名称は一般的な文献に見られず、記載内容（1965年インドで初確認、サシチョウバエ媒介、モンスーン期に中西部インドで発生、15歳未満の小児に急性脳炎を引き起こす）から、Chandipura virus（チャンディプラウイルス）である可能性が高い。ソース記事の固有名詞誤記の可能性に留意し、続報で正式病原体名を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch: USA sagen weitere 242 Millionen Dollar im Kampf gegen Ebola zu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: U.S. pledges another $242 million in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, the United States pledges an additional $242 million for immediate Ebola response, regional prevention, and humanitarian aid, bringing direct U.S. support to over $512 million for the outbreak and adding $350 million for humanitarian aid in the DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda. The funding supplements an ongoing, larger $1.8 billion UN OCHA framework and follows commitments tied to the June G7 summit at Lake Geneva, signaling continued support amid a widening emergency. In eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, the outbreak has escalated to the country’s largest Ebola surge to date, with almost 4,000 confirmed infections and more than 1,800 deaths two and a half months after the wave began.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:米国がエボラ対策にさらに2億4200万ドルの追加拠出を表明
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で同国史上最大規模のエボラ流行が発生し、感染者約4000人・死者1800人超と深刻化しており、国際的な資金支援も拡大していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部での大規模エボラ流行と、それに対する米国等の資金支援に関する内容。南スーダン・ウガンダへの人道支援言及もあるが対象国リスト外のため除外。米国・スイスは資金拠出国であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 男子随手拍死飞虫 被迫摘除眼球 小小蛾蚋竟成"移动传染源"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A man who casually swatted a flying insect is forced to have his eyeball removed; the tiny biting midge has become a 'mobile source of infection'.
article.articleSummary: A Shenzhen man swatted a tiny moth fly (drain fly) from his left eyelid, rubbed the eye, and developed seasonal conjunctivitis with vision down to 0.02, later confirmed to involve Pseudomonas aeruginosa and culminating in enucleation of the left eyeball. In another case, an eight-year-old girl suffered over a month of vomiting live moth-fly larvae, diagnosed as drain fly larval intestinal infection; exposure likely from toilet and sink splashes spreading larvae to toothbrushes and cups, leading to ingestion. Conventional oral antiparasitics failed; resolution required thorough plumbing cleaning and elimination of the moth fly source. The common white-spotted moth fly (3–4 mm) carries bacteria such as Escherichia coli, Salmonella, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa on its body; it breeds in pipes and drains, contaminating food, toiletries, and surfaces, and can cause ocular, oral, skin, and digestive infections, particularly in elderly, children, and immunocompromised individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 男性が虫を叩いて眼球摘出、小さな蛾蚋(がじょう)が「移動感染源」に
triage.triage_reason: 個別の衛生害虫（蛾蚋）による感染事例の報道であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生やヒト-ヒト感染のリスクを示すものではない。健康啓発的な内容で、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は個人の衛生害虫（蛾蚋/drain fly）による感染事例2件（眼球摘出、幼虫嘔吐）を報じたもので、アウトブレイクや集団感染ではなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。疾患名にParatyphoid/E.coli/Typhoidがタグ付けされているが、記事内容とは直接関連が薄い。

article.articleHeadline: DOH Orders Leptospirosis Fast Lanes in Public Hospitals as Heavy Rains, Flooding Hit Metro Manila and Luzon
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, the Department of Health (DOH) orders leptospirosis fast lanes in public hospitals as heavy rains from Tropical Storm Maymay and the southwest monsoon flood Metro Manila and Luzon. DOH coordinates with local government units to strengthen emergency response and sanitation in evacuation centers. The advisory warns against WILD diseases—water-borne diseases, influenza-like illnesses, leptospirosis, and dengue—and to prepare family emergency go bags. Floodwaters may be contaminated with animal urine, especially from rats, transmitting leptospirosis; avoid wading or swimming. If outdoors, wear protective gear like rubber boots and long rain gear. People with open wounds should seek immediate medical consultation after floodwater exposure. Doxycycline prophylaxis, like other preventive meds, must be doctor-prescribed and not used to justify exposure. Drink only safe or boiled water if water safety is uncertain.

triage.headline_ja: DOH、マニラ首都圏とルソン島での豪雨・洪水を受け、公立病院にレプトスピラ症ファストレーンを設置指示
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の洪水に伴うレプトスピラ症・水系感染症・インフルエンザ様疾患の拡大リスクがあり、保健省が公式に予防対応を指示しているため、WPRO基準（長期曝露・流行しやすさ）と政府関心の両方に該当する。
triage.notes: 毎年の台風・モンスーン季節に伴う恒例のレプトスピラ症対策であり、DOHによる国内の予防的公衆衛生措置。重症例数や死亡者数など具体的な被害規模の情報はなく、国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。続報で症例数・重症度を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Congo: bevestigde ebolagevallen bijna 4000 - stijging
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: confirmed Ebola cases nearly 4,000 – increase
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 3,973 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,801 deaths. The outbreak is the second-largest on record worldwide, behind the West Africa epidemic of 2014–2016. The United States government has allocated an additional 242 million dollars (about 209 million euros) for humanitarian aid to support containment, treatment, and relief efforts. The figures come from government data and reflect ongoing transmission within the country, with international funding mobilized to bolster Congo's public health response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：確認済みエボラ症例が約4,000人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（症例約4,000人、死者1,801人）で史上2番目の規模となっており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的な資金支援が動員されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 米国からの2.42億ドルの人道支援がコンゴのエボラ対応に充てられているが、米国・アンゴラは発生地域として記載されているが記事の主題国ではないため除外。史上2番目の規模の流行として継続的な国内伝播が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: US plans additional $242 million in Ebola aid for Africa
article.articleSummary: US plans an additional $242 million in Ebola aid for Africa to bolster emergency response, regional preparedness, and humanitarian assistance for the outbreak, subject to Congressional consultation. The funding would raise total direct US assistance to fight Ebola to more than $512 million and follows commitments made at the June G7 summit. Separately, the administration would provide $350 million in humanitarian aid for the Democratic Republic of Congo, South Sudan and Uganda as part of a previously announced $1.8 billion package for the UN OCHA. This comes as the administration has scaled back international aid programs since January 2025, cutting foreign assistance, reviewing programmes, and withdrawing from the WHO. Ebola is a highly infectious, often fatal viral disease spread through direct contact with infected people or their bodily fluids. The eastern DRC outbreak is described as more critical than ever about two and a half months after it began, the largest in the country’s history, with >3,600 laboratory-confirmed infections and ~1,500 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、アフリカへのエボラ支援としてさらに2億4200万ドルを計画
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で同国史上最大規模のエボラ流行が続き、3600例超・死者約1500人に達しており、米国が追加支援を計画するなど国際的関心・対応が高まっているため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部のエボラ流行を主題とし、米国の追加資金拠出（対アフリカ支援）とG7合意、UN OCHAを通じたDRC・南スーダン・ウガンダへの人道支援を報じているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: SANTÉ - Éventuelle fermeture des frontières aux pays foyers d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health - Possible border closures to Ebola-affected countries.
article.articleSummary: Madagascar is considering border closures and a 21-day quarantine for entrants from Ebola-affected countries, specifically Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo, with isolation facilities likely hotels near airports. The government also proposes banning missions to highly affected areas to prevent importation of Ebola. The Democratic Republic of Congo reports Ebola spreading at an unprecedented pace, with about 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths as of 30 July 2026 (crude fatality rate ~44%, mortality near 50% in the country). If introduced to Madagascar, transmission could be rapid due to poor hygiene and crowding, especially in public transport. Transmission occurs via contact with blood or body fluids or contaminated objects; corpses remain contagious for days after death. Madagascar has run airport simulations for suspected cases, but concerns about health-system capacity, PPE, and staffing persist.

triage.headline_ja: 保健 - エボラ発生国への国境閉鎖の可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラが前例のない速度で拡大し致死率約44%、3,605例・1,587死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、周辺国マダガスカルが国境閉鎖・検疫を検討するなど国際的拡大・渡航制限リスクが顕在化しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ流行とマダガスカル・ウガンダへの波及懸念だが、対象国リストにマダガスカル・ウガンダは含まれないためverified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола уносит жизни: в ДРК число жертв превысило 1,8 тысячи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola takes lives: in the DRC the death toll has surpassed 1,800.
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda has reached 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths. The death toll surpasses 1,800 amid ongoing transmission, with remaining patients under medical care or observation. Earlier figures reported combined deaths in DRC and Uganda at 1,657, indicating a continued rise. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, signaling high regional risk. WHO continues to monitor and assess the probability of spread beyond the outbreak zone, prioritizing rapid case finding, contact tracing, and measures to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが命を奪う：コンゴ民主共和国での死者数が1,800人を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの大規模エボラアウトブレイク（症例3,973例、死者1,801人）であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOは2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: India deploys joint outbreak response team as Chandipura virus spreads in Gujarat, Rajasthan
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus disease (CHPV) outbreak in Gujarat and Rajasthan with at least 22 child deaths reported in Gujarat. The Centre deployed a National Joint Outbreak Response Team (NJORT) on Aug 5 to bolster outbreak investigation, surveillance, clinical management, laboratory coordination, vector surveillance, and public health measures. CHPV is an RNA virus in the Vesiculovirus genus (Rhabdoviridae), transmitted primarily by sandflies; vectors can inhabit cracks in walls and mud- or sand-built dwellings. The primary affected age group is children 9 months to 14 years; symptoms start with fever, vomiting, and diarrhea, and can progress to encephalitis with seizures, altered sensorium, and delirium. Transmission is not person-to-person, and there is no approved vaccine. The virus was first identified in 1965 in Chandipura village, Maharashtra.

triage.headline_ja: インドがグジャラート州・ラジャスタン州でのチャンディプラウイルス拡大を受け合同アウトブレイク対応チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: 小児22名の死亡を伴う脳炎アウトブレイクで、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、政府が国家対応チームを派遣するなど社会的・行政的関心も高い。
triage.notes: サンドフライ媒介性でヒト-ヒト感染はないが、子供を中心に多数の死亡例が報告され、複数州（グジャラート、ラジャスタン、マハラシュトラ、ウッタルプラデシュ）に拡大している点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）因埃博拉疑似病例截停一艘船只
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo halts a vessel over suspected Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with 3,973 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths, and 776 recoveries as of August 4, affecting Ituri, North Kivu, Upper Uele, Tshopo, and South Kivu. On August 5, Kinshasa authorities halted a vessel on a river about 65 km from Kinshasa after a passenger who had disembarked in the Bimu health zone, Mongala Province, later died with suspected Ebola symptoms. The ship originated from eastern DR Congo’s Tshopo Province. Officials deployed a mobile laboratory on site and will test all passengers and crew on board; no passenger count was disclosed. The case remains suspected pending laboratory confirmation. The move follows higher-level engagements with WHO’s director-general and Africa CDC leadership; MSF warned the eastern outbreak is severe and accelerating, with no signs of slowdown.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ疑い症例で船舶を停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ確定3,973例・死亡1,801例に加え、疑い症例による船舶の緊急停止という新たな拡大リスクが発生しており、IHR基準にも複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: MSFはエボラ流行が東部で加速し減速の兆しがないと警告。WHO事務局長・Africa CDCとの高官級協議も実施されており、国際的関心が高い事案。疑い症例のため確定を待つ必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: DR Kongo - Ebola verbreitet sich in großem Tempo, schon 1.800 Todesopfer
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo - Ebola spreading rapidly, already 1,800 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of August 6, 2026. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Kinshasa for the second time since the outbreak was announced in mid-May, warned that transmission is outpacing response efforts. The Congolese health ministry reports 1,801 officially confirmed deaths and nearly 4,000 confirmed infections. The United States has provided more than $242 million in additional funding to combat the Ebola epidemic, with direct U.S. support nearly doubling, according to the State Department. The report underscores ongoing international involvement and the severe progression of the outbreak within the DR Congo, highlighting high-level statements from WHO leadership and substantial financial backing to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ - エボラが急速に拡大、既に1,800人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRコンゴで急速に拡大し、死者1,800人・感染者約4,000人に達し、WHO事務局長が現地訪問して対応が追いついていないと警告するなど、深刻性・国際的関心・支援必要性が高いためフルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 米国からの資金支援やWHO事務局長の現地訪問が報じられており、国際的な政治的関心が非常に高い。感染拡大が対応能力を上回っているとの警告があり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Gánh nặng lây nhiễm cúm mùa ở trẻ em và giá trị dự phòng của vaccine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Burden of Seasonal Influenza Infection in Children and the Preventive Value of the Vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Influenza burden and vaccine value in Vietnamese children: Seasonal influenza causes millions of cases globally, with children under 5, especially those under 2, at high risk of severe disease and hospitalization. In Vietnam, the National Children's Hospital reports late-summer 2026 activity with 60–80 lab-confirmed influenza cases per week and about a 20% admission rate, signaling potential winter outbreaks. Common symptoms include abrupt fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, myalgia, and fatigue; most recover in about a week but complications such as pneumonia, otitis media, bronchiolitis, myocarditis, encephalitis, and exacerbation of asthma or congenital heart disease occur, particularly in infants, preterms, immunocompromised, and chronic disease patients. Prevention hinges on hygiene and, most effectively, annual influenza vaccination, which reduces infection, hospitalization, and severe outcomes, and promotes community protection. Do not wait until infection to act.

triage.headline_ja: 小児の季節性インフルエンザ感染負担とワクチンの予防的価値
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な啓発・予防記事であり、異常な流行やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行パターンと予防啓発に関する記事であり、異常な感染症イベントではない。National Children's Hospitalの週60-80症例・入院率20%は季節性の一般的な範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 赣州疾控温馨提醒：8月注意防范登革热、基孔肯雅热等蚊媒传染病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ganzhou CDC warmly reminds: In August, take precautions to prevent dengue fever, chikungunya fever, and other mosquito-borne infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: August in Ganzhou, Jiangxi, brings heat, humidity, and rainfall, boosting mosquito activity. The Ganzhou CDC warns of dengue fever and chikungunya fever, both spread by Aedes mosquitoes, with fever and rash. Respiratory illnesses—influenza and SARS-CoV-2 infection—are elevated, especially among the elderly and the chronically ill; symptoms include fever, cough, and sore throat. Travellers returning from Southeast Asia should perform 14-day self-monitoring and inform clinicians of travel history. Prevention: masks in crowded indoor spaces, handwashing, ventilation, and early medical care for symptoms. Enteric diseases rise with heat; mushroom poisoning is noted. Ensure safe drinking water, wash produce, fully cook meat/eggs/seafood, keep raw and cooked foods separate, and maintain kitchen hygiene. Seek care for diarrhea or jaundice. Rabies risk increases with dog/cat bites; vaccinate pets, leash animals, avoid stray wildlife. If exposed, wash wounds with soap and water for 15 minutes, disinfect, and seek vaccination within 24 hours, with immunoglobulin as indicated.

triage.headline_ja: 贛州疾病予防管理センターからの注意喚起：8月はデング熱、チクングニア熱等の蚊媒介感染症に注意
triage.triage_reason: これは季節性の一般的な健康注意喚起（公衆衛生啓発）記事であり、具体的な発生や症例数の報告がなく、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性の予防啓発情報であり、具体的な発生事例や感染者数の報告を含まないため、対象国リストにおける実発生の確認はできない。

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू और वायरल बुखार में क्या अंतर है? डॉक्टर ने कहा ये 3 लक्षण देते हैं Dengue का संकेत, कभी ना करें इग्नोर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is the difference between Dengue and viral fever? The doctor said these 3 symptoms indicate Dengue; never ignore them.
article.articleSummary: On 6 August 2026, this Hindi article explains how dengue fever and viral fever differ during the monsoon season. Dengue is marked by a sudden high fever that comes and goes and typically lasts 2–3 days. Three warning signs should not be ignored: fever with joint pain, pain behind the eyes, and a rash that can appear on the hands, feet, face, and other skin areas. Dengue often causes muscle and joint pains described as breakbone fever, plus headache and eye pain. Abdominal pain and vomiting may occur with dengue. If fever persists beyond two days, testing is advised to obtain laboratory confirmation and distinguish dengue from a simple viral fever. The guidance is attributed to Dr. Tarang Jain Arora.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱とウイルス性発熱の違いは？医師が語る、見逃してはいけない3つの症状
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、デング熱とウイルス性発熱の症状の違いを説明する一般的な健康啓発記事であるため。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な感染事例や流行状況を報告するものではなく、季節性の症状鑑別に関する一般的な医療情報記事である。特定の発生地域データは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO calls for more aid as DRC Ebola cases surpass 3,700
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak intensifies as of 6 August 2026: 3,748 confirmed cases and 1,657 deaths; 708 recovered, 227 suspected, with nearly 17,000 contacts under monitoring. WHO spokesperson Tarik Jašarević says the outbreak is expanding faster than response capacity, callers for more resources to bolster surveillance, testing, treatment, and community support. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns infections are doubling within a week in some hotspots and urges stronger response measures with enhanced protection for healthcare workers. Continued population movements heighten cross-border spread risk, underscoring the need for improved surveillance and preparedness. In related developments, Moderna has launched a Phase 1 trial of its experimental mRNA-1469 vaccine targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV), one of Ebola’s causative viruses. The situation underscores ongoing outbreak management in the DRC and the importance of international assistance.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCのエボラ症例数が3,700人を超え支援拡大を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が急拡大し致死率も高く、WHOが国際支援を要請していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たし、社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOが症例倍加速度や医療従事者保護強化を強調しており、国境を越えた人口移動によるリスクも指摘されている。Moderna社のBDBVワクチン治験開始は関連情報として付記。

article.articleHeadline: QDENGA approval hailed by doctors amid seasonal dengue spike in Karnataka
article.articleSummary: India’s first dengue vaccine, QDENGA by Takeda, has been approved by the Drugs Controller General of India for individuals aged 4–60 years and is designed to protect against all four dengue serotypes without prior dengue screening. In Karnataka’s monsoon-driven dengue spike, doctors welcome the approval but note it is unlikely to be available during the current season in Karnataka. The two-dose regimen is administered three months apart. Clinical data show about an 80% reduction in symptomatic dengue and roughly a 90% reduction in hospitalisations during the first year after vaccination; protection against hospitalisation remains high at about 85% for up to four-and-a-half to five years. Dengue can be caused by four serotypes; many infections are asymptomatic, but severe dengue can cause bleeding, fluid buildup, internal haemorrhage, and death, making vaccination a significant preventive step in states like Karnataka.

triage.headline_ja: カルナタカ州で季節性デング熱が急増する中、QDENGAの承認を医師らが歓迎
triage.triage_reason: インドのカルナタカ州で季節性デング熱の流行が報告されているが、通常の季節的増加であり異常性や国際的拡大の兆候は明確でないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性デング熱の流行状況とワクチン承認に関するもので、危機的な公衆衛生イベントとしての性質は薄い。

article.articleHeadline: Nästan 4 000 fall av ebola i Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 4,000 Ebola cases in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa region) continues to rise. By 6 August 2026, 3,874 laboratory-confirmed cases have been reported, with at least 1,751 deaths; the number of confirmed cases is nearing 4,000. The outbreak began in May and is linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment available. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls for broader, intensified response efforts as transmission accelerates; he notes new cases have doubled in some transmission zones over the past week. The article does not provide details on imported or exported cases. Urgent expansion of public health measures is deemed necessary to curb spread in affected districts and to protect healthcare workers and communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱がほぼ4,000例に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（約4,000例、致死率高）が拡大中で、ワクチン・特異的治療法がない変異株によるもの。WHO事務局長も対応強化を呼びかけており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く（約45%）、ワクチン・治療法未確立のBundibugyo型エボラ株による大規模流行。WHOが国際的な対応拡大を要請しており、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Nästan 4 000 fall av ebola i Kongo-Kinshasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Almost 4,000 cases of Ebola in Kongo-Kinshasa.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Kongo-Kinshasa region of the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused at least 1,751 deaths among 3,874 laboratory-confirmed cases. The outbreak began in May and has been linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which no vaccine or specific treatment is currently available. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns the response is lagging behind the spread, calling for broader, more comprehensive actions. He notes that the outbreak is spreading faster than the response can scale up, with new cases doubling in some transmission areas in the past week. The situation underscores the urgent need for intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and accelerated deployment of resources and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国(キンシャサ)でエボラ出血熱がほぼ4,000症例に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が大規模流行し、WHO事務局長が対応の遅れを警告するなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないBundibugyoエボラウイルス株による流行で、致死率が高く(約45%)、感染拡大速度が対応能力を上回っているとWHOが警告している。

locations.name: Independent State of Papua New Guinea

article.articleHeadline: Menkes: Ada Bakteri E Coli di Kasus Keracunan MBG Semarang dan Jayapura
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minister of Health: There are E. coli bacteria in MBG poisoning cases in Semarang and Jayapura.
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli detected in poisoning cases linked to the Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) program in Semarang, Central Java, and Jayapura, Papua. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin announced after lab results confirmed E. coli in the foods served, not limited to watermelon, at a Jakarta press conference on August 5, 2026. The ministry has alerted the National Nutrition Agency (Badan Gizi Nasional, BGN) and is pursuing corrective actions. BGN head Sudaryono said the Jayapura cases mirror the Semarang incident, with rushed cooking schedules contributing to contamination risk: kitchen logs show prep starting around 7:00–7:30 a.m. the previous day for delivery at 11:00 a.m. the next day. Sudaryono warned that if sabotage or other wrongdoing is found, investigations will be launched with police involvement, and culprits will not be shielded.

triage.headline_ja: 保健相：スマランおよびジャヤプラのMBG食中毒事件で大腸菌（E.コリ）を検出
triage.triage_reason: 国家栄養プログラム（MBG）に関連した食中毒事件で大腸菌汚染が確認され、保健省が公式記者会見を行うなど社会的・行政的関心が高く、汚染原因（調理スケジュールの逼迫）が継続している可能性がある。
triage.notes: 本事案はインドネシア国内の学校給食プログラム（MBG）における食中毒事案であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際拡大のリスクは低いが、複数都市（スマラン・ジャヤプラ）で類似事例が発生しており、調理工程の管理体制不備が継続的リスクとなっている。パプアニューギニアは地理データの誤付与と判断し対象から除外。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）因埃博拉疑似病例截停一艘船只
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo halts a ship due to a suspected Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo halts a ship about 65 km from Kinshasa after a passenger who disembarked in Mongala Province’s Bimu Health Zone developed suspected Ebola symptoms and died. The deceased sought care locally, then died; authorities traced the vessel and stopped it as a precaution. A mobile laboratory was deployed on site to test all passengers and crew; vessel passenger count not disclosed. The ship originated from eastern DRC’s Tshopo Province. A barrier was established around the vessel. As of Aug 4, the DRC reported 3,973 confirmed Ebola cases, 1,801 deaths, and 776 recoveries, across Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo and South Kivu provinces. President Tshisekedi met WHO Director‑General Tedros and Africa CDC Director, calling for strengthened community mobilization, protection of health workers, and epidemiological surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ疑い症例により船舶を停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の進行中の大規模流行（累計3,973症例、1,801死亡）に加え、船舶での疑い症例発生により隔離措置が取られており、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限の両方が該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにTibet Autonomous Region（中国）が含まれているが、記事本文はDRCのエボラ流行と船舶停止に関するものであり、中国は記事配信元に過ぎないため除外した。Bimuの座標情報がチベット地域と誤って紐づけられている可能性がある（データ不整合）。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura virus outbreak, currently no specific antiviral treatment or vaccine
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus disease (CHPV) outbreak in Gujarat and Rajasthan, India, with at least 22 child deaths in Gujarat this monsoon season. Gujarat reports 35 laboratory-confirmed CHPV infections among 184 suspected acute encephalitis syndrome cases, all in children under 15; 7 remain under treatment, and 11 samples are pending. Rajasthan confirms three CHPV cases from border districts Dungarpur and Sirohi, with at least one associated death. On August 5, the Union Ministry dispatched a National Joint Outbreak Response Team (NJORT) to bolster investigation, epidemiological assessment, clinical management, lab coordination, vector surveillance and public health measures. The NCDC Public Health Emergency Operations Centre is activated; routine Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme (IDSP) surveillance continues. CHPV is an emerging arbovirus transmitted chiefly by sandflies; there is no antiviral or vaccine, making early recognition and intensive supportive care critical. NJORT will report findings and recommendations to the Union Health Ministry.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルス感染症の集団発生、現時点で特効的な抗ウイルス薬・ワクチンなし
triage.triage_reason: インドのグジャラート州・ラジャスタン州でチャンディプラウイルス感染症の集団発生が確認され、子どもを中心に22人以上が死亡。ワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、国家レベルの緊急対応チームが派遣されるなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められIHR基準2項目以上に該当する。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介の急性脳炎症候群を引き起こす新興アルボウイルス。ヒト-ヒト感染の明確な証拠はないが、媒介生物対策の不備が流行拡大リスクとなる。国家合同アウトブレイク対応チーム(NJORT)が派遣され、国レベルでの重大事案として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: ‏ ارتفاع حصيلة إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 3973 إصابة و1801 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 3,973 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,801 deaths from Bundibugyo virus Ebola. The daily epidemiological bulletin notes ongoing surveillance, contact tracing, and the strengthening of diagnostic and treatment services in affected areas to curb transmission and bring the outbreak under control. Health authorities emphasize continued monitoring and coordinated responses in hotspots as the country fights the seventh Ebola outbreak. The outbreak was declared on 15 May after confirmation of Bundibugyo virus, with the World Health Organization declaring it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May. Efforts focus on surveillance, case identification, and expanding diagnostic and treatment capacity to reduce fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が3,973例、死者数が1,801人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ流行であり、致死率も高く公衆衛生上深刻な影響があるため、フルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: WHOにより2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。第7次エボラ流行として継続中で、死亡者数・症例数が高水準。

article.articleHeadline: Kampf gegen Ebola: USA stellen Millionenhilfe in Aussicht
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fight Against Ebola: US to Provide Millions in Aid
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues as the largest on record in the country, with over 3,600 laboratory-confirmed infections and about 1,500 deaths, two and a half months after transmission began in the east. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids. WHO chief Tedros Ghebreyesus, visiting Kinshasa, urged a massive intensification of frontline support, training, and protection for responders as the outbreak spreads at an extraordinary pace. The United States proposes an additional 242 million USD for immediate actions, regional preparedness, and humanitarian aid, lifting direct US funding for the outbreak to over 512 million USD. An extra 350 million USD is planned for humanitarian relief in the DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda, as part of a broader 1.8 billion USD package for UN OCHA. The new assistance follows commitments from the June G7 summit at Lake Geneva, despite longstanding Trump-era reductions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとの闘い：米国が数百万ドル規模の支援を検討
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での過去最大規模のエボラ流行（感染確定3,600例超、死亡約1,500例）で、異常な速さで拡大しており、国際的な資金・人道支援が動員されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: スイス（ジュネーブ）、米国、南スーダン、ウガンダは資金拠出・地域準備の文脈で言及されているが、感染の主発生国はコンゴ民主共和国のみと判断。南スーダン・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Τα "καλοκαιρινά" της έβαλε (και) φέτος η γρίπη
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The flu has hit her again this year with its "summer" symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Influenza (flu) remains active into summer in Greece, with rising cases among teenagers and young adults on holiday. Health centers on popular islands have prescribed hundreds of antivirals recently. Transmission is linked to crowding in beach bars, clubs, ships, and narrow streets, reflecting travel-driven mixing. Southern Hemisphere data show Australia and New Zealand with the strongest activity, with Brazil and Chile also increasing and co-circulation of influenza A and B. Travelers from these regions could import the virus to the Northern Hemisphere. Epidemiologists monitor the South to guide surveillance and the selection of strains for Europe’s next winter vaccines. In Greece, community positivity was under 10% by early July; there have been sporadic new admissions but no ICU cases. Symptoms range from mild to severe: fever, chest pain, cough (productive or dry), runny nose, myalgias, sore throat, hoarseness. Seek care if fever persists or breathing difficulty occurs.

triage.headline_ja: 今年もインフルエンザが「夏型」の症状を見せている
triage.triage_reason: ギリシャにおける季節性インフルエンザの夏季流行に関する記事で、重症例やICU入院もなく、対象国での主要な発生事例でもないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はギリシャの季節性インフルエンザであり、ブラジル・チリ等は南半球サーベイランスの比較データとして言及されているのみで、対象国での主要な発生事例ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。
