article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Temukan Bakteri di Kasus Keracunan MBG Papua dan Semarang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Finds Bacteria in MBG Poisoning Cases in Papua and Semarang
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli detected in food samples from the Free Nutritious Meal (MBG) program poisoning cases in Papua and Semarang, Central Java. Laboratory results confirming E. coli were submitted to the National Nutrition Agency (BGN) as technical input. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin said rapid deployment collected samples and found E. coli in several foods, not only watermelon. BGN Chief Sudaryono emphasized the poisoning is a fatal safety issue and aims for zero cases; a governance overhaul of MBG kitchen operations is underway. In Papua, kitchen logs show cooking started around 7:00–7:30 AM the previous day for service at 11:00 AM; in Semarang, cooking began at 21:00 the night before distribution. Authorities will consider legal action if intent or sabotage is found, while upholding presumption of innocence. BGN will strengthen public education on food safety, nutrition, and shelf life for beneficiaries.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、パパイアと三muran(スマラン)のMBG食中毒事例で細菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: 国内の給食プログラムにおける食品由来のE.coli中毒事例であり、人-人感染や国際的拡大のリスクは認められず、渡航・貿易制限の懸念もないため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にパプアニューギニアが含まれるが、記事の主題はインドネシア国内（パプア州及びスマラン）でのMBG給食プログラムに関連する食中毒事例であり、パプアニューギニア（対象国外）は該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Dodental door ebola in Congo gestegen tot boven 1800
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from Ebola in Congo rises above 1,800.
article.articleSummary: On 6 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports Ebola deaths exceeding 1,800 and 3,973 confirmed cases, with a sharp ongoing rise: two weeks earlier under 1,000 deaths and under 2,500 cases. This outbreak becomes the second-largest Ebola epidemic on record, surpassed only by the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone), which WHO tallied at about 11,000 deaths and 28,000 cases. The current outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which, unlike the more common Zaïre (Zaire) strain, there is no vaccine or treatment available for it. Public health authorities are monitoring the escalation and the lack of available therapeutics.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラによる死者数が1,800人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の死者数・症例数が急増し、史上2番目の規模となっており、有効なワクチン・治療法が存在しないため公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にリベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネが含まれるが、これらは2014-2016年の過去の流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現在の流行の発生地ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 印度22名儿童感染金迪普拉病毒死亡|光华网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 22 Indian children die after contracting Jindipula virus.
article.articleSummary: Jindipula virus outbreak in Gujarat, western India, with 184 suspected cases and 35 laboratory-confirmed infections as of August 3; 22 deaths and 7 critical among patients all under 15 years old. India’s Ministry of Health and Family Welfare has deployed a National Joint Epidemic Response Team to Gujarat for epidemiologic assessment, investigation, and clinical management. The National Centre for Disease Control notes that Jindipula virus, a member of the Rhabdoviridae family, periodically causes outbreaks in western and central India, especially during the monsoon. Transmission is via sandfly bites. Symptoms include high fever, severe headache, nausea, and fatigue; severe cases can spread to the brain, causing vomiting, seizures, and loss of consciousness. Without timely treatment, illness can progress to coma or death within 48–72 hours. There is currently no approved antiviral drug or vaccine for Jindipula virus.

triage.headline_ja: インド・グジャラート州で子ども22人がチャンディプラウイルス（金迪普拉病毒）感染により死亡
triage.triage_reason: 15歳未満の子どもを中心に35例が検査確定、22人死亡という高い致死率を示しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められるためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: 『金迪普拉病毒』はチャンディプラウイルス（Chandipura virus）の中国語表記と推測される。サシチョウバエ媒介性で季節性（モンスーン期）に西部・中部インドで周期的に発生することがNCDCにより指摘されており、既知の疫学パターンではあるが今回の致死率・症例数は注視が必要。ヒト-ヒト感染は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: إدارة ترامب تعتزم تخصيص 242 مليون دولار إضافية لمكافحة إيبولا بأفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump administration to allocate an additional $242 million to combat Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: U.S. State Department announces an additional $242 million to combat Ebola outbreaks in Africa, with funding pending Congressional consultation to support emergency response, regional preparedness, and humanitarian aid tied to the outbreak. The move follows ongoing U.S. reductions in international aid since January 2025 and a withdrawal from the WHO. The new funds rise from commitments made at the June G7 summit, bringing direct U.S. Ebola assistance to over $512 million. Of the package, $350 million will provide humanitarian aid to the Democratic Republic of Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda, as part of a broader $1.8 billion package for UN OCHA that will benefit multiple countries. Ebola is a highly contagious viral disease, often deadly, transmitted through direct contact with patients or their body fluids.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ政権、アフリカでのエボラ対策に2億4200万ドルの追加資金拠出を表明
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行への米国資金拠出に関する政治・財政ニュースであり、DRC等における具体的な症例数や流行状況の新規情報は記載されていないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は資金拠出に関する政治・外交ニュースが主体であり、DRCにおける現行エボラ流行の具体的な症例状況（規模、致死率、地域拡大等）の記述はない。南スーダン・ウガンダも言及されるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。既知の継続流行への支援表明であり新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低いが、エボラの重大性から経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dans l'est de la RDC, où sévit l'épidémie d'Ebola, la baisse des aides internationales fragilise la prise en charge des plus démunis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In eastern DRC, where the Ebola outbreak is raging, the decline in international aid jeopardizes the care of the most vulnerable.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is raging in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with Mongbwalu designated the outbreak's epicenter after it was officially declared in mid-May. Action Against Hunger (ACF) facilities in Mongbwalu show cartons piled in the courtyard, signaling supply and logistical pressures during the response. The local response capacity appears limited, with about twenty beds at the ACF site. A sharp decline in international aid threatens care for the most vulnerable, risking gaps in treatment and basic services in the affected communities as of 6 August 2026. The report underscores the human cost and logistical strain at local humanitarian facilities amid shrinking funding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱が猛威を振るう中、国際援助の減少が最貧困層への対応を脆弱化させている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクがDRC東部で継続中であり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月中旬に公式宣言されたエボラアウトブレイクの継続状況と、国際援助減少による人道支援体制の脆弱化を報じている。既存の公衆衛生上重大なイベントであり、資金不足によるケア提供の停滞が懸念される。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A

article.articleHeadline: Гонконгский и свиной грипп в России: когда начнется эпидемия и как защититься
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong Flu and Swine Flu in Russia: When Will the Epidemic Begin and How to Protect Yourself
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong flu and Swine flu in Russia raise questions about when an epidemic will begin and how to protect against influenza A and B. No exact case counts exist; estimates rely on historical data. Past data suggest children not yet exposed to a given strain form a susceptible niche, raising outbreak potential. Swine flu and Hong Kong flu differ little in clinical course; both are influenza A and B, with similar progression. In unexposed children, infection can be more severe: incubation about five to six days, with noticeable symptoms around days six to seven. The virus can evade early immune detection, delaying the adaptive response and causing greater damage to the respiratory tract and vascular system, especially if vaccination is not implemented. Public health measures and vaccination remain key protections.

triage.headline_ja: 香港型インフルエンザと豚インフルエンザ、ロシアで流行の懸念:いつ始まりどう身を守るか
triage.triage_reason: ロシアにおける季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な健康情報記事であり、具体的な症例数や異常な事象の報告はなく、対象国（中国等）での実際の発生も確認できない。
triage.notes: 発生地域に香港・中国が含まれるが、記事の主題はロシアにおける季節性インフルエンザの一般的解説であり、香港・中国での具体的な発生事例を示すものではないため、対象国としては該当なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Menos picaduras, menos contagios: la revolución científica contra el dengue ya está en marcha - HSB NOTICIAS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fewer mosquito bites, fewer transmissions: the scientific revolution against dengue is already underway - HSB News
article.articleSummary: Dengue control is increasingly driven by biotechnological strategies targeting the Aedes aegypti mosquito. The approach uses controlled releases of modified males to render offspring inviable or block virus transmission, notably via Wolbachia infection or the sterile insect technique (SIT), with some programs combining IIT-SIT. In Indonesia, Wolbachia releases reduced dengue cases by about 77% in treated areas. Singapore trials showed reductions in vector populations and transmission risk, and several field studies report >50% declines in dengue incidence with sustained efforts. Large-scale implementations include Brazil’s biofactory producing millions of mosquitoes weekly for release in high-risk zones, and Latin American programs that have protected millions and achieved ongoing case reductions. Advantages include avoidance of chemical pesticides, environmental sustainability, and reduced insecticide resistance, since males do not bite. Challenges include high upfront costs, community acceptance, local climate and density effects, and the need for long-term evidence; these strategies should complement traditional control.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊刺されの減少、感染の減少:デング熱対策の科学革命が進行中 - HSB NOTICIAS
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱の生物学的防除技術（ウォルバキア法・不妊虫放飼法）に関する科学的・技術的解説であり、新規の異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症の発生報告ではなく、デング熱対策技術（ウォルバキア法・SIT/IIT）の紹介記事。シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Unpaid wages and deadly risk: Why health workers are threatening to abandon the Ebola response
article.articleSummary: In eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Bunia (Ituri province), the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak is the largest on record, with at least 3,874 infections and 1,751 deaths reported by the Congolese health ministry as of Aug 6, 2026. Detected in both DRC and neighboring Uganda, Uganda has declared itself Ebola-free, while transmission continues in eastern Congo. The outbreak, which began mid-May, has concentrated mainly in Ituri, where more than 90% of confirmed cases are recorded; it is characterized by limited vaccines and treatments for Bundibugyo, and ongoing conflict impedes access. Attacks on facilities and community mistrust have worsened response; at least a dozen facilities have been attacked. Health workers say wages are unpaid; nurse Micheline Kayimpa at Elikya Ebola Treatment Center in Bunia has not received government pay since June, despite MSF bonuses.

triage.headline_ja: 未払い賃金と死のリスク:エボラ対応から医療従事者が撤退を検討する理由
triage.triage_reason: 史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが継続中で、感染者数・死者数が甚大かつ医療従事者の離脱リスクにより対応が悪化している。IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事内でエボラ終息を宣言済みのため verified_locations には含めていない。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Više od 3600 zaraženih ebolom u Kongu. Trump šalje novu pomoć
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 3,600 people infected with Ebola in Congo. Trump sends new aid.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak—the largest in the country’s history—has more than 3,600 laboratory-confirmed cases and about 1,500 deaths, with transmission ongoing for nearly two and a half months (per MSF). Ebola is highly contagious, spreading through direct contact with infected individuals or their bodily fluids. In response, the U.S. administration plans to earmark an additional $242 million to fight Ebola in Africa, awaiting Congressional approval, for urgent outbreak containment, regional preparedness, and humanitarian aid. This supplements total direct U.S. Ebola-related assistance to exceed $512 million, built on commitments from the June G7 summit. Separately, $350 million in humanitarian aid will go to the DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda as part of an earlier $1.8 billion UN OCHA package.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで3,600人以上がエボラに感染。トランプ氏が新たな支援を送る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続し、致死率も高く国際的な人道支援が動員されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国が主体。米国・ウガンダ・南スーダンへの言及は支援国・近隣国としての記載であり、発生国はDRCのみと判断。ウガンダ・スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Cuáles son los síntomas del cólera?; la enfermedad que aún representa un riesgo para millones de personas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What are the symptoms of cholera, the disease that still poses a risk to millions of people?
article.articleSummary: Cholera, a persistent global threat, originated in India with a 1817 pandemic and reached Veracruz, Mexico, in 1833. The article notes one of the worst outbreaks occurred in Iztapalapa, Mexico City. Today, cholera remains a public health risk in regions with limited potable water and sanitation. The CDC estimates 1.3–4 million cases and 21,000–143,000 deaths annually worldwide. Symptoms include acute watery diarrhea, vomiting, and muscle cramps, which can rapidly cause severe dehydration without treatment. Immediate rehydration with electrolyte-rich fluids is the cornerstone of therapy, with antibiotics reserved for specific cases. In Mexico, Vida Suero Oral has long been used since the 1980s to prevent diarrheal complications and dehydration. Prevention hinges on drinking safe water, good hand hygiene, proper food washing and disinfection, and avoiding contaminated products. Imported/exported cases are not detailed in this article.

triage.headline_ja: コレラの症状とは？依然として何百万人もの人々にとってリスクとなっている疾患
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はコレラの歴史・症状・予防法に関する一般解説であり、現在進行中の具体的な発生事例を報告するものではないため、シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は1817年のインドでの発生や1833年のメキシコ・ベラクルスでの歴史的流行に言及しているが、いずれも過去の歴史的事例であり、現在の発生を示すものではない。現行の対象国における新規発生報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Unpaid wages and deadly risk: Why health workers are threatening to abandon the Ebola response
article.articleSummary: On Aug 6, 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 3,874 infections and 1,751 deaths since mid-May, per the Congolese health ministry, making it the largest outbreak ever reported in the DRC. The epicenter is Bunia, Ituri province, where MSF runs a 90-bed Elikya Ebola Treatment Center; staffing is stretched, with two to three nurses caring for patients with more than 10 conditions. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no proven vaccines and limited treatments. The flare-up was detected in both DRC and Uganda—Uganda has declared Ebola-free, but transmission continues in eastern Congo. Mistrust, misinformation, and resistance to burial restrictions fuel hostility toward responders, and health workers have protested delayed wages; Kayimpa has not been paid since June, underscoring morale and security risks as violence persists and facilities are attacked.

triage.headline_ja: 未払い賃金と命の危険:保健医療従事者がエボラ対応放棄を警告する理由
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で過去最大規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク(感染3,874例、死亡1,751例)が継続中で、ワクチンのないブンディブギョ株による人道的・国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの発生も報告されているが、記事時点でウガンダはエボラ終息宣言済みであり、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。主な発生地はDRC東部イトゥリ州ブニアである。

article.articleHeadline: Centre deploys national team as Chandipura outbreak probe intensifies
article.articleSummary: 35 laboratory-confirmed Chandipura virus infections and 22 deaths among 184 suspected cases in children under 15 across Gujarat this monsoon, with Rajasthan also reporting pediatric cases, prompting deployment of a National Joint Outbreak Response Team (NJORT) to bolster investigations and containment. Chandipura, a sandfly-borne virus, can rapidly progress from fever to acute encephalitis syndrome (AES); researchers are examining whether mosquitoes, ticks or mites act as co-vectors. First identified in Chandipura village, Maharashtra (1965), the virus has caused AES outbreaks in Gujarat and Andhra Pradesh during the monsoon. The NJORT comprising NCDC, ICMR, DAHD supports outbreak investigation, epidemiology, lab coordination, clinical management, and vector surveillance; NCDC’s Public Health Emergency Operations Centre is activated. Cross-border cases from Rajasthan led to its inclusion. Intensive studies by ICMR institutes, ICAR, and GBRC analyze transmission, clinical spectrum, evolution, and reservoirs, with AFI/AES surveillance, serosurveys, vector and animal sampling, and whole-genome sequencing to guide interventions.

triage.headline_ja: 中央政府、チャンディプラウイルス感染症の発生調査強化のため国家チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: 小児を中心に35例の検査確定例と22例の死亡（疑い184例中）が報告され、国家合同アウトブレイク対応チーム（NJORT）が派遣されるなど、深刻性と異常性が認められるためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 発生地域はGujarat、Rajasthan、Maharashtra、Andhra Pradeshなどインド国内の複数州にまたがるが、すべてインド国内のためverified_locationsはIndiaのみとした。サシチョウバエ媒介ウイルスで、蚊やダニ等が共媒介者となる可能性も調査中であり、ベクター媒介感染症としての拡大リスクにも注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Глава ВОЗ предупредил об ускорении распространения Эболы в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO chief warned of the accelerating spread of Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, the WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned of accelerating spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Specialists are intensifying response measures to prevent further transmission. WHO is coordinating with local authorities and international partners to localize the outbreak. The organization calls for rapid identification of new cases and expanded epidemiological surveillance and contact tracing to curb spread. No case or death counts are reported in the article. The focus remains on prompt case finding, strengthened surveillance, and collaborative public health action to contain the outbreak within affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴでのエボラ拡大加速を警告
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長自らがエボラ拡大加速を警告しており、公衆衛生上の深刻性・国際的拡大リスクの観点からIHR基準に複数該当する可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 症例数・死亡数の具体的な報告はなく詳細情報が不足しているが、WHOトップの警告という重大性から高優先度でフルRRAへ進めるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Trump odobrava još 242 milijuna dolara za obuzdavanje ebole u Africi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump approves another $242 million to contain Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: U.S. to allocate an additional $242 million for Ebola containment in Africa, pending Congress approval, to rapidly curb the outbreak, bolster regional preparedness, and provide humanitarian aid. The funds follow June G7 commitments, lifting direct U.S. Ebola assistance to over $512 million. An extra $350 million in humanitarian aid will go to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda as part of an $1.8 billion UN OCHA package for multiple countries. Ebola is a highly contagious virus transmitted through direct contact with infected individuals or their bodily fluids and is often fatal. MSF warns the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak, ongoing for about two and a half months, is the largest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history, with more than 3,600 lab-confirmed cases and roughly 1,500 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ、アフリカでのエボラ抑制に追加で2億4200万ドルを承認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で史上最大規模のエボラ流行(確定例3,600以上、死者約1,500人)が継続中であり、米国・G7・国連が大規模資金拠出を行うなど国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の資金拠出に関する内容だが、主題であるエボラ流行そのものはDRC東部で発生。南スーダン・ウガンダも人道支援対象国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国は資金拠出国であり発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: From 31% to 45% cases: Why is Congo's Ebola outbreak getting deadlier?
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has surpassed 3,800 confirmed cases and 1,800 deaths, with the case-fatality rate rising from 31% at the end of June to about 45%, and projections that cases could exceed 4,000 this week. Bunia hosts the epidemic's largest treatment centre, where roughly 90% of patients arrived without being flagged by contact tracing, signaling that transmission continues to slip past containment. More than 70% of confirmed Ebola deaths have occurred outside treatment facilities. Early treatment can improve survival three- to four-fold, but no approved Bundibugyo-specific therapy exists; care relies on supportive measures, including up to 5 litres of daily IV fluids and electrolyte correction. The surge is linked to conflict, a collapsing health system, and poverty that fuel distrust and delayed care, allowing the virus to spread before treatment is sought.

triage.headline_ja: 31%から45%へ：コンゴのエボラ流行はなぜ致死率が上昇しているのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な致死率上昇）に該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国東部のBundibugyoエボラウイルス流行で症例数3,800件超、死亡者1,800人超、致死率が31%から45%へ上昇。接触者追跡から漏れる症例が9割に上り、感染連鎖の把握が困難な状況。紛争・医療体制崩壊・貧困が要因とされ、外部支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 乘客疑染埃博拉亡　刚果（金）截停一艘船
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Passenger dies after suspected Ebola infection; DR Congo intercepts a ship.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports a suspected Ebola case linked to a ship intercepted about 65 km from Kinshasa after a passenger, who had disembarked in Mongala Province’s Bimu Health Zone, developed Ebola-like symptoms and died. The vessel, which departed from eastern DR Congo’s Tshopo Province, is under a security cordon while mobile laboratories test all passengers and crew; the deceased’s infection status is unconfirmed. As of Aug 5, 2026, DR Congo had 3,973 confirmed Ebola cases, 1,801 deaths, and 776 recoveries, with outbreaks across Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, and South Kivu. President Tshisekedi met with WHO Director-General Tedros and Africa CDC Director in Kinshasa to reinforce community engagement, health worker protection, and epidemiological surveillance. MSF warns the eastern outbreak remains at an “unprecedented” and rapidly expanding pace, with no signs of slowing.

triage.headline_ja: 感染疑いの乗客死亡、コンゴ民主共和国（金）が船舶を拿捕――エボラ出血熱
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認エボラ症例3,973件・死亡1,801件に達する大規模流行が継続中で、キンシャサ近郊での船舶関連の疑い例発生や国際機関トップの現地訪問など、公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクが複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: MSFは東部の流行を『前例のない』速さで拡大していると警告。首都キンシャサ近郊での船舶関連疑い例は、感染拡大の新たな経路として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Temor en Kinshasa ante sospecha de caso de ébola en una embarcación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fear in Kinshasa over suspected Ebola case on a vessel
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case on a vessel bound for Kinshasa triggers a tense response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The ship, carrying more than 200 passengers, was held about 60 kilometers from Kinshasa as a mobile laboratory was deployed to test passengers and crew. The case concerns a person from the Pimbu health zone in Mongala Province who disembarked, developed symptoms off the vessel, sought care, and died; authorities say the death is not yet confirmed as Ebola, but precautionary measures include tracing and maintaining a cordon around the ship while tests proceed. INRB teams will examine all aboard. The WHO has deployed teams to Maluku port to support detection. The Congo’s Ebola outbreak, declared May 15 and linked to the Bundibugyo strain, has affected five provinces, with 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths as of August 3. High-level talks emphasized community engagement, health worker protection, and reinforced surveillance to prevent home deaths.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサでエボラ疑い例、船舶での感染疑いに緊張走る
triage.triage_reason: 既に3,874症例・1,751死亡を出しているDRCのエボラ流行が、大都市キンシャサへの拡大の可能性を示す新たな疑い例（船舶）として報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にNigeria(Kaduna State等)が含まれているが、記事本文はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のエボラ流行および船舶での疑い例に関するものであり、ナイジェリアは主題ではないため除外した。既存の大規模流行（5州、3,874症例、1,751死亡）の拡大局面としてキンシャサ港での新規疑い例が報告されている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: بدء تجارب لقاح جديد لـ"إيبولا" مع ارتفاع الإصابات والوفيات فى الكونغو الديمقراطية |
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola vaccine trials begin as infections and deaths rise in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports accelerated development of therapeutics and the first vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola as the DRC faces the largest Bundibugyo outbreak to date, which began in mid-May. As of August 1, the outbreak totals 3,748 cases and 1,657 deaths, with 708 recoveries. No vaccine or therapy has yet proven safe and effective for Bundibugyo Ebola; however, phase I trials began in the United Kingdom on July 24, with Canada slated to start soon, testing in ferrets and nonhuman primates before advancing. Data from Ervebo, a licensed vaccine for a different Ebola strain, have been reported. WHO’s technical advisory group met last Friday and will publish recommendations later. In Ituri province, three clinical trial sites have opened, with a fourth to open this week, evaluating an oral post-exposure prophylaxis drug in over 25 high-risk contacts, led by the National Institute for Biomedical Research in DRC with partners. Trials emphasize safety and careful progression.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で感染者・死者が増加する中、新たなエボラワクチン治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のブンディブギョ株エボラ流行が発生しており（3,748症例、1,657死亡）、IHR基準の複数該当およびWPRO基準の該当が多数あるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 英国・カナダでの臨床試験はワクチン開発目的であり、実際の疾病発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。致死率約44%と非常に高く、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: US government commits additional $242 million to Ebola fight
article.articleSummary: Ebola response: The United States adds $242 million to Ebola fight in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda, and other affected countries, bringing direct assistance to over $512 million and complementing earlier humanitarian commitments. The funds, announced by the U.S. Department of State in coordination with the CDC and regional governments, support outbreak response, preparedness, and humanitarian aid, and align with a G7 pledge for up to $500 million more. The DRC Ebola situation remains concerning, while Uganda is commended for swift containment. Interventions include surveillance and detection, patient isolation and treatment, border screening, health‑facility strengthening, and community engagement to counter misinformation. Previous US support has enabled screening of about 8.6 million people, risk messaging to over 1 million, operation of 12 Ebola treatment centres in the DRC, 11 laboratories, and distribution of nearly 300 metric tonnes of supplies. Travel advisories remain Level 4 for DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: 米国政府がエボラ対策に追加で2億4200万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国を中心にエボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続し、複数国への拡大や渡航制限（レベル4）が発生しているため、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンにおけるエボラ対応への米国追加支援に関するもの。ウガンダ・南スーダン・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。既存アウトブレイクの継続的資金拠出報道だが、DRCの状況は依然懸念材料とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Yoga With Swami Ramdev: मच्छर पनपने से कितने घातक हुए डेंगू,मलेरिया ? Prevention For Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yoga With Swami Ramdev: How deadly have Dengue and Malaria become as mosquitoes proliferate? Dengue Prevention.
article.articleSummary: During the monsoon rains, mosquito breeding has amplified the threat from Dengue and Malaria. The program 'Yoga With Swami Ramdev' links rising transmission to standing water and offers prevention through Yoga-based practices, specifically Yogic Panch. Dengue and Malaria share symptoms on the list: muscle pain, low platelets (thrombocytopenia), brain fog, and high fever, with Chikungunya pain also referenced as part of the rainy-season mosquito-borne illnesses. The article emphasizes that standing water during monsoon increases seasonal problems and calls for preventive measures to reduce exposure and transmission. No case or death counts are reported; the focus remains on awareness and non-pharmacological prevention as a response to the vector proliferation.

triage.headline_ja: ヨガ・ウィズ・スワミ・ラムデフ：蚊の発生によりデング熱・マラリアはどれほど危険になったのか？デング熱予防法
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の蚊媒介感染症に関する一般的な健康啓発・予防番組の内容であり、具体的な症例数・死亡数の報告や異常な流行拡大の記述がないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドの健康情報番組内でのデング熱・マラリア・チクングニアの季節性予防啓発であり、具体的な発生報告や統計データは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil mantiene a RD bajo vigilancia máxima por propagación de la fiebre porcina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil keeps the Dominican Republic under maximum surveillance due to the spread of swine fever.
article.articleSummary: African Swine Fever (Peste Porcina Africana, PPA) continues to threaten the Dominican Republic, which is under maximum surveillance to curb spread. Brazil, noting no PPA cases since 1984 thanks to border controls, herd monitoring, and private-sector biosecurity, hosts the Grupo de Prevención PPA Américas to coordinate regional prevention efforts among 21 member countries. The Dominican Republic was among the first cases observed within the group, highlighting the need for coordinated action after a failed 2022 eradication project funded by the United States that proposed depopulation and restocking of pigs. Juan Luis Uccelli, coordinator, argues that PPA has no vaccine and can be latent, a 'time bomb,' and true eradication would require total culling of swine, as in the 1980s. While the continent aims for a PPA-free Dominican Republic, the missed opportunity in 2022 has raised pork costs.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、豚熱(アフリカ豚熱)の拡大でドミニカ共和国を最大限の監視下に置く
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は非ヒト感染症（動物疾病）であり、対象国のうちブラジルは1984年以降症例なしで実際の発生国はドミニカ共和国（対象国外）であるため、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしては該当しない。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱は人獣共通感染症ではなく、記事の主題は動物衛生・貿易への影響。実際の発生国であるドミニカ共和国は対象国リストに含まれず、ブラジルは1984年以降症例なしのため発生国として除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO "민주콩고 에볼라 확산 지속...대응 역량 강화 시급"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola spread continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; urgent to strengthen the response capacity.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks continue in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Cumulative confirmed cases reach 3,874 with 1,751 deaths. As of August 3, 2026, 717 people are in isolation or hospital care, and recoveries total 749. The outbreak spans 51 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, and South Kivu provinces, with Ituri alone accounting for 87.1% of cases. On August 4, 2026, the World Health Organization urged urgent reinforcement of response capacity, including expanding patient treatment, scaling up epidemiological investigations, safe burial practices, and community-based outbreak response teams. Additional funding and resources are needed to sustain surveillance and contact tracing and to bolster preventive measures. The WHO notes this is the largest Ebola outbreak on record in the DRC."

triage.headline_ja: WHO「コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ拡大継続…対応能力の強化が急務」
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国史上最大規模のエボラ流行と表明し、死者1,751人・累計症例3,874人に達し、国際的な資金・支援強化を要請しているため。
triage.notes: WHOが『DRC史上最大のエボラ流行』と明言しており、51の保健区域に拡大中。渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事内で言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Chief Warns Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo Is Accelerating
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo accelerates; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits Kinshasa to urge rapid scale-up amid insecurity and displacement hindering response. The outbreak is described as the fastest-spreading and second-most deadly in DRC history, with the majority of cases in Ituri province along the Uganda border. As of Monday, Congo’s Ministry of Health reports 3,874 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,751 deaths. Ongoing challenges include reaching affected communities, training and supporting health workers, and accelerating access to care and surveillance in a context of insecurity and frontline health worker strikes demanding better pay and conditions. The United States pledges an additional US$242 million for immediate response and preparedness. Tedros stresses placing communities at the center of response to stop transmission; authorities race to strengthen surveillance and care in affected districts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが加速していると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、WPRO基準も全項目該当。WHO事務局長の現地訪問や米国の大規模資金拠出など社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 史上最速拡大かつDRC史上2番目に致死的なアウトブレイクとされ、イツリ州（ウガンダ国境付近）が中心。治安不安、住民避難、医療従事者ストライキが対応を阻害。米国が2.42億ドルの追加拠出を表明。ウガンダ・米国は発生地域リストに含まれるが対象国リストに該当せず除外。

article.articleHeadline: Vi khuẩn E.coli thường xuất hiện ở đâu và có thể gây những bệnh gì?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Where do E. coli bacteria commonly occur, and what diseases can they cause?
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli (E. coli) bacteria, typically harmless in the gut, include pathogenic strains that cause illness via contaminated food, water, or environment. A Vietnamese case from Ninh Bình involves a 72-year-old man who developed E. coli meningitis; initial symptoms were headache and altered consciousness, with cerebrospinal fluid confirming E. coli meningitis. Expanded testing revealed concurrent Angiostrongylus cantonensis (roundworm) infection; the worm does not directly cause meningitis but larvae can enable bacteria to enter the bloodstream, leading to bacteremia and meningitis. Treatment included antibiotics per susceptibility testing, anti-helminthic therapy, and intensive care, with improvement after about 12 days. The article notes common reservoirs for pathogenic E. coli: undercooked beef or poultry, raw leafy greens, unpasteurized dairy, and contaminated water from wells or rivers, plus contaminated surfaces. Symptoms range from diarrhea and abdominal pain to dehydration; severe cases risk hemolytic-uremic syndrome and sepsis.

triage.headline_ja: 大腸菌はどこに存在し、どのような病気を引き起こすのか？
triage.triage_reason: 単一の症例報告に基づく一般的な健康啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 1例の症例（E.coli髄膜炎とAngiostrongylus cantonensis合併感染）を用いた一般向け医療解説記事であり、アウトブレイクや集団感染を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: САД планираат дополнителни 242 милиони долари помош за борба против еболата во Африка
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States plans to provide an additional $242 million in aid to fight Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: The United States plans to provide an additional $242 million to fight Ebola in Africa, per the State Department, for rapid outbreak response, regional preparedness, and related humanitarian aid. This brings total direct U.S. Ebola relief to over $512 million and aligns with June G-7 commitments. Washington also announced $350 million in humanitarian aid for the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), South Sudan, and Uganda as part of an $1.8 billion UN OCHA package for multiple countries. This follows a period of reduced international aid and withdrawal from the WHO since January 2025. Ebola is highly contagious and deadly, transmitted by direct contact or bodily fluids. The eastern DRC outbreak is the largest in the country, with over 3,600 lab-confirmed cases and more than 1,500 deaths, according to MSF, about two and a half months after it began.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、アフリカでのエボラ対策支援としてさらに2億4200万ドルの追加支援を計画
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で過去最大規模のエボラ流行（症例3,600件超、死者1,500人超）が継続しており、米国・G7・国連が大規模な国際支援を実施していることから公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的関心の高さが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRCにおけるエボラ流行への国際支援に関するもの。南スーダン・ウガンダへの人道支援も言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。米国は資金拠出国であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Најголемата епидемија на ебола во историјата на Конго, САД испраќаат дополнителна помош
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The largest Ebola epidemic in Congo's history; the United States is sending additional aid.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo marks the largest epidemic in the country’s history, with the outbreak continuing for about two and a half months. Laboratory-confirmed cases exceed 3,600 and roughly 1,500 people have died. The United States is expanding assistance, with direct Ebola-focused aid surpassing $512 million and an additional $350 million in humanitarian support for the DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda, as part of a broader $1.8 billion UN OCHA package. The funds follow commitments made at the June G7 summit. Ebola is a highly contagious viral disease transmitted through direct contact with infected persons or their bodily fluids. The MSF warns the eastern DRC outbreak has reached unprecedented scale, prompting intensified regional preparedness and international involvement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ史上最大のエボラ流行、米国が追加支援を派遣
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ流行が同国史上最大規模となり、確定症例3,600人超・死者1,500人に達しており、国際的な大規模支援が動員されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUnited States, Uganda, Sudanが含まれるが、記事の主題はDRC東部での流行であり、これらは支援国・周辺国としての言及に留まるため、対象国リストにあるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた（Uganda, Sudanは対象国リスト外）。

article.articleHeadline: Глава ВОЗ заявил об удвоении числа случаев Эболы в отдельных очагах в ДР Конго -- НИАТ "Ховар"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General says the number of Ebola cases has doubled in certain outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo have doubled new cases in some foci over the past week, indicating faster spread than response capacity. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, after visiting Kinshasa, urged rapid, large-scale strengthening of measures across all fronts—expanded access to care, intensified epidemiological surveillance, protection of healthcare workers, and safe burial practices. He emphasized that trust and participation of local communities are crucial to containment. The 17th Ebola outbreak began on 15 May in eastern DRC; on 1 August WHO called it the largest in the country’s history. As of 1 August 2026, the outbreak has infected more than 3,700 people and caused about 1,600 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国の一部感染集中地域でエボラ症例数が倍増したと発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC史上最大規模の流行となり、症例が急増して対応能力を上回るペースで拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行はDRC史上最大規模とWHOが認定。致死率約43%（1,600/3,700）と高く、感染拡大速度が対応能力を上回っている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Az ebolajárvány elleni küzdelem fokozására szólított fel a WHO főigazgatója
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO Director-General called for stepping up the fight against the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus travelled to Kinshasa amid a multi-province Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo driven by the Bundibugyo variant, spanning five eastern and northeastern provinces. Since May 15, the outbreak has 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths; the 2018–2020 outbreak caused about 2,300 deaths and ~3,500 cases. Tedros urged rapid, mass public-health actions and strengthened protection, training, and support for health workers, following meetings with President Félix Tshisekedi. In Ituri Province’s Mongbwalu, hospital staff protested wage increases, dispersed by police. The Bundibugyo virus currently has no approved vaccine or treatment. In July, a volunteer received the first dose of an Oxford-developed Bundibugyo vaccine using the same platform as AstraZeneca’s COVID shot; the rVSV-Bundibugyo vaccine is under development by Hilleman Laboratories in Singapore. Canada authorized Moderna to begin trials of another vaccine; remdesivir, obeldevisir, and MBP134 monoclonal antibody are under evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ流行との闘い強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで多州にまたがるエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行が継続中(症例3,874・死者1,751)で、WHO事務局長が現地訪問し緊急対応を呼びかけており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSingaporeとCanadaが含まれるが、これらはワクチン開発・臨床試験の実施国であり感染発生国ではないため除外。対象国リストに含まれないため元々該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Tedros urge a intensificar de forma "masiva" la respuesta al brote...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros urges a "massive" intensification of the response to the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains the most lethal outbreak recorded there. As of the latest health authority balance, 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths, with 749 recoveries; 717 patients are in isolation or hospitalized. Case fatality rate stands at 45.1%. Declared May 15, the outbreak spans five provinces—Alto Uélé, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo—with 51 health zones affected. There is no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls for urgent, massive intensification across all response pillars to reach affected communities despite insecurity and displacement, strengthen protection, training and support for health workers, and accelerate access to care, surveillance, and dignified, safe burials under government leadership.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス事務局長、エボラ発生への対応を「大規模に」強化するよう緊急要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ(ブンディブジョ株)アウトブレイクが致死率45.1%と極めて高く、5州51保健地域に拡大し、ワクチンも未承認であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が直接介入を呼びかけている点から国際的な懸念が非常に高いことが確認できる。ワクチン未承認のブンディブジョ株であることも管理可能性のリスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола в Конго се разпространява с рекордни темпове, случаите скоро ще надхвърлят 4000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo is spreading at a record pace; cases will soon exceed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading at a record pace, with the outbreak approaching 4,000 cases and becoming the largest observed in the country by late July. Globally, it ranks as the second-largest outbreak after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (more than 28,000 cases and over 11,000 deaths). The outbreak is expanding about five times faster than previous ones; the 2,000-case milestone was reached in ~two months, compared with ten months in 2018–2020. The virus is the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or proven effective treatment, unlike the Zaire strain. Contributing factors include undetected circulation since January, early misdiagnoses, and initial use of tests for a different Ebola species. WHO says about 80% of new cases occur outside known transmission chains; funding shortfalls and violence in eastern Congo hinder containment and raise cross-border spillover risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱が記録的な速さで拡大、症例数はまもなく4000人を超える見込み
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が記録的速度で拡大しており、ワクチン未承認の株であること、国境を越えた波及リスク、資金不足・治安悪化による対応困難が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではAngolaへの言及がないため対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: US commits additional $242 million to combat Ebola in DRC and Uganda
article.articleSummary: US commits an additional $242 million to Ebola response in DRC and Uganda, bringing total State Department support to more than $512 million amid one of Africa's fastest-growing outbreaks. The funds, part of a broader G7 pledge, will fund emergency response operations, disease surveillance, treatment, border screening and humanitarian aid across affected communities. Since May 2026 the outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo strain with no approved vaccine or specific treatment, has reached about 3,900 confirmed cases and over 1,750 deaths as of early August, with true cases likely higher due to under-detection in conflict-affected areas. WHO warns the outbreak is accelerating; 60–70% of new infections are not linked to known contacts. Uganda has acted swiftly on imported cases; Kenya monitors cross-border risks. US emphasizes regional coordination and urges further international funding.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダにおけるエボラ対策に追加で2億4200万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目が該当し、致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダで急速に拡大しており、国際的な資金支援も動員されている重大な公衆衛生事象であるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダとケニアも記事の主題国だが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・特異的治療法がなく、感染経路不明の症例が60-70%を占めるなど流行拡大の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Trump-Regierung plant Millionenhilfe für Kampf gegen Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump administration plans millions in aid for the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: US plans $242 million in aid for the Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, including immediate measures, regional preparedness, and humanitarian assistance, with funding awaiting Congressional approval. The package reflects commitments from the June G7 summit. The Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC is the largest ever recorded in the country, with more than 3,600 laboratory-confirmed infections and approximately 1,500 deaths. The funding aims to bolster rapid response capabilities, protection of healthcare workers, and cross-border coordination, as authorities intensify containment efforts. As of 2026-08-06, international support is accelerating the response to this protracted outbreak in the conflict-affected region. Discussions with the US Congress are underway.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ政権、エボラ対策に数百万ドルの支援を計画
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確定感染3,600人超、死者約1,500人）が継続しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心・支援の必要性が高いため。
triage.notes: 米国は資金支援国であり発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。紛争影響地域での対応継続が課題。

article.articleHeadline: Infos27 : " Ebola : un bateau sous traçage met Kinshasa à l'épreuve
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a boat under tracing puts Kinshasa to the test.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola-suspected death on a passenger vessel arriving at Maluku port in Kinshasa, after a voyage from Mongala on the Congo River, triggers a rapid containment. The boat, with about 200 passengers, was escorted by naval forces and isolated at Maluku. Authorities impose a 21-day follow-up for all travelers and intensify surveillance to prevent spread to major urban centers. A mobile laboratory is deployed and the vessel remains under monitoring. Diplomatically, Kinshasa hosts high-level talks with WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom and Africa CDC Director Dr. Jean Kaseya; the United States pledges over $240 million to bolster the response. Clinically, more than 700 people have recovered across five affected provinces; a 100-bed treatment center opens in Ituri to ease hospital congestion. In Bunia, at the Kigonze displacement site, deaths have declined due to ongoing community outreach.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：追跡中の船がキンシャサを試練にさらす
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、船舶での感染疑い死亡例が主要都市キンシャサに到達し、WHO・Africa CDC・米国が関与する国際的対応が行われていることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 感染疑い例を乗せた船がキンシャサの主要港に到着し隔離措置を実施。既存のエボラアウトブレイクは5州に及び、700人以上が回復。WHO事務局長・Africa CDC所長が現地入りし、米国が2億4000万ドル以上の支援を表明するなど国際的な関心・関与が高い事案。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）因埃博拉疑似病例截停一艘船只
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo halts a vessel due to a suspected Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo halted a river vessel about 65 kilometers from Kinshasa after a passenger who disembarked in Mongala Province’s Bimu health district developed Ebola-like symptoms and subsequently died, a suspected Ebola case. Authorities traced the boat, stopped it as a precaution, and deployed a mobile laboratory on site to test all passengers and crew; passenger counts aboard were not disclosed. The vessel originated from eastern DR Congo, from Tshopo Province. The health ministry’s update as of August 4 shows 3,973 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, 1,801 deaths, and 776 recoveries, with transmission across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, and South Kivu. President Tshisekedi met with WHO Director-General and Africa CDC Director to bolster community mobilization, protection of health workers, and epidemiological surveillance. Doctors Without Borders warned the eastern outbreak remains “unprecedentedly severe,” with no slowdown observed despite frontline efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ疑い症例で船舶を停止
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱流行（確定症例3,973件、死亡1,801人、5州にまたがる）に関連し、疑い症例に伴う船舶の移動制限が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にTibet Autonomous Region（Bimuの誤ジオコーディングと推測）およびChinaが含まれるが、記事内容はコンゴ民主共和国（Mongala州Bimu保健地区）でのエボラ疑い症例と既存流行に関するものであり、China・Tibetは主題国から除外した。既に大規模流行が進行中であり、船舶停止という新規動向が国際拡大リスクを示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Amnesty Calls for MBG Suspension After Hundreds Fall Sick
article.articleSummary: Amnesty International Indonesia calls for suspension and a full review of the Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) program after suspected mass food poisoning linked to MBG meals sickened hundreds of students and teachers. As of August 5–6, 2026, incidents are reported in Jayapura, Papua, and Semarang, Central Java, with Depapre District (Jayapura Regency) reporting around 150 suspected cases after MBG meals on August 4, 2026. A July 28, 2026 incident affected at least 120 at a Jayapura public senior high school, and a July 31, 2026 incident at a Semarang public vocational high school affected about 707. Since MBG’s January 2025 launch, more than 37,000 students have reportedly been affected, including around 9,000 cases from January–May 2026. Symptoms include nausea, dizziness, weakness, vomiting, and diarrhea. Calls include supply-chain investigations, governance review, and accountability, amid constitutional and Komnas HAM rights concerns.

triage.headline_ja: アムネスティ、数百人が体調不良を訴えたことを受けMBG(給食プログラム)の停止を要求
triage.triage_reason: 感染症ではなく集団食中毒(疑い)事案であり人-人感染のリスクは低いが、政府給食プログラムに関連し累計3万人超という規模と社会的関心の高さから継続的な経過観察が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 本事案は感染症ではなく食品由来の集団食中毒(疑い)であり、原因(病原体・毒素等)は記事中で特定されていない。ヒト-ヒト感染性がないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、政府の無償給食プログラム(MBG)に関連する継続的・大規模な健康被害として社会的・政治的注目度は高い。パプアニューギニアは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では主題として言及されておらず対象国リストにも該当しないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Tedros urge a intensificar de forma "masiva" la respuesta al brote...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros urges a massively intensified response to the outbreak...
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the deadliest on record there, driven by the Bundibugyo strain with no approved vaccine. As of the latest health authority balance, 3,874 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths, with 749 recovered (case fatality 45.1%). 717 patients remain in isolation or hospitalized. Declared May 15, the outbreak is confined to five provinces: Upper Uele (Alto Uélé), Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo, across 51 health zones. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls for an urgent, massively intensified response across all pillars, under government leadership, to reach affected communities despite insecurity and displacement, protect health workers, and accelerate access to care, surveillance, and dignified, safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行への対応を「大規模に」強化するよう緊急要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WHO事務局長が国際的な緊急対応強化を呼びかけていることから、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 致死率45.1%、承認済みワクチンのないブンディブギョ株による過去最悪規模の流行。治安不安・住民避難が対応を困難にしており、WHOが国際支援の拡大を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: Over 100 Fall Ill After Drinking Contaminated Water In Greater Noida Society; Bacteria Found In Supply
article.articleSummary: Over 100 residents in Greater Noida Society, Greater Noida, have fallen ill over two weeks after consuming contaminated water, including about 70 children. Private laboratory tests of water samples found the supply unfit for drinking and detected coliform bacteria and Escherichia coli. Residents have begun boiling water for consumption. Accusations of negligence target the Association of Owners’ Association (AOA), which allegedly failed to clean overhead tanks and to test water promptly; testing occurred only after public complaints. The AOA says tank cleaning is delayed due to the rainy season and will begin in the first week of September. No specific symptoms are listed in the report, but illnesses are linked to the contaminated water supply as of 2026-08-06.

triage.headline_ja: グレーターノイダの集合住宅で汚染水摂取後100人以上が体調不良、水道供給から細菌検出
triage.triage_reason: 特定の集合住宅内での水質汚染による健康被害であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、公衆衛生上の管理不備が続いており経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 単一集合住宅内の水質汚染事案であり、タンク清掃の遅延が原因とされる。9月まで清掃開始が延期されており、感染拡大が続く可能性がある。重症度・入院・死亡等の詳細情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: El director de la OMS advierte que el brote de ébola en RDC se duplica en casos semanales
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO director warns that the Ebola outbreak in the DRC is doubling in weekly case numbers.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the deadliest on record in the country, driven by the Bundibugyo strain with no approved vaccine. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns cases have doubled in some outbreak foci over the past week and calls for an urgent, massive intensification of the response across all pillars and partners. Latest official tallies from the DRC Public Health Institute: 3,874 confirmed cases, 717 in isolation or hospitalized, 749 recoveries, 1,751 deaths (case fatality rate 45.1%). The outbreak spans five provinces—Haut-Uele, Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, and Tshopo—with 51 health zones affected. Authorities stress reaching affected communities amid insecurity and displacement, protecting health workers, and expediting access to care, surveillance, and safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が週単位で倍増していると警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が発生し、症例が週単位で倍増、致死率45.1%と極めて深刻であり、WHO事務局長が国際的な緊急対応強化を訴えている。
triage.notes: ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株による流行で、5州51保健地区に拡大。治安不安と住民避難が対応を困難にしており、WHOが国際支援の緊急強化を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết tăng gần 24%, TP.HCM khuyến cáo người dân chủ động phòng bệnh trước cao điểm mùa mưa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever rises nearly 24%, Ho Chi Minh City urges residents to proactively prevent disease ahead of the peak of the rainy season.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is rising in Ho Chi Minh City (TP.HCM) and southern Vietnam ahead of the rainy-season peak. In week 30 (20–26 July), TP.HCM recorded 995 dengue cases, up 20% from the four-week average; year-to-date total is 23,481, up 23.9% from 2025. Across the southern region, 53,428 cases occurred in the first 29 weeks of 2026, up 38.9% year-on-year, with Đồng Nai, TP.HCM and Tây Ninh among hotspots. Hotspots in TP.HCM include An Nhơn Tây, Chánh Phú Hòa, and Ngãi Giao. Dengue, transmitted by Aedes aegypti, thrives in hot, humid monsoon conditions with water-holding containers. Early symptoms include high fever, headache, and muscle pains; progression can cause plasma leakage, hemorrhage, shock, or multi-organ failure if untreated. Prevention emphasizes eliminating breeding sites, covering water sources, regular cleaning, fish in large tanks, bed nets, long sleeves, repellents, and vaccination for ages 4+ as an adjunct. Seek care for warning signs; community action is essential.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱がほぼ24％増加、ホーチミン市が雨季ピークを前に住民に予防の積極対応を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は例年季節的に流行する既知の感染症であり、症例増加は懸念材料だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。地域の流行状況として継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱の季節的増加に関する地方保健当局の注意喚起。前年比・平均比での増加率は示されているが、重症例や死亡者数の具体的情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief says Ebola outbreak is outpacing response as aid workers strike over pay
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province (Bunia), with 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths as of Monday. New cases are doubling in hot spots; contact tracing fails with an estimated 60-70% of new cases outside monitored exposure. Health workers have struck over unpaid wages, limiting care in rebel-affected, remote east near South Sudan, Uganda and Rwanda. The Bundibugyo virus has no approved treatment or vaccine and is thought to have begun before the May 15 declaration. The United States pledges an additional $242 million for immediate response, bringing direct assistance to over $512 million. Fatality rate ~45%; in a 24-hour window, 44 of 77 recent cases died; 717 patients are in isolation and 749 have recovered. WHO Director-General Tedros calls for rapid scale-up, earlier detection, stronger tracing, and community-centered action.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ出血熱の流行が対応能力を上回っていると発言、援助関係者は賃金未払いでストライキ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行が拡大し致死率約45%、接触追跡が機能不全、周辺国への波及リスクがあり、国際的な資金・対応の緊急拡大が要請されているため。
triage.notes: 米国、南スーダン、ウガンダ、ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのイトゥリ州（ブニア）が主発生地。

article.articleHeadline: الولايات المتحدة تخصص أكثر من 242 مليون دولار إضافية لمكافحة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States allocates more than $242 million in additional funding to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: The United States allocated over $242 million in additional funding to combat Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid a new outbreak wave. This boosts direct Ebola assistance to more than $512 million, enabling expansion of interventions across Africa. The funding complements $350 million in humanitarian aid for the DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda as part of a broader $1.8 billion package to the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs announced on May 14. The United States remains the leading financial contributor to Ebola response and urges other donors to mobilize more resources. Uganda is praised for swift containment measures, while travel restrictions have been imposed targeting travelers from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, and U.S. citizens are barred from returning directly to the United States from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ対策に2億4200万ドル以上の追加資金を拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で新たなエボラ流行波が発生し、米国が大規模追加支援を実施、複数国で渡航制限も課されておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行波と米国の資金拠出が主題。ウガンダ・南スーダン・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Jangan Terkecoh Demam Turun, Ini Fase Paling Berbahaya Penderita DBD yang Wajib Diwaspadai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't be fooled by a fever that subsides: This is the most dangerous phase for dengue fever patients that must be watched.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (DBD) from Aedes aegypti remains a major public health threat in Indonesia, with transmission among the highest in Southeast Asia. Early fever follows a saddle-shaped pattern: temperatures rise to 38–39°C in days 1–3, dip, then rise again before leveling off. The critical phase lies around days 4–6, when Dengue Shock Syndrome (DSS) risk increases despite apparent improvement. Laboratory confirmation is essential, but hematocrit monitoring is more informative than platelet counts; rising hematocrit signals plasma leakage and blood concentration. Leakage reduces circulating volume and can cause fluid in the pleural space and abdomen, leading to dyspnea. After the critical phase, fever may rebound around day 7, followed by itching as recovery begins. Emphasizing recognition of plasma leakage is crucial for timely management and avoiding fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: 解熱しても油断は禁物、デング熱患者が最も警戒すべき危険な段階とは
triage.triage_reason: デング熱に関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、新規の異常事態や急増を示す情報がなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の臨床経過（発熱パターン、危険な段階の見分け方）に関する一般的な医療情報記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや症例急増を報じるものではない。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية" تحذر: إيبولا يتسارع في الكونغو ويتجاوز قدرات الاستجابة | سبق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "World Health Organization" warns: Ebola accelerates in the Congo and exceeds response capacities | Sabq
article.articleSummary: WHO warns Ebola is accelerating in the Democratic Republic of Congo, exceeding current response capacities and prompting urgent additional funding and support. Lab-confirmed cases rise to 3,748 with 1,657 deaths and 708 recoveries; 227 suspected cases and about 17,000 contacts are under monitoring. During a field visit, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged intensified health interventions and protection for health workers, warning some areas could double their case counts within a week. The agency emphasizes strengthened surveillance and early preparedness as population movement increases and cross-border transmission to neighboring countries remains a risk. The statement calls for rapid financing and operational support to contain the epidemic in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 「WHO」警告：エボラ出血熱がコンゴで加速し、対応能力を超過
triage.triage_reason: WHOがDRCでのエボラ流行が対応能力を超えて加速していると警告し、死者1,657人・確認症例3,748人に達し、国境を越えた拡大リスクも指摘されているため、IHR基準を複数満たす重大シグナルと判断。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長による現地視察に基づく声明であり、国際的な資金・運用支援の要請が明記されている。渡航・貿易制限への言及はないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. doubles Ebola funding to $512 million as Africa battles its second-largest outbreak ever
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) reached 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths per Congolese government; WHO cautions true scale may be larger. It is described as the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic on record, part of Africa's second-largest outbreak to date, threatening about 10 countries and drawing global alarm. Containment hampered by delayed virus detection, surveillance gaps, and ongoing armed conflict in eastern DRC; illegal mining cited as a facilitator. There are no established vaccines or medical treatments specific to the Bundibugyo strain. In response, the United States has doubled funding to $512 million to support emergency operations over the next six months, enabling operations of more than 180 health facilities and distribution of nearly 300 tons of medical supplies. U.S. officials say aid improvements have increased efficiency despite criticisms of aid structure changes.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ資金を5億1200万ドルに倍増 ― アフリカで史上2番目の規模の流行と戦う
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速拡大とされる大規模エボラ流行が発生し、周辺約10カ国への拡大脅威、ワクチン・治療薬未確立、国際的な資金投入がなされておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUnited Statesが含まれるが、これは資金支援国であり感染発生国ではないため除外。Africa(大陸)も対象国リストに該当しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: especialistas avaliam risco de alastramento no país em meio a surto e baixa cobertura vacinal em SP; tire suas dúvidas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Experts assess the risk of spread across the country amid an outbreak and low vaccination coverage in São Paulo; clear up your doubts.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Brazil prompts a vaccination push across São Paulo state and major cities. The Health Ministry recommends revaccination of all individuals and a ‘dose zero’ for babies under one year in São Paulo capital, São Bernardo do Campo, and Guarulhos. Brazil has 17 measles cases in 2026: 1 in Rio de Janeiro, 13 in São Paulo, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 in Guarulhos. Three cases have been contained with no further spread (including the Rio de Janeiro case); 14 remain under monitoring in the three Paulista cities. In Rio, a March-confirmed case involved a 22-year-old unvaccinated hotel worker; contact tracing and vaccination of contacts were carried out. In São Paulo state, 7 male and 9 female cases include 10 infants under one year, with the majority not fully vaccinated. Eder Gatti of the National Immunization Program notes high transmission risk from dense urban mobility but says containment is achievable with vigilance and vaccination. Brazil has not yet lost measles-free status.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：専門家がサンパウロ州での流行拡大リスクとワクチン接種率低下を評価、疑問に答える
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹排除国であったブラジルで2026年に17例の症例が発生し、低ワクチン接種率と都市部の人口密集により拡大リスクが指摘されており、保健当局が積極的な対応を行っている。
triage.notes: ブラジルは麻疹排除国のステータスをまだ失っていないが、乳児を含む未接種者への感染が続いており、今後の拡大動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: DOH reports decline in leptospirosis cases
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases in the Philippines declined amid heavy rains from a low pressure area (LPA) and the southwest monsoon (Habagat). As of July 18, 2026, the Department of Health (DOH) recorded 2,877 cases nationwide, down 6% from 3,048 in the same period last year. Total deaths reached 181, CFR 6.29% (down from 11.61% last year’s 354 deaths). The regions reporting the highest case load were Cagayan Valley (458), the National Capital Region (412), Davao Region (265), and Caraga (263). Despite the drop, authorities urge continued vigilance during the rainy season. Leptospirosis is a bacterial infection caused by Leptospira found in the urine of infected animals, especially rats, contaminating floodwater or mud. Infections can occur through broken skin or via eyes, nose, or mouth. Those who waded through floodwater should consult a doctor for appropriate treatment.

triage.headline_ja: DOH、レプトスピラ症症例の減少を報告
triage.triage_reason: レプトスピラ症は前年比で減少傾向にあり、既知の季節性疾患として通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 症例数・死亡率ともに前年より減少しており、DOHが通常の注意喚起を行っている段階。雨季による継続的な曝露リスクはあるが、既知の季節性疾患のため新規シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Thời tiết giao mùa, nhiều virus hô hấp gia tăng: Cha mẹ cần làm gì để bảo vệ con?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The changing seasons bring a rise in respiratory viruses: What should parents do to protect their children?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, Hanoi faces co-circulation of COVID-19, Adenovirus, influenza, and RSV as schools resume. In the last week of July 2026, Hanoi CDC recorded 268 COVID-19 cases across 89 wards, with a year-to-date total of 855 cases in 114 wards. Measles added 10 cases in 9 wards and pertussis 4 cases in 4 wards. Adenovirus remains a pediatric concern: at Hanoi’s National Pediatric Hospital, 2,777 children tested positive in 2026, triple 2025; early July added 383 new cases, with pneumonia or respiratory failure in some. Transmission is mainly via droplets and close contact, aided by crowded classrooms. Preventive measures include masking in crowded places, frequent hand hygiene, cough etiquette, ventilation, and healthy sleep and nutrition. Parents should monitor for fever, rapid breathing, poor feeding, lethargy, cyanosis, or seizures and seek early care. Vaccination against influenza, measles, pertussis, pneumococcus, and RSV is advised.

triage.headline_ja: 季節の変わり目で呼吸器ウイルスが増加：親は子どもを守るために何をすべきか？
triage.triage_reason: ハノイにおける季節性呼吸器感染症（COVID-19、アデノウイルス、インフルエンザ、RSV等）の通常の増加を報告する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性呼吸器感染症の複数病原体同時流行に関する一般的な予防啓発記事。ハノイCDCによる通常のサーベイランスデータ報告であり、特段の異常事態や国際的懸念は記載されていない。アデノウイルスの小児感染は前年比3倍と増加しているが、これは対象疾患リストに明示的に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Keracunan MBG di Papua-Semarang, Hasil Laboratorium Temukan Ada Bakteri E. Coli |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MBG poisoning case in Papua-Semarang, laboratory results reveal E. coli bacteria | Republika Online
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli contamination has been confirmed in cases of food poisoning linked to Indonesia's Free Nutritious Meal Program (MBG) in Papua and Semarang, Central Java. On 2026-08-06, Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin said lab results show E. coli bacteria in several foods served under MBG, with watermelon among the items implicated and other foods also affected. The Ministry of Health has advised the National Nutrition Agency (BGN), and stressed rapid action to prevent recurrence, including addressing issues at the Nutrition Service Units (SPPG). BGN head Sudaryono warned that poisoning is fatal and must be prevented, aiming for zero cases. The findings underscore the need for stricter food safety measures in MBG supply chains; no specific case counts or fatalities were disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: パプア・スマランでのMBG食中毒事件、検査で大腸菌が検出
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア政府の学校給食プログラム(MBG)における食中毒事件で大腸菌汚染が確認され、保健省・栄養庁が対応する社会的関心の高い事案であるため。
triage.notes: 『パプア』はインドネシア領パプア州を指し、パプアニューギニアではない。国家給食プログラム(MBG)供給網における食品安全問題として、政府対応・社会的関心が高いためPICKUPと判定。ただし具体的な症例数・重症度・死亡者数は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Invasive Mosquito Pushes Malaria Into Africa's Cities
article.articleSummary: Anopheles stephensi, an Asian malaria vector, is invading Africa’s cities, shifting malaria risk from rural to cities. Detected in Djibouti City in 2012, it has spread through the Horn of Africa and is tracked as far west as Ghana, with Ghana confirmed in 2024. A July 2026 Parasites & Vectors study confirmed urban transmission in Djibouti, finding 2 of 196 An. stephensi carrying Plasmodium vivax sporozoites; the haplotypes match Horn lineages. Unlike native vectors, An. stephensi breeds in water tanks, wells and construction sites, rests indoors and outdoors, bites by day, and feeds on livestock as well as people, undermining bed nets and indoor spraying. Ethiopian data show the species dominating districts (about 51% of sampled Anopheles). Kenya’s KEMRI and National Malaria Control Programme conduct national surveillance via Community Health Promoters. WHO vector alert; detection often lags. Westward spread toward megacities like Accra and Lagos is a key concern.

triage.headline_ja: 侵略的な蚊がアフリカの都市部にマラリアをもたらす
triage.triage_reason: アジア由来のマラリア媒介蚊Anopheles stephensiがアフリカ都市部に拡大し、既存の対策（蚊帳・屋内散布）を無効化する恐れがあり、国際的拡大リスクと異常性の両基準に該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はジブチ・エチオピア・ケニア・ナイジェリア(ラゴス)・ガーナ(アクラ)にも言及するが、対象国リストに含まれるのはガーナのみ。ナイジェリア・ガーナは『今後の懸念地域』として言及されており、確定的な都市部感染事例はジブチ・ガーナで報告。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola avança na República Democrática do Congo e já deixa 1.751 mortos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola advances in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and has already claimed 1,751 lives.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola variant drives the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak, which has 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths as of May 15. Ituri province is the epicenter near Uganda, South Sudan, and Rwanda, with insecurity and violence hampering response, patient transport, and healthcare worker safety. New infections are rising rapidly in some areas, with reports of doubling cases; 60–80% of cases occur outside existing contact networks. There is no licensed vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo; experimental vaccines and treatments are in early human trials in the UK and Canada, including an RNA vaccine from Moderna. The WHO and DRC authorities urge immediate, scaled-up action, stronger protection of health workers, and community engagement. The United States has pledged US$242 million, bringing total aid to over US$512 million for treatment centers, surveillance, contact tracing, and humanitarian support. Globally, risk remains low, but regional spread is possible without strengthened controls.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が拡大、死者数はすでに1,751人に達する
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（症例3,874件、死者1,751人）で、ワクチン未承認・治安悪化による対応困難・急速な症例倍増が報告されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 米国が2億4200万ドルを追加拠出し、支援総額が5億1200万ドルを超えるなど国際的な関心・支援が高まっている。イトゥリ州が震源地で、ウガンダ・南スーダン・ルワンダなど近隣国への越境拡大リスクが指摘されているが、これら周辺国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolaausbruch: USA sagen weitere 242 Millionen Dollar im Kampf gegen Ebola zu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: U.S. pledges another $242 million in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has become the largest ever registered there, expanding over about two and a half months to nearly 4,000 lab-confirmed cases and over 1,800 deaths. The United States pledges an additional $242 million for immediate response, prevention, and humanitarian aid, bringing direct Ebola support to more than $512 million, and adds $350 million for humanitarian operations in the Democratic Republic of Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda. The move follows G7 commitments from June and signals renewed U.S. engagement amid a largely isolationist discourse. Doctors Without Borders calls the situation 'more critical than ever' as the outbreak persists in the region. No details on transmission sources or imported/exported cases are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：米国がエボラ対策にさらに2億4200万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱の流行（約4000例、死者1800人超）が継続しており、国際的な緊急支援が拡大していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国東部での過去最大規模のエボラ流行に対する米国の追加資金拠出を報じている。ウガンダ・南スーダンは人道支援対象国として言及されているが、感染拡大の確認事例は記載なし。米国は対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Лихорадка Эбола унесла жизни уже 1,8 тысячи человек в ДР Конго - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fever has already claimed the lives of 1,800 people in DR Congo - News on Vesti.ru.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, Ebola fever in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused 1,801 deaths among 3,973 confirmed cases, a case fatality rate of about 45%. About 717 patients remain in hospitals or in isolation. Outbreaks have been concentrated in eastern DRC and in Uganda since mid-May. On 4 August, official DRC deaths were reported at 1,405, indicating rapid escalation. Ebola fever is a highly dangerous viral hemorrhagic illness, with symptoms including high fever, severe intoxication, vomiting, diarrhea, and external or internal bleeding. The figures come from the Ministry of Communications and Media Affairs; the report provides no details on laboratory confirmation or infection sources beyond the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱、DRコンゴで死者すでに1800人に - Vesti.ru
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約45%、死者数が急増している大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断する。
