article.articleHeadline: Туристы Коми привозят из отпуска кишечные инфекции и лихорадку Денге
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Komi tourists bring back from vacation gastrointestinal infections and dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Tourists from the Komi Republic return from vacation with infectious illnesses, notably gastrointestinal infections (rotavirus, norovirus, enterovirus) and three cases of dengue fever. Maldives, Myanmar, Vietnam, Sri Lanka, and India are cited as sources of rarer illnesses. Russia has no licensed dengue vaccine; it is being tested in two cities. Dengue has four serotypes, and infection with a different serotype can be more severe, with symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, and a hemorrhagic rash. Preventive advice includes using repellents and avoiding standing water; Legionella-related pneumonia is another risk linked to hotel air conditioning if not cleaned after installation. The report highlights travel-associated infections among Komi tourists; no fatalities or further imported/exported case details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コミ共和国の観光客が休暇先から消化器感染症とデング熱を持ち帰る
triage.triage_reason: ロシア人観光客の輸入症例（少数例）に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、対象国側での発生拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア（コミ共和国）在住者が海外旅行先（モルディブ、ミャンマー、ベトナム、スリランカ、インド）で感染症に罹患し帰国した事例を紹介する一般的な旅行医学記事。対象国側での発生状況やアウトブレイクの詳細は記載されておらず、対象国自体での公衆衛生イベントとは言えないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: US Pledges US$242 Million More for DR Congo Ebola Fight
article.articleSummary: US pledged an additional 242 million dollars on 5 August 2026, raising total US Ebola funding for the DR Congo outbreak to over 512 million. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain in Ituri province, first detected in May, has driven the deadliest wave with more than 1,700 deaths by early August; Uganda’s outbreak was declared over on 28 July 2026 after 20 confirmed cases, 15 linked to the DRC. The DRC continues to face a concerning trajectory with no licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo, unlike Zaire strain vaccines (Ervebo). US support funds surveillance, isolation and treatment, border screening, clinics, and community work against misinformation, with 8.6 million health screenings and risk messaging to over 1 million people; 180+ facilities; 12 treatment centers inside DRC; nearly 300 metric tons of supplies; 11 laboratories. CDC entry ban covers recent exposure to DRC/Uganda/South Sudan; Uganda and Rwanda closed borders with DRC; three imported cases outside Africa (France, Germany) recovered. Ten at-risk neighboring countries named.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対策に追加で2億4200万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: DRCのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行は1,700人超の死者を出し、有効なワクチンがなく、フランス・ドイツへの越境輸入例や国境閉鎖・入国制限を伴う国際的懸念事案であり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は7月28日に終息宣言済みだが、DRCは依然拡大傾向にあり、ワクチン未承認の希少株（ブンディブギョ）による致死性の高い流行が継続中。周辺10カ国がリスク国として指定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Αυξημένα περιστατικά γρίπης καταγράφονται και φέτος παρά την άνοδο της θερμοκρασίας. - dete.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza cases are up again this year despite the rise in temperature.
article.articleSummary: Summer influenza surge in Greece and island destinations, mainly affecting teens and young adults. Crowded beach bars, clubs, ships, and streets facilitate spread; local health centers have dispensed hundreds of antiviral medications. World Health Organization data show rising influenza activity in the Southern Hemisphere—Australia, New Zealand, Brazil, Chile—with co-circulation of influenza A and B strains. Travel from these regions to Greece raises importation risk to the Northern Hemisphere and informs Europe’s next-season vaccine composition. In Greece, Dr. Stamoula Tsikrika, pulmonologist at Sotiria Hospital and president of the Union of Pulmonologists of Greece, notes summer respiratory infections can affect vulnerable groups; EOODY reports positivity below 10% to early July; no ICU admissions yet. A mild wave begins with youths, who spread the virus to friends and family after holidays. Symptoms: fever, myalgia, cough, pharyngitis, rhinitis, hoarseness, chest pain. Seek care if fever persists, productive cough, breathing difficulty, wheeze, or chest pain.

triage.headline_ja: 気温上昇にもかかわらず、今年もインフルエンザ患者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する通常の報道であり、主な発生地はギリシャ（対象国外）。重症例やICU入院もなく、ブラジル等は南半球の流行動向の参考情報として言及されているに過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はギリシャにおける夏季インフルエンザ流行。ブラジル・チリ・オーストラリア・ニュージーランドはWHOの南半球インフルエンザ活動データの文脈で言及されているのみで、これらの国での具体的な発生イベントの主題ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例本土傷寒！中部7旬婦無旅遊史發燒確診　42接觸者採檢出爐
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first locally transmitted typhoid fever! A 70-year-old woman in Central Taiwan with no travel history diagnosed after fever; 42 contacts tested.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's CDC reported the year's first locally transmitted typhoid fever case, a woman in her 70s from Central Taiwan with chronic illness and no recent travel history. She developed fever and diarrhea in mid‑July, was hospitalized, and laboratory testing confirmed typhoid; she has since been discharged home. Investigations identified 42 contacts; three cohabitants and one symptomatic contact were tested, with all four results negative, and ongoing health monitoring and education provided. This year Taiwan has four typhoid cases (one local, three imported); since 2022, 40 total cases (11 local, 29 imported), predominantly aged 20–39, with Indonesia the leading source of imported cases (22). Typhoid incubation is typically 8–14 days; symptoms include fever, headache, diarrhea. Transmission is fecal‑oral via contaminated food or water. Public guidance emphasizes boiled or bottled water, fully cooked foods, avoiding cross‑contamination, and proper hand hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初の国内感染腸チフス！中部在住70代女性が渡航歴なしで発熱・確診　接触者42名を検査
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における単発の国内感染腸チフス症例であり、接触者の検査結果は全て陰性、対象国（台湾は対象外）にも該当せず、社会的関心や国際的拡大リスクも低い。
triage.notes: 台湾はGeoNames対象国リストに含まれない。インドネシアは輸入症例の主要な起源国として言及されているが、本イベント自体はインドネシアで発生したものではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief says Ebola outbreak is outpacing response as aid workers strike over pay
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to outpace response, with WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warning that new cases are doubling in hot spots nearly three months after the outbreak began in mid-May. In Kinshasa remarks, he urged rapid scale-up across all response pillars as aid workers in Ituri province strike over delayed wages. The outbreak has reached 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths as of Monday, per Congo's Ministry of Health. Ituri houses the epicenter, where frontline workers' strikes have hampered healthcare in a region already unsettled by rebel conflict and proximity to South Sudan, Uganda, and Rwanda. While some workers say payments resumed for work done since the start, many call for improved pay. The situation underscores ongoing challenges in outbreak containment, including access to affected communities and security constraints.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ出血熱の流行が対応を上回っていると警告、援助従事者は賃金未払いでストライキ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例・死者数が急増し(3,874例、1,751人死亡)、WHO事務局長が対応の遅れを警告。援助従事者のストライキや治安不安により封じ込めが困難な状況で、国際的拡大リスクもあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、南スーダン、ルワンダは近接地域として言及されているのみで、実際の感染確認地域ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。イトゥリ州が流行の中心地。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo halts passenger boat outside Kinshasa over suspected Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola virus disease case prompts vessel interception near Kinshasa, DR Congo, on 2026-08-06. A passenger boat from outbreak-hit Tshopo province was halted about 65 km from central Kinshasa after a former passenger who disembarked in Mongala developed fever and diarrhea and subsequently died. The alert concerns a suspected, not confirmed, case; a mobile laboratory tested all passengers and crew and a security/health cordon was established around the vessel. Kinshasa, a megacity of about 20 million, has no confirmed Ebola cases and is not among the five affected provinces. The action coincides with a high-level meeting chaired by President Felix Tshisekedi with WHO Director-General Tedros and Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya to strengthen response, protect health workers, and improve case detection. Doctors Without Borders warns eastern DRC outbreak is accelerating; 3,973 confirmed cases, 1,801 deaths, 776 recoveries since May 15.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ、キンシャサ近郊でエボラ疑い例発生を受け旅客船を停止
triage.triage_reason: 既存の大規模エボラ流行（確定3,973例、死亡1,801例）が首都キンシャサ近郊にまで拡大する可能性を示す疑い例が発生し、渡航制限措置（船舶停止）も取られており、IHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 疑い例は未確定だが、既に加速中とされる東部DRCのエボラ流行の一環であり、大統領・WHO事務局長・Africa CDC事務局長による高官級会合も開催されるなど、社会的・政治的関心が非常に高い事案。キンシャサでの確定例はまだない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 快新聞／國內出現今年首例本土傷寒　中部70多歲女性確診 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: This year's first locally transmitted typhoid fever case in the country; a woman in her 70s in Central Taiwan has been diagnosed.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, Taiwan reports its first locally transmitted typhoid fever case of the year: a woman in her 70s in Central Taiwan with chronic illness, no recent travel. She developed fever and diarrhea in mid-July, was hospitalized, and is lab-confirmed for Salmonella Typhi; she has been discharged home. Investigations identified 3 cohabitants and 42 related contacts; one contact had diarrhea. Three cohabitants and one symptomatic contact were tested; all results were negative; authorities continue hygiene education and monitoring. Year-to-date, four typhoid cases: one locally transmitted, three imported; local cases this year mirror 2022–2025 ranges (1–3). Since 2022, Taiwan has 40 cases: 11 locally transmitted, 29 imported, with most patients aged 20–39; Indonesia accounts for 22 imported cases. Typhoid is caused by Salmonella Typhi; incubation 8–14 days (3–60); transmission via contaminated food or water; symptoms include fever, headache, malaise, abdominal pain, diarrhea, and possibly trunk rash. Preventive measures: boil water, fully cook foods, and proper hand hygiene; suspected cases should seek care and report dietary history within 24 hours; consult 1922 or the Taiwan CDC site for information.

triage.headline_ja: 速報／国内で今年初の本土感染腸チフス症例　台湾中部の70代女性が確定診断
triage.triage_reason: 台湾中部で発生した単発の腸チフス症例であり、接触者の検査は陰性、例年の発生数の範囲内であるため公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。対象国（台湾は対象外、インドネシアは輸入症例の由来国として言及されるのみで発生国ではない）にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。インドネシアは過去の輸入症例の出身国として言及されているのみで、今回のイベント発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak to record over 4,000 cases
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo species, surpassed 4,000 cases by late July, making it the largest in the country and the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic after West Africa's 2014-16 crisis (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone). Delayed detection, overwhelmed surveillance, ongoing conflict, and no licensed vaccine or proven treatment for Bundibugyo have allowed transmission to outrun containment. The 2018-2020 Congo outbreak had 3,481 cases and 2,299 deaths; this outbreak reached 2,000 confirmed cases in roughly two months, and within three months of declaration. May declaration followed months of undetected spread, with early cases misdiagnosed as peritonitis and tests for the wrong Ebola species; Kinshasa samples were mishandled. A July Science report estimated the outbreak began as early as January near Mongbwalu. About 80% of new infections occur outside known transmission chains; aid cuts and funding shortfalls, plus displacement and cross-border movement, hinder response, including attacks on health facilities.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最速で拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行、症例数4,000人超を記録へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ種）の症例数が4,000人を超え、同国史上最大かつ西アフリカ危機以降で最速の流行となっており、ワクチン未承認・治療法未確立、越境移動や紛争による対応困難さから国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネは2014-16年西アフリカ流行との比較対象として言及されているのみで、今回の流行地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ種であること、80%が既知の感染経路外での感染である点が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: واشنطن تعلن تمويلًا إضافيًّا بقيمة 242 مليون دولار لمواجهة تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Washington announces an additional $242 million in funding to combat the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On August 6, 2026, the United States announced more than $242 million in additional funding to combat the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), as the country faces a new transmission wave. This funding advances a pledge made at the June G7 summit to provide up to $500 million more for international Ebola response. With this add, total direct U.S. assistance to the outbreak surpasses $512 million, alongside $350 million in emergency humanitarian aid allocated to the DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda. The funds will expand health and humanitarian interventions and bolster coordination with governments, humanitarian organizations, and private-sector partners to contain the outbreak. The U.S. reiterated calls for other international donors to increase contributions to help eradicate Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱の流行対策のために2億4200万ドルの追加資金拠出を発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での新たな感染拡大に対し米国が大規模追加支援を発表しており、IHR基準（深刻性・国際的拡大リスク）を2つ以上満たすためフルリスク評価に進める。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの新たな感染拡大（new transmission wave）に対する米国の資金支援を報じている。南スーダン・ウガンダは人道支援対象として言及されているが、感染拡大の主題国ではないため対象国リストに含めない。米国は対象国外のため除外。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Symptoms Of H1N1 Virus: Day-1 Warning Signs That Differentiate It From A Common Cold
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, H1N1 (swine flu) cases are reported globally and in India per the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC); ongoing surveillance of this seasonal influenza is essential to manage the health burden and cluster spread. Day-1 symptoms include sudden high fever (>100°F/37.8°C), severe body aches, chills, persistent headache, dry cough, sore throat, runny or stuffy nose, fatigue, and loss of appetite. While some symptoms overlap with the common cold, H1N1 is marked by abrupt fever, more intense body aches, fatigue, and chills. The article lists symptoms that may suggest H1N1—sudden-onset illness, high fever, severe weakness, body pain, chest discomfort, and persistent cough—and warns red flags requiring medical attention: difficulty breathing, persistent chest pain, blue lips/face, confusion, severe dehydration, or worsening after initial improvement. It references a 2009 outbreak and notes higher-risk groups, though detailed risk factors are not provided in the excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1ウイルスの症状：一般的な風邪と区別する初日の警告サイン
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の一般的な症状解説記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の重大な影響を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事は健康情報・症状解説を目的とした一般向け記事であり、具体的な発生数・アウトブレイク情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例！中部70歲女確診本土傷寒　45人健康監測
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First case of the year! A 70-year-old woman in the Central region diagnosed with domestic typhoid fever; 45 people under health surveillance.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, Taiwan’s Centers for Disease Control reports the year’s first domestically acquired typhoid fever case: a woman in her 70s in the Central region with chronic illness, no recent domestic or international travel. She developed fever and diarrhea in mid-July, was hospitalized, and laboratory confirmation confirmed typhoid; she has since been discharged. A household of three and 42 related contacts are under health surveillance, with one symptomatic contact. Tests were completed for three household members and the symptomatic contact; all four results were negative, and authorities continue hygiene and food-safety education. Nationally, four typhoid cases have been confirmed in 2026 (1 domestic, 3 imported). Since 2022, Taiwan has reported 40 cases (11 domestic, 29 imported), mostly aged 20–39; imported cases include 22 from Indonesia. Typhoid, caused by Salmonella Typhi, spreads via contaminated food or water; incubation typically 8–14 days (range 3–60). Prevention emphasizes boiled water, fully cooked foods, and hand hygiene; seek care and report dietary history; 24-hour reporting required.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初の症例！台湾中部の70歳女性が国内感染の腸チフスと確診、45人が健康監視下に
triage.triage_reason: 台湾国内での単発の腸チフス症例であり、接触者の検査は陰性、重症例や拡大の兆候もなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 台湾はモニタリング対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。インドネシアは過去の輸入症例の出身地として言及されているのみで、現時点での発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 男子野外钓鱼后多器官衰竭病危 恙虫病险夺命
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man in critical condition with multi-organ failure after outdoor fishing; scrub typhus nearly claimed his life.
article.articleSummary: Scrub typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi) caused a life-threatening illness in a 56-year-old man (Mr. Huang) in Wuhan, China, after outdoor fishing and field work. He developed dizziness, periorbital discomfort, and a fever up to 40°C, progressing to extensive bilateral pneumonia, septic shock, and multi-organ failure. Despite broad-spectrum antibiotics and antivirals, his condition worsened, requiring mechanical ventilation and vasopressors. At Tongji Hospital (Huazhong University of Science and Technology), laboratory tests showed hypotension, thrombocytopenia, hepatic injury, pleural effusion, and cardiac dysfunction. Bronchoalveolar lavage fluid gene testing confirmed Orientia tsutsugamushi infection, i.e., scrub typhus, a pathogen that often mimics influenza or cold in early stages and is notoriously difficult to diagnose promptly. The case highlights the need to consider scrub typhus in febrile patients with pneumonia and shock after outdoor exposure and to initiate targeted therapy promptly to avert organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: 男性が野外釣り後に多臓器不全で重体、恙虫病が一時は命を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: 武漢における恙虫病（つつが虫病）の単発個別症例報告であり、アウトブレイクや異常な流行を示す情報はなく、社会的・政治的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 恙虫病はダニ媒介性の風土病であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はしない。単一患者の重症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態やアウトブレイクを示唆する内容ではないため、対象国リストの中国での発生は確認されるが、シグナルとしては見送り（DISMISS）と判断。

article.articleHeadline: 快訊／今年首例！中部7旬女「發燒、腹瀉」染本土傷寒 42接觸者健康監測
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: First case of the year! A woman in her 70s from Central Taiwan with fever and diarrhea contracted locally acquired typhoid fever; health monitoring for 42 contacts.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports this year’s first domestically confirmed typhoid fever case: a woman in her 70s with chronic illness in Central Taiwan, with no recent domestic or international travel. She developed fever and diarrhea in mid-July; diagnosis confirmed by stool testing after four days of symptoms and hospitalization. She recovered and was discharged August 5. Contact tracing identified 3 cohabitants and 42 related contacts; one contact had diarrhea symptoms. Three cohabitants and one symptomatic contact were tested; all results were negative. Public health authorities continue health monitoring and hygiene education for contacts, including food safety and hand hygiene. Nationally this year there are 4 confirmed typhoid cases (1 domestic, 3 imported). Since 2022, Taiwan has 40 total cases (11 domestic, 29 imported), with ages 20–39 most affected and Indonesia the source for 22 imported cases. Typhoid is caused by Salmonella Typhi; incubation typically 8–14 days, transmitted via contaminated food or water, with fever, malaise, abdominal pain, and diarrhea as common symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 速報／今年初例！台湾中部の70代女性が「発熱・下痢」で国内感染の腸チフスに罹患、接触者42人を健康観察
triage.triage_reason: 台湾国内での単発の腸チフス症例で、接触者検査は陰性、患者も回復・退院しており、拡大の兆候はない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれず、また事例自体も散発的で公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアを輸入症例の由来国として言及しているが、今回の事例自体は台湾国内感染であり、インドネシアでの発生ではないため verified_locations には含めない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: НАЈГОЛЕМА ЕПИДЕМИЈА ВО ИСТОРИЈАТА НА КОНГО - Трамп итно одвојува уште 242 милиони долари за борба со еболата
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Biggest Epidemic in Congo's History – Trump Urgently Allocates Another $242 Million to Fight Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-06, the Trump administration plans to allocate an additional $242 million to fight the Ebola outbreak in Africa, pending Congressional approval, to curb the epidemic, bolster regional preparedness, and provide humanitarian aid. The funds follow commitments made at the June G7 summit and would lift direct U.S. Ebola assistance to over $512 million. In a broader package, Washington also unveiled about $350 million in humanitarian aid for the Democratic Republic of Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda as part of a $1.8 billion UN OCHA response. Ebola, a highly infectious virus spread through direct contact with infected people or their bodily fluids, remains frequently fatal. MSF says the eastern DRC outbreak is the largest in the country’s history, with over 3,600 lab-confirmed cases and roughly 1,500 deaths over nearly two and a half months.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ史上最大の流行 – トランプ政権がエボラ対策に2億4200万ドルを緊急追加拠出
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で同国史上最大規模のエボラ流行（確定症例3,600超、死者約1,500人）が発生しており、米国が2億4200万ドルの追加支援を決定するなど国際的関心・対応が高まっているため。
triage.notes: 記事は資金拠出に関する内容が中心だが、根拠となるエボラ流行はDRC東部で発生。ウガンダ・南スーダンへの人道支援は言及されているが、これらは疾患発生国としてではなく資金配分先として記載されているため verified_locations には含めていない。米国は資金拠出国であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: World's fastest-growing Ebola outbreak is spreading faster
article.articleSummary: World’s fastest-growing Ebola outbreak is in Congo’s Ituri province, with 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths as of Aug 6, nearly three months after mid-May declaration. New cases are doubling in some hotspots, as the outbreak outpaces response. Frontline workers in Ituri have gone on strike over pay, reducing access to care in a remote area near South Sudan, Uganda and Rwanda. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Kinshasa, urging urgent, scaled-up action across all response pillars. The U.S. State Department has added $242 million for immediate Ebola response and preparedness, bringing total direct assistance to over $512 million. The outbreak is the second-largest on record and the fastest-transmitting Ebola outbreak, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: 世界最速で拡大するエボラ流行がさらに加速
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大速度、国境地帯での国際的拡大リスク）に加え、WHO・米国が緊急対応を強化しており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 発生地域に米国・スーダン・アンゴラ・ルワンダ・ウガンダが含まれるが、記事主題はDRC・イツリ州でのアウトブレイクであり、これら周辺国は接触・国境リスクとして言及されているに過ぎないため、verified_locationsからは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例本土傷寒！中部70多歲女「發燒、腹瀉」確診 感染源不明
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first locally transmitted case of typhoid fever! A woman in her 70s in Central Taiwan diagnosed with fever and diarrhea; source of infection unknown.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first locally transmitted typhoid fever case this year: a woman in her 70s with chronic illness in Central Taiwan, with no recent travel history. She developed fever and diarrhea in mid‑July, was hospitalized, and stool culture confirmed Salmonella Typhi; she has since recovered at home. Investigations identified three cohabitants and 42 related contacts; one contact had diarrhea. Three cohabitants and one symptomatic contact were tested; all results were negative; authorities continue surveillance and hygiene education. Domestic typhoid cases this year total four (one locally transmitted, three imported). Since 2022 Taiwan has recorded 40 typhoid cases (11 locally, 29 imported), with imported cases mainly from Indonesia (22). Typhoid is a second-class infectious disease caused by Salmonella Typhi, incubation 8–14 days, transmitted via contaminated food or water. Symptoms include persistent fever, headache, fatigue, abdominal pain, diarrhea; seek medical care and report dietary history; public health line 1922.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初の国内感染腸チフス症例！台湾中部の70代女性が発熱・下痢で確診、感染源不明
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での単発の国内感染腸チフス症例であり、接触者調査も陰性で管理下にある。対象国での発生でもなく、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。インドネシアは輸入症例の過去の由来国として言及されているのみで、今回のイベント（台湾中部での国内感染症例）はインドネシアで発生したものではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : un bateau isolé à 65 km de Kinshasa, un laboratoire mobile
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: an isolated boat 65 km from Kinshasa, a mobile laboratory.
article.articleSummary: On Aug 5, 2026, Congolese authorities reported a suspected Ebola case after a boat from Tshopo was intercepted near Kinshasa. A passenger who disembarked at Pimu in Mongala province (over 1,200 km from Kinshasa) developed fever and diarrhea before dying at a local health center. Officials stressed no definitive Ebola diagnosis has been made and urged calm. A mobile laboratory was deployed to test all passengers, with the National Biomedical Research Institute (INRB) and Prof. Jean-Jacques Muyembe mobilized to strengthen screening and contact tracing. The vessel remains about 65 kilometers from Kinshasa as a precaution, and other boats were being evacuated after screening. No additional deaths were reported at the time, and results were not yet available; authorities warned against misinformation and pledged to announce findings when available.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：キンシャサから65km地点で船舶を隔離、移動検査室を展開
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の疑い例が確認され死亡例も発生、コンゴ民主共和国当局が緊急対応（移動検査室展開、接触者追跡）を実施しており、ヒト-ヒト感染や拡大のリスクが懸念されるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 確定診断はまだ出ておらず疑い例の段階。船舶の乗客は複数州（Tshopo、Mongala、Kinshasa）にまたがって移動しており、感染拡大の地理的リスクが高い。検査結果の続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例本土傷寒　感染源不明
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first locally transmitted typhoid fever case; source of infection unknown.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first locally transmitted typhoid fever case this year. A woman in central Taiwan, in her 70s with no recent travel, developed fever and diarrhea in mid-July and was hospitalized after Salmonella Typhi was confirmed. She sought emergency care four days after onset; stool testing detected the pathogen. Investigations identified three cohabitants and 42 contacts; one contact had diarrhea symptoms. Testing of the three cohabitants and the symptomatic contact was negative, and authorities provided health education and ongoing monitoring for contacts, plus food-safety and hand-hygiene guidance. This year four confirmed typhoid cases in Taiwan: one local, three imported. Since 2022, Taiwan has 40 cases (11 local, 29 imported), with imported cases mainly from Indonesia (22). Typhoid has an 8–14 day incubation and is transmitted via contaminated food or water. Guidance includes boiled or bottled water, fully cooked foods, and reporting within 24 hours.

article.articleHeadline: Congo: aantal bevestigde ebolagevallen stijgt tot bijna 4000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: number of confirmed Ebola cases rises to nearly 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo have risen to 3,973, with 1,801 deaths, according to government data reported on Aug 5, 2026. The outbreak is the second-largest ever recorded, surpassed only by West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic. The United States government announced an additional $242 million (roughly €209 million) in humanitarian aid to bolster the response, including relief operations and medical support for affected communities. The update highlights the ongoing scale of the Ebola crisis in the DRC and the continued international funding committed to mitigate morbidity and mortality. The figures reflect confirmed cases and fatalities reported by authorities, reinforcing the need for sustained public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ確定症例数が約4,000人に増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ確定症例が約4,000人、死亡者1,801人に達し、史上2番目の規模の流行となっており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的な人道支援が確認されているためフルRRAに進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 米国から2.42億ドルの追加人道支援が発表されており、国際的な関心と支援の必要性が高い。アンゴラ・米国は発生地域として付与されているが、記事の主題はDRCの流行であるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 感染源不明！中部7旬婦燒瀉住院 竟今年首例本土傷寒 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unknown source of infection! Central Taiwan woman in her 70s hospitalized for vomiting and diarrhea, the year's first locally acquired typhoid fever case.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's first locally acquired typhoid fever case of the year: a woman in her 70s from central Taiwan with chronic illness, no recent domestic or international travel. In mid-July she developed fever and diarrhea, was hospitalized after four days, and stool testing confirmed Salmonella Typhi infection; the infection source remains unknown. Four typhoid cases have been confirmed in Taiwan this year—one local and three imported. Since 2022, Taiwan has recorded 40 cases (11 local, 29 imported), with imported cases mainly from Indonesia (22). The patient was discharged on August 5 after clinical improvement. Typhoid typically has an 8–14 day incubation (range 3–60 days) and spreads via contaminated food or water from carriers or patients. Public health guidance stresses boiling drinking water, thoroughly cooking food, avoiding cross-contamination, and proper hand hygiene. Contact tracing included 3 cohabitants and 42 related contacts, of which four tested negative.

article.articleHeadline: 國內驚見今年首例本土傷寒！中部女發燒、腹瀉染疫　常見症狀、傳染途徑一次看
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first locally acquired typhoid fever case detected in the country! A Central Taiwan woman contracted typhoid fever, presenting with fever and diarrhea — common symptoms and transmission routes at a glance.
article.articleSummary: Typhoid fever, caused by Salmonella Typhi, was locally acquired in Taiwan this year for the first time: a Central Taiwan woman with fever and diarrhea. Investigations identified 3 cohabiting relatives and 42 related contacts; 4 people (3 household members and 1 symptomatic contact) were tested, all negative. Health authorities are monitoring contacts and reinforcing food and hand hygiene. This year Taiwan has 4 confirmed typhoid cases: 1 locally acquired and 3 imported. Since 2022, Taiwan has 40 cases (11 locally, 29 imported), with most patients aged 20–39; imported cases include 22 from Indonesia. Typhoid is a Class 2 notifiable disease; incubation is 8–14 days (range 3–60). Transmission is via contaminated food or water from feces/urine; symptoms include persistent fever, headache, malaise, abdominal pain, diarrhea, and sometimes rash or bradycardia. Prevention emphasizes boiled or bottled water, fully cooked foods, avoiding cross-contamination, and proper handwashing.

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết ở TPHCM tăng mạnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever surges in Ho Chi Minh City.
article.articleSummary: Week 30, 2026 (20–26 July) recorded 995 dengue cases in Ho Chi Minh City, up 20% from the prior four weeks; year-to-date total 23,481, up 23.9% versus 2025. Highest incidence districts: An Nhơn Tây, Chánh Phú Hòa, and Ngãi Giao. HFMD remained stable with 1,050 new cases in Week 30, bringing the cumulative total to 27,289. Areas with HFMD counts exceeding 100,000 population include Con Dao, Bình Khánh, and Hiệp Phước. COVID-19 showed no unusual surge; hospitalizations were stable and symptoms mild, especially in older adults or those with comorbidities; no respiratory support needed. Genomic surveillance in July 2026 found NB.1.8.1 (SV.1.1 and RK.1) as the dominant variant, followed by XFG.1.1, with no evidence of increased virulence per WHO. Prevention emphasizes dengue vaccination, environmental cleaning, eliminating standing water, larval control, and mosquito avoidance; HFMD prevention follows the “3 clean” rule; seek care for symptomatic children.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市でデング熱が急増
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市でデング熱症例数が前年比23.9%増加しているが、季節性の流行拡大の範囲内であり、重症例や死亡の急増、異常な変異株等の報告はない。手足口病・COVID-19は安定的推移で特段の異常なし。
triage.notes: 定例の週次サーベイランス報告であり、デング熱の増加傾向は媒介蚊対策の強化余地はあるものの、現時点で国際的懸念や渡航制限等のリスクは認められない。今後の増加トレンドを注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: مدير عام منظمة الصحة العالمية: تفشي إيبولا يتجاوز سرعة الاستجابة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General: Ebola outbreak outpaces the response.
article.articleSummary: Global health leader says Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest in the world, outpacing response efforts, during a Kinshasa visit amid a health workers strike over pay. About three months after mid-May's emergence, new Ebola cases are rising in the hardest-hit areas. This is Ghebreyesus' second visit since the outbreak was declared. He called for an urgent, massive scale-up of the response across all pillars and with all partners. Congolese Ministry of Health data show 3,874 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,751 deaths as of last Monday. The remarks underline the urgent need for intensified surveillance, patient care, and international support to reverse the transmission trajectory.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長:エボラ出血熱の流行は対応速度を上回っている
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が緊急対応の大規模拡大を要請するほどの深刻なエボラ流行であり、確認症例3,874例・死亡1,751例と大規模で、国際的拡大・対応不足のリスクが高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長自らキンシャサを訪問し、対応の遅れと医療従事者のストライキが流行拡大に影響していると指摘。致死率は約45%と高い。

article.articleHeadline: MSF warns Ebola outbreak in DR Congo worsens as cases near 4,000
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies. DR Congo Health Ministry reports 3,973 lab-confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths; MSF notes WHO figures of 3,605 confirmed cases as of Aug 1, marking the largest Ebola epidemic in the country’s history, surpassing 2018. The outbreak began May 15, with WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days later. Transmission shows no signs of slowing, with new infections nearly daily and spread into areas outside known transmission chains. Seven Ebola treatment centers and over 15 isolation wards (capacity >480 beds) are operated by MSF, which has deployed 1,400+ staff and treated 1,362 patients, including 554 lab-confirmed cases with 282 recoveries. MSF urges expanded international response and removal of access barriers; no information on imported/exported cases is provided. WHO Director-General Tedros to visit Kinshasa to discuss containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が悪化し症例数が4000人近くに達したと警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻性・異常性など複数該当し、PHEIC宣言済みかつ過去最大規模の流行であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOはすでにPHEICを宣言しており、コンゴ史上最大規模のエボラ流行と報告されている。国際的な症例輸出の情報は記事中に明記されていないため国際拡大の実態は不明点あり。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS afirmó que el brote de ébola en África está superando la capacidad de respuesta para combatirlo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO said that the Ebola outbreak in Africa is exceeding its capacity to respond and combat it.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri near borders with South Sudan, Uganda, and Rwanda, has 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths to date. The Bundibugyo virus is responsible; there is no approved treatment or vaccine. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Kinshasa, warned the outbreak is spreading faster than control measures can respond, making it the second-largest on record after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (over 28,000 cases, >11,000 deaths). MSF says transmission is accelerating and the response is not yet rapid enough to interrupt chains. Health-worker strikes over pay have hindered access, though some payments began last week. The United States has added $242 million in funding, bringing total aid to more than $512 million. Case fatality rate around 45%; in the last 24 hours, 77 new cases and 44 deaths; 717 isolated, 749 recovered. Contact tracing appears ineffective for 60–70% of new cases; authorities stress early detection and community engagement.

article.articleHeadline: US pledges additional Sh31bn for East Africa Ebola Response
article.articleSummary: The United States pledged an additional $242 million (about Sh31.2 billion) to Ebola response and preparedness in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda, and neighboring East African countries. Announced by the State Department and CDC, the funds will bolster surveillance, detection, isolation and treatment, border screening, health facility strengthening, and humanitarian support amid the ongoing DRC outbreak and Uganda’s swift response. With this pledge, U.S. assistance dedicated to the outbreak now exceeds $512 million, following a G7 commitment of up to $500 million. To date, programs have supported 8.6 million health screenings, reached over 1 million people with messaging, strengthened more than 180 facilities, and operated 12 specialised Ebola treatment centres in the DRC. Nearly 300 metric tonnes of supplies have been distributed, and 11 laboratories have boosted diagnostics. A Level 4 Do Not Travel advisory remains for the DRC, Uganda and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、東アフリカのエボラ対応に追加で312億シリング（約2億4200万ドル）を拠出

triage.notes: 記事はDRCで進行中のエボラ流行に対する米国の資金支援に関する内容。ウガンダ、スーダン、モザンビーク、米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。既知の流行に対する追加支援報道であり新規発生シグナルではないが、国際的な資金・関心の高まりを示すためPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City Proactively Implements Epidemic Control Measures.
article.articleSummary: Week 31 (27 July–2 August 2026) in Ho Chi Minh City recorded 1,130 dengue cases, up 20% from the four-week average; year-to-date dengue totals reach 24,651. Surveillance by Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City shows the southern region at 53,428 dengue cases, up 38.9% year-on-year. Dengue activity is rising in Đồng Nai City and Tây Ninh; in Ho Chi Minh City, high-incidence localities include An Nhơn Tây commune, Minh Thạnh commune, and Chánh Phú Hòa Ward. Hand, foot, and mouth disease numbered 1,012 cases in Week 31 and remains broadly stable. Covid-19 surveillance shows no unusual changes; hospitalizations are stable with no severe cases or deaths. July 2026 sequencing identifies NB.1.8.1 and XFG.1.1 (XFG), sublineages of Omicron, under close monitoring. Authorities advocate mosquito control, personal/environment hygiene, the '3 clean' rule, masking when needed, vaccination for high-risk groups, and prompt care if symptoms arise.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、疫病対策措置を積極的に実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱がベトナム南部で前年比38.9%増加し流行拡大傾向にあるが、重症例・死亡の急増や医療逼迫の報告はなく、COVID-19も安定しているため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱の症例数増加が主題。COVID-19は新規変異株（NB.1.8.1、XFG.1.1）の監視中だが、重症化や異常な変化はないと明記されている。当局が既に対策を主導的に実施しており、外部支援の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: AIDS 2026 spotlights Fiji - responding to the fastest-growing epidemic in the world - Doherty Institute
article.articleSummary: Fiji was spotlighted at AIDS 2026 in Rio as hosting the fastest-growing HIV epidemic globally. Across Asia and the Pacific, new infections rose 2010–2024, and Fiji’s MOHMS declared a national outbreak in early 2025. The Fiji HIV Surveillance Report 2025 records 2,016 new HIV diagnoses in 2025—the highest annual figure since 1989—with 67% in people aged 20–34. UNAIDS estimates 1.6% prevalence among 15–49-year-olds (about 1 in 60). Fiji rapidly expanded prevention and care: rapid PrEP rollout, enhanced peer outreach, stronger condom programs, and HIV care integrated into 15 of 21 primary healthcare facilities; vertical transmission estimated at 18% in 2025. Ongoing gaps include absence of needle-and-syringe programs. The response has strong political backing and international support from Australia, New Zealand and India; Australia pledged A$48 million for Fiji and Pacific programming.

triage.headline_ja: AIDS 2026がフィジーに注目 ― 世界最速で拡大するHIV流行への対応
triage.triage_reason: フィジーで国家的HIVアウトブレイクが宣言され、1989年以降で最多の新規診断数を記録するなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な状況であり、国際的な支援も動員されているためフルRRAが妥当。
triage.notes: 主題の発生国はフィジーであり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には含まれないためverified_locationsは空。ブラジル（リオ）はAIDS 2026会議開催地、インドは支援国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo: As Ebola child deaths pass 300, UNICEF warns outbreak also threatens essential health services
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ituri Province Ebola outbreak reaches record levels with 743 confirmed child cases and 330 child deaths (0–17) as of 2 August 2026. Children under five have a case fatality rate more than double adults. Ongoing disruption and fear have slashed essential health services by 42% in outbreak hotspots (Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nizi, Rwampara) April–June 2026, and 13%. Routine vaccines fell: first-dose measles −69% in Mongbwalu; pentavalent third dose −22%; second measles dose −18%, with 23,000 fewer doses May–June. Facility-delivered births declined 13%; declines up to 70% in Nizi; first antenatal visits down ~28% in hotspots. No comparable seasonal decline in 2025. UNICEF and partners trained ~13,000 frontline actors, reached 2.4 million people, and carried out 505,000 household visits; supplied IPC kits to eight Ebola treatment centers and 45 facilities; mental health support for 21,000+ people. UNICEF revised six-month appeal to US$113.45 million, with US$23.5 million mobilized and US$89.9 million gap.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラによる子供の死者数が300人を超え、UNICEFはアウトブレイクが基本的な保健サービスも脅かしていると警告
triage.triage_reason: イツリ州のエボラ流行が記録的水準に達し、子供の死者330人・確定症例743人と重大な公衆衛生影響があり、基本保健サービスの著しい低下（麻疹ワクチン接種率-69%等）と国際的な資金不足（$89.9M）を伴うため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にルワンダ（Kigali Province等）が含まれるが、記事本文では感染拡大の記述はなくDRC国内（イツリ州）の状況のみが主題であるため、ルワンダはverified_locationsから除外した。また麻疹はワクチン接種率低下の文脈で言及されているのみで、主要な感染症イベントはエボラである。

article.articleHeadline: 感染源不明！中部7旬婦燒瀉住院 竟今年首例本土傷寒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unknown source of infection! Central Taiwan woman in her seventies hospitalized with fever and diarrhea — the year's first locally acquired typhoid fever.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports the year's first locally acquired typhoid fever case in Central Taiwan. A woman in her seventies with chronic illness developed fever and diarrhea in mid-July; four days later she sought urgent care, was hospitalized, and stool testing confirmed Salmonella Typhi infection. She recovered and was discharged on Aug 5; she has no domestic or international travel history, and the infection source remains unknown. Four close contacts were tested; all negative. This year Taiwan has four typhoid confirmations: 1 local and 3 imported. Since 2022, Taiwan has 40 total cases (11 local, 29 imported), with imports led by Indonesia (22). Typhoid transmission occurs via contaminated food or water; incubation typically 8–14 days (range 3–60 days). Symptoms include fever, diarrhea, abdominal pain. Public health guidance emphasizes boiled or bottled water, thorough cooking, avoiding cross-contamination, and strict hand hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 感染源不明！中部在住70代女性が発熱・下痢で入院 ― 今年初の本土感染性腸チフス症例
triage.triage_reason: 感染源不明の単発の本土感染チフス症例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は限定的だが、感染経路が特定されていない点で継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 対象国リストに台湾は含まれないため verified_locations は空。インドネシアは過去の輸入症例の由来として言及されているのみで、本イベントの発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 國內驚見今年首例本土傷寒！中部女發燒、腹瀉染疫　常見症狀、傳染途徑一次看
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first locally transmitted typhoid fever case in the country! A Central Taiwan woman with fever and diarrhea contracted the infection — common symptoms and transmission routes at a glance.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first locally transmitted typhoid fever case in 2026: a woman in her 70s from Central Taiwan with chronic illness, no recent domestic or overseas travel. In mid‑July she developed fever and diarrhea, was hospitalized, and laboratory confirmation followed; she has since recovered and been discharged. Investigations identified 3 cohabitants and 42 related contacts; 4 people (3 cohabitants and 1 symptomatic contact) were tested and all results were negative; health education and monitoring are ongoing. This year Taiwan records 4 confirmed typhoid cases, including 1 local and 3 imported; since 2022 the country has had 40 cases (11 local, 29 imported), with Indonesia the primary source of imported cases (22). Typhoid is caused by Salmonella Typhi; incubation typically 8–14 days (range 3–60). Transmission is via contaminated food or water; symptoms include fever, headache, fatigue, loss of appetite, abdominal pain, diarrhea, and sometimes trunk rash or relative bradycardia. Prevention emphasizes boiled or bottled water, fully cooked food, avoidance of cross-contamination, and rigorous hand hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 国内で今年初の本土感染腸チフス症例！台湾中部の女性が発熱・下痢で感染――よくある症状と感染経路のまとめ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾国内での単発の本土感染腸チフス症例であり、接触者の検査は全て陰性、患者も回復・退院済みで管理下にある。対象国（台湾は対象外）にも該当せず、国際的拡大懸念も低い。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドネシアは過去の輸入症例の由来地として言及されているのみで、今回の本土感染イベントの発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Bàn giải pháp ngăn chặn dịch bệnh trên đàn vật nuôi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Discussing solutions to prevent disease outbreaks in livestock.
article.articleSummary: Quang Ngai Province, Vietnam, is intensifying anti-disease measures as African swine fever (ASF) spreads among livestock. Since the start of 2026, ASF-affected households reached 243 in 86 hamlets across 34 communes/wards, with 1,611 pigs infected, dead, or culled, and over 96.6 tons disposed. From early July to Aug 4, outbreaks expanded to 178 households in 19 communes, triggering the culling of 1,076 pigs and disposal of more than 59.2 tons. Outbreaks mainly involve smallholders with weak biosecurity. A highly virulent recombinant ASFV genotype I/II (rASFV I/II) complicates control and may reduce vaccine effectiveness. Other diseases include bovine lumpy skin disease (55 cases in 48 households across 19 communes; 36 cattle culled) and rabies (10 dogs culled; outbreak in Kon Tum ward not yet ended). Authorities distributed hundreds of thousands of vaccine doses, 13,500 liters of disinfectants, and conducted training/sampling across 96 communes.

triage.headline_ja: 家畜の疫病拡散防止策を議論
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱の組換え株(rASFV I/II)の出現やランピースキン病・狂犬病の同時発生が見られるが、いずれも動物疾病でヒトへの直接的な公衆衛生影響は記載されておらず、国内の家畜管理問題に留まるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本イベントは家畜(豚・牛・犬)の疾病であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的影響は記事内で言及されていない。ASFVの組換え株出現によるワクチン効果低下の懸念は農業・畜産分野でのリスクとして注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: US to provide additional $242m for DRC, Uganda Ebola response
article.articleSummary: United States announces $242 million in additional Ebola funding for eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda, bringing direct Ebola assistance to more than $512 million. The funding supports surveillance, detection, treatment, border screening and community engagement across affected areas, with aims to bolster outbreak response and preparedness amid a highly complex outbreak in the region. Since outbreak onset, health systems are strained, requiring isolation facilities, strengthened lab capacity and large-scale distribution of protective equipment. Cross-border transmission risks have prompted heightened vigilance in Uganda, which has praised swift action to contain imported cases; authorities in the DRC warn that misinformation and insecurity continue to hamper response efforts. The package aligns with a G7 commitment to provide up to $500 million for Ebola response in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ対応に追加2億4200万ドルを拠出へ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のDRC・ウガンダにおける複雑な流行が継続し、国境を越えた感染拡大リスクと大規模な国際支援（米国追加拠出2.42億ドル）が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。国境を越えた感染拡大がDRC側の状況に直接関連するため、DRCのみを対象国として計上。

article.articleHeadline: Trump Plans $242M for Africa Ebola Response | Sada Elbalad
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, the Trump administration plans to allocate an additional $242 million to combat the Ebola outbreak in Africa, subject to Congressional consultations, to fund emergency response operations, strengthen regional preparedness, and provide humanitarian assistance. This would raise Washington's direct Ebola response funding to more than $512 million, following earlier commitments at the June G7 Summit. Separately, the State Department announced $350 million in humanitarian aid for the Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda, as part of a $1.8 billion package for the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs. Ebola is a highly infectious viral disease transmitted through direct contact with infected people or their bodily fluids and can be fatal.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ政権、アフリカのエボラ対応に2億4200万ドルを計画
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はDRCで進行中の致死的な流行であり、米国政府が追加の大規模資金拠出（2億4200万ドル、累計5億1200万ドル超）を計画するなど国際的な政治的関心・支援ニーズが顕著であるため、フルRRAでの確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は米国政府によるアフリカ（主にDRC）のエボラ対応への資金拠出計画に関する報道。南スーダン・ウガンダも言及されるが対象国リスト外のため除外。具体的な流行規模・感染者数・地理的拡大状況の詳細は記事内で不明。

article.articleHeadline: La RD Congo supera la barrera de los 1.800 muertos por ébola y se acerca a los 4.000 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo surpasses the 1,800-death toll from Ebola and approaches 4,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths as of August 4, 2026, with a case fatality rate of 45.3%. The bulletin reports 674 patients in isolation or hospitalized and 776 recoveries, while contact tracing stands at 75.3%. The outbreak was declared on May 15 in the east and data come from the Congolese Ministry of Communication. This snapshot underscores high mortality and ongoing transmission, requiring continued surveillance, isolation, and robust contact tracing to curb spread. No details are provided on the infection source or any imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者数1,800人の壁を超え、症例数4,000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で症例数約4,000人・致死率45.3%と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高いと判断される。
triage.notes: 致死率45.3%と高く、接触者追跡率75.3%にとどまることから引き続き拡大リスクが懸念される。国際的な感染拡大や渡航制限に関する情報は記事内になし。

article.articleHeadline: 54 Hewan Positif Rabies di Jembrana Bali, Desa Diminta Perbarui Data HPR, Cegah Penyebaran Virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 54 Rabies-Positive Animals in Jembrana, Bali; Villages Asked to Update HPR Data to Prevent the Spread of the Virus
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Jembrana Regency, Bali, involves 54 rabies-positive animals across five districts (Mendoyo 21; Negara 18; Melaya 5; Jembrana 5; Pekutatan 5) as authorities intensify control measures. A resident died under investigation for suspected rabies after reportedly being scratched by a rabies-transmitting cat. To curb spread, village authorities and adat communities are urged to coordinate with the Rabies Response Team (Tisira) to conduct ongoing data collection on rabies-transmitting animals (HPR). PKH head I Gusti Ngurah Putu Sugiarta says accurate HPR population data underpin targeted vaccination and help distinguish whether animals are wild or pets released by owners. Alongside mass vaccination and sterilization, continuous community reporting is encouraged to press down transmission and reduce bite cases. Releasing pets into the wild increases rabies risk, particularly where they may contact infected wild dogs.

triage.headline_ja: バリ州ジェンブラナで狂犬病陽性動物54頭、村落にHPRデータ更新を要請しウイルス拡散を防止
triage.triage_reason: 動物54頭の狂犬病陽性に加え、猫による咬傷後に住民が死亡（狂犬病疑い、調査中）しており、地域内でのヒト-動物間感染拡大リスクと行政の積極的対応（大量ワクチン接種・報告体制強化）が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 人の死亡例は狂犬病疑いで確定診断は不明。バリ島では狂犬病が地域的流行病として継続しており、国際的拡大リスクは低いが、地域内感染拡大と動物由来感染源の管理が課題。続報での確定診断・感染拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: إدارة ترامب تعتزم تخصيص 242 مليون دولار إضافية لمكافحة إيبولا في أفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Trump administration plans to allocate an additional $242 million to combat Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Africa: The U.S. Department of State plans an additional $242 million to aid Ebola response across Africa, pending Congressional consultation. Funds will support emergency response efforts, strengthen regional preparedness, and provide humanitarian assistance related to the outbreak. This follows commitments announced at the June G7 summit and would raise total direct U.S. Ebola assistance to over $512 million. Separately, $350 million in humanitarian aid will be provided to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda. The funding is part of an earlier package worth $8.1 billion for the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs, targeting multiple countries. The article does not report new Ebola case or death counts; it concentrates on funding allocations and international support.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ政権、アフリカでのエボラ対策に追加で2億4200万ドルを拠出する計画
triage.triage_reason: DRCを含むアフリカでのエボラ対応に対し米国が大規模な追加資金支援を計画しており、既存アウトブレイクの継続・国際支援の必要性が示唆されるため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は新規症例数・死亡者数を報告しておらず、米国の資金拠出（対DRC・南スーダン・ウガンダ）に焦点を当てている。南スーダン・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの既存エボラアウトブレイクへの継続対応を示す内容。

article.articleHeadline: Centre Deploys Outbreak Team as Chandipura Virus Probe Expands in Gujarat and Rajasthan
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus disease (CHPV) outbreaks in Gujarat and Rajasthan trigger the Centre to deploy a National Joint Outbreak Response Team (NJORT). The team, drawn from NCDC, ICMR, and DAHD, coordinates outbreak investigations, lab testing, patient management, and enhanced surveillance under the Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme (IDSP). The Public Health Emergency Operations Centre of the NCDC is activated to support rapid field response. National research bodies—including NIV, NIE, NIVCR, and NIVEDI—collaborate to study CHPV transmission characteristics, clinical features, epidemiology, potential treatments, and viral genetics, aiming to inform control measures. Surveillance has intensified for Acute Febrile Illness (AFI) and Acute Encephalitis Syndrome (AES), with community-level surveys to gauge spread, identify asymptomatic infections, and determine reservoirs or vectors. Findings will guide timely health interventions in Gujarat and Rajasthan.

triage.headline_ja: 中央政府、グジャラート州とラジャスタン州でのチャンディプラウイルス感染拡大調査のため対策チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: チャンディプラウイルスによる急性脳炎症候群（AES）のアウトブレイクに対し、インド中央政府が国立合同アウトブレイク対応チーム（NJORT）を派遣するなど公衆衛生上深刻な対応が取られており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスは主に小児に急性脳炎症候群を引き起こし致死率が高いことで知られる。国家レベルの対応チーム（NCDC, ICMR, DAHD等）が派遣されており、ベクター・宿主特定調査も進行中。国際的拡大や渡航制限の情報は現時点で確認されていない。

locations.name: Independent State of Papua New Guinea

article.articleHeadline: Menkes Budi: Penyebab Keracunan MBG di Jayapura Akibat Bakteri E Coli, Makanan Dimasak Terlalu Dini
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister Budi: MBG poisoning in Jayapura caused by Escherichia coli, food cooked too early.
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli contamination was identified in multiple MBG (Makan Bergizi Gratis) meals in Jayapura, Papua, following Ministry of Health laboratory analysis, with a similar pattern to a prior case in Semarang, Central Java. Meals served to MBG students tested positive for E. coli, not only in watermelon but in several items. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin said technical guidance was provided to the National Nutrition Agency (Badan Gizi Nasional, BGN) to prevent recurrence, including stricter compliance with Sertifikat Laik Higiene Sanitasi (SLHS). BGN head Sudaryono attributed the contamination to cooking that occurred too early relative to serving, citing kitchen logs showing cooking around 19:00–19:30 local time the day before, and service around 11:00 the next day, allowing bacterial growth. BGN warned of police involvement if sabotage or intentional wrongdoing is found, and pledged transparency.

triage.headline_ja: ブディ保健大臣：ジャヤプラでのMBG食中毒事件は大腸菌が原因、食品調理が早すぎたことに起因
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア国内の学校給食における大腸菌食中毒事件であり、単一地域・限定的な食品衛生問題で、国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 食品由来の大腸菌汚染による集団食中毒事件で、既存の給食制度（MBGプログラム）の調理・保存管理の問題として保健省が対応中。過去にセマランでも類似事例あり、システム上の課題として国内対応が進められている。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura virus: Paediatrician explains what parents need to know
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus outbreak in Gujarat underscores rapid progression and urgent care needs. The virus is transmitted by sandflies, especially at dusk; there is no vaccine or specific antiviral. In children under 15—the mean age around 10—symptoms begin like a typical fever with headache, body aches, vomiting, and irritability, making early diagnosis challenging. In a subset, illness rapidly turns neurotropic: seizures, disorientation, altered consciousness, lethargy, and coma. Surveillance from the 2024 Gujarat outbreak noted circulatory collapse and shock in more than a third of confirmed cases, with liver dysfunction common and acute kidney injury in about 20%. Diagnosis requires laboratory RT-PCR to detect viral RNA in blood, CSF, or throat swab; no quick bedside test exists. Without rapid hospitalisation and aggressive supportive care, progression to acute encephalitis and death can occur within 24–48 hours. There is no human-to-human transmission; prevention focuses on keeping sandflies away from children.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルス:小児科医が保護者に伝えるべきことを解説
triage.triage_reason: チャンディプラウイルスは重症度が高く進行が急速だが、本記事は2024年の流行データを基にした啓発的解説記事であり、新規の大規模発生や社会的関心の急上昇を示す情報は確認できない。
triage.notes: 本記事はグジャラート州における2024年のチャンディプラウイルス流行のサーベイランスデータを引用した小児科医向け解説記事であり、最新の発生状況や症例数の増加を示す情報はない。ベクター媒介性で人-人感染はないとされる。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例本土傷寒！中部7旬婦發燒腹瀉 無國內外旅遊史
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first locally transmitted typhoid fever! A woman in her seventies in Central Taiwan with fever and diarrhea, with no domestic or international travel history.
article.articleSummary: First locally transmitted typhoid fever case in Taiwan this year: a woman in her 70s in Central Taiwan with fever and diarrhea, no domestic or international travel history. Diagnosed in mid-July after hospitalization; has since recovered and been discharged. Epidemiologic tracing identified three cohabitants and 42 related contacts; four people (three cohabitants and one symptomatic contact) tested negative; ongoing health monitoring and education. Typhoid fever is caused by Salmonella Typhi, with incubation 8–14 days (range 3–60). Transmission occurs via contaminated food or water; symptoms include persistent fever, headache, malaise, abdominal pain, diarrhea, and may include relative bradycardia or trunk rash. Public health guidance: boil or bottled water, fully cook food, prevent cross-contamination, and practice hand hygiene; notify clinicians with dietary history; facilities should report suspected cases within 24 hours. Taiwan has four confirmed typhoid cases this year—one locally transmitted, three imported; imported cases mainly from Indonesia, totaling 22 since 2022.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初の本土感染腸チフス！台湾中部の70代女性が発熱・下痢、国内外の渡航歴なし
triage.triage_reason: 台湾中部での単発の腸チフス感染症例であり、既に回復・退院済み。接触者調査でも新規感染確認なく、対象国（Indonesiaは輸入症例の起源として言及されるのみで発生地域ではない）に該当する事象もないため見送り。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれていない。Indonesiaは輸入症例の起源国として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題となる発生地域ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: La RD Congo supera la barrera de los 1.800 muertos por el brote de ébola y se acerca a los 4.000 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo surpasses the 1,800-death barrier in the Ebola outbreak and nears 4,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 1,801 Ebola deaths and 3,973 confirmed cases as of August 4, with a 45.3% fatality rate. Five provinces are affected: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo. The outbreak shows sustained transmission and high virus circulation, with no new geographic expansion in the previous 24 hours. There are 674 patients in isolation or hospitalized and 776 recoveries. This outbreak is the second-largest by cases globally and the largest in DRC history, though well below the 2014-2016 West Africa epicenter. Uganda declared Ebola-free on July 28 after 20 confirmed cases, 15 imported from DRC, including 2 deaths. The strain is Bundibugyo Ebola virus, with a 30-50% fatality range; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhage.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の流行で死者1,800人を超え、症例数は4,000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目に該当し、致死率45%超・大規模流行・ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの輸入症例（15例、うち2死亡）が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC国内5州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ、オートウェレ、ツォポ）にまたがる大規模流行で、ワクチン未承認・治療法未確立の点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: La RD Congo supera los 1.800 muertos por ébola y se acerca a los 4.000 contagios - Diario de Santiago. Noticias de Santiago de Compostela y Galicia.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC surpasses 1,800 Ebola deaths and approaches 4,000 cases - Diario de Santiago. News from Santiago de Compostela and Galicia.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 3,973 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,801 deaths since the May 15 declaration. As of August 4, 2026, 674 patients are isolated or hospitalized, 776 have recovered, and contact tracing is 75.3% complete. The outbreak spans five provinces, with Ituri as the main hotspot and also affecting North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo. It is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus lineage; the WHO notes no vaccine or specific treatment authorized for this variant. The crisis is the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the fastest-growing by case count in the country’s history, though still below Africa’s 2014–2016 Western Africa outbreak. Neighbors: Uganda reported 20 cases and 2 deaths and declared Ebola-free on July 28; 15 Ugandan cases were imported from DRC. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, with symptoms including fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhagic manifestations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者1,800人を超え感染者4,000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大のエボラアウトブレイクが5州に及び、死者1,800人超・感染者約4,000人、ワクチン未承認かつウガンダへの越境感染も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダは越境症例が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダは既にエボラ終息宣言済み（7月28日）。

article.articleHeadline: US boosts Ebola fight with $242 million funding package
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) region receives a new $242 million U.S. funding package announced August 6, 2026 by the U.S. Department of State, reinforcing Washington's role as the largest financial contributor. The contribution lifts total U.S. support for the Ebola response in the region to over $512 million, with funds allocated to immediate outbreak response, preparedness in neighboring countries, and humanitarian assistance for vulnerable communities affected by the crisis. Africa CDC describes the funding as vital solidarity that will save lives and strengthen country-led response operations and cross-border preparedness. It also urges other partners to close financing gaps and rapidly disburse commitments for a coordinated, Africa-led response. The article does not provide case counts or specific clinical details.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ対策に2億4200万ドルの追加資金拠出を発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する国際的資金支援のニュースであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は資金拠出に関する報道であり、具体的な症例数や臨床詳細は記載されていない。既存のDRCエボラアウトブレイクへの対応継続を示す内容。米国は資金拠出国であり発生地域には該当しないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Alarmante" el brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Alarming" the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: An ongoing Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo remains alarmingly unchecked two and a half months after its declaration. In about 11 weeks, nearly 1,500 people have died, far exceeding earlier outbreaks, including the 2014 West Africa epidemic (which would reach about 11,000 deaths by 2016), where 279 deaths occurred in the same early period. Daily suspected cases continue to appear outside established transmission chains. Only about 59% of contacts linked to patients in Ituri province—the outbreak’s epicenter—have been traced. Médecins Sans Frontières runs seven Ebola treatment centers in eastern DRC. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived to bolster the response. African Union health chief says the outbreak is controllable only if the response outpaces transmission, amid a region strained by conflict, malnutrition, malaria, measles, and cholera.

triage.headline_ja: 「憂慮すべき」エボラ出血熱の流行
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で進行中のエボラ流行は約11週間で1500人近い死者を出し過去の流行を上回るペースで拡大しており、WHO事務局長が現地入りするなど国際的な関与も強まっているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC（特にイツリ州）のみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Merka ta duna mas sèn pa kombatí Ébola - èxtra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Market Gives More Sense to Combat Ebola - Extra
article.articleSummary: United States pledges an additional $242 million to combat the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), making Washington the leading financial contributor in the global response. The administration calls on other nations to increase funding while facing criticism of U.S. travel restrictions and plans to open a quarantine center in Kenya. The DRC has declared the outbreak—affecting the African nation’s population of over 100 million—an ongoing emergency. As of the report, 3,874 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been reported, with 1,751 deaths since the outbreak began. In response, the DRC and other authorities have imposed travel restrictions on those coming from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, and the United States prohibits Americans from re-entering directly from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 市場、エボラ対策への意識を高める - Extra
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（3,874例確認・1,751死亡）が継続しており、国際的な渡航制限や多国間の資金協力が発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たすシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 米国・ケニア・ウガンダ・南スーダン等は渡航制限や対応拠点として言及されているが、発生国はDRCのみであり、対象国リスト中ではDRCのみverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Explainer: Why Congo's Ebola outbreak is spreading faster than previous epidemics
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo's Ituri Province near Mongbwalu is projected to surpass 4,000 confirmed cases this week, the fastest-spreading epidemic in the country since its May declaration. It ranks as the world's second-largest Ebola outbreak after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone), which exceeded 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain driving the current outbreak has no licensed vaccine or proven treatment, limiting countermeasures. Transmission is reportedly five times faster than previous outbreaks at the same stage. Transmission likely began as early as January near Mongbwalu; initial infections were misdiagnosed and laboratory delays allowed undetected spread. About 80% of new infections occur outside known transmission chains; contact tracing is overwhelmed. Funding shortfalls, unpaid health workers, and reduced humanitarian aid hinder response amid ongoing violence and population movement, increasing cross-border risk.

triage.headline_ja: 解説:コンゴのエボラ流行はなぜ過去の流行より速く拡大しているのか
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が過去最速のペースで拡大し4000症例に迫り、ワクチン・治療法がなく、国境を越える拡大リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 西アフリカ(ギニア、リベリア、シエラレオネ)は2014-2016年流行との比較のための歴史的言及であり、現在の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: ROUNDUP: Trump-Regierung plant Millionenhilfe für Kampf gegen Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ROUNDUP: Trump administration plans millions in aid for the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, the United States plans 242 million USD in additional Ebola response funding to support immediate measures, regional preparedness, and humanitarian relief in Africa. Combined with earlier commitments, direct Ebola aid exceeds 512 million USD, with an extra 350 million for humanitarian aid in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda as part of a 1.8 billion USD UN OCHA package. The Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is described as the largest on record there, with 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths (case fatality 45.3%), and 674 patients in isolation. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids, and the situation is described as critical. The funding follows G7 commitments amid a broader shift away from some international programs.

triage.headline_ja: ロイター速報：トランプ政権、エボラ対策に数百万ドル規模の追加支援を計画
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で史上最大規模とされるエボラ流行が継続し、致死率45.3%と極めて深刻。米国が2億4200万ドルの追加支援を計画するなど国際的関心・支援ニーズが高く、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国東部のエボラ流行に対する米国の追加資金拠出が主題。南スーダン・ウガンダは人道支援対象として言及されているが、感染事例発生国としての記載はなく対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو تقترب من 4 آلاف ومنظمة الصحة تحذر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections in the Congo near 4,000, and the World Health Organization warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths, according to government data released yesterday. The outbreak, the 17th in the DRC, was first declared on May 15. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the outbreak is spreading faster than the response and urged a scaled-up, urgent effort, protection and training for frontline health workers, and safe, dignified burials. Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa after visiting Ituri province in the northeast, which accounts for about 90% of cases. The current outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or treatment yet, and transmission occurs through close contact and contaminated bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever; Ebola has killed over 15,000 people in Africa in the past five decades. The deadliest outbreak occurred 2018-2020 with around 2,300 deaths out of about 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が4,000人に近づき、世界保健機関が警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株、有効なワクチン・治療法なし）が約4,000症例・1,800人以上の死者に達し、WHOが対応の遅れを警告しており、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威かつ国際的関心が高いため。
triage.notes: DRCで17回目のエボラ流行。イツリ州が症例の約90%を占める。ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・治療法が未確立で、WHO事務局長が対応拡大の緊急性を訴えている。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola en RDC : le Président Félix Tshisekedi mobilise les partenaires internationaux autour de la riposte | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola in the DRC: President Félix Tshisekedi mobilizes international partners for the Ebola response | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo convened in Kinshasa on August 5 with Prime Minister Judith Suminwa and government ministers to coordinate the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, targeting the Bundibugyo strain. The meeting included the World Health Organization and Africa CDC, who reviewed actions and set priorities to limit transmission. Key themes: closer collaboration among national authorities, technical partners, and communities to improve field interventions; community engagement through traditional leaders, religious figures, and youth organizations; enhanced protection for healthcare workers; strengthened epidemiological surveillance to enable rapid case management. WHO and Africa CDC praised the government's efforts and reconfirmed ongoing technical and operational support to consolidate the response and contain viral spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：フェリックス・チセケディ大統領、対応強化のため国際パートナーを動員
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが継続し、大統領がWHO・Africa CDCを含む国際パートナーを動員するなど、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 大統領自らが国際パートナーを動員し、WHO・Africa CDCが技術支援を継続していることから、フルリスク評価（RRA）への移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh chủ động các biện pháp kiểm soát dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City proactively takes measures to control the epidemic.
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, Ho Chi Minh City's Centre for Disease Control reports dengue fever is increasing with the rainy season and is forecast to remain elevated through the remaining months of 2026. The rise in dengue reflects seasonal transmission patterns, prompting proactive public health measures by the municipal authorities to curb the outbreak. By contrast, hand, foot, and mouth disease is essentially stable, and there are no unusual developments for Covid-19. No case counts or fatalities are provided in the report. The update emphasizes ongoing vigilance against dengue, while maintaining management of HFMD and Covid-19 without signs of escalation. The message highlights seasonal dynamics in urban Vietnam and the continued role of local health authorities in surveillance and response to infectious diseases during the year-end period.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、感染症対策措置を積極的に実施
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱の増加に対する当局の予防的対応であり、症例数・死亡者数の報告もなく、HFMDやCOVID-19は安定しているため、現時点でPICKUP基準は満たさないが季節的動向として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱は雨季に伴う季節性の増加であり、当局は既存の枠組みで対応中。具体的な症例数・重症度データが不足しており、異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: CG: गांव या मोहल्ले में अचानक फैले बीमारी, न हों परेशान, एक जैसी बीमारी के दो मरीज दिखने पर यहां दें सीधे सूचना... | CG: If a disease suddenly spreads in your village or neighborhood, do not panic; report it directly on the IHIP portal as soon as two patients with similar symptoms are observed...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CG: A disease that has suddenly spread in your village or neighborhood, do not panic; report it directly on the IHIP portal as soon as two patients with the same disease are observed.
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, two or more cases of the same disease in a village, neighborhood, or settlement should be reported on the Integrated Health Information Platform (IHIP) to flag a potential outbreak. The IHIP, part of India's IDSP, enables Community Based Surveillance by allowing any citizen to log suspicious health events online. Reports trigger rapid investigation, sample collection, treatment, and containment measures to prevent escalation. When submitting, provide name, mobile number, age, gender, address, occupation, date, place, and a brief description of the illness; photos or documents can be uploaded as evidence. Reports are verified via OTP and forwarded to health authorities, who may request additional information. Public should share truthful, factual information and avoid rumors. Submit at https://ihip.mohfw.gov.in/cbs/#/.

triage.headline_ja: CG：村や地域で突然病気が広がった場合は慌てず、同じ症状の患者が2人確認され次第、IHIPポータルに直接報告を
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な疾病発生事例ではなく、インドの疾病監視報告制度（IHIP）の利用方法を案内する一般的な広報記事であり、実際の健康被害イベントの発生は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の疾病発生を報じるものではなく、住民向けの疾病報告制度（IHIP）の周知記事であるため、トリアージ対象の感染症イベントには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Wagub Jihan Minta Tanggamus Percepat Temuan Kasus TBC, Capaian Baru 37 Persen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vice Governor Jihan Asks Tanggamus to Accelerate TB Case Finding, New 37 Percent Milestone
article.articleSummary: TB in Tanggamus Regency, Lampung Province, Indonesia: estimated TB cases 2,532 with only 946 (37%) detected to date; TB preventive therapy (TPT) coverage 13%. On 6 August 2026, Vice Governor Jihan Nurlela chaired a virtual TP2TB coordination meeting urging accelerated active case finding, expanded screening for high-risk groups, stronger health-service networks, and improved reporting via the SITB system. Emphasis on compliance with Presidential Regulation 67 of 2021 and collaboration with Forkopimda, TP-PKK, academia, business, religious figures, and community health actors to speed case finding and treatment. The province has a Regional Action Plan for TB 2025–2030 and TP2TB, but Desa Siaga TB sites and TB cadres are limited (about 50 people). Calls for rapid RAD-to-program implementation to boost TB control efforts in the district and broader province.

triage.headline_ja: 副知事ジハン氏、タングガムスにTBC(結核)症例発見の加速を要請、達成率は新たに37%
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核の通常の行政対応・症例発見加速に関する記事であり、異常性・急性の公衆衛生上の脅威は認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は慢性的な風土病であり、地方政府による通常の対策会議・目標達成に関する記事。急性の公衆衛生危機ではないためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns Ebola outbreak in DRC accelerating as cases double
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating, with new infections doubling over the past week as of 6 August 2026. The country has confirmed nearly 3,900 cases and more than 1,700 deaths since the outbreak was declared in May. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus warns that transmission is increasing and urges a robust global response, including improved protection for frontline health workers who face elevated risk. The agency notes that multiple vaccine and treatment candidates remain in development and testing, underscoring the urgent search for effective tools. The announcement underscores the need for sustained international support to strengthen outbreak control measures, surveillance, and health system response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCでのエボラ流行が加速し症例が倍増していると警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOが公式に警告するDRCでのエボラ流行拡大で、症例・死亡者数が多く、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が直接警告している点、致死率が高い（約44%）点から重症度・緊急性が高いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात में चांदीपुरा वायरस से 22 बच्चों की मौत, क्यों इतना खतरनाक है यह वायरस, डॉक्टर ने बताया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Twenty-two children die from Chandipura virus in Gujarat; why is this virus so dangerous, the doctor explains.
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus, named after Chandipur, Maharashtra, has caused 22 deaths among children in Gujarat, with cases rising during the monsoon. First identified in 1965, the infection presents with fever, headache, fatigue, body and muscle pain, vomiting, and seizures; severe cases may progress to pneumonia, acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), and encephalitis, with death if the brain is involved. The virus is zoonotic and can spread to humans via sandflies, ticks, and mosquitoes; affected individuals are predominantly children up to 14 years old. The Gujarat outbreak has prompted high alert from health authorities with concerns about spread to other states. Prevention emphasizes hygiene (handwashing with soap and water), avoiding contact with wildlife, and vector control using insect repellents and bed nets to deter the insect vectors responsible for transmission.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルスにより子供22人死亡、なぜこのウイルスは危険なのか医師が解説
triage.triage_reason: インドのグジャラート州で子供22人が死亡するチャンディプラウイルス（脳炎を引き起こす人獣共通感染症）の集団発生が発生しており、当局が警戒を強めている。IHR基準2つ該当かつWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・グジャラート州（マハーラーシュトラ州チャンディプルにちなみ命名）での発生を主題としている。バングラデシュは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文中で具体的な発生の言及がないため除外。他州への拡大が懸念されているが、これはインド国内の拡大であり国際的拡大とは異なる。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya keeps vigil to keep Ebola at bay
article.articleSummary: Kenya maintains heightened Ebola surveillance at the Malaba One Stop Border Post on its western frontier to keep Ebola out of the country as the outbreak continues in neighboring DRC. About 1,500 travelers are screened daily at the border, with more than 50,000 people screened since enhanced surveillance began. As of Aug. 4, the Democratic Republic of Congo had recorded 3,973 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,801 deaths. Uganda had already declared an end to its latest Ebola outbreak on July 28 after completing the required surveillance period without new cases, but Kenya has kept border checks and cross-border vigilance due to ongoing transmission in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ出血熱の侵入を防ぐため警戒を継続
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例3,973人・死亡1,801人という深刻なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、近隣国境での越境拡大リスクと渡航制限（国境検疫強化）が確認されるため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで継続中のエボラ流行に対するケニアの国境警戒だが、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダは既に流行終息を宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Congo : le nombre de cas d'Ebola s'élève à 3 973 et 1 801 décès
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Ebola case count rises to 3,973 with 1,801 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths, according to authorities in Kinshasa. The update underscores continued epidemiological surveillance and contact tracing across affected areas, with enhanced diagnostic and treatment services deployed to improve patient outcomes and curb transmission. Health authorities emphasize that these measures form part of the broader effort to reduce the spread of Ebola and bring the outbreak under control.
