The figures reflect ongoing transmission within the country as of the published date, with Kinshasa serving as the reporting location for the update. This report does not specify the time frame beyond the current total.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ出血熱の症例数が3,973人、死者数1,801人に達する
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の累計症例3,973人・死亡1,801人という大規模かつ致死率の高い継続的アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約45%と非常に高く、継続的な感染拡大が示唆される。渡航・貿易制限の有無や国境を越えた拡大の具体的状況については記事に明記されていないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: تحذير أممي عاجل من تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو مع تضاعف الإصابات أسبوعيا - سواليف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgent UN warning of Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as infections double weekly.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than containment efforts, with some foci doubling weekly. According to the DRC Ministry of Health, by Monday there were 3,874 confirmed infections and 1,751 deaths. The outbreak is the fastest ever recorded, and the second-largest since the West Africa epidemic of 2014–2016. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain lacks a licensed vaccine or approved treatment. The situation is worsened by health-worker strikes over salaries and deteriorating security in Ituri province in eastern DRC, where about 90% of cases are concentrated and displacement continues. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, during a Kinshasa visit, urged a rapid, scaled-up response. The health crisis underscores the urgent need for intensified public health measures, vaccine development for this strain, and protection of frontline responders.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が急拡大、感染者数が週単位で倍増と国連が緊急警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOが「史上最速」の流行拡大と警告し、感染者3,874人・死者1,751人、ワクチン未承認株、治安悪化・医療従事者ストライキが重なりIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーでは言及がないため除外。イツリ州（Ituri）はDRC国内の地域として集約。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تحت حصار إيبولا.. الوباء يكسر حواجز السيطرة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo under Ebola siege: the outbreak breaks through containment barriers.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo accelerates beyond containment, driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant with no vaccine or treatment. As of the latest figures, 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths have been reported, with Ituri in northeastern DRC accounting for about 90% of cases. The outbreak, the seventeenth in DRC, was first declared on May 15 and is described as the fastest Ebola surge globally. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa to coordinate the response amid weak governance and under-resourced health systems across five eastern provinces. Transmission occurs via close contact and contaminated body fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever. Ebola has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa over the past five decades. No vaccine or treatment exists for the Bundibugyo variant.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ包囲下に：流行は封じ込めの壁を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）が急速に拡大し、確定症例3,973例・死亡1,801例に達し、WHO事務局長が現地入りするなど国際的関心も高く、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法未確立のブンディブジョ株による第17次エボラ流行。5州にわたり拡大、WHO事務局長が現地訪問し対応調整中。渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事内に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: EUA Anunciam Mais de 240 M$ em Apoio Financeiro Para Resposta ao Surto na RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: U.S. Announces More Than $240 Million in Financial Support for Outbreak Response in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: On Aug 5, 2026, the United States announced $242 million to support the Ebola outbreak response in eastern DRC, bringing total direct U.S. assistance to $512 million. The funds will cover up to six months of response operations. Officials cite rapid spread due to delayed detection, weak surveillance, ongoing conflict, and lack of vaccines or treatments for circulating strain. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) says the situation is more critical than ever. In 11 weeks since the outbreak declaration, deaths are reportedly more than five times those seen in the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. As of Tuesday, the DRC government reports 3,874 cases and 1,751 deaths, though WHO warns the real scale could be 2–4 times higher due to detection and contact-tracing gaps. The U.S. remains the largest funder, supporting over 180 health facilities and about 300 tons of materials. Pigott defended aid continuity amid critiques of prior cuts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：米国、コンゴ民主共和国での流行対応に2億4000万ドル以上の資金支援を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性の2基準に該当し、WPRO基準も全て該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部でのエボラ流行に対する米国の資金支援が主題。米国・アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文の主題はDRCのみであるため除外した。WHOは実際の症例数がDRC政府発表の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘しており、検出・接触追跡の不備が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: RDCongo ultrapassa as 1.800 mortes e regista quase 4.000 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: DR Congo surpasses 1,800 deaths and reports nearly 4,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in DR Congo: as of Aug 4, 2026, death toll 1,801 and 3,973 confirmed cases; CFR 45.3%. 674 patients in isolation or hospitalized; 776 recovering. Contact tracing rate 75.3%. Five provinces affected: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo. No new geographic spread in the last 24 hours; the outbreak remains in sustained transmission with high virus circulation. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and the fastest-growing since the declaration on May 15. Uganda declared Ebola-free on July 28 after 20 cases, 15 imported from DR Congo, and 2 deaths. The virus belongs to the Bundibugyo strain; case fatality is 30–50%; there is no vaccine or approved treatment. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever with vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で死者1,800人超、症例数はほぼ4,000人に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続しており、致死率も高く、国境を越えた感染（ウガンダへの拡大）も確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既にエボラ終息宣言済み（7月28日）であり、記事の主題はDRCでのアウトブレイク継続。ワクチン・承認された治療法がない点も重症化リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: EE.UU. destina 242 millones de dólares más a la respuesta contra el ébola en la RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. allocates another $242 million to the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: US allocates an additional $242 million to the Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), lifting Washington’s total contributions for the outbreak to over $512 million and accompanying humanitarian aid. Africa CDC notes this funding supports country-led response and cross-border preparedness in affected and at-risk neighbors; US State Department puts total humanitarian support for the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan at $350 million. On June 25, Africa CDC raised its funding needs forecast to $1.4 billion, nearly triple the initial $518 million. Congolese authorities report 1,801 deaths and 3,973 confirmed Ebola cases since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The epidemic is the second-largest by infections and the largest in the DRC; the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak had about 11,000 deaths and 28,000 cases. Uganda declared Ebola-free on July 28 after 20 infections (15 imported from the DRC) and two deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応にさらに2億4200万ドルを追加拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目の規模となるエボラ流行が継続中で、死者1,801人・症例3,973人に達し、国際的な資金支援と越境拡大リスクが確認されているため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUnited States, Sudan, Angola, Ugandaが含まれるが、記事本文で実際の流行地はコンゴ民主共和国東部のみ。ウガンダは輸入症例で7月28日にエボラ終息宣言済み、南スーダンは支援対象国として言及されているのみで発生確認なし。米国・アンゴラ・スーダンは資金拠出国/無関係のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 4 آلاف.. ارتفاع إصابات "إيبولا" في الكونغو وسط تحذيرات أممية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4,000 Ebola cases rise in Congo amid UN warnings.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo: confirmed cases rise to 3,973 with 1,801 deaths as of yesterday, in one of the longest and most complex outbreaks. The WHO warns that transmission is accelerating in some areas, outpacing field responses. During a field visit, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged intensified efforts, stressing protection for health workers and continued logistical and medical support for isolation and case follow-up to prevent further spread. The outbreak is hampered by health-system and security challenges that limit access to some rural zones, with ongoing community transmission. Authorities emphasize intensified awareness and expanded vaccination as critical control measures. International and local health actors are evaluating urgent needs amid concerns that renewed spread could strain Congo’s fragile health system, underscoring the necessity of rapid, coordinated response to prevent escalation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者4,000人に増加、国連が警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模拡大しており、致死率が高く、WHOが国際的懸念を表明していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルRRAが必要と判断。
triage.notes: 感染者数3,973人、死者1,801人と致死率が非常に高く、コミュニティ内感染が継続。WHO事務局長が現地訪問し、国際支援強化を訴えている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Defends Uganda's Early End to Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Uganda declared the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak over before the standard 42-day waiting period, with WHO defending the move as prioritizing the halt of transmission and public health protection. The outbreak had 20 confirmed cases, mostly imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo, and a case fatality rate of about 10% (DR Congo ~44%). Uganda has since deployed health workers to support responses in eastern DR Congo. WHO and Africa CDC praised Uganda’s handling as a regional model. Africa CDC also criticized the United States for maintaining travel restrictions on Uganda despite its containment achievements.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはウガンダのエボラ流行終息宣言の早期実施を擁護
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準の複数（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大、渡航制限）に該当し、DRCでの流行継続とCFR約44%という高い致死率、国際的な政治的関心（米国の渡航制限をめぐるAfrica CDCの批判）も確認されるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダのブンディブジョ流行終息宣言だが、症例の大半がDRCからの輸入例であり、DRCでのCFRが約44%と高く、ウガンダがDRCの対応支援に医療従事者を派遣していることから、DRCも実質的な発生国として扱う。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: La RD Congo supera la barrera de los 1.800 muertos por ébola y se acerca a los 4.000 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo surpasses the 1,800-death toll from Ebola and approaches 4,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, according to a Ministry of Communication bulletin with data through 4 August 2026, reports a case fatality rate of 45.3%. The death toll has surpassed 1,800 and total cases are approaching 4,000. Currently, 674 patients remain in isolation or hospitalized, and 776 have recovered. The bulletin notes a contact tracing rate of 75.3%, a key metric for containment. No further clinical or laboratory details are provided in the bulletin. These figures, drawn from official data, reflect the ongoing high lethality and the substantial case load, underscoring continued emphasis on isolation and contact tracing to limit spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラによる死者数が1,800人を超え、症例数は4,000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: 致死率45.3%、死者1,800人超・症例4,000人近くという大規模かつ深刻なエボラ流行であり、国際的拡大リスクや渡航・貿易制限の可能性を含むIHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率45.3%は非常に高く、感染拡大が継続中。接触者追跡率75.3%は一定の対応能力を示すが、症例数の急増が続いており国際支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: ارتفاع الإصابات بإيبولا إلى (3973) حالة بينها (1801) وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Ebola infections rise to 3,973 cases, including 1,801 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 3,973 confirmed cases, including 1,801 deaths, according to government data released yesterday. The update comes as the World Health Organization warns that transmission is accelerating and in some areas the surge exceeds current response capacity. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, during a visit to the DRC, called for intensified efforts to fight Ebola, with a focus on protecting health workers and ensuring they receive the necessary support to continue the response. The report underscores the persistent challenge of containing the outbreak and the need to intensify efforts to curb further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ感染者数が3,973例に増加、うち1,801人死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WHO事務局長が現地訪問し対応能力を超える感染拡大を警告するなど社会的・政治的関心も高いため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 致死率約45%と高く、WHOが対応能力を超える感染拡大を警告。事務局長の現地訪問は国際的関心の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus TBC Tanggamus Baru Terdeteksi 37 Persen - Pesawaran Inside
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 37 percent of TB cases in Tanggamus were newly detected - Pesawaran Inside.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) in Lampung Province, Indonesia, shows weak detection in Tanggamus District: an estimated 2,532 cases with only 946 detected (about 37%). The Lampung provincial government is accelerating TB control to reach elimination by 2030, emphasizing active case finding, complete treatment, and stigma reduction. Tuberculosis Preventive Therapy (TPT) coverage in Tanggamus is only 13%. Authorities urge expanding screening of high risk groups, strengthening health facility networks, and improving reporting via SITB with regular program evaluations. Vice Governor Jihan Nurlela led the TP2TB meeting on August 6, 2026, virtual from the Governor’s Office, praising the Regional TB Action Plan 2025 2030 and TP2TB. They noted too few TB Alert Villages and only about 50 TB cadres. A collaboration with PDPI is developing Peduli Tuberculosis Lampung for self screening, with results integrated into the Free Health Check program CKG.

triage.headline_ja: タンガムスで結核（TBC）新規発見率は37パーセント
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核の検出率改善に関する行政報告であり、突発的・異常な公衆衛生事象ではないためピックアップ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による結核対策プログラムの進捗報告記事であり、新規アウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: ارتفاع الإصابات بإيبولا إلى قرابة 4 آلاف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola infections rise to around 4,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have reached 3,973 confirmed cases with 1,801 deaths as of August 6, 2026, according to health authorities, amid intensified containment efforts. The rise coincides with World Health Organization warnings of accelerating transmission, with some areas reporting case numbers outpacing response capacity. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting the DRC, urged heightened Ebola control efforts, stressing protection and support for health workers. The DRC previously announced on May 15 the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country, and the current outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo variant, for which no vaccine or targeted treatment is currently available. U.S. funding for Ebola response has surpassed $242 million in additional support, bringing total direct assistance to over $500 million.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ感染者数が約4,000人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模に拡大し(約4000症例、死者1801人)、対応能力を上回るペースで感染拡大、WHOトップが現地訪問するなど国際的関心・懸念が非常に高いため。
triage.notes: ワクチンや標的治療法がないBundibugyo株による第17次アウトブレイク。米国が5億ドル超の支援。United Statesは支援国であり発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ressemblances et différences entre Ebola et Choléra, deux épidémies en cours en RDC - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Similarities and differences between Ebola and Cholera, two ongoing epidemics in the DRC - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, DRC, as of Aug 6, 2026, health experts describe similarities and differences between the two ongoing epidemics: Ebola virus disease (EVD) and cholera. Ebola: 1,751 deaths and 3,874 laboratory-confirmed cases; fever with hemorrhagic signs is typical; incubation 2–21 days; case fatality ranges by strain (Ebola-Zaïre up to 90%, Bundibugyo ~40%), with overall potential 25–90%. Management demands intensive supportive care in isolation, specific antivirals (monoclonal antibodies), and vaccines for some strains. Cholera: acute watery diarrhea without fever, vomiting, rapid dehydration; incubation hours to 5 days; fatality under 1% with early treatment, up to ~50% with delayed care. Transmission is waterborne (bacterial). Treatment centers on oral rehydration or IV fluids, plus targeted antibiotics for severe cases. Both cause severe digestive disturbances; cholera is waterborne and typically afebrile, Ebola is viral with fever and hemorrhage. Noted Lubumbashi’s Jason-Sendwe hospital context.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとコレラの類似点と相違点――RDCで進行中の2つの流行
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（死亡1,751人、確定症例3,874人）とコレラの両流行が同時進行しており、致死率も高くIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は既存の流行状況の比較解説だが、死亡者数・症例数が大規模でありエボラの国際的拡大リスクも高いため注視が必要。詳細な地理的拡大状況や対応能力についての追加情報が求められる。

article.articleHeadline: 國內出現今年首例本土傷寒！中部婦發燒腹瀉就醫確診
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First domestically acquired typhoid fever case of the year in the country! Central Taiwan woman diagnosed after presenting with fever and diarrhea.
article.articleSummary: First domestically acquired typhoid fever case of 2026 in Taiwan: a woman in her 70s from Central Taiwan with chronic illness and no domestic or international travel history developed fever and diarrhea in mid-July, visiting the hospital where stool culture confirmed Salmonella Typhi infection. She recovered and was discharged. Public health authorities expanded contact tracing to 3 cohabitants and 42 close contacts; one contact had diarrhea but all tests were negative; others remain under self-health monitoring. Nationally, 4 confirmed typhoid cases this year (1 locally acquired, 3 imported); since 2022, 40 total (11 local, 29 imported). Most cases occur in 20–39-year-olds; among imports, Indonesia is the primary source with 22 cases. Typhoid has an 8–14 day incubation and is transmitted via contaminated food or water from patients or carriers. Prevention emphasizes boiled water, fully cooked foods, hand hygiene, and avoiding cross-contamination.

triage.headline_ja: 国内で今年初の本土感染性腸チフス症例！台湾中部の女性が発熱・下痢で受診し確定診断
triage.triage_reason: 台湾国内の単発の本土感染症例であり、感染拡大や重症化の兆候はなく、対象国（台湾は対象外）における発生でもないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。インドネシアは輸入症例の主要な感染源として言及されているが、本記事の主題イベント（本土感染症例）はインドネシアで発生したものではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Fogging Ramai Dilakukan, Tapi Mengapa Kasus DBD Tetap Bertambah?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fogging is widely carried out, but why are dengue fever cases still increasing?
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Riau, Indonesia climb despite widespread fogging. Rokan Hilir (Rohil) records the highest increase, with 625 cases by week 21, up 94 that week; the prior week added 95 suspected cases. Bengkalis reported +46, Pekanbaru +31, and Dumai +22. Health officials note fogging kills only flying adult Aedes aegypti mosquitoes; eggs, larvae, and pupae persist in water containers. More effective is 3M Plus larval source management: regularly draining water-holding containers, tightly sealing water storage, and reusing or eliminating potential breeding sites. No district has declared a Dengue outbreak (KLB); authorities say cases remain controlled, though some areas show increases and are now reportedly declining. Rohil has held cross-sector coordination meetings involving public security and business sectors, emphasizing community participation and environmental cleanliness as essential to suppress transmission beyond fogging.

triage.headline_ja: フォギングは広く実施されているが、なぜデング熱の症例は増え続けるのか？
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・リアウ州でのデング熱の季節的増加であり、自治体はアウトブレイク宣言をしておらず状況は制御下にあると報告されている。異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: デング熱は同地域で流行性のある既知の疾患であり、アウトブレイク宣言もなく通常の季節的変動の範囲内と考えられる。地方当局による対策（3M Plus、部門横断連携）も進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Число смертей от лихорадки Эбола в Конго превысило 1800
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola in Congo has surpassed 1,800.
article.articleSummary: Lab-confirmed Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo have reached 1,801, with 3,973 cases and a case fatality rate of 45%. About 717 patients are in hospitals or medical isolation, and contact tracing stands at 80% coverage. The outbreak began May 15 in eastern DRC and Uganda, with the epicenter in Ituri Province. Uganda declared the end of its Ebola outbreak on July 28; Congo continues to face ongoing transmission. Figures are reported by the government via Armenpress. The current data reflect laboratory-confirmed fatalities and total infections; the report references cross-border spread between DRC and Uganda. Context date: 2026-08-06.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱による死者数が1800人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の死者数1,801人・致死率45%と深刻な公衆衛生への影響があり、国境を越えたウガンダへの感染拡大も報告されているためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダは7月28日に自国のアウトブレイク終息を宣言済みだが、DRCでは感染継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Sinovac gets approval for China's first serum-free rabies vaccine
article.articleSummary: China's Sinovac Biotech has obtained the National Medical Products Administration's drug registration for a freeze-dried rabies vaccine that is serum-free and animal component-free. This approval makes it the first serum-free rabies vaccine in China approved for both the conventional five-dose post-exposure prophylaxis regimen and the WHO-recommended abridged four-dose schedule, shortening the primary course to as little as 14 days. The four-dose plan uses injections on days 0, 3, 7, and between days 14 and 28. Rabies is almost invariably fatal once symptoms appear, underscoring the importance of timely vaccination after exposure. Sinovac emphasizes the manufacturing approach's safety and supply benefits. The company is pursuing overseas development, including a product development partnership with Brazil and multiple international clinical studies in Pakistan.

triage.headline_ja: Sinovac、中国初の無血清狂犬病ワクチンの承認を取得
triage.triage_reason: 新規ワクチンの承認に関する製薬企業のニュースであり、疾病アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は狂犬病アウトブレイクではなく、Sinovac社の新ワクチン承認を報じる企業ニュース。ブラジル・パキスタンは海外開発パートナーシップ先として言及されているのみで、感染症発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Tested positive for dengue? Here's what to do first and how to support your platelet count naturally
article.articleSummary: During monsoon season in India, dengue cases are rising. WHO notes dengue can cause platelet suppression; normal platelets 150,000-450,000 per µL; counts drop usually after fever subsides, around days 4–7. There is no specific antiviral; most recover with medical care, hydration, rest. After a positive test, regular platelet counts (sometimes daily) are advised; monitor for warning signs. Emphasize staying hydrated and following doctor's advice; avoid over-the-counter pain relievers to prevent bleeding. Home remedies like papaya leaf extract have no proven benefit and may cause nausea. Diet can include fruits like dragon fruit; not a treatment. Seek hospital if vomiting, severe stomach pain, bleeding, or trouble breathing. Most patients recover with timely care.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱検査が陽性だったら？まず何をすべきか、血小板数を自然に支える方法とは
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱に関する一般的な健康情報・治療解説記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節のインドにおけるデング熱の一般的な症状管理・治療ガイダンス記事で、特定の異常な発生や集団感染を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola crisis deepens in DR Congo as cases surge in hotspots
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo virus, is accelerating with transmission rising and cases doubling in some hotspots. The Congo Ministry of Health reports 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths. The outbreak is described as the second-largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded and the fastest-spreading in Congo's history. With no approved vaccine or treatment for this strain, authorities are racing to contain spread. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus met with President Félix Tshisekedi in Kinshasa—the Director-General's second visit to the country since the outbreak was declared in mid-May—highlighting ongoing concern. The United States announced an additional 242 million dollars in funding for emergency Ebola response, preparedness, and humanitarian support across the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ危機深刻化、ホットスポットで症例急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、史上第2位規模・過去最速拡大のエボラ流行でWHO事務局長訪問や米国からの大規模支援も報じられており、社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 米国の資金拠出は地域全体の緊急対応・準備支援を目的としているが、発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のみであるため米国は対象国リストから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Lage im Kongo immer dramatischer
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola situation in the Congo is becoming increasingly dramatic.
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is escalating, with nearly 4,000 lab-confirmed infections and over 1,800 deaths, the largest Ebola outbreak in the country to date. About 90% of cases are in Ituri Province, where WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus has visited and planned talks in Kinshasa, urging a massive intensification of the response. Medical responders face severe gaps in identifying contacts; at a Bunia treatment center, around 90% of patients were not previously recorded as contacts. Political instability, rebel fighting, and distrust of authorities complicate containment, with the rainy season potentially hindering efforts. The United States announced an additional 242 million dollars for Ebola control, lifting total U.S. support to over 500 million, and urging other nations to increase aid, while Uganda was praised for its actions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ状況、ますます深刻化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が進行中で、致死率が高く、封じ込めが困難な状況にあり、国際的な資金支援も行われていることからIHR基準・WPRO基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国が2億4200万ドルの追加支援を発表し、WHO事務局長が現地訪問するなど、国際的関心・対応が非常に高い事案。政治的不安定・武装勢力の妨害・雨季の影響で封じ込めが困難とされ、他国への波及リスクも懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Co giật kéo dài khi sốt, bé gái 7 tháng tuổi được phát hiện mắc viêm não Nhật Bản
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prolonged seizures during fever in a 7-month-old girl diagnosed with Japanese encephalitis
article.articleSummary: Seven-month-old girl with Japanese encephalitis virus infection presenting with fever and a prolonged generalized seizure lasting about 20 minutes. She was admitted to the Pediatric Center at Bac Mai Hospital, Ninh Bình branch, Vietnam. Initial resuscitation controlled seizures and stabilized respiration and circulation. Given the atypical nature of prolonged seizures in a 7-month-old, clinicians pursued etiological workup beyond fever-related convulsions. After parental consent for lumbar puncture, CSF analysis showed leukocytosis indicating central nervous system inflammation. Brain MRI revealed brain parenchymal lesions compatible with encephalitis. Subsequent tests confirmed Japanese encephalitis virus infection. She required 24 days of intensive care with seizure control, management of cerebral edema, careful fluid-electrolyte and nutritional support, and continuous neuro monitoring. She recovered, became afebrile, seizure-free, alert, and was discharged with follow-up planned to monitor potential neurological sequelae. Clinicians emphasize timely LP when suspected meningitis/encephalitis and to discuss invasive tests with families.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱時に長時間のけいれん、生後7か月の女児が日本脳炎と診断される
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の臨床報告であり、日本脳炎はベトナムで既知の風土病であるため異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低く、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 単一小児症例の臨床経過報告。日本脳炎はベトナムで毎年一定数発生する既知の風土病であり、集団発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: 國內出現今年首例本土傷寒！中部婦發燒腹瀉就醫確診
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first locally acquired typhoid fever case in the country! A woman in the central region sought medical care for fever and diarrhea and was diagnosed.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first locally acquired typhoid fever case in 2026: a woman in the central region, over 70 with chronic illness, developed fever and diarrhea in mid-July, was hospitalized, and diagnosed with Salmonella Typhi. After confirmation, authorities traced 3 cohabitants and 42 related contacts; one contact had diarrhea but all tests were negative, while others remain under self-monitoring. The patient recovered and was discharged. Year-to-date Taiwan has 4 confirmed typhoid cases: 1 domestically acquired and 3 imported. Since 2022, total 40 cases (11 domestic, 29 imported); most patients are aged 20–39. Among imported cases, Indonesia accounts for 22. Typhoid is a second-class legally notifiable disease; incubation 8–14 days; transmission via food or water contaminated with feces or urine. Preventive guidance includes boiling or bottled water, fully cooking foods, avoiding cross-contamination, and thorough handwashing before meals and after toilet/diaper changes; authorities emphasize rapid investigation to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 国内で今年初の本土感染腸チフス症例！中部の女性が発熱・下痢で受診し確診
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での単発の本土感染腸チフス症例であり、患者は回復・退院済み、接触者調査でも陽性者なし。対象国（台湾は非対象、インドネシアは輸入症例の統計上の言及のみ）に該当する実際の発生はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれず、インドネシアは過去の輸入症例の出身地としての統計的言及であり、本事象の実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: দূষিত জলেই লুকিয়ে বিপদ! শিশুদের হেপাটাইটিস 'এ' নিয়ে বিশেষজ্ঞের সতর্কবার্তা
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Danger Lurks in Polluted Water! Expert Warns About Hepatitis A in Children.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A, a fecal-oral, waterborne liver infection, threatens children in India. Globally, ~1.4 million new Hepatitis A infections occur each year. In Indian children, about 90% under age 10 are exposed at some point, though most infections are subclinical; Hepatitis A accounts for roughly 70–85% of viral hepatitis and 40–60% of liver failure in the country. Symptoms can be nonspecific—loss of appetite, vomiting, fatigue, dark urine, right‑sided abdominal pain, or jaundice—yet many cases show no obvious signs, making blood tests essential for diagnosis. Treatment is supportive: maintain hydration, adequate nutrition, and regular monitoring. A Hepatitis A vaccine exists, typically started at age 1 in two doses (six months apart); a single live dose is available. It is not yet in India’s national program, but vaccination is advised given waterborne risk. Prevention hinges on safe water, hygiene, and clean food.

triage.headline_ja: 汚染水に潜む危険!子供のA型肝炎について専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: 特定の集団発生や急性イベントではなく、A型肝炎に関する一般的な健康啓発・専門家解説記事であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はインドにおけるA型肝炎の一般的な疫学状況とワクチン啓発を目的とした解説記事であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات ووفيات إيبولا وسط تحذيرات من تفاقم الأزمة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising Ebola cases and deaths amid warnings of a worsening crisis.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating, with World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warning that current response efforts are not keeping pace. During a visit to Congo, he stressed the urgent need to intensify interventions with all partners to curb transmission. According to the DRC Ministry of Health, confirmed EVD cases totaled 3,874 and deaths reached 1,751 as of early August 2026. Officials note that new infections have doubled in some of the most affected areas since the outbreak was declared roughly three months ago. The remarks underscore ongoing international concern and the imperative to bolster surveillance, case finding, and other public health measures to halt the spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の感染者・死者数が増加、危機悪化への警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染者3,874人、死者1,751人に達し、一部地域で新規感染が倍増するなど深刻化しており、WHO事務局長も直接介入を表明していることからフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長のコンゴ訪問が報じられており、国際的な注目度が高い。3か月で新規感染が倍増しており対応の遅れが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع الإصابات بإيبولا إلى نحو 4 آلاف حالة في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections rise to around 4,000 cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rose to 3,973 cases, with 1,801 deaths, according to government data issued Aug 5, 2026. Health authorities are intensifying containment measures to curb transmission as the outbreak persists. The World Health Organization warns that the pace of spread is accelerating, with infection rates in some areas exceeding local health-system capacity. The rising case counts underscore the ongoing Ebola outbreak and the need for sustained surveillance, rapid case management, and community-level public health actions to interrupt transmission chains. The data reflect a near-4,000-case burden, highlighting the continuing threat posed by Ebola in the region as authorities work to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者数が約4000人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴで約4000症例・1801人死亡という大規模流行となっており、WHOも感染拡大の加速と医療キャパシティ超過を警告しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率(約45%)が高く、地域の医療体制を超える感染拡大が報告されている。フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo supera 1.800 mortes, com quase 4.000 casos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo surpasses 1,800 deaths, with nearly 4,000 Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,801 deaths and 3,973 confirmed cases as of 4 August, with a case fatality rate of 45.3%. The outbreak remains in a sustained transmission phase, with the virus circulating at high levels. Five provinces are affected: Ituri (the epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo. Isolation or hospitalization total 674 patients; 776 people are recovering. The contact-tracing rate is 75.3%. Uganda has declared itself Ebola-free as of 28 July after 20 cases, including 15 imported from the DRC, with two deaths. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, for which vaccines or approved specific treatments are not available. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals, producing severe hemorrhagic fever with vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者数1,800人超・症例数4,000人近くに達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大〔ウガンダへの越境〕）に加え、ワクチン未承認株による持続的伝播が続いており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: ウガンダは2026年7月28日にエボラ終息宣言済み（DRCからの輸入例15例含む20例、死亡2例）だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。流行株はBundibugyo株でワクチン・特異的治療法が未承認。致死率45.3%と高い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo intercepts passenger boat near Kinshasa that carried suspected Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo persists, spanning five provinces including Tshopo and Mongala. As of Aug 5, government data report 3,973 infections and 1,801 deaths. A 32-year-old man who died after developing Ebola-like symptoms had disembarked in Mongala on July 25; no biological sample was collected from him due to testing-kit shortages. On Aug 6, authorities intercepted a passenger boat carrying about 200 people from Kisangani to Kinshasa at Maluku, 65 km from Kinshasa, raising concern about transmission to the capital’s 17+ million residents. A mobile laboratory has been deployed to test all passengers and crew aboard. River travel between Kisangani and Kinshasa can take weeks, and communications are often limited, complicating containment. Seven confirmed cases are in Tshopo, contributing to the ongoing multi-province outbreak; no further traveller deaths were reported.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、キンシャサ近郊でエボラ疑い患者を乗せた旅客船を拿捕
triage.triage_reason: DRCで多州にわたるエボラ流行が継続中（感染3,973人、死亡1,801人）で、首都キンシャサへの拡大懸念が生じており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 検査キット不足により死亡者からの検体採取ができず確定診断に至らないケースがあり、監視体制の脆弱性が懸念される。キンシャサ（人口1700万人超）への感染拡大リスクが焦点。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática del Congo supera la barrera de los 1.800 muertos por ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 1,800 Ebola deaths.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as of August 4, 2026: 1,801 deaths and 3,973 confirmed cases (case fatality 45.3%). About 674 patients remain in isolation or hospitalized, with 776 recovered and a 75.3% contact-tracing rate. Five provinces are affected—Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo—with the outbreak declared in eastern DRC on May 15. No new geographic extension in the 24 hours prior to the bulletin; transmission is sustained with high virus circulation per INSP. The epidemic is the second-largest by cases and the largest in the DRC, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak (2,299 deaths, 3,481 cases). Uganda was declared Ebola-free on July 28 after 20 cases (15 imported from the DRC) and 2 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing severe hemorrhagic fever with vomiting and diarrhea.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱による死者数が1,800人の壁を超え、症例数は4,000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続しており、死亡率45.3%、複数州への拡大、ワクチン未承認株という深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、既に隣国ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既にエボラフリー宣言済み(7月28日)であり、記事の主題はDRCでの継続的アウトブレイクであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダは対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Polda Sulbar dan Dinkes Kolaborasi, Penanganan TBC di Majene Meningkat hingga 55 Persen - Pikiran Rakyat Sulbar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Sulawesi Regional Police and Department of Health collaborate, TB treatment in Majene increases by up to 55 percent - Pikiran Rakyat Sulbar
article.articleSummary: West Sulawesi Regional Police (Polda Sulbar) and the West Sulawesi Health Department, Population Control and Family Planning, report tangible gains in tuberculosis (TB) management in Majene Regency. At a partnership event at Andi Depu Hall, Governor’s Office Sulbar, on August 6, 2026, the Health Department announced TB management coverage in Majene rising from 0% to 55%. Police involvement emphasizes community protection from infectious disease, with Bhabinkamtibmas tasked to support early detection, educate residents, and accompany patients to complete treatment. The cross-sector collaboration aims to expand reach to rural areas with limited health access, reinforced by capacity-building and the distribution of TB control pocket guides for field staff. No TB case or death counts are disclosed in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 西スラウェシ州警察と保健局が協力、マジェネのTB治療対応率が55%まで増加
triage.triage_reason: TB対策の実施率向上に関する行政・広報的な内容であり、症例数や死亡者数の急増、異常発生等の記載はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: TBは既知の流行病であり、本記事は行政の取り組み成果を報告するものでアウトブレイクの兆候ではない。地方政府（警察・保健局）の関心は高いが、緊急対応や国際支援を要する内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Jaktim gencarkan skrining TBC lewat CKG, sasar 77 ribu warga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Jakarta City Government steps up TB screening through CKG, targeting 77,000 residents.
article.articleSummary: East Jakarta's City Government expands Tuberculosis (TB) screening by integrating it with Free Health Check (CKG), targeting 77,800 residents across 778 focal locations (lokus) in Jakarta Timur. Each locus screens about 100 residents, with RPTRA Cililitan cited as one example. The program emphasizes early TB detection and community education to curb stigma that can lead to isolation of patients. Local officials highlight active community involvement, as camats and lurahs coordinate at each locus to reach individuals showing TB indications. By promoting prompt medical examination and rapid treatment, the initiative aims to interrupt transmission and lower TB incidence. Preventive messages also reinforce clean and healthy living (PHBS) and overall health maintenance, supporting a sustained public health effort in Jakarta Timur.

triage.headline_ja: 東ジャカルタ市、CKG(無料健診)を通じてTBCスクリーニングを強化、7万7000人の住民を対象に
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムに関するルーティンな公衆衛生活動の報告であり、異常な流行や急激な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による結核の早期発見・スクリーニングプログラムの通常業務報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Le gouvernement congolais, l'OMS et le CDC Africa renforcent la riposte à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: The Congolese government, the WHO, and Africa CDC strengthen the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo faces ongoing Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo strain. On August 5, 2026, at the African Union Headquarters, President Félix Tshisekedi chaired a crisis meeting on the persistence of Ebola Bundibugyo, with WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and Africa CDC Director Dr. Jean Kaseya, plus Prime Minister Judith Suminwa. After nearly two hours, officials noted that most transmissions occur during funeral rites. Tedros urged strengthened community engagement, calling for involvement of religious leaders, traditional chiefs, youth groups, and other social actors to boost sensitization. WHO and Africa CDC Africa reiterated support for the Congolese government’s leadership. The new strategy centers on community awareness, protection of health workers, and enhanced surveillance to prevent patients from dying at home instead of in medical facilities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：コンゴ政府、WHO、アフリカCDCがエボラ対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が継続し、大統領・WHO事務局長・アフリカCDC長官による危機対応会議が開催されるなど、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的関与が確認されるため。
triage.notes: エボラはコンゴ民主共和国で既知の継続的流行であり、既に国際機関の支援体制が構築されている案件。新規発生ではなく既存アウトブレイクの対応強化に関する続報。

article.articleHeadline: Kapolda Sulbar Minta Bhabinkamtibmas Jemput Bola Cegah Penularan TBC - Pikiran Rakyat Sulbar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Sulawesi Police Chief Asks Village Police Liaison Officers to Proactively Reach Out to Prevent TB Transmission - Pikiran Rakyat Sulbar
article.articleSummary: West Sulawesi’s Police Chief, Irjen Pol. Adi Deriyan Jayamarta, urged village police liaison officers (Bhabinkamtibmas) to actively help curb tuberculosis transmission at the desa level in West Sulawesi, Indonesia. During a TB prevention partnership at the Governor’s Office of West Sulawesi, he emphasized that TB control cannot rely only on health facilities; officers should educate communities, accompany patients, and help ensure complete treatment. “We must be there as a solution—to escort, care for, and ensure they recover fully. TB transmission is rapid, and only with strong synergy can we break the chain,” he said. The initiative includes briefing Bhabinkamtibmas on TB management to support early detection, public education, and patient support in their areas. The event took place on August 6, 2026 (Thursday).

triage.headline_ja: 西スラウェシ州警察本部長、結核感染防止のため村落警察官に積極的な対応を要請
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核に対する通常の地域啓発・治療支援活動を報じる内容であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 警察による地域保健活動への協力を呼びかける通常の広報記事であり、緊急性・異常性は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Dozens of health workers at epicenter of Congo's Ebola outbreak protest lack of payment
article.articleSummary: Dozens of health workers at Congo's Ebola outbreak epicenter in Bunia, Ituri province, protested over unpaid wages and bonuses, abandoning several facilities and disrupting patient care. Ituri accounts for nearly 90% of Congo's Ebola cases, underscoring the outbreak's concentration in this region and its status as the world's fastest-growing Ebola outbreak. The protesting clinicians, including nurses providing critical care to Ebola patients, say they have not received wages since the outbreak was declared in mid-May. The protests, staged at the governor's office, follow weeks of pay-related demonstrations and threaten to hamper frontline responses at treatment centers in the epicenter as of 6 August 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行震源地で、数十人の医療従事者が未払い賃金に抗議
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の急拡大流行地における医療従事者のストライキで対応体制が崩壊しつつあり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と管理可能性の懸念があるためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州がコンゴの症例の約90%を占め、世界最速で拡大しているエボラ流行とされる。医療従事者への賃金未払いによるストライキが患者ケアと対応体制を阻害しており、アウトブレイク管理能力への影響が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola Vakaları 3 Bin 973'e Yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 3,973.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus–driven Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths, according to the DRC Ministry of Health in its daily epidemiological bulletin published August 5. The bulletin notes ongoing transmission-control efforts, including epidemiological surveillance, contact tracing, and strengthened diagnostic and treatment services in affected areas. Since Bundibugyo ebolavirus was first detected on May 15, the country has announced it as the 17th Ebola outbreak. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. Authorities emphasize continued surveillance and response to limit spread and protect communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ症例数が3,973人に増加
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みのエボラ大規模流行（症例3,973人、死亡1,801人）であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: WHOにより2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。致死率は約45%と高く、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Protestas de trabajadores sanitarios en el epicentro del brote de ébola en Congo por salarios impagos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protests by health workers at the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo over unpaid salaries.
article.articleSummary: Dozens of health workers at the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo staged a protest in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province, demanding unpaid salaries and bonuses. The action led to the abandonment of several healthcare facilities and interruptions in care at the outbreak’s fastest-growing epicenter worldwide. Ituri accounts for about 90% of the Ebola cases in the country. The protests follow weeks of wage-related grievances since the outbreak was declared in mid-May, with nurses and other frontline staff delivering critical care to Ebola patients among those walking off the job. The stoppage underscores ongoing labor disputes as the outbreak continues to expand, threatening response capacity in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・エボラ流行の震源地で医療従事者が未払い賃金を巡り抗議行動
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行が拡大中のイトゥリ州で医療従事者の抗議によりケアが中断し、対応能力に支障が出ているため、既存流行に対するリスク増大要因としてフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラ流行そのものは既知だが、医療従事者のストライキによる対応能力低下は流行拡大リスクを高める新たな要因であり、注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ada Bakteri E. coli di MBG, Pemerintah Janji Perketat Keamanan Pangan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There Are E. coli Bacteria in MBG, Government Promises to Tighten Food Safety
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli detected in MBG (Free Nutritious Meals program) meals triggers tighter food-safety oversight by Indonesia’s National Nutrition Agency (BGN) and the Health Ministry. Investigations following several food-poisoning cases across multiple regions found E. coli in various samples, not only watermelon but other foods. Health Ministry teams conducted field checks and laboratory analyses to identify the source and processing steps needing improvement, with results shared with BGN. A deadline of August 10 has been set for MBG kitchens without the Hygiene Sanitation Certificate (SLHS); without SLHS they cannot operate. Any poisoning cases will be met with decisive action: temporary shutdown of implicated kitchens, laboratory testing of foods, evaluation of SPPG operators, and comprehensive investigations of causes. The government aims for zero cases, prioritizing child safety. Some outbreaks were linked to foods prepared too early, causing excessive storage, or take-home meals consumed outside distribution.

triage.headline_ja: MBG(無償栄養食プログラム)にE.coli菌、政府が食品安全対策強化を約束
triage.triage_reason: 学校給食プログラムでの食中毒事例とE.coli検出が確認されているが、規模・重症度の詳細は不明であり、政府はすでに対応措置を実施中のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 国内の食品安全問題として政府が主体的に対応しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。継続的な食中毒事例の報告状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Најголемата епидемија на ебола во историјата на Конго: САД издвојуваат уште 242 милиони долари
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The largest Ebola outbreak in Congo's history: the United States allocates another $242 million.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has grown to the largest in the country’s history, with over 3,600 laboratory-confirmed cases and about 1,500 deaths after roughly 2.5 months. The U.S. administration plans to earmark an additional $242 million for Ebola response in Africa, pending Congressional approval, to fund urgent containment, regional preparedness, and humanitarian aid. Separately, $350 million in humanitarian assistance is announced for the DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda. Ebola is a highly contagious viral disease transmitted through direct contact with infected persons or their bodily fluids and is often fatal, underscoring the need for coordinated regional control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ史上最大のエボラ流行:米国がさらに2億4200万ドルを追加拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最大規模のエボラ流行(3,600例超・死者約1,500人)であり、IHR基準の複数該当かつ国際的な資金支援・社会的関心が高いためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRCでの流行拡大と米国の資金拠出を扱っている。ウガンダ・南スーダンへの人道支援は言及されるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれるウガンダ・南スーダン国内での感染事例ではなく地域支援としての言及のため除外。米国も対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 湖南疾控发布最新监测：新冠主流毒株较温和，两到三周后达到峰值
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hunan CDC releases latest surveillance: Dominant COVID-19 variants are milder, and will peak in two to three weeks.
article.articleSummary: Hunan Provincial CDC reports COVID-19 remains in a mid-endemic phase with intermittent peaks; the dominant NB.1.8.1 evolutionary sublineage is circulating in Hunan, causing milder illness, mainly upper-respiratory infection, with very low pneumonia and ICU risk. Immune escape is increased, raising reinfection risk, though symptoms tend to be lighter. National data show a rising trend; Hunan mirrors this pattern. In the latest week, about 1 in 6 outpatients with fever, cough, or sore throat tested positive for SARS-CoV-2; in some prefectures as high as 1 in 3-4. Officials forecast a province-wide peak in two to three weeks from early August 2026. The health authority cautions against complacency: maintain protective measures, especially for older adults, people with chronic diseases, immunocompromised individuals, young children, and pregnant women. Recommendations include mask-wearing, hand hygiene, ventilation, healthy lifestyle, and prompt medical care for symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 湖南疾控発表最新監視：新型コロナ主流株はやや温和、2〜3週間後にピークに達する見込み
triage.triage_reason: 既知のCOVID-19変異株（NB.1.8.1）による季節的な感染再拡大であり、重症度は低いとされているが、地域的な感染者増加傾向が報告されているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 既知の変異株による季節性の流行であり、重症度は低いとされる。地方CDCによる通常の監視報告であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは言及されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 54 Kasus Positif Rabies di Jembrana, Aparat Desa hingga Adat Diimbau Data HPR di Wilayahnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 54 Positive Rabies Cases in Jembrana Regency, Village and Traditional Authorities Urged to Provide HPR Data in Their Area
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, Jembrana Regency in Bali reports 54 positive rabies cases among rabies-transmitting animals (HPR). Distribution: Melaya 5, Negara 18, Jembrana district 5, Pekutatan 5, and Mendoyo 21, with Mendoyo most affected. A prior resident death with suspected rabies following HPR exposure has been reported. Ongoing data collection, mass vaccination, sterilization, and active community reporting aim to curb spread and reduce bites. The Dinas Pertanian, Perikanan dan Pangan Jembrana notes the need to distinguish between owned and feral HPR to better target vaccination. An advisory urges village and adat authorities to coordinate with the Rabies Response Team (Tisira) to document HPR in their areas and enforce pet-owner responsibility; avoid releasing pets to prevent transmission from unknown strays.

triage.headline_ja: ジェンバラナ県で狂犬病陽性54件、村・慣習機関にHPR(狂犬病媒介動物)データ提供を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: バリ島ジェンバラナ県における狂犬病は地域的に流行している人獣共通感染症であり、疑い死亡例が1件報告されているが、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは低く、続報を注視するレベル。
triage.notes: バリ島は狂犬病流行地域として知られており、地元当局（Dinas Pertanian, Perikanan dan Pangan Jembranaおよび狂犬病対応チームTisira）が予防接種・不妊化・データ収集を実施中。疑い死亡例の詳細（確定診断の有無）は不明。

article.articleHeadline: En RD Congo, le chef de l'OMS appelle à "intensifier" la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, the WHO chief calls for intensifying the response to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths since its 17th outbreak was declared on 15 May in eastern and northeastern provinces, areas where state presence is fragile and health infrastructure is under-resourced. In Kinshasa, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged on 5 August to intensify the response and protect health workers. The surge is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, with no approved vaccine or treatment to date. A first vaccine dose from Oxford University, using the platform of AstraZeneca’s COVID-19 shot, was given to a volunteer in late July. The rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine is in development by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore). Canada has authorized Moderna to start trials for another Bundibugyo-targeted vaccine. Antivirals remdesivir and obeldesivir, and MBP134 monoclonal antibody are under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で、WHO事務局長がエボラ対応の「強化」を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例3,874件・死亡1,751人に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続し、WHO事務局長が対応強化を直接呼びかけている点から、深刻性・異常性ともに高くフルRRAが必要と判断。
triage.notes: シンガポール・カナダはワクチン開発拠点として言及されているのみで、実際の流行発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。Bundibugyo変異株による流行で承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Jaktim Gencarkan Skrining TBC Lewat Cek Kesehatan Gratis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Jakarta City Government Ramps Up TB Screening Through Free Health Checks.
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, East Jakarta City Government is intensifying tuberculosis (TB) screening by integrating TB screening with Free Health Check (Cek Kesehatan Gratis, CKG) across 778 focus locations (lokus) in Jakarta Timur, targeting more than 77,800 residents. Assistant for Economy and Development Fauzi stated each locus screens 100 residents, with RPTRA Cililitan among the sites. The program aims to enable early TB detection and also educate communities to reduce stigma against TB patients, who are often socially isolated. Authorities urge residents not to fear seeking medical care to interrupt transmission, while promoting Clean and Healthy Living Behaviors (PHBS). The effort relies on collaboration with camats and lurahs (subdistrict and village officials) to ensure broad participation. The primary goal is rapid diagnosis, timely treatment, and lowering TB spread.

triage.headline_ja: 東ジャカルタ市政府、無料健康診断を通じて結核スクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムの推進に関する行政広報であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 結核は地域流行病であり、本記事は通常のスクリーニング・啓発活動の報道であるためシグナルとしては見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak spreading faster than containment efforts, says WHO chief
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo (Kinshasa) is spreading faster than containment efforts, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. He urged an urgent, massively scaled-up response across all pillars and by all partners, after meeting officials in Kinshasa, Congo's capital. This is his second visit to the Central African nation since the outbreak was declared in mid-May. The report does not provide case counts, laboratory confirmation, or specific infection sources. The emphasis remains on rapid, comprehensive action to curb transmission in the Congo, with international partners coordinating with local authorities as of 6 August 2026. Further details were not disclosed in the article.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、封じ込め対策を上回るスピードで拡大とWHO事務局長が警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がWHO事務局長により封じ込めを上回る速度で拡大していると警告されており、公衆衛生上の深刻性・国際的拡大リスクともに高く、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 症例数・検査確定情報・感染源は不明。WHO事務局長のキンシャサ訪問(5月中旬の発生宣言以降2回目)を受けた警告であり、続報での詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dozens of health workers at epicenter of Congo's Ebola outbreak protest lack of payment
article.articleSummary: Dozens of health workers at the epicenter of Congo's Ebola outbreak protested at the governor's office in Bunia, Ituri province, demanding payment of wages and bonuses not received since the outbreak was declared in mid-May. Ituri accounts for about 90% of Congo's Ebola cases, making it the outbreak's hotspot as aid groups warn the transmission is accelerating. Frontline staff, including nurses caring for Ebola patients, are abandoning facilities amid long-standing pay issues and security challenges from rebels and angry mobs. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged authorities to prioritize support for responders. Doctors Without Borders described the outbreak as still spreading at an alarming and unprecedented rate, with the expanding response not reaching communities quickly enough to break transmission chains. The situation underscores the broader risks to frontline workers and the need for timely compensation and logistics.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行の中心地で、数十人の医療従事者が未払い賃金に抗議
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でエボラ出血熱の感染拡大が「前例のない速度」で加速しており、医療従事者のストライキにより対応体制が崩壊しつつあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長やMSFが介入し、5月中旬の流行宣言以来賃金未払いが続いていることが最前線対応の崩壊要因となっている。イトゥリ州がコンゴの症例の約90%を占めるホットスポットである点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola response hit as unpaid health workers protest in Ituri
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, dozens of health workers in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province, protested at the governor’s office over unpaid Ebola wages and bonuses since the outbreak was declared in mid-May, leaving several facilities short-staffed. The walkout coincides with Congo’s Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri and accounting for about 90% of cases, the second-largest in history. Frontline nurses and responders warn that delayed payments hinder a fragile response as the virus spreads rapidly. Officials cite logistical problems behind payment delays. During a Congo visit, WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged authorities to prioritize responder care. Doctors Without Borders says the outbreak remains alarming and spreading at an unprecedented rate, with the response not reaching communities quickly enough to interrupt transmission chains. The protests highlight unpaid staff, security threats, and the challenges of a remote, vulnerable region with rebel and mob attacks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ対応、イトゥリ州で給与未払いの保健医療従事者の抗議により打撃
triage.triage_reason: 史上2番目の規模とされるコンゴのエボラ流行が急速に拡大しており、対応体制の機能不全（給与未払いによるストライキ、人員不足）が伝播阻止を妨げているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長がコンゴを訪問し対応者へのケア優先を要請、国境なき医師団は伝播鎖の遮断が追いついていないと警告。給与未払いによる医療従事者のストライキが対応能力をさらに弱体化させている。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا بالكونغو تقترب من 4 آلاف ومنظمة الصحة تحذر مجدداً - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo near 4,000, and WHO warns again - Libya News 24
article.articleSummary: Nearly 4,000 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths as of this outbreak surge that began on May 15, representing the current seventh wave. The Bundibugyo strain drives transmission, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. Infections spread through direct contact with the sick or their bodily fluids, causing severe hemorrhagic fever and high mortality. Ituri province in northeast DRC accounts for about 90% of current infections, while security and displacement challenges impede containment. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged an accelerated, broad-scale response, improved community reach, protection and training for health workers, enhanced contact tracing, and safe burial practices. He visited Kinshasa and Ituri to support authorities. Context notes the 2018–2020 outbreak with ~3,500 cases and >2,300 deaths; Africa-wide deaths exceed 15,000 over five decades.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者が4000人に迫る、WHOが再び警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が第7波として拡大、致死率が非常に高く、ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長がキンシャサとイトゥリを訪問し、対応強化を要請。ワクチン・治療薬不在のブンディブギョ株による致死率の高い流行で、治安・避難民問題が封じ込めを妨げている。

article.articleHeadline: En RD Congo, le chef de l'OMS appelle à "intensifier" la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo, the WHO chief calls to intensify the response against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is contending with an unprecedented Ebola outbreak in its eastern and northeastern provinces, now totaling 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths since it began. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Kinshasa, urged a massive intensification of the response and stronger protection, training, and support for frontline health workers. The surge is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or established treatment. A first vaccine dose based on Oxford University technology (the same platform as AstraZeneca’s Covid‑19 vaccine) was given to a volunteer in late July; a second vaccine candidate, rVSV Bundibugyo, is being developed by Hilleman Laboratories in Singapore and is described as the most promising. Canada has authorized Moderna to begin trials of another Bundibugyo vaccine. Trials are also testing antivirals remdesivir and obeldesivir and the monoclonal MBP134. The outbreak demands strengthened public health outreach in regions with fragile governance and weak health infrastructure.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で、WHO事務局長がエボラ対応の「強化」を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 3,874症例・1,751死亡に達した前例のない規模のエボラ出血熱流行で、WHO事務局長が現地訪問し対応強化を呼びかけており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: シンガポール・カナダはワクチン開発拠点として言及されているのみで、流行発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。致死率が高くワクチン・治療法未確立のBundibugyo変異株による流行であり、脆弱な保健システム下での拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Giám đốc WHO cảnh báo dịch Ebola vượt khỏi tầm kiểm soát
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General warns that the Ebola outbreak is out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is out of control, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Visiting Ituri province, he warned the Bundibugyo strain is spreading faster than response efforts can contain. As of mid-May 2026, the Congo Ministry of Health reports 3,874 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,751 deaths, marking it the second-largest outbreak by cases to date. The strain has no approved vaccine or therapy. Health workers in Ituri’s Bunia have staged strikes over unpaid wages, reducing care capacity and fueling transmission; tracing is breaking down, with 60-70% of new infections from people not on surveillance. Case fatality sits around 45%; 24 hours saw 77 new cases, 44 deaths. The U.S. pledged an additional $242 million, bringing direct aid to over $512 million. Global scientists are testing Bundibugyo vaccines by Moderna, Oxford, and Hilleman Labs. Long-term control hinges on community trust and participation.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ流行が制御不能と警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行がWHO事務局長により制御不能と警告され、致死率約45%、ワクチン未承認、追跡不能な感染拡大が進行中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 米国は資金支援国であり発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。ワクチン未承認・保健従事者ストライキによる対応能力低下・サーベイランス破綻が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Власти Конго перехватили под Киншасой судно с 200 пассажирами из-за подозрения на Эболу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congolese authorities intercepted a vessel off Kinshasa with 200 passengers on suspicion of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola suspected in Kinshasa after a river boat carrying about 200 passengers en route from Kisangani was intercepted at Maluku port, 65 km from Kinshasa. A passenger who had previously disembarked died July 25 with Ebola-like symptoms. A mobile laboratory was sent to test all aboard. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba said no additional traveler deaths were recorded. The 32-year-old man who died had disembarked in Mongala province about 550 km downstream; symptoms developed after. Provincial health officials reported no samples were taken due to lack of testing systems. Travel along the Congo River can take weeks with limited connectivity. Chopo province has seven confirmed cases, among five affected provinces. Since the outbreak began, 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths have been reported. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments. Kinshasa’s infection would mark a new phase of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ当局、エボラ感染疑いでキンシャサ近郊にて乗客200人を乗せた船を拿捕
triage.triage_reason: 進行中の大規模エボラ流行（症例3,973件、死亡1,801件）が首都キンシャサへ拡大する可能性があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株、5州に拡大、承認済みワクチン・治療薬なし）が、河川船舶を介して首都キンシャサへ波及する可能性がある重大事案。検査体制の不備や渡航制限措置（船舶拿捕）も確認されており、国際的な支援・監視強化が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例本土傷寒現蹤　中部7旬婦確診
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first locally transmitted typhoid fever case detected; a woman in her seventies in central Taiwan diagnosed.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, Taiwan reports this year’s first locally transmitted typhoid fever case: a woman in her 70s from central Taiwan with no recent domestic or international travel history. She developed fever and diarrhea in mid-July, was hospitalized, and diagnosed with typhoid fever; she has since been discharged. Contact tracing identified 3 cohabitants and 42 related contacts; 1 contact had diarrhea. Four individuals were tested (3 cohabitants and the symptomatic contact); all results were negative; ongoing monitoring and health education continue. This year Taiwan has 4 confirmed typhoid cases: 1 local, 3 imported; local cases comparable to 2022–2025. Since 2022, Taiwan has 40 typhoid cases (11 local, 29 imported), with most affected aged 20–39; imported cases largely from Indonesia. Typhoid is caused by Salmonella Typhi and spreads via contaminated food or water; incubation 8–14 days; symptoms include fever, headache, fatigue, abdominal pain, and diarrhea. Prevention emphasizes safe water, fully cooked foods, avoiding cross-contamination, and thorough handwashing; suspected cases should seek care promptly and be reported within 24 hours.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初の国内感染性腸チフス例確認　台湾中部の70代女性が診断
triage.triage_reason: 台湾国内の単発の腸チフス症例で、接触者調査も陰性、過去の水準と同程度であり、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空。インドネシアは輸入症例の由来として言及されているのみで、現地での発生ではないため含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Bundibugyo : Tshisekedi mobilise le Gouvernement, l'OMS et Africa CDC pour renforcer la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Bundibugyo: Tshisekedi mobilizes the Government, WHO, and Africa CDC to bolster the response.
article.articleSummary: On 5 August 2026, in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), President Félix Tshisekedi chaired a strategic meeting at the African Union Headquarters to accelerate the response to the Bundibugyo Ebola strain outbreak. Attendees included Prime Minister Judith Suminwa, sector ministers, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, and Africa CDC Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya. The plan centers on inclusive community mobilization, engaging religious leaders, traditional chiefs, and youth groups to promote door-to-door awareness and rapid reporting of suspected cases to break transmission and reduce stigma. Strengthening epidemiological surveillance, faster testing, and relocating patients to treatment centers were prioritized to prevent home deaths that fuel spread. Protecting health workers through equipment, procedure training, and psychosocial support was emphasized. WHO and Africa CDC commended DRC’s progress and pledged technical, logistical, and vaccine support as needed, underlining a continued partnership to stop the 17th Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ・ブンディブギョ株:チセケディ大統領、政府・WHO・アフリカCDCを動員し対応強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行(ブンディブギョ株)への対応強化を大統領・WHO・アフリカCDCが協議しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心・支援が明確なためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: エボラ・ブンディブギョ株によるDRC第17次流行。大統領主導の対応強化会議にWHO・アフリカCDCが参加し、ワクチン支援等を約束。既知の流行株のため『異常/予想外』はNoと評価。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Papua Tengah perkuat kapasitas nakes Deiyai kendalikan penyakit menular - ANTARA News Papua Tengah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Papua Health Office Strengthens the Capacity of Deiyai Health Workers to Control Communicable Diseases
article.articleSummary: On 6 August 2026, the Central Papua Province Health Office strengthens Deiyai district health workers’ capacity to control HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, and malaria (ATM). Isak Waine, head of the Communicable Disease Prevention and Control Division, announced On the Job Training (OJT) for HIV, TB, and malaria programs at Deiyai puskesmas. The initiative emphasizes active case finding, standard treatment, patient follow-up, and accurate reporting. Dozens of health workers will receive OJT focused on case finding, patient management, monitoring, and documentation. Deiyai is a priority area for malaria elimination in Central Papua, requiring strengthened surveillance, lab testing, case investigations, guideline-based treatment, vector control, and community involvement. HIV services will expand with broader screening, testing access, ART adherence, and stigma reduction; TB will improve case finding, contact investigations, treatment success, and TB-HIV collaboration. Fransina Rumbiak says on-site mentoring improves competency at puskesmas and service quality; ongoing support aims to reach ATM targets.

triage.headline_ja: 中部パプア保健局、デイヤイの保健従事者の能力を強化し感染症対策を推進
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病（HIV、結核、マラリア）に対する通常の保健従事者能力強化研修であり、異常な流行や新規事象を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は既存の疾病対策プログラム（能力強化研修）に関するもので、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Co giật kéo dài khi sốt, bé gái 7 tháng tuổi được phát hiện mắc viêm não Nhật Bản
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prolonged seizures during fever in a 7-month-old girl diagnosed with Japanese encephalitis.
article.articleSummary: A 7-month-old girl presented with high fever and a prolonged generalized seizure lasting about 20 minutes. After extensive laboratory testing, doctors diagnosed encephalitis caused by Japanese encephalitis virus infection. The patient required 24 days of intensive care, during which she received supportive treatment and close monitoring. She ultimately recovered well and was discharged from the hospital. This case highlights that Japanese encephalitis can present in infancy with febrile illness and prolonged seizures, and demonstrates that sustained intensive care plus accurate laboratory confirmation can lead to favorable outcomes. No outbreak or transmission details are provided in the report, underscoring the importance of early recognition of fever-associated seizures in infants and the role of targeted diagnostics in confirming Japanese encephalitis.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱中に長時間のけいれんを起こした生後7ヶ月の女児、日本脳炎と診断される
triage.triage_reason: 単一の散発症例報告であり、アウトブレイクや感染拡大の情報はなく、日本脳炎は既知の風土病であるため異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 単発の臨床症例報告。日本脳炎はベトナムで既知の風土病であり、ワクチンで予防可能。アウトブレイクの兆候なし。

article.articleHeadline: DRC ramps up fight against Ebola, after 1,700 died from the virus
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s northeast, centered in Ituri province, has killed more than 1,700 people and infected over 3,800 since it was declared on May 15. Health authorities are boosting surveillance and public awareness to curb transmission. The outbreak persists despite interventions, with armed groups and mass displacement hindering response efforts. Health workers conducting contact tracing and safe burials report hostility from community members who doubt the disease’s existence. A doctor in one of the hardest-hit regions says many patients seek care only after the illness has advanced. The report underscores ongoing transmission, the need for intensified community engagement, and protective measures to interrupt spread, as authorities monitor the evolving situation in northeastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱によりこれまでに1,700人が死亡し、対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（死者1,700人超、感染者3,800人超）が継続中で、武装勢力や住民の不信により対応が困難となっており、国際的拡大リスクや公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: エボラ流行はDRCで既知の継続的アウトブレイクであり、既にWHO等により認知・対応が進んでいる可能性が高いが、死者数の多さと対応困難な状況から引き続き注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Bangka berhasil turunkan kasus malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangka Health Office has successfully reduced malaria cases.
article.articleSummary: On 6 August 2026, the Bangka Regency Health Office in the Bangka Belitung Islands Province reported a malaria reduction in the district due to prevention and treatment efforts. Data from community health centers show 152 malaria cases from April 2026 to date, with monthly counts of 13 (April), 79 (May), 48 (June), and 12 (July); August 2026 has recorded no new cases so far. Among patients, 0–5 years: 2; 6–9 years: 5; 10–19 years: 29; 20–59 years: 109; 60+ years: 7. Anggia Murni, Head of Prevention, Control of Diseases and Environmental Health at Dinas Kesehatan Kabupaten Bangka, urged residents, especially in Belinyu District where risk is high, to keep environments clean and eliminate standing water to prevent transmission. Officials remain optimistic August could be malaria-free.

triage.headline_ja: バンカ県保健局、マラリア症例の減少に成功
triage.triage_reason: 地域の風土病であるマラリアの減少傾向を報告する内容であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクはなく、当局も改善傾向を強調している。
triage.notes: 記事は症例減少を報告する前向きな内容であり、地方保健局が独自に対応可能な既知の風土病事例。

article.articleHeadline: Maluku : après un cas suspect d'Ebola, une embarcation stoppée sur le fleuve et un laboratoire mobile déployé pour dépister les passagers
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maluku: after a suspected Ebola case, a boat halted on the river and a mobile laboratory deployed to screen passengers.
article.articleSummary: A suspected Ebola case prompted a mobile laboratory deployment after a 200-passenger boat traveling from Kisangani (Tshopo Province) was halted on the Congo River about 60 km from Kinshasa. The passenger, who exhibited fever and diarrhea, died in Pimbu, Mongala Province. The vessel had left Kisangani between July 19 and 21. A mobile lab was set up at Makulu port to screen all passengers, and blood samples from the suspected case were sent to the Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB) for testing. As of now, the diagnosis is not confirmed; authorities caution that other diseases can cause similar symptoms. Government officials, including Health Minister Dr. Roger Kamba and spokesperson Patrick Muyaya, report that health, interior, and transport teams are mobilized and other boats have been dispatched to evacuate those screened; no other deaths on board have been reported.

triage.headline_ja: マルク：エボラ疑い例発生後、コンゴ川で船舶が停止され、乗客検査のため移動式検査室が展開
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疑い患者が死亡し、200人乗りの船舶が拘束されるなど、公衆衛生上の重大性と地域拡大リスクが示唆され、政府も積極対応している。
triage.notes: 疑い例であり確定診断待ち。ナイジェリア（Kaduna State）は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事主題と無関係のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : Kinshasa renforce son dispositif après l'interception d'un bateau suspect
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Kinshasa strengthens its response after the interception of a suspected vessel.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with Kinshasa intensifying response after intercepting a passenger boat about 60 km from the capital on August 5, 2026. A passenger who left the vessel died with fever and diarrhea; a mobile laboratory tested remaining travelers, and a cordon sanitaire was set around the ship. The vessel originated from Tshopo province; the alert traces to Pimu health zone in Mongala, over 1,200 km away. Officials stress that no Ebola confirmation has been made yet and other diseases can cause similar symptoms. Kinshasa authorities urge calm; the city is not in the affected provinces. A high-level government meeting with WHO and Africa CDC leaders endorsed stronger epidemiologic surveillance, community engagement, health-worker protection, and faster case detection. As of August 6, 2026: 3,973 confirmed cases, 1,801 deaths, 776 recoveries; no vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：不審な船舶の拿捕を受け、キンシャサが対応体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける進行中の大規模エボラ流行（確定3,973例、死亡1,801例）であり、首都キンシャサへの拡大懸念とWHO/Africa CDCの介入が確認されるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: キンシャサ近郊での不審な船舶からの疑い例は未確認（他疾患の可能性も指摘）だが、既存のエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株、ワクチン・特異的治療法なし）は大規模かつ深刻であり、WHO・Africa CDCとの高官級会合が行われている点からPICKUP判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura outbreak: Govt sends joint response team to Gujarat, Rajasthan
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus (CHPV) infections prompt deployment of a National Joint Outbreak Response Team to Gujarat and Rajasthan as cases rise. Gujarat reports 35 confirmed CHPV among 184 suspected, with 22 deaths in children under 15; Rajasthan confirms three cases from Dungarpur and Sirohi. The NJORT, drawn from NCDC, ICMR, NCVBDC and others, will conduct epidemiological investigations, bolster surveillance and lab testing, support vector surveillance and control, and coordinate clinical management and public health response. CHPV, a member of Rhabdoviridae, causes Acute Encephalitis Syndrome (AES) and is transmitted by sand flies, mosquitoes, and ticks; it mainly affects children under 15 and can progress from fever to convulsions, coma, and death within 48–72 hours. Past Indian outbreaks show case fatality 56–75% (WHO). No antiviral or approved vaccine exists; prevention focuses on vector control, sanitation, insect nets, repellents, and prompt care. The 2024 outbreak included 245 AES cases and 82 deaths, triggering responses.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルス感染症の発生：政府がグジャラート州とラジャスタン州に合同対応チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: 小児における致死率の高いチャンディプラウイルス感染症の集団発生であり、国家合同対応チームが派遣されるなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルス（CHPV）はサンドフライ等が媒介し、小児の急性脳炎症候群（AES）を引き起こす。グジャラート州で35例確定・22例死亡、ラジャスタン州で3例確定。過去の致死率は56-75%と非常に高い。国家合同アウトブレイク対応チーム（NJORT）が派遣されており、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Meet Meidinliu Newmai, Manipur's ASHA Hero Who Walked 28 Kilometres to Protect Children From Polio - The Logical Indian
article.articleSummary: On October 2025, Meidinliu Newmai, an Accredited Social Health Activist (ASHA) under the Tamei Primary Health Centre in Manipur, walked 28 kilometres through forests and across five rivers to vaccinate 17 children in Nenloung Atangkhullen, Tamenglong district, during India's Intensified Pulse Polio Immunization (IPPI) campaign. Over about eight hours, she carried a cold-chain vaccine carrier to keep oral polio vaccines at the correct temperature, vaccinating 10 children aged 0–3 and seven aged 3–5. Her trek underscores how frontline workers in Manipur's remote hills must reach villages with limited road access to sustain immunisation and maintain the cold chain. India has been polio-free since 2014, but vaccination campaigns remain essential to guard against reintroduction via imported cases. As of 2026-08-06, IPPI continues to be a critical measure to keep polio at bay.

triage.headline_ja: ミーディンリウ・ニューマイさんに会う ― ポリオから子どもたちを守るため28キロを歩いたマニプール州のASHAヒーロー
triage.triage_reason: 実際のポリオ症例発生ではなく、インドの定期予防接種活動（IPPI）に従事する医療従事者を称える人物紹介記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: インドは2014年よりポリオフリー。本記事はワクチン接種活動を担う医療従事者の美談記事であり、実際の感染事例報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Podcast JR 15 Min #1480 | Sarampo e outras doenças: o risco da baixa cobertura vacinal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Podcast JR 15 Min #1480 | Measles and Other Diseases: The Risk of Low Vaccination Coverage
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-06, JR 15 Min #1480 discusses measles and other diseases in Brazil’s national Multivaccination Campaign. The initiative has begun to update vaccination records and restore coverage among children and adolescents under 15, aiming to prevent a re-emergence of diseases that had been brought under control in Brazil, notably measles. The episode features infectious disease specialist Hemerson Luz to explain why maintaining high vaccination uptake is critical amid concerns of low coverage.
