The program highlights vaccination as a public health measure, and promotes RecordPlus content from RECORD, available free live via app. No outbreak figures or lab-confirmation details are provided in the article, but the focus is on preventing outbreaks through immunization.

triage.headline_ja: ポッドキャストJR 15分 #1480 | はしかとその他の疾患：低いワクチン接種率のリスク
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染者数や発生事例の報告はなく、ワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する啓発的なポッドキャスト内容であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な麻疹症例やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、ブラジルの予防接種キャンペーンに関する一般的な啓発コンテンツ。実際の発生事例なし。

article.articleHeadline: Tiongkok-Kongo Bersatu: Misi Besar Menumpas Wabah Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China-Congo United: A Grand Mission to Stamp Out the Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: China will continue assisting Africa in ending the Ebola outbreak, following the arrival of its third medical expert team in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, on August 1. The team comprises specialists in epidemiology, health quarantine, clinical care, and laboratory testing of pathogens, reflecting a multidisciplinary approach to outbreak response. Building on the efforts of previous missions, the group will enhance exchanges and coordination with DR Congo authorities and international organizations to strengthen prevention, surveillance, and control measures amid the ongoing outbreak. Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian stated the commitment from Beijing, with Xinhua reporting the development. China has explicitly pledged to deploy additional medical professionals to Africa to support rapid containment. The announcement underscores Beijing’s ongoing public health collaboration with African nations to curb Ebola transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 中国・コンゴ連携：エボラ流行終息に向けた大規模ミッション
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR(2005)上、単発事例でも通知対象となる重篤な疾患であり、DRCでの継続的流行に対し中国が医療支援を継続している状況はフルリスク評価の対象となる。
triage.notes: 記事は中国によるDRCへの医療支援チーム派遣に関する報道であり、実際の流行発生地はDRCのみ。中国は支援国であり発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。エボラは重篤な疾患のため、流行状況の詳細（症例数・致死率等）確認のためフルRRAが推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Afrique: Ebola - Les États-Unis débloquent 242 millions USD supplémentaires pour soutenir la riposte au pays
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: Ebola - The United States releases an additional $242 million to support the country's response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to drive international support. As of 2026-08-06, the United States announces an additional $242 million to the response, bringing U.S. aid to over $512 million. Funds will bolster epidemiological surveillance, entry-point and border screening, patient care, and community outreach to counter misinformation and vaccine hesitancy in affected areas. To date, U.S.-funded programs have conducted 8.6 million screenings, reached more than 1 million people, supported 180 health facilities, and strengthened diagnostic capacity at 11 laboratories. The U.S. calls on other international partners to increase contributions as the outbreak's evolution remains concerning, particularly in the DRC. Uganda’s surveillance and control measures are highlighted as reducing cross-border transmission. The U.S. remains committed to assisting national authorities and international organizations in containing this Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：エボラ出血熱－米国、同国の対応支援のためさらに2億4200万ドルを追加拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱流行に対し、米国が追加支援を表明するなど国際的関心・支援ニーズが高く、越境感染リスクも指摘されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは越境監視強化の文脈で言及されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの流行継続と米国の資金支援であるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño eleva risco de dengue e Prefeitura reforça alerta contra o Aedes aegypti - Correio de Minas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño raises dengue risk and City Hall reinforces alert against Aedes aegypti - Correio de Minas
article.articleSummary: El Niño is expected to raise dengue risk by boosting Aedes aegypti activity in coming months in Minas Gerais, Brazil, according to City Hall health authorities and the Ministry of Health. Warmer temperatures and altered rainfall patterns can create more standing water, facilitating mosquito breeding. The authorities urge intensified arbovirus surveillance and vector control, while stressing that community participation is essential since most breeding sites are inside or around homes. Practical measures include weekly property checks, removing water-holding containers, keeping water storage tanks sealed, cleaning gutters and drains, filling plant pot saucers with sand or discarding them, and disposing of tires, bottles, cans, and other water-collecting items. Vector-control agents will visit homes. Prevention remains a collective responsibility to protect families and the city.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョがデング熱リスクを高め、市がネッタイシマカ対策の警戒を強化 - Correio de Minas
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の発生確認ではなく、エルニーニョによる将来的なリスク上昇を懸念した予防啓発・注意喚起の記事であり、異常な公衆衛生事象の発生は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 季節性・気候要因によるデング熱リスク上昇の予防的注意喚起記事で、具体的な症例数や異常発生の報告はない。市当局による通常の予防対策の呼びかけに留まる。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura virus explained: Symptoms, spread, treatment, prevention and why children face higher risk
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus (CHPV), a member of the Rhabdoviridae family, continues to affect parts of India, with a recent outbreak highlighting a rare but potentially life-threatening infection that mainly strikes children. Transmission is via bites of infected sandflies; mosquitoes and ticks are being studied as possible vectors. There is currently no person-to-person transmission and no vaccine or specific antiviral. Diagnosis relies on clinical assessment plus RT-PCR or virus-detection tests; treatment is supportive, requiring hospitalisation, IV fluids, fever and seizure control, and close neurological monitoring. Most vulnerable are children under 15 in rural or forested areas during the monsoon when vectors surge. Early symptoms include sudden high fever, headache and vomiting; progression can cause acute encephalitis. Prevention focuses on reducing bites: full-sleeved clothing, insecticide-treated nets, repellents, screens, removing standing water, and trimming vegetation. Seek urgent care for persistent vomiting, confusion, seizures, drowsiness, or altered consciousness.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルスとは：症状、感染経路、治療、予防法、そして子どもがより高リスクである理由
triage.triage_reason: チャンディプラウイルスに関する一般的な解説記事であり、具体的な新規症例数や死亡者数などの最新アウトブレイク情報が示されていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Trump-Regierung plant Millionenhilfe für Kampf gegen Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump administration plans multimillion-dollar aid for the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains the largest outbreak ever recorded there, with 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths (mortality 45.3%), and 674 patients in isolation. About 99 new cases were reported in the last 24 hours, and aid groups describe the situation as 'critical.' The outbreak is centered in eastern DRC. The Trump administration plans more than $242 million in additional direct aid for immediate response, regional preparedness, and humanitarian relief, bringing U.S. commitments to over $512 million; an extra $350 million is pledged for humanitarian aid in the DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda. The funding is part of a broader $1.8 billion UN OCHA package announced after the June G7 summit in Geneva, with discussions in Congress ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ政権、エボラ対策に数百万ドル規模の追加支援を計画

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تطلق تحذيراً شديداً: تفشي "إيبولا" بالكونغو يتجاوز سرعة الاستجابة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Health Organization issues a stern warning: the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is outpacing the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is outpacing the response, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. He warned that after roughly three months since the outbreak began, new infections have surged in some of the hardest-hit areas, even as healthcare workers protest over overdue salaries. Speaking after meetings with officials in Kinshasa, Tedros’ second visit since the mid-May declaration underscored the need to dramatically scale up the response across all pillars and secure robust international partnership. The World Health Organization and Congo’s Ministry of Health report 3,874 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,751 deaths as of last Monday. The report highlights the mismatch between outbreak dynamics and the response pace, amid worker pay disputes and ongoing efforts to mobilize resources and coordination.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、深刻な警告を発令：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は対応速度を上回っている
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行拡大が対応能力を上回っていると警告し、致死率の高い感染者数・死亡者数の増加と国際支援の必要性が明確に示されているため。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長がキンシャサを訪問し、対応の抜本的強化と国際的パートナーシップの確保を訴えている。確定症例3,874例、死亡1,751例（致死率約45%）と重篤な状況。医療従事者の給与未払いによる抗議活動も対応の遅れに影響している。

article.articleHeadline: 22 çocuk hayatını kaybetti! Beyni hedef alan virüs alarmı büyüyor

article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, India reports 22 child deaths linked to Chandipura virus, prompting government alarm. The Health Ministry has deployed national intervention teams to Gujarat and Rajasthan to coordinate with local health units, strengthen case surveillance, intensify containment measures, and provide technical support to frontline workers to prevent further cases. The World Health Organization notes the virus poses a higher risk during the monsoon season and can spread to humans via vectors including sandflies, mosquitoes, and ticks. Chandipura infection can affect the central nervous system, causing encephalitis, with severe cases carrying a risk of death, particularly among children who are more vulnerable. Officials urge insect-bite prevention and prompt medical care for fever, altered consciousness, or neurological signs. The article does not detail laboratory confirmation or any imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 22人の子供が死亡！脳を標的とするウイルスへの警戒が高まる
triage.triage_reason: インドでチャンディプラウイルスによる脳炎で子供22人が死亡し、政府が国家介入チームを派遣する事態となっており、深刻な公衆衛生への影響と地域拡大の可能性があるためフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief urges stronger Ebola response in DR Congo visit
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, declared May 15 in five eastern provinces, has 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths, according to WHO. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no approved vaccine or treatment. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Kinshasa, urged a massive scale-up of the response, protection for health workers, and intensified surveillance, care access, and safe burials, noting the outbreak is spreading faster than response efforts—with new cases doubling in some hotspots over the past week. The United States has earmarked more than $242 million in additional funding, bringing total direct assistance to over $500 million. Ituri accounts for nearly 90% of cases; Mongbwalu saw protests at an Ebola treatment centre over unpaid allowances, while a new 100-bed centre opened in Bunia. Trials include Moderna and Oxford vaccines, and Hilleman Laboratories’ candidate; MBP134, remdesivir, and obeldesivir are being studied in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国訪問でエボラ対応の強化を要請

article.articleHeadline: EUA destinam mais 242 milhões de dólares no combate ao ébola na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. allocates another $242 million to the fight against Ebola in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to expand: as of August 4, 2026, 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths, with 674 patients in isolation/hospitalized and 776 recovering, case fatality 45.3%. The outbreak is the 17th in the DRC, second-largest by case numbers in history, and the fastest-growing since its May 15 declaration. Uganda reports 20 cases (15 imported from the DRC) and two deaths, and Uganda declared Ebola-free on July 28. US funding adds $242 million to the DRC response, bringing total US contributions to over $512 million, with $350 million in humanitarian aid for DRC and neighboring Uganda and South Sudan. Africa CDC had by June 25 estimated $1.4 billion in funding needs, triple the initial $518 million. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus warns the outbreak is spreading faster than response efforts during a Kinshasa visit.

article.articleHeadline: الكونجو تعترض قاربا قرب العاصمة بعد الاشتباه في إصابة راكب بإيبولا - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congolese authorities intercept a boat near the capital after a passenger is suspected of having Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo authorities intercepted a boat carrying about 200 people traveling from Kisangani to Kinshasa after a passenger who disembarked on July 25 with symptoms suggestive of Ebola died. The interception occurred at the Maluku River port, roughly 65 km from Kinshasa, amid fears of seeding the capital’s more than 17 million inhabitants. Health Minister Samuel Kamba said a mobile laboratory was deployed to test all on board. The 32-year-old man suspected of Ebola left Mongala province about 550 km before symptoms developed. No biological samples were taken from him due to a lack of testing equipment at the treating facility. No additional passenger deaths were reported. Seven confirmed cases have been recorded in the Chuobo region; the outbreak has reached 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros urged a stronger response during his Congo visit as the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak persists with exceptional spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、乗客がエボラ感染疑いで首都近郊で船を臨検
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がキンシャサ首都圏への拡大の恐れを伴い、既に3,973例・1,801人の死亡を記録する大規模流行であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 17回目のエボラ流行で、WHO事務局長も現地訪問し対応強化を要請。人口1700万人超のキンシャサへの拡大リスクが懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола приблизилась к городу с 17 миллионами жителей: лодку с 200 пассажирами перехватили у Киншасы в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola approaches a city with 17 million inhabitants: a boat carrying 200 passengers intercepted near Kinshasa in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: A boat carrying about 200 passengers and crew was intercepted near Kinshasa at the Maluku river port, 65 km from the city, amid Ebola concerns. One man who disembarked earlier in Mongala province (≈550 km from Kinshasa) died July 25 with Ebola-like symptoms; laboratory confirmation for Ebola was not obtained due to lack of tests, so the case remains suspected, not confirmed. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamby reported no new deaths among other passengers. The vessel traveled from Kisangani in Chopo Province; river routes could continue for weeks, complicating contact tracing. The current Congo Ebola outbreak is the country’s largest and the world’s second-largest since 2014–2016, with 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths as of August 5, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission requires direct contact with blood/fluids; not airborne. Europe risk is low per ECDC; main threat remains within the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがキンシャサに接近：コンゴで200人乗りの船が抑留
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が続く中、感染疑い患者が乗船した船が人口1700万人のキンシャサに接近し拘束された。国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。

Despite the protests, humanitarian workers warn the outbreak continues to spread at an alarming rate. The report highlights critical staffing shortages and the potential for further spread as the response is hampered by wage-related disruptions. No laboratory-confirmed case details are provided in the excerpt; the focus remains on the protests and the ongoing, deadly outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: احتجاجات للعاملين بالصحة في الكونغو للمطالبة برواتبهم وسط تفشي إيبولا - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protests by health workers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to demand their salaries amid an Ebola outbreak - Shorouk Portal
article.articleSummary: Health workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo protested at the Bunia governor’s office (Bunia, capital of Ituri province), demanding overdue salaries as Ebola care intensifies, disrupting services across facilities. Frontline staff, including nurses, say they have not received wages or bonuses since the outbreak was declared in mid-May, prompting departures and strikes that hinder the response. Ituri’s Bunia accounts for about 90% of the country’s Ebola cases, highlighting the potential impact of payroll protests on outbreak control amid what authorities describe as the fastest Ebola outbreak in the world.

article.articleHeadline: Mandaue dengue cases rise in July 2026
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Mandaue City, Cebu rose in July 2026, with 373 cases and 1 death from Jan 1 to July 30, a 6.8% increase versus the same period in 2025. The 2025 full-year tally was 520 cases and 3 deaths. Of the 2026 cases, 96 were laboratory-confirmed, 140 suspected, and 137 probable. Affected individuals ranged from newborns to 87 years, median age 13; 204 males and 169 females. Children 1–10 years old accounted for 38% of infections. Among barangays, Tabok accounted for 8% of cases, followed by Alang-Alang and Cabancalan at 6.7% each, and Umapad at 6.2%. The case fatality rate stood at 0.3% so far in 2026, lower than 0.6% in 2025. Health officials continue a 4S dengue control strategy (search for breeding sites, self-protection, seek early medical care, support targeted spraying) with misting in affected areas; community participation remains essential during the rainy season.

triage.triage_reason: フィリピン地方都市における季節性デング熱の定期報告であり、致死率は前年より低下、異常な増加や国際的懸念は見られないため。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola en la RDC alcanza los 3.973 casos confirmados mientras la respuesta se mantiene en cinco provincias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC reaches 3,973 confirmed cases as the response remains in five provinces.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains geographically stable across Haut-Uélé, Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu and Tshopo, with 51 health zones affected as of the August 4 update. The outbreak has reached 3,973 confirmed cases, including 674 hospitalized or isolated, 776 recoveries, and 1,801 deaths (case fatality 45.3%). Ituri remains the epicenter, accounting for 87.1% of cumulative cases. A first recovery was documented in Haut-Uélé, signaling progress outside the main hotspot. Response infrastructure expands: the Ebola Treatment Center in Rwankole, Ituri, with 120 beds, opened; additional centers under construction in Musienene, Beni, and Isiro to bolster isolation and clinical management. Surveillance remains active: 876 alerts investigated in the last 24 hours; contact tracing coverage 75.3%. Risk communications involve over 12,000 people, 36 community radio stations, and 16 rumors clarified. Border screening reports 96.6% traveler screening.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、5州で対応継続の中3,973例の確定症例に達する

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC Says Contact Tracing Is Not Working in Congo Ebola Outbreak as Deaths Pass 1,700
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province, Bunia epicenter) has reached 3,802 cases and 1,707 deaths since it was declared on May 15. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya says contact tracing is not working; most new infections are from community transmission rather than traced contacts (estimates 60–80%). With no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo virus, control relies on early supportive care; ring vaccination is not available. More than 17,000 contacts are being monitored, about 80% followed up daily, yet transmission is spreading beyond the tracing net, concentrated in Ituri (roughly 90% of cases) with confirmed cases in Kisangani and five other provinces. Trials ongoing: post-exposure prophylaxis drugs in Ituri; two vaccine trials in the UK and Canada; Merck’s vaccine cross-protection being explored. Export risk evident with imported cases in France (late June) and a US case evacuated to Germany; Uganda had Ebola-free status in mid-June.

In response, teams of doctors have been dispatched and specialized centres have been established in the hardest-hit provinces as the outbreak continues. Trials to identify an effective vaccine are ongoing, reflecting the ongoing effort to find a preventive option amid persistent transmission in DR Congo.

article.articleHeadline: U.S. donates additional $242 million to combat Ebola, issues travel advisory to citizens
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, the United States announced an additional $242 million donation to Ebola response efforts in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), bringing total direct Ebola assistance to more than $512 million and aligning with a broader $500 million commitment announced at the G7 Summit. The Department of State said the funds support immediate outbreak response, preparedness, and humanitarian aid in the region, with the CDC leading the federal response. A Level 4 Travel Advisory remains for the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, warning Americans not to travel to these countries. The State Department is aiding U.S. citizens in or recently in the DRC or affected by travel restrictions, including offering loan-based financial assistance to change travel plans and secure temporary lodging outside the DRC before returning to the United States.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dozens of health workers in the Ebola outbreak epicenter in Congo protest over not receiving salaries - Al Shorouk Gate
article.articleSummary: Dozens of health workers protest unpaid salaries at the Ebola outbreak epicenter in Congo, leaving many health facilities in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province, and affecting care as the outbreak accelerates. The protests, which involve nurses and other frontline staff, come as about 90% of Congo’s Ebola cases have been reported in Ituri. Workers say they have not received salaries or bonuses since the outbreak began in mid-May, undermining the response to what officials describe as the world's fastest-spreading Ebola event. Authorities had previously attributed payroll delays to logistical issues; there was no immediate comment from the government on Thursday. The disruption compounds risks in a region among the most isolated and impoverished in Congo, where health workers and facilities face attacks by rebels and agitated crowds.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行震源地で医療従事者数十人が給与未払いに抗議 - アル・シュルーク・ゲート
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴで「世界最速の拡大」と報じられ、給与未払いによる医療従事者のストライキが対応能力を損なっており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と管理可能性の懸念が認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: 18 Organisasi Profesi Bekerja Sama Tanggulangi TBC di Sleman - Suara Merdeka Kedu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 18 Professional Organizations Collaborate to Combat TB in Sleman - Suara Merdeka Kedu
article.articleSummary: Eighteen professional organizations in Sleman Regency, Indonesia, have formed the Coalition of Indonesian Professional Organizations for Tuberculosis Control (KOPI TBC) to combat tuberculosis (TB) in Sleman. Launched by Regent Harda Kiswaya on 6 August 2026, KOPI TBC aims to accelerate TB case finding, treatment, and patient support on the path to national TB elimination by 2030. The coalition emphasizes cross-sector collaboration (pentahelix) beyond medical treatment to include prevention and stigma reduction for TB survivors. Sleman Health Office head Cahya Purnama notes that active case finding already exceeded targets (over 100%), with diagnosis occurring at health facilities after community identification by KOPI TBC networks and subsequent integration into district management. The initiative underscores ongoing screening, treatment, and stigma reduction to advance toward TB elimination by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: 18の専門家団体が連携、スレマンで結核対策に取り組む - Suara Merdeka Kedu
triage.triage_reason: 結核対策のための多機関連携という既存の公衆衛生プログラム推進の話題であり、異常な発生や急増を示す情報はなく、通常業務の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola health workers protest unpaid wages, disrupting response as deaths top 1,800
article.articleSummary: Bunia, Congo – Dozens of health workers at the outbreak’s epicenter protested unpaid wages, abandoning several facilities and disrupting the response as Ebola continues to spread. As of Tuesday, August 5, 2026, government data show 3,973 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,801 deaths. The protests reflect the strain on frontline responders during what authorities describe as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. The Congo outbreak is the second-largest on record, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that logged more than 28,000 cases and over 11,000 deaths. Aid workers warn transmission remains ongoing, underscoring the challenge of containment while the workforce is diverted by wage disputes.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ対応、医療従事者の未払い賃金抗議で混乱、死者数1,800人超に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（症例3,973件、死者1,801人）が継続中であり、史上最速拡大とされる深刻な公衆衛生事象で、対応体制も医療従事者のストライキにより崩壊しつつある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文はコンゴ（DRC）のブニアでの流行に焦点を当てており、Angolaでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'OMS alerte sur une flambée " hors de contrôle " et appelle à une mobilisation massive
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the WHO warns of an 'out-of-control' outbreak and calls for a massive mobilization.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has become the largest outbreak ever recorded there. As of 30 July 2026, the country reports 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality about 44%), with week 30 recording 567 new cases and 296 deaths. The outbreak began in Mongbwalu, Ituri, and has spread to five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo—affecting 49 health zones; Ituri accounts for 88% of confirmed cases (3,176) and 82.6% of deaths. About 17,900 contacts have been identified, with roughly 13,400 under active surveillance. Health workers remain heavily affected: 151 infections and 44 deaths, 68 recoveries. Uganda declared its outbreak over on 28 July 2026 but remains at risk of reintroduction; France reported an imported case on 24 June 2026. WHO urges urgent, massive scale-up of surveillance, labs, clinical care, community engagement, and safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:WHOが「制御不能」な流行拡大を警告し、大規模な動員を呼びかける
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ出血熱流行が発生し、致死率約44%、5州49保健地区に拡大、国際的な症例輸出（フランス）も確認されておりIHR基準を複数満たす。

article.articleHeadline: "四川造"狂犬病疫苗获批上市，最快14天完成全程接种
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sichuan-made Rabies Vaccine Approved for Market Launch, Full Vaccination Can Be Completed in as Fast as 14 Days
article.articleSummary: On Aug 6, 2026, Sichuan-made, lyophilized human rabies vaccine (Vero cell) from Chengdu-based Sinovac Biotech received NMPA drug registration and market approval. The vaccine supports two regimens: a five-dose schedule (0, 3, 7, 14, 28 days) and a simplified four-dose schedule (0, 3, 7, 14 days), completing vaccination in as fast as 14 days. It is produced with a serum-free, animal-origin-free process, using ATCC-validated Vero cells (Vero-SF-ACF) and the rPV-2061 strain, via fixed-bed bioreactor perfusion, and is formulated as a 'five-zero' product (no serum, no animal materials, no preservatives, no antibiotics, no gelatin, no dextran). Phase III, randomized, double-blind data show 100% seroconversion by day 14 after first dose and at 3 months; at 6 months, seroconversion >97.5% (vs 96.47% for comparator). Adverse events were similar to comparator, with no vaccine-related serious events. Sichuan promotes vaccine clusters, including Tianfu Vaccine Valley in Chengdu.

triage.headline_ja: 「四川造」狂犬病ワクチンが市場承認を取得、最短14日間で全接種完了可能

article.articleHeadline: U.S. FDA Accepts sBLA for ENFLONSIA (clesrovimab-cfor) to Update its Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Lower Respiratory Tract Disease Indication to Include Children Under Two Years at Increased Risk for Severe RSV for Their Second Season
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, the U.S. FDA accepted a second-sBLA for ENFLONSIA (clesrovimab-cfor) to expand its RSV LRTD preventive indication to children under two years at increased risk for severe RSV during their second season. ENFLONSIA was approved in the United States (June 2025) and by the European Commission (April 2026) for infants born during or entering their first RSV season, and is the first and only RSV LRTD preventive given without weight-based dosing. The expansion targets high‑risk groups—chronic lung disease, congenital heart disease, or early/moderate preterm birth with risk conditions—to reduce severe RSV in a second season. Regulatory filings are underway for additional countries and indication expansion where already approved. The decision draws on Phase 3 SMART MK-1654-007 data, presented at RSVVW'26 and published in NEJM (Sept 2025 interim) and JAMA Pediatr (July 2026 full results). ENFLONSIA is approved in more than 40 countries, including the U.S., Canada, EU, China and Japan.

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola spreads in DRC, declining international aid exposes the vulnerable
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, Ebola is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Mongbwalu named the outbreak’s epicenter after its official declaration in mid-May. The report notes declining international aid jeopardizing the response and leaving vulnerable communities exposed. In Mongbwalu, cardboard boxes piled in the courtyard of Action Against Hunger (ACF) offices symbolize the pressures facing responders. The article centers on the ongoing outbreak, regional challenges, and the gap between needs and aid flows, highlighting the risk to local patients, health workers, and residents in the epicenter and nearby areas while containment efforts continue amid constrained resources.

triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC東部で公式に流行宣言され拡大中であり、国際援助の減少により対応能力が損なわれているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Mongbwaluが流行の中心地とされ、国際援助の減少が対応の障害となっている点が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. FDA Accepts sBLA for ENFLONSIA™ (clesrovimab-cfor) to Update its Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Lower Respiratory Tract Disease Indication to Include Children Under Two Years at Increased Risk for Severe RSV for Their Second Season
article.articleSummary: Merck’s ENFLONSIA™ (clesrovimab-cfor) has its U.S. FDA supplemental Biologics License Application accepted to broaden RSV lower respiratory tract disease (LRTD) prevention to children under 2 years at increased risk for severe RSV through their second season; FDA target action date is March 22, 2027 (PDUFA). EMA likewise accepted EU expansion in July 2026. ENFLONSIA, approved in the U.S. (June 2025) and EU (April 2026) for infants in their first RSV season, is the first and only RSV LRTD preventive given without weight-based dosing. The expansion relies on Phase 3 SMART MK-1654-007 data, with interim RSV season 1 results in NEJM 2025 and full results in JAMA Pediatrics 2026, presented at RSVVW’26. In season 2, eligible under-2 high-risk children received a 210 mg open-label dose (n=276; 138/138 by prior arm); nearly all had chronic lung disease or congenital heart disease. ENFLONSIA is approved in 40+ countries including the U.S., Canada, EU, China, and Japan; regulatory filings are underway in additional markets. RSV seasons typically autumn through spring, and RSV remains a leading cause of infant hospitalization.

triage.triage_reason: 本記事は医薬品の規制申請受理に関する企業発表であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な感染拡大を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 3973 إصابة و1801 وفاة إيبولا يتفشى في الكونغو الديمقراطية

article.articleSummary: 3,973 confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases and 1,801 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to government data as of 2026-08-06. Health authorities continue intensified efforts to contain the outbreak and limit transmission. The rise comes with World Health Organization warnings of accelerating spread, with infection rates in some areas reportedly exceeding response capacities. The available excerpt does not detail symptoms, laboratory confirmation specifics, the infection source, or any imported/exported cases. The report underscores a mounting burden on the health system and the need for strengthened containment across affected regions of the DRC.

article.articleHeadline: Епидемията от ебола в Конго се очаква да премине границата от 4000 заразени
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo is expected to surpass the 4,000 infected mark.
article.articleSummary: As of early August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is expected to exceed 4,000 infections, making it the fastest-spreading in the country’s history and the world’s second-largest after West Africa’s 2014–2016 crisis (over 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths). The outbreak, declared in May, is expanding about five times faster than prior events; 2,000 cases were reached in roughly two months, versus more than ten months in 2018–2020. Experts say the virus circulated unseen since January, with early patients misdiagnosed and some labs testing for a different Ebola virus, plus improper sample handling delaying detection. It is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or proven effective treatment, unlike the Zaire strain. WHO warns that population mobility raises the risk of wider spread and complicates containment. Reuters reports via Bulgaria ON AIR.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、感染者数が4000人を超える見込み
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大のエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株、ワクチン未承認）が4000人超に達する見込みで、WHOが人口移動によるさらなる拡大リスクを警告しているため、IHR基準に複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBulgariaとAngolaが含まれるが、記事はブルガリアのメディア（Reuters経由）による報道であり、Angolaでの発生は本文中で言及されていないため除外。ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株による史上最速の流行拡大という点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Āfrikā izplatās invazīvs malārijas ods no Indijas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An invasive malaria-carrying mosquito is spreading in Africa from India.
article.articleSummary: An invasive malaria-carrying mosquito, Anopheles stephensi, from India, is spreading rapidly across Africa, fueling malaria outbreak concerns in major urban centers. As of 2026-08-06, the World Health Organization warns that 126–130 million additional people may be at risk, especially in fast-growing African cities where malaria has been less common. An. stephensi thrives in densely populated urban areas, breeding in water containers around buildings, complicating control. It shows resistance to nearly all major insecticides. First detected in East Africa’s Djibouti in 2012, it has since reached Ethiopia, Sudan, Somalia, Kenya, Nigeria, and Ghana; Nigerian samples in 2024 indicate spread to West Africa. Researchers are pursuing biological control, innovative technologies, and next-generation insecticides. Monitoring is hampered by funding gaps and conflict, limiting knowledge of full distribution (Kenya Medical Research Institute).

triage.headline_ja: インドから来た侵略的なマラリア媒介蚊がアフリカで拡大している
triage.triage_reason: WHOが1億2600万〜1億3000万人の追加リスクを警告するなど、複数国にまたがる公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常な拡大が確認されており、IHR基準を2つ以上満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: インドは侵略的蚊（Anopheles stephensi）の起源地として言及されているのみで、現在の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。ガーナは記事内で本種が到達したと明記されているため対象国として含めた。エチオピア、スーダン、ソマリア、ケニア、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief urges stronger Ebola response in DR Congo visit
article.articleSummary: DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, has 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths across five eastern provinces, with about 90% of cases in Ituri. In Mongbwalu, Ebola treatment center staff protested unpaid allowances, highlighting fragility of health system; on Aug 4 a 100-bed treatment center opened in Bunia. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or therapy yet. Trials are underway: Canada approved Moderna to begin Bundibugyo vaccine trials; a late July dose of another Bundibugyo vaccine from Oxford University; Hilleman Laboratories pursuing a third candidate; the WHO notes the Oxford/others use the same rVSV platform as Ervebo, licensed for Zaire strain. US funding on Aug 5 exceeds $242 million this year, bringing total assistance to over $500 million, the largest contributor. WHO Director-General Tedros visited Kinshasa Aug 5, urging rapid scale-up, frontline worker protection, community outreach, surveillance, and safe burials.

triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行は確定症例3,874例、死亡1,751例に達し、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyoウイルス株による大規模流行であり、WHO事務局長が現地訪問して対応強化を要請するなど国際的関心・支援ニーズが高い。
triage.notes: 米国・カナダはワクチン支援・資金提供国として言及されているのみで発生地域ではないため、verified_locationsからは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết bùng phát ở đặc khu Phú Quý, nhiều ca nặng đáng lo ngại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever outbreak in Phu Quy Special Administrative-Economic Zone, many severe cases raise concerns.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in Phu Quy Special Administrative-Economic Zone, Lam Dong Province, reports 82 cases and 6 severe cases as of August 4, 2026, the largest in years. All six hamlets on the island are affected. Phu An is the hotspot with 43 cases (over half) including two severe. Quy Thanh and My Khe each have 12 cases (two severe in Quy Thanh, one in My Khe). Triều Duong has 2 cases (one severe); Quy Hai and Phu Hai have fewer. Nine transmission foci identified; Phu An accounts for four, Quy Thanh three, My Khe one, Triều Duong one. Health authorities have addressed 7 of 9 foci, ending 6; 3 foci remain monitored, with one having a second chemical spray and two more spraying campaigns planned. Measures include mass environmental cleaning, larviciding, and fogging; nearly 2,000 households have been sprayed island-wide, with Phu An receiving two rounds. Residents are urged to eliminate breeding sites and seek early medical care upon fever to prevent severe dengue.

triage.headline_ja: フーカイ特別行政経済区でデング熱が流行、重症例多数で懸念広がる
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの離島地域における局地的なデング熱アウトブレイクで、近年最大規模かつ重症例も報告されているが、地方当局により対応中でIHR基準の該当は確認できず、国際的拡大の可能性は低い。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで季節性に流行する疾患であり、今回は離島の特定地域（Phu Quy）での局地的アウトブレイク。地方当局が防除措置（薬剤散布、環境整備）を実施中で、外部支援の必要性は記事に明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO desak penguatan respons wabah Ebola di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Urges Strengthening of the Ebola Outbreak Response in Kongo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues to surge, with the WHO confirming this as a high-risk, international concern. As of the latest figures, DRC has 3,748 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,657 deaths. On May 17, WHO designated the outbreak in both DRC and Uganda as a public health emergency of international concern, and by August 1 the spread was accelerating to the fastest pace in the country’s history. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, speaking from Kinshasa, stressed the need to massively scale up all response efforts with partners, including reaching communities despite security and displacement challenges, strengthening government-led coordination, protecting and supporting health workers, and speeding access to care, surveillance, and safe burials. The international risk remains high in the region, with ongoing efforts to control the epidemic in both DRC and Uganda.

triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言し、DRCで3,748例・1,657人死亡と大規模流行が加速している。国際的関心・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確でIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta que el ébola avanza más rápido que la respuesta internacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that Ebola is advancing faster than the international response
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo strain, is advancing faster than the response, as of 2026-08-03 with 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths. Ituri, epicenter, faces healthcare workers’ strike for better pay and rebel violence hindering response. The case fatality rate is about 45%, with 77 new cases and 44 deaths reported in the last 24 hours. A total of 717 patients remain in isolation, while 749 have recovered. No approved treatment or vaccine exists. Contact tracing is failing; up to 70% of new infections originate outside surveillance. The United States added $242 million to the response, bringing its total aid to over $512 million. Doctors Without Borders warns that aid is not arriving quickly enough to halt transmission. WHO and regional bodies urge urgent, massive expansion of detection, tracing, and access to quality care, with government leadership and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の拡大が国際的な対応を上回っていると警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが致死率約45%、症例数3,874人と深刻化し、サーベイランス外での感染拡大や治療・ワクチン未承認など公衆衛生上の重大な懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 米国は対応国であり発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。医療従事者のストライキや反政府勢力による妨害など、対応能力を著しく低下させる要因が複数存在し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Outbreak Races Ahead As Health Workers Go On Strike Over Pay
article.articleSummary: Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, is expanding faster than response efforts since it began mid-May. By August 6, the health ministry reported 3,874 laboratory-confirmed infections and 1,751 deaths, with Ituri the worst-hit as frontline workers strike over pay, tightening pressures on Bunia and eastern frontier regions near South Sudan, Uganda, and Rwanda. The virus has no licensed vaccine or specific therapy, and tracing gaps have left 60–70% of new infections outside monitored contact networks. Case fatality is around 45%, with 717 in isolation and 749 recovered; in one 24-hour period, 44 of 77 new cases died. The outbreak is described as the second-largest Ebola event ever, after 2014–2016 West Africa. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged rapid scale-up and community-led response; the US added $242 million for immediate response and preparedness, bringing direct aid to over $512 million.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが加速、医療従事者は賃金未払いでストライキ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目の規模とされるエボラアウトブレイクが拡大中で、致死率約45%、追跡不能な感染連鎖が6-7割に達しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 南スーダン・ウガンダ・ルワンダとの国境地帯への波及リスクが言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染拡大の中心はコンゴ・イトゥリ州およびブニアである。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A

article.articleHeadline: Вирусолог Волчков рассказал, кто находится в зоне риска заражения свиным гриппом
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Virologist Volchkov explained who is at risk of contracting swine flu.
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, Russia expects an autumn epidemic of swine flu and Hong Kong flu. Virologist Pavel Volchkov identifies children as the primary transmitters; households with unvaccinated or previously uninfected children are at high risk of intra-household spread due to close contact and large viral loads. Older adults and people with chronic illnesses are most vulnerable, and swine flu could be fatal for patients on chemotherapy. Typical symptoms include high fever, muscle pains, and headaches. The article notes guidance on distinguishing influenza from acute respiratory viral infection, citing 360.ru and Vecherna Moskva. No case counts, laboratory confirmations, or explicit infection sources are provided. The piece underscores vaccination and protective measures for families with children as a key public health consideration.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス学者ヴォルチコフ氏、豚インフルエンザ感染リスクのある層について解説
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ流行への一般的な注意喚起記事であり、症例数や検査確定情報もなく、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアにおける秋の季節性インフルエンザ流行予測に関する専門家解説であり、中国・香港は主題として明示されていない（発生地域リストにあるが本文で言及なし）。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC, l'OMS et le CDC Africa renforcent la riposte à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC, WHO and Africa CDC step up the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: On Wednesday, August 5, 2026, at the African Union City (Cité de l’Union Africaine), the Democratic Republic of the Congo President Félix Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo chaired a high-level crisis meeting on the persistence of Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo strain. Attendees included WHO Director-General Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Africa CDC Director Dr Jean Kaseya, Prime Minister Judith Suminwa, and other government officials involved in the response. The session signals a stepped-up Ebola response with intensified international coordination to address ongoing transmission. The report emphasizes leadership and coordinated action from DRC authorities, WHO, and Africa CDC, rather than detailing case counts or clinical data, showcasing a mobilization of political and health-system efforts to curb persistence of the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、WHO、アフリカCDCがエボラ対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の持続的な感染拡大に対し、DRC大統領主催の高レベル危機対応会議が開催され、WHOおよびアフリカCDCが関与する国際的な対応強化が行われており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが示唆される。
triage.notes: 症例数や臨床データは記事に記載されておらず、政治的・保健システム的な対応強化に焦点が当てられている。continued transmissionが示唆されるが具体的な数値情報は不明。

article.articleHeadline: ಚಂಡಿಪುರ ವೈರಸ್‌ಗೆ ಬಲಿಯಾಗುತ್ತಿರುವ ಮಕ್ಕಳು; ಈ ವೈರಸ್ ಯಾವ ರೀತಿ ಹರಡುತ್ತೆ ಗೊತ್ತಾ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Children affected by Chandipur virus; do you know how this virus spreads?
article.articleSummary: Chandipur virus is affecting children in Chandipur. The article explains how the virus may spread via vectors such as mosquitoes and sandflies, emphasizing vector-control as key to prevention. Household guidance includes installing insecticides, sleeping under mosquito nets or sandfly nets at evening and night, and using child-safe insect repellents. It also advises keeping homes and nearby areas clean, and sealing cracks in earthen mud walls where sandflies can breed, along with improving sanitation around the home to curb vector populations. The recommendations target reducing exposure during dusk and nighttime when vectors are active, especially for children. The piece does not provide case counts or laboratory confirmation, and focuses on practical, at-home measures to limit transmission.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルスの犠牲になる子供たち；このウイルスはどのように広がるのか？
triage.triage_reason: 既知のベクター媒介ウイルス（チャンディプラウイルス）に関する一般的な予防啓発記事で、症例数や検査確認情報がなく、具体的な発生地・規模が不明であるため、続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はチャンディプラウイルスの一般的な予防・啓発情報が中心で、症例数や検査確認、具体的発生地の記載がない。発生地域にはバングラデシュの地名（Rajshahi Division, Chandipur）も含まれるが、対象国リスト外のため除外。チャンディプラウイルスは主にインドで既知の風土病であるためIndiaのみ計上。

article.articleHeadline: Здравствените работници во Конго протестираат против неисплатените плати за време на епидемијата на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Healthcare workers in Congo protest against unpaid salaries during the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Tens of healthcare workers at the Ebola epicenter in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, protested unpaid salaries, prompting several facilities to halt operations and complicate patient care. Reports indicate workers, including nurses delivering frontline Ebola care, have not received pay and per‑diem allowances since the outbreak was declared in mid-May. The protests have continued for weeks, with delayed payments driving staff to abandon frontline health centers that serve as the main line of defense against the outbreak. Ituri Province is currently the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC, and health authorities say the virus is spreading rapidly in the region. The protests are taking place outside the provincial government headquarters in Bunia, the capital of Ituri, where nearly 90% of the country’s Ebola cases occur.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行下、医療従事者が未払い賃金に抗議
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州のエボラ流行震源地で医療従事者のストライキが発生し、感染対応の中核となる医療施設が機能停止するなど、流行対応能力の著しい低下が懸念される。
triage.notes: エボラ流行下での医療従事者への未払い賃金により、最前線の医療施設が業務停止し、感染拡大対応が脆弱化している。イツリ州はDRCのエボラ症例の約9割を占める震源地であり、状況の悪化がさらなる感染拡大につながるリスクが高い。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Children Bear Brunt of DRC's Fastest-Growing Ebola Outbreak - UNICEF
article.articleSummary: DRC faces its fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record; as of Aug 2, 2026, 743 confirmed Ebola cases among children 17 and under, including 330 deaths. Children account for about 25% of cases but nearly one-third of deaths; under-five case fatality rate exceeds 60% versus under 30% for adults 18+. Disruption of essential health services is worsening outcomes by limiting treatment for malaria and diarrhoea. UNICEF has revised its six-month appeal to $113.45 million to expand operations from 21 to 51 high-risk health zones, but only $23.5 million has been mobilized, leaving an $89.9 million shortfall. About 13,000 frontline workers have been trained and deployed; prevention messages have reached over 2.4 million people, and more than 505,000 household visits have been conducted to identify suspected cases. Eight Ebola treatment centers and 45 health facilities are equipped with infection prevention supplies; mental health support has reached over 21,000 people, including 5,100 children.

triage.headline_ja: 子どもたちがDRCで史上最速拡大のエボラ流行の犠牲に - UNICEF
triage.triage_reason: DRCで記録上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が進行中で、743症例・330死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、資金不足による対応能力の限界も報告されているためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: UNICEFは資金支援appeal(1億1345万ドル)を出しているが23.5百万ドルしか集まっておらず、8990万ドルの資金ギャップが存在。5歳未満の致死率が60%超と極めて高い点が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: Especialistas alertam para o perigo das hepatites virais, doenças silenciosas que atacam o fígado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts warn of the danger of viral hepatitis, silent diseases that attack the liver
article.articleSummary: Viral hepatitis remains a public health challenge in Brazil due to its silent progression that can damage the liver for years. Experts from the Institute of Medical Assistance to Public Servants (IAMSPE) say early diagnosis and prevention are the most effective tools to halt progression and prevent irreversible damage. Nationally, infections are mainly hepatitis A, B and C, with D and E present. About 70% of acute cases are asymptomatic early on; when fatigue, loss of appetite, nausea, abdominal pain, or jaundice appear, the disease is often advanced. Hepatitis B and C can become chronic, increasing risks of cirrhosis and liver cancer; A and E typically have limited evolution with recovery. Diagnosis relies on laboratory tests; annual testing is advised for high-risk groups and routine testing for adults. Prevention combines vaccination (A and B) with hygiene: condoms, treated water, safe food handling, and not sharing needles. Regular testing enables treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家が肝臓を蝕む「静かな病」ウイルス性肝炎の危険性を警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける一般的な啓発記事であり、特定の集団感染や異常事態の報告ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は専門家による一般的な啓発・予防情報であり、特定のアウトブレイクや症例急増を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola outbreak becomes world's fastest-growing as scientists race for vaccine
article.articleSummary: DRC's Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak has grown rapidly since it was first reported in Ituri on 15 May, spreading to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. As of 30 July, 3,605 people have been infected and more than 1,587 have died, making it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak and the second-largest on record. Conflict zones, population displacement, delayed diagnosis, undetected transmission chains, overcrowded camps and limited healthcare resources hinder containment. The outbreak has triggered cross-border concerns with Uganda and South Sudan, with Uganda reporting imported cases contained without sustained transmission and South Sudan maintaining heightened border monitoring. Funding: AfDB approved US$13 million in emergency funding to DRC, Uganda and South Sudan to boost early diagnosis, surveillance, community awareness, cross-border coordination and emergency response. No approved vaccine for Bundibugyo yet; trials are underway (WHO treatment trials in DRC; Oxford/Serum Institute Bundibugyo vaccine; Moderna mRNA vaccine).

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、世界最速の拡大を見せる中、科学者らはワクチン開発を急ぐ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが急速に拡大し、感染者3,605人・死者1,587人超と過去2番目の規模に達しており、周辺国への越境拡大懸念もあることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境懸念が記載されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。承認済みワクチンなし、複数の臨床試験進行中。AfDBが緊急資金1,300万米ドルを承認。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolu v Kongu se nedaří zastavit. Šéf WHO se o tom přesvědčil osobně
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo can't be stopped. The WHO chief has seen it for himself.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is currently the fastest-spreading in the disease’s history, with the second-highest death toll among 17 outbreaks. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the eastern province of Ituri near the Uganda border, where most cases are reported; he noted some areas have doubling in cases over the last week and urged broader efforts. As of Monday, authorities confirmed 3,874 Ebola cases and 1,751 deaths. More than 700 patients are in isolation; 749 people have recovered. Transmission occurs through contact with blood, secretions, and bodily fluids of the infected, and animals can also transmit the virus, putting health workers at high risk. The virus has five strains named Bundibugyo, Sudan, Taï Forest, Reston, and Zaire; three strains cause serious disease in humans. Ebola first emerged in 1976 in Zaire (DRC).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱が制御不能に。WHO事務局長が現地で自らそれを確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ流行が継続し、感染者3,874人・死者1,751人に達しており、WHO事務局長が現地視察するなど国際的関心も高いためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ国境付近での症例増加が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。国際的拡大リスクとしては記述あり。

article.articleHeadline: പ്രളയ ബാധിത പ്രദേശങ്ങളിൽ ആശങ്കയായി രോഗവ്യാപനം. ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി, മഞ്ഞപ്പിത്തം അടക്കമുള്ള രോഗങ്ങൾ ഭീഷണി ഉയർത്തുന്നു. പ്രളയജലത്തിൽ ഇറങ്ങിയവർ എലിപ്പനി പ്രതിരോധത്തിനായി ഡൊക്സിസൈക്ലിൻ കഴിക്കണമെന്ന നിർദേശവുമായി ആരോഗ്യ പ്രവർത്തകരും.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Disease spread has become a concern in flood-affected areas. Dengue fever, malaria, and other diseases are posing a threat. Those who entered floodwaters are advised to take doxycycline to prevent leptospirosis.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, flood-affected areas in Kottayam district face rising threats from dengue fever, malaria, and leptospirosis. Prolonged exposure to contaminated floodwater and mud increases infection risk, with fever and other illnesses common in affected populations. Health authorities are distributing doxycycline as chemoprophylaxis: adults are advised a 200 mg dose once weekly after meals, to be swallowed with plenty of water, and to remain upright for at least 30 minutes after intake. The preventive course should continue weekly for as long as contact with floodwater persists. Pregnant women, lactating mothers, and children under eight should not take doxycycline. Treatment should follow a physician’s instructions; if fever, body aches, or eye redness occur, individuals should not self-treat but seek care immediately. The health department is coordinating distribution in camps.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水被災地域で感染症拡大が懸念。デング熱、黄疸などの疾病が脅威に。洪水水に入った人はレプトスピラ症予防のためドキシサイクリン服用を保健当局が呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケーララ州の洪水後にデング熱・マラリア・レプトスピラ症のリスクが高まっているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、地域的な公衆衛生対応の域内にとどまるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 洪水後の複数の媒介動物由来感染症（デング熱、マラリア、レプトスピラ症）に関する季節的・地域的な公衆衛生対応事案。保健当局が予防投薬を実施しており、管理体制は機能している模様。

article.articleHeadline: الكونجو تعترض قاربًا على متنه 200 شخص وسط مخاوف من انتشار إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo intercepts a boat carrying 200 people amid fears of Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo authorities intercepted a boat carrying about 200 people traveling from Kisangani to Kinshasa at Maluku River Port, roughly 65 km from Kinshasa, amid fears of an Ebola outbreak. A previously deceased passenger is suspected to have Ebola after leaving the vessel. Health officials said a mobile laboratory was dispatched to test all passengers and crew; the 32-year-old man had disembarked in Mongala Province before symptoms appeared. No further deaths were reported among passengers, though the patient had not undergone laboratory confirmation due to equipment shortages at the facility where he was treated. River journeys between Kisangani and Kinshasa can last weeks, complicating surveillance. Government data indicate seven confirmed Ebola cases in Tshpo/Tshopo Province across five affected provinces, with 3,973 infections and 1,801 deaths to date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ流行への懸念の中、200人乗りの船を拿捕
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の疑い例が発生し、川船での長距離移動により感染拡大のリスクが高く、既に7例確認・複数州に拡大している状況で、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 船内の疑い症例は検査機器不足のため未確定。キサンガニ～キンシャサ間の河川移動は数週間かかり、監視が困難。既存の流行はTshopo州を含む5州で3,973例・1,801死亡と報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: கொங்கோவில் எபோலா பரவல் மோசமடைந்துள்ளது; உடனடி சர்வதேச நடவடிக்கை அவசியம் - எல்லைகளற்ற மருத்துவர்கள் அமைப்பு எச்சரிக்கை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo has deteriorated; urgent international action is necessary — Doctors Without Borders warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has deteriorated, prompting urgent international action per Doctors Without Borders. As of August 1, 2026, WHO data report 3,605 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases—the largest outbreak in DRC to date—accompanied by about 1,500 deaths in the past 11 weeks. New suspected infections are reported daily in new districts, and current measures are not containing spread. Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Sopo provinces host 7 treatment centers and 15+ isolation wards; 1,362 patients have been admitted since onset, with 282 recovered. Over 1,400 staff are engaged in the response. MSF notes that 90% of admitted patients are not from known contacts and only 59% of total contacts in Ituri are traced. Emphasis on community engagement, sustained essential health services (malaria, diarrhea, cholera, malnutrition), and unhindered access for humanitarian organizations amid rainy-season access challenges.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ拡大が悪化；緊急の国際的対応が必要 ― 国境なき医師団が警告
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行（確定例3,605件、死者約1,500人）が拡大を続け、接触者追跡率も低く制御不能な状況にあり、MSFが緊急の国際的対応を要請している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にPortugal（Viana do Castelo等）が含まれるが、記事サマリー上は主題ではなくDRCでの流行のみが該当。感染は北キブ・南キブ・イトゥリ・ソポ州で確認され、新規感染者が新たな地区で日々報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: बारिश में दुधारू पशुओं पर बढ़ता इन खतरनाक बीमारियों का खतरा, अपनाएं ये जरूरी उपाय
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising risk of these dangerous diseases in dairy cattle during the rainy season; adopt these essential measures.
article.articleSummary: As monsoon arrives, dairy cattle face elevated risks of viral and bacterial infections and parasitic diseases, threatening milk yield. Diseases highlighted include galghonto, adharangi, Black Quarter (Blackleg), and Foot-and-Mouth Disease, plus Fascioliasis (liver fluke) from contaminated water and fodder. External parasites such as ticks, lice, and fleas drive Babesiosis and Theileriosis, with fever and red urine possible; snail-like vectors spread parasites. To reduce risk, maintain proper housing: Head-to-Head systems allow easier feeding but raise cross-infection risk; Tail-to-Tail systems reduce contact and aid ventilation and cleaning. Rural farms favor Head-to-Head for space and feed management; urban dairies prefer Tail-to-Tail for hygiene and housing density. Mastitis risk increases during calving; keep barns clean, dry, ventilated, and elevate resting areas to avoid mud. Provide balanced diets, avoid moldy fodder, ensure clean water, and perform deworming and vaccination against mastitis-linked pathogens and Foot-and-Mouth disease during the monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季に乳牛を襲う危険な疾病リスク増加、実施すべき必須対策とは
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の家畜疾病予防に関する一般的な農業啓発記事であり、人への公衆衛生上の異常事態やアウトブレイクの報告は含まれない。
triage.notes: 家畜（乳牛）の季節性疾病予防に関する一般的な農業指導記事であり、具体的なアウトブレイク事例の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Gerak Cepat Lawan TBC! Pemdes Gapuk Gandeng Dinkes dan Puskesmas Gelar Tracing dan Cek Kesehatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapid Action Against TB! Gapuk Village Government Teams Up with the Health Office and the Community Health Center to Conduct Contact Tracing and Health Checks.
article.articleSummary: Gapuk Village Government, in collaboration with the West Lombok Health Office and Puskesmas Dasan Tapen, held Integrated Tuberculosis (TB) Tracing and Free Health Checks in Gapuk, Gerung District, West Lombok Regency, to boost early detection, prevention, and access to health services. The event was officially opened by Hj. Erni Suryana, S.Si., M.M., Head of the West Lombok Health Office’s PPKB, with support from Gapuk Village Secretary H. Zaenudin, S.E., M.E., and Puskesmas Dasan Tapen Chief Dr. Sabarudin, who led free health screenings and TB education. Activities included measuring height and weight for children and community education on early detection of communicable diseases, especially TB. The initiative reinforces TB control efforts and expands local health services; no TB case counts or outbreaks are reported.

triage.headline_ja: 結核対策に迅速対応！ガプック村政府が保健局・保健所と連携し追跡調査と健康診断を実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策・地域啓発活動の報道であり、症例数や集団感染の報告がなく、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・社会的関心の高まりも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の早期発見・予防活動を紹介する地域啓発報道であり、アウトブレイクや症例数の急増は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 'Check your cupboards' - Warning as food item recalled due to presence of salmonella
article.articleSummary: Salmonella risk triggers recall by Ireland’s Food Safety Authority of Compania Indilor Orientale Susan Sesame Seeds, 50 g, batch L1312242, origin India, best before 31/07/2026. The batch was recalled on 5 August 2026; consumers should not eat the implicated product and should check their cupboards. Retailers must remove the item from sale and display recall notices; wholesalers/distributors should contact affected customers and provide point-of-sale recall notices to retailers. Salmonella infection typically appears 6–72 hours after ingestion (often 12–36 hours) with diarrhoea (sometimes bloody), fever, headache, and abdominal cramps; illness lasts 4–7 days and can require hospital admission in the elderly, infants, and those with impaired immunity. The notice emphasizes avoiding the batch to prevent illness.

triage.headline_ja: 『戸棚を確認してください』－サルモネラ菌混入により食品がリコール、との警告
triage.triage_reason: アイルランドでの食品（インド産ごま）リコールに関する予防的通知であり、実際の感染症例は報告されていない。対象国での発生事例でもないため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Antigo Hospital São Lucas é multado por focos da dengue em Taubaté
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Former São Lucas Hospital fined for dengue hotspots in Taubaté.
article.articleSummary: Taubaté, Brazil – The former São Lucas Hospital was fined by the City Hall after Sinantrópicos Animal Control (CAS) inspectors identified recurring Aedes aegypti breeding hotspots on the property. The action followed inspections that confirmed ongoing mosquito proliferation. Aedes aegypti is the vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The municipality notes that fines can be applied to any property owner, whether the site is active or not, whenever breeding habitats are found. CAS conducts daily door-to-door visits to locate and eliminate breeding sites and urges residents to remove containers that collect water. Band Vale is attempting to contact the hospital owners; the property remains open for comment. No dengue, Zika, or chikungunya cases or laboratory confirmations are reported in the article. Published 2026-08-06.

triage.headline_ja: 旧サン・ルーカス病院、タウバテ市でデング熱発生源として罰金処分
triage.triage_reason: 特定施設でのデング熱媒介蚊の発生源に関する行政措置の記事であり、実際の感染症例や公衆衛生上の異常事態の報告はない。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊の発生源管理に関する地方自治体の措置についてのみ言及しており、症例報告や流行の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: DRC: Five provinces still affected by Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths across 51 health zones in five provinces, with Ituri province as the active epicenter and monitoring in Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. No new transmission clusters in the prior 24 hours, signaling stabilization. 717 confirmed patients are isolated or receiving care; 749 have recovered, for a case fatality rate of 45.1%. In the latest day, 22 patients recovered. Authorities are reinforcing Ebola Treatment Centers with additional staff and supplies, prioritizing North Kivu and Haut-Uélé. National community surveillance and contact tracing cover 78.4% of contacts; South Kivu has 100% follow-up, with other regions above 80% and strategies adapted for lagging areas. Response continues under challenging security and humanitarian conditions, with emphasis on community engagement, safe burials, risk communication, and psychosocial support to sustain public trust and preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱の流行が依然として5州に影響
triage.triage_reason: 致死率45.1%、5州51保健地区にまたがる大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、IHR基準の複数該当及び国際的関心・支援の必要性が明白なため。
triage.notes: 接触者追跡率は全国78.4%、南キブは100%と地域差あり。治安・人道状況の悪化が対応の課題として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Положението вече е критично! Епидемията от ебола в ДР Конго навлиза в нова фаза
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The situation is already critical! The Ebola epidemic in DR Congo enters a new phase.
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in eastern DR Congo is described as more critical than ever by Doctors Without Borders, as WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits the region to bolster control measures. As of early August 2026, the Ministry of Health reports 3,874 cases and 1,751 deaths, about two and a half months after the outbreak began. MSF warns the virus is spreading at an alarming, unprecedented pace despite frontline medical efforts. A key hurdle is insufficient contact tracing: roughly 90% of patients at the Bunia treatment center had not been identified as contacts prior to infection, hindering containment. Public health experts emphasize that identifying, isolating, and treating contacts early could bring the outbreak under control. Calls for greater community involvement and local leadership come amid widespread distrust of authorities and ongoing fighting in rebel-controlled areas. This is the largest Ebola outbreak in DR Congo; the rainy season is expected to complicate transport and humanitarian operations.

triage.headline_ja: 状況はすでに危機的だ！DRコンゴのエボラ流行が新たな局面に突入
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRコンゴ史上最大規模で急速に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当し、WHO事務局長の現地訪問など国際的関心も高いためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 3,874症例・1,751死亡（致死率約45%）で、DRコンゴ史上最大のエボラ流行とされる。接触者追跡の不備、紛争地域での治安悪化、雨季による人道支援の困難が拡大要因として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Boehringer Ingelheim aposta em vacina em gel para prevenir Salmonella em suínos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Boehringer Ingelheim bets on a gel-based vaccine to prevent Salmonella in pigs.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella in pigs poses clinical disease, subclinical production losses, and a public health risk as a zoonosis. At SIAVS 2026, Boehringer Ingelheim showcased a gel-based vaccine to prevent Salmonella infection in pigs. The vaccine is administered in gel, does not induce fever, and reduces stress during handling, enhancing practicality for on-farm use. The strategy targets initiation within the farm and aims to extend impact across the entire production chain, improving swine health management and biosecurity. The presentation is part of O Presente Rural’s SIAVS 2026 coverage, highlighting ongoing innovation in vaccination approaches for swine.

triage.headline_ja: ベーリンガーインゲルハイム、豚のサルモネラ予防にジェル状ワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: これは豚向けワクチン製品の紹介記事であり、実際の疾病発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報じるものではない。
