article.articleHeadline: Ébola, en punto crítico, dice OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola at a critical point, says WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is at a critical juncture, with the outbreak accelerating faster than response efforts. In Ituri, the epicenter, frontline workers have gone on strike over pay, hindering access to care amid ongoing conflict near borders with South Sudan, Uganda and Rwanda. As of last Monday, the outbreak shows 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths. Detected about three months ago in mid-May, transmission is described as alarmingly rapid and unprecedented—the second-largest on record, surpassed only by the West Africa outbreak of 2014–2016 (over 28,000 cases and more than 11,000 deaths). WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Kinshasa, urged rapid, scaled-up action across all response pillars. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) warned that transmission is proceeding at an alarming pace.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、危機的な局面に―WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が急速に拡大し、3,874症例・1,751死亡と過去2番目の規模に達しており、WHOが緊急対応を呼びかけている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 国境地帯（南スーダン、ウガンダ、ルワンダ）での紛争が対応を阻害しており、越境拡大のリスクが懸念される。対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases near 4,000 as DRC struggles to contain fast-spreading outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) has reached 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths, declared mid-May and the largest in DRC history. Five provinces are affected, with Ituri the epicenter, accounting for about 90% of cases; Bunia hosts a 100-bed Ebola treatment centre. The outbreak is spreading faster than response capacity, prompting scale-up and protection for health workers. Kinshasa is at risk after a passenger boat, Yingfeng 2, carrying about 200 people from Tshopo, was intercepted en route to Kinshasa; all aboard will be tested after a suspected case on board and a death in Mongala; Ebola status unconfirmed. The US has allocated $242 million; WHO calls for surveillance, safe burials, and action in Ituri. Vaccines for Bundibugyo are experimental: Moderna and Oxford candidates in trials; Hilleman Laboratories pursuing a third; Ervebo targets Zaire strain; three treatments are under testing in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の症例が4,000人近くに、DRCが急速に拡大する流行の抑制に苦慮
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行で死者1,801人・症例3,973人に達し、5州に拡大、首都キンシャサへの波及リスクもあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 米国は資金拠出国であり発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。キンシャサへの拡大疑いは未確定（Ebola status unconfirmed）だが、既にDRC国内で5州に拡大しており深刻度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : contamination record avec plus de 3000 cas confirmés en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: record high number of confirmed cases in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached unprecedented levels. As of 30 July, the WHO reports 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths since the outbreak began on 15 May, a case fatality rate of about 44%. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment yet; a ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine candidate remains in trials. The outbreak started in Mongbwalu, Ituri, and has spread to five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo. In the last surveillance week, 567 new confirmed cases and 296 deaths were recorded, with health workers accounting for 151 infections (44 deaths). Response efforts continue with UN agencies, Congolese authorities, and humanitarian partners, but insecurity, population displacement, and access obstacles impede control. WHO urges intensified international mobilization and strengthened cross-border surveillance due to high transmission risk near borders.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例数が記録的な3000人超に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約44%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが5州に拡大し、医療従事者感染や国境付近での越境感染リスクが高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOが国際的な動員強化と国境を越えたサーベイランス強化を呼びかけており、ワクチン未承認かつ治療法未確立の状況下で致死率が高い点が重大。フルRRAへの移行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: How early screening can beat 'silent killers' Hepatitis B and C
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, Hepatitis B and C often progress silently for years, risking cirrhosis, liver failure or liver cancer before warning signs appear. In India, about 300 million people live with HBV or HCV unaware of infection. Early screening via a simple blood test is the key to prevention: HBV can be controlled with antivirals and vaccinated against, while most Hepatitis C infections are now curable with oral medicines taken for a few months. Transmission varies: HBV through infected blood, unprotected sex, or mother-to-child; HCV mainly through infected blood via unsafe injections, unsterile medical or dental procedures, tattooing, or sharing needles. High-risk groups include family history, healthcare workers, pre-screened blood transfusion recipients, dialysis patients, multiple sexual partners, injection drug users, and persistently abnormal liver tests. Do not wait for symptoms; early diagnosis reduces risk of cirrhosis and cancer.

triage.headline_ja: 早期スクリーニングが『沈黙の殺し屋』B型・C型肝炎を防ぐ方法
triage.triage_reason: 慢性肝炎の啓発・早期検診を促す一般的な健康記事であり、急性の公衆衛生イベントや異常な集団発生を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 急性アウトブレイクではなく、慢性肝炎に関する啓発・医療情報記事のためシグナルトリアージ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-Chef zu Gesprächen über Ebola-Bekämpfung erneut im Kongo - Deutsches Ärzteblatt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief in talks on Ebola containment again in the Congo - Deutsches Ärzteblatt
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo escalates as WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits Kinshasa amid rapid spread, with Ituri province alone accounting for about 90% of cases. The outbreak has more than 3,600 laboratory‑confirmed infections and around 1,500 deaths, the largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded in the DRC. Containment lags as resources are stretched for treatment capacity, on‑site research, safe burials, and social support. A critical factor is contact tracing; in Bunia, about 90% of patients were not previously identified as contacts. Ongoing conflict and distrust hinder response, and the rainy season may impede transport and aid. The United States pledges an additional $242 million for immediate measures, regional preparedness, and humanitarian aid, adding to over $512 million in direct U.S. assistance and part of a broader $1.8 billion for UN OCHA, including funds for DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴでエボラ対策協議のため再訪問
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（感染確定3,600例超、死者約1,500人）が進行中で、WHO事務局長が直接対応協議のため訪問しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 米国は2.42億ドルの追加支援を表明し、既存の5.12億ドル以上の直接支援に加え、UN OCHAを通じた広範な支援（南スーダン、ウガンダを含む）の一部として提供。ウガンダ・南スーダン・米国は発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。渡航・貿易制限の情報は記事中に明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Kryzys w Kongo. Nie dostają pensji, więc przerwali walkę z groźnym wirusem
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Crisis in the Congo. They aren't getting paid, so they halted the fight against a dangerous virus.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province (Bunia), has reached 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths. The current wave is the second-largest in Ebola history, surpassed only by the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (over 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths). About 674 patients are in isolation, most in Ituri. Since mid-May, when the epidemic was officially declared, healthcare workers have protested delayed salaries and allowances, halting some response efforts in a region split by fighting with armed groups. WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged the government to provide real support to frontline workers. MSF warns of unprecedented transmission, noting assistance does not reach communities promptly. Surveillance covers roughly 75% of direct contacts, but 60–70% of new cases occur in people not on known contact lists, with new foci forming in remote towns amid insecurity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ危機。給料が支払われず、医療従事者らが危険なウイルスとの闘いを中断
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は歴史上2番目の規模（確定症例3,973人、死亡1,801人）に達し、医療従事者のストライキによる対応中断や監視率の低下、既知接触者リスト外での新規感染多発など深刻かつ制御困難な状況にあるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文ではDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア）のみが流行地として言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: De epidemie in Congo is snelst groeiende ebola-uitbraak ooit: al meer dan 1800 mensen overleden
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever: more than 1,800 people have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the fastest-growing ever, with death toll above 1,800 and nearly 4,000 confirmed infections since late April. By end of June about 30% of confirmed patients had died; current fatality rate among confirmed cases exceeds 45%. Neighboring Uganda experienced early cases, but was declared Ebola-free by end of July. Contributing factors include late presentation to treatment centers and more than 70% of deaths occurring at home; even when facilities are reached, infection sources are often unclear. Doctors Without Borders notes only about 10% of infections are detected by contact tracing at several posts, raising concern that true cases are higher. Security concerns and community resistance hinder containment, with violence around centers, funeral restrictions, and unpaid health workers threatening strikes. Moderna has begun first-stage vaccine trials in Canada for the current variant (80 volunteers); no approval yet, with plans to supply over 500,000 doses at affordable prices to poorer countries, including Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行は史上最速の拡大、死者1800人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率45%超、死者1800人超の急拡大するエボラ流行であり、封じ込め困難な要因（在宅死70%超、接触追跡検出率低い、治安・コミュニティ抵抗）が複数存在するためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既にエボラ終息宣言済み、カナダはワクチン治験実施国であり発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Les Etats-Unis vont fournir 242 millions de dollars supplémentaires pour financer la lutte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States will provide an additional $242 million to fund the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, the United States will provide an additional $242 million to fund the immediate Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, coordinated with Congress. The funding will support the outbreak response, as well as preparedness and humanitarian assistance related to the Ebola outbreak. The U.S. State Department announced the package, signaling continued international commitment to controlling Ebola and assisting affected communities through enhanced operational efforts and aid delivery in the two countries. The allocation underscores ongoing U.S. support for outbreak management in these nations.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ対策のためにさらに2億4200万ドルを追加拠出へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対し、米国が多額の追加資金を投入するとの発表であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ対応への米国資金提供を報じているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。米国は資金拠出国であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: "موديرنا" تختبر لقاحا جديدا ضد سلالة نادرة من "إيبولا" لأول مرة على البشر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Moderna tests a new vaccine against a rare strain of Ebola for the first time in humans
article.articleSummary: Moderna launched the first-in-human trial of an experimental Ebola vaccine designed against the rare Bundi-bugyo strain, leveraging mRNA technology. In this Phase I study, 80 healthy adult volunteers will be evaluated for safety, tolerability, and potential adverse effects, while measuring the vaccine’s ability to provoke an immune response against the virus. The Bundi-bugyo strain is one of Ebola’s rare lineages that has caused limited but serious outbreaks, accounting for about 1,650 deaths, mostly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, during the second-largest outbreak phase. If the trial demonstrates acceptable safety and immunogenicity, it could pave the way for broader vaccines capable of protecting against multiple Ebola strains, reinforcing global preparedness and response, particularly in regions prone to Ebola outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: モデルナ、まれなエボラ株に対する新規ワクチンをヒトで初めて試験
triage.triage_reason: 記事はモデルナによるエボラ・ブンディブギョ株向けワクチンの第I相臨床試験に関するもので、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクの発生を報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての該当性はない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発・臨床試験に関する報道であり、DRCでの過去のアウトブレイク（第2位規模）に言及しているのみで、現在の発生地域としての言及ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Boală mortală: OMS trage un semnal de alarmă. Focarul de virus "mai critic ca niciodată" - Ziarul Românesc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fatal disease: WHO sounds the alarm. The virus outbreak "more critical than ever."
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola variant outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread rapidly, with about 4,000 confirmed infections and more than 1,700 deaths. In some regions, cases have doubled in weeks, and many transmission chains remain unidentified. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns the virus is expanding faster than response efforts can keep up. The outbreak is hampered by conflict in eastern DR Congo, large population movements, shortages of medical staff, and the rainy season, which complicate containment and logistics. There is no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo yet, while two ARNm vaccines have begun clinical trials: one developed by Oxford University with Serum Institute of India, and another by Moderna; treatments and a possible prophylaxis for contacts are also being tested. Preclinical results are promising, but months will pass before vaccines reach all affected. The United States pledges an additional $242 million, bringing its total to over $500 million, with Uganda commended for cross-border prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的な疾患：WHOが警鐘を鳴らす。ウイルス流行は『かつてないほど深刻』
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱の流行が急速に拡大し、約4000人感染・1700人以上死亡、WHOが警鐘を鳴らしており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: インドはワクチン開発パートナー（Serum Institute of India）として言及されているのみで、実際の感染発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: اعتراض قارب للاشتباه بإصابة راكب بإيبولا واحتجاجات عاملين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Boat intercepted on suspicion that a passenger was infected with Ebola, and workers' protests.
article.articleSummary: Congolese health authorities intercepted a Kisangani-bound boat headed for Kinshasa at Maluku River Port after a passenger who disembarked July 25 developed Ebola-like symptoms and died. About 200 people were aboard; a mobile lab was dispatched to test all passengers and crew. The patient, 32, left the vessel in Mongala before symptoms appeared. No biological samples were taken due to facility constraints, and officials reported no further deaths among passengers. River travel from Kisangani to Kinshasa could take weeks given limited communications along the route. The Ebola outbreak in the DRC remains active, with ChuBo region reporting seven confirmed cases; total infections 3,973 and 1,801 deaths. Separately, health workers in Ituri’s Bunia protested for overdue salaries, disrupting care amid violence and attacks on frontline staff.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラ感染疑いの乗客により船が拿捕、労働者の抗議も
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行下、感染疑い患者の死亡と大人数(約200人)が乗船した船舶の拿捕事案が発生しており、検査体制の不備や医療従事者のストライキも重なり、深刻性・異常性・拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にGhanaが含まれるが、記事本文はDRC国内の事例のみを扱っており、Ghanaへの言及はないため除外した。検体採取ができず確定診断が未了である点は重要な情報不足として留意。

article.articleHeadline: 인도서 '뇌염 유발' 바이러스 감염 어린이 22명 사망
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In India, 22 children died from infection with an encephalitis-causing virus.
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus, an encephalitis-causing pathogen, has triggered a new outbreak in India. Gujarat state reports 184 suspected cases with 35 laboratory-confirmed infections, including 22 deaths among children under 15. In nearby Rajasthan, 3 infections have been confirmed. Transmission occurs via sandflies and ticks, and infection can cause seizures and coma, with fatalities possible. There is currently no treatment, and the reported case fatality rate ranges from 56% to 75%. About two years ago, Chandipura virus outbreaks in India caused roughly 70 deaths. The report underscores the western region as the current focus and notes ongoing transmission risk, but provides no further clinical details or public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: インドで『脳炎誘発』ウイルス感染により子ども22人死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常性」の2項目に該当し、致死率56-75%という高い重症度も確認されるためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ等の媒介動物により伝播し、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性は低いとされる。過去にも同様の集団発生歴があり、インド西部（グジャラート州、ラージャスターン州）で継続的な感染リスクが指摘されている。治療法が確立されていない点も重大な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: إجابات أهم الأسئلة عن فيروس تشانديبورا المتسبب في وفاة 22 بالهند؟ - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Answers to the most important questions about the Chandipura virus, which caused 22 deaths in India?
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus has caused 22 deaths in Gujarat, India, with 35 of 184 suspected cases; many remain critically ill on ventilators and oxygen. Identified in 1965 in Chandipur, Maharashtra, the rhabdovirus is spread mainly by sandflies, with possible roles for mosquitoes and ticks. Outbreaks have occurred mainly in western, central, and southern India. The disease triggers rapid-onset viral encephalitis; common symptoms include high fever, severe headache, vomiting, seizures, altered consciousness, agitation, loss of coordination, and coma in severe cases. It primarily affects children; monsoon season increases vector activity in rural and tribal areas. No vaccine or specific antiviral exists; care is supportive. WHO estimates case fatality 56–75%. Past outbreaks: 2024 (245 cases, 82 deaths; Gujarat highest) and 2003 Andhra Pradesh (329 suspected, 183 deaths). Human-to-human transmission has not been observed; prevention focuses on vector avoidance, nets, repellents, protective clothing, and reducing breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: インドで22人が死亡したチャンディプラウイルスに関する重要な質問への回答
triage.triage_reason: 致死率56-75%とされる稀な脳炎ウイルス（チャンディプラウイルス）によりインド・グジャラート州で22人が死亡し、184人の疑い例が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBangladeshが含まれているが、記事サマリーはインド・グジャラート州（過去例としてマハーラーシュトラ州、アンドラプラデーシュ州）のみを主題としており、Bangladeshでの発生は記載されていないため除外した。ヒト-ヒト感染は確認されていないが、ベクター媒介で農村・部族地域の子供に多発し、致死率が非常に高い点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: IIT-G develops low-cost device to detect toxic metals, bacteria in water
article.articleSummary: IIT Guwahati unveils E-Eye, a portable optical sensor that detects toxic metals (arsenic, lead, iron, chromium), fluoride, and Escherichia coli in water. Priced about Rs 3,500 with per-test cost around Rs 2, the device enables on-site water-quality checks at water sources, including rural areas lacking laboratories. It uses a colorimetric reaction whose intensity corresponds to contaminant concentration, read via optical sensing, converted to digital data, and transmitted wirelessly to water-treatment facilities. E-Eye’s results have shown comparability with standard UV-Visible and Atomic Absorption spectrometry across more than 2,700 samples. Operates on Beer-Lambert law, combining optics with digital electronics. Supports Jal Jeevan Mission goals for safe rural tap water; applicable to environmental/biological samples and foods. Commercialization via ENVIONIX Labs Pvt Ltd, with plans for solar panels and cloud connectivity; collaborators include KIIT Bhubaneswar and Ramakrishna Mission Residential College, Kolkata.

triage.headline_ja: IIT-Gが水中の有毒金属・細菌を検出する低コストデバイスを開発
triage.triage_reason: 感染症のアウトブレイクに関する報道ではなく、水質検査技術の開発に関する記事であるため、公衆衛生上の緊急性や社会的関心の高まりは見られない。
triage.notes: 本記事はE-Eyeという水質検査デバイスの開発に関する技術紹介記事であり、実際のE. coli感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。感染症イベントとしての実体がないため対象国は空欄とした。

article.articleHeadline: ZDA bodo Afriki zagotovile dodatnih 242 milijonov dolarjev za boj proti eboli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States will provide Africa with an additional $242 million to fight Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Washington and Kinshasa, 06 August 2026 – The U.S. State Department said the Trump administration will provide an additional $242 million to help fight the Ebola outbreak in Africa. The funding is earmarked for the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the latest outbreak has persisted for several weeks and is not yet contained. The announcement signals ongoing U.S. support for international efforts to curb Ebola transmission on the African continent. The article does not report specific case or death counts. This aid complements other multinational efforts to bolster Congo's capacity to respond to the outbreak and prevent further spread within and beyond its borders.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ対策としてアフリカに追加で2億4200万ドルを供与へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で数週間にわたり継続中の未収束エボラ流行に対し、米国が多額の追加支援を表明しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事に記載なし。米国の資金拠出発表が主体であり、DRC国内の流行状況の詳細は続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Viêm não Nhật Bản: Vì sao đã tiêm rồi vẫn cần kiểm tra đủ mũi?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Japanese Encephalitis: Why, even after vaccination, is it still necessary to verify that you have completed the full course of doses?
article.articleSummary: Japanese Encephalitis vaccination verification in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam: Parents may recall vaccination but not the number of doses, timing of the last dose, or whether a booster is due. Does 'vaccinated' mean 'fully vaccinated'? The program addressing this—titled “Japanese Encephalitis: Vaccination Right Not Enough, Fully Vaccinated Is Required”—features TTƯT.BS Trương Hữu Khanh, Vice Chairman of the Ho Chi Minh City Infectious Diseases Association, and ThS.BS Nguyễn Hiền Minh, Deputy Head of the Immunization Unit at University of Medicine and Pharmacy Hospital, Ho Chi Minh City. They will explain how to review vaccination histories for late schedules, lost records, or vaccines given at multiple sites, and how to determine if a child is adequately protected. Airs at 19:00 on Thursday, 6 August 2026 in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: 日本脳炎:なぜ接種済みでも接種回数の確認が必要なのか?
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はホーチミン市における日本脳炎ワクチン接種状況の啓発番組の告知であり、実際の症例発生や公衆衛生上の異常事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は日本脳炎ワクチン接種の完了確認に関する教育番組の告知であり、疾病発生や流行の報告ではないため、対象国における実発生イベントとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: 利德曼：子公司重组B群脑膜炎球菌疫苗获临床试验批准
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lideman: Subsidiary's recombinant Group B meningococcal vaccine approved for clinical trials.
article.articleSummary: Lideman (SZ:300289) announced on 2026-08-06 that its subsidiary Beijing Xiansheng Xiangrui Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd. received the National Medical Products Administration’s Drug Clinical Trial Approval Notice to conduct clinical trials of a recombinant Group B meningococcal vaccine. The vaccine targets epidemic meningitis caused by Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B and uses a multi-component recombinant protein approach with an Escherichia coli expression system. Globally, GlaxoSmithKline and Pfizer already market related products, and domestically similar programs are in clinical development. The approval for clinical trials is not expected to materially impact the company’s annual performance. The article reports no outbreak, case counts, or deaths.|

triage.headline_ja: 利徳曼:子会社の組換えB群髄膜炎菌ワクチンが臨床試験承認を取得
triage.triage_reason: アウトブレイクや症例報告ではなく、企業のワクチン臨床試験承認に関する事業発表であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 記事は疾病アウトブレイクではなく、企業のワクチン開発・臨床試験承認に関する報道。E. coliは疾患名ではなくワクチン製造の発現系として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: FAO Strengthens Brucellosis Diagnosis to Protect Livestock, Wildlife and Communities in KAZA
article.articleSummary: FAO strengthens brucellosis diagnosis in the Kavango-Zambezi Transfrontier Conservation Area (KAZA) with a five-day Complement Fixation Test (CFT) training at the Victoria Falls Wildlife Trust Veterinary Laboratory (20–24 July 2026), funded by EU STOSAR II and the Pandemic Fund. The program advances diagnostic capacity beyond initial Rose Bengal Plate Test screening toward confirmatory CFT testing at the wildlife–livestock interface, enabling timely detection in KAZA. Participants included veterinarians and laboratory technologists from the Victoria Falls Wildlife Trust, ZimParks, Zimbabwe’s Central Veterinary Laboratory, Bulawayo and Masvingo Provincial Labs, FAO Zambia and FAO Zimbabwe, with support from the KAZA Secretariat. The initiative reinforces One Health collaboration to reduce human health risks, protect communities, and bolster safer livestock production. Knowledge gains rose from 69% to 82% post-training, while Zimbabwe’s Central Veterinary Laboratory will continue mentorship and quality assurance across KAZA.

triage.headline_ja: FAOがKAZA地域における家畜・野生生物・地域社会保護のためブルセラ症診断能力を強化
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生・アウトブレイク報告ではなく、診断能力強化のためのトレーニングプログラムに関する記事であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はジンバブエ（対象国外）を中心としたブルセラ症診断能力強化のトレーニングプログラムに関する内容。ザンビアはFAO Zambiaとして支援・参加国として言及されているのみで、実際の疾病発生地域としての記載はないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Eye Flu in CG: बारिश की एंट्री के साथ छत्तीसगढ़ में फैली खतरनाक बीमारी! एक महीने में सामने आए 600 से ज्यादा मामले, डॉक्टरों ने लोगों को दी ये नसीहत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eye Flu in Chhattisgarh: With the onset of the rains, a dangerous disease spreads in the state! Over 600 cases reported in a month; doctors have given this advice to people.
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, Eye Flu (conjunctivitis) outbreaks in Bastar district, Chhattisgarh, with over 600 cases reported in the past month during the monsoon. Major facilities Jagdalpur—Maharani Hospital and Medical College—are treating daily. Chief Medical and Health Officer Dr. Sanjay Bask says the situation is currently under control, though negligence could accelerate spread. The surge is linked to humid, dusty conditions in the rainy season; conjunctivitis is a viral infection easily transmitted between people. With timely treatment and hygiene, symptoms typically resolve in 7–15 days; home remedies or delays can worsen spread. Health officials have directed all BMO and ophthalmologists to counsel patients, provide treatment promptly, and share prevention tips. Seek immediate medical evaluation if the eye is red, discharge present, or burning sensation; do not rely on home remedies.

triage.headline_ja: アイフルー(結膜炎)：雨季の到来とともにチャッティースガル州で危険な病気が拡大！1ヶ月で600件以上の症例が報告、医師が住民に助言
triage.triage_reason: 結膜炎(Eye Flu)は季節性・自己限定的な感染症で、当局も「状況は制御下」としており、重症度・国際的拡大リスクとも低い。
triage.notes: 結膜炎は軽症で7-15日で自然回復するとされ、当局も状況をコントロール下としている。地域的な季節性流行であり、フルリスク評価の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: கொங்கோவில் கட்டுக்கடங்காமல் பரவும் எபோலா! - ITN News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Spreading Uncontrollably in Congo! - ITN News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is spreading uncontrollably, MSF warns. After two and a half months, the situation is unprecedentedly severe. WHO data report 3,605 confirmed infections and about 1,500 deaths in the last 11 weeks, the largest Ebola outbreak on record in Congo. New cases are detected daily in new areas. At Bunia's treatment center, 90% of admitted patients were not previously identified contacts; in Ituri province, only 59% of contacts are monitored. Emphasizing community engagement, authorities stress that containment requires local participation. Malaria, diarrhoea, cholera and malnutrition are contributing to deaths, underlining the need for essential health services alongside Ebola care. The rainy season is complicating delivery of medical supplies to remote areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが制御不能な拡大を見せる！ - ITN News
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で史上最大規模のエボラ流行が制御不能に拡大しており、感染者3,605人・死者約1,500人に達し、接触者追跡も不十分でIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: MSFがWHOデータを引用し、史上最大規模のコンゴエボラ流行と警告。接触者追跡率が低く（Ituri州で59%）、マラリア・コレラ・栄養失調などの併発疾患も死亡に寄与。雨季による医療物資輸送の困難も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Idaron intensifica bloqueio sanitário após confirmar casos de raiva bovina em Jaru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Idaron Steps Up Sanitary Blockade After Confirming Cases of Bovine Rabies in Jaru.
article.articleSummary: Idaron tightens sanitary blockade in Tarilândia district, Jaru, Rondônia after confirming bovine rabies. Emergency vaccination covers all cattle within 3 km of the infected property; farms 3–12 km away must immunize and provide vaccination proof to Idaron. The monitored zone extends about 70 km from Jaru's urban center into parts of Governador Jorge Teixeira. Lab confirmation followed a farmer noticing abnormal behavior; three cases are confirmed on the same property, with additional suspected cases under investigation. Idaron teams are conducting epidemiological surveys, notifying breeders, and ensuring compliance with sanitary measures. Any animal with behavioral or neurological symptoms should be reported immediately to enable rapid response and prevent spread. Vaccination of workers on the affected property is underway; emphasizes keeping herd schedules up to date to protect animal and human health.

triage.headline_ja: イダロン、ジャルでの牛狂犬病確認後に衛生封鎖を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ロンドニア州における牛の狂犬病（動物疾病）で、地元当局（Idaron）が予防接種と衛生封鎖により迅速に対応しており、人への感染確認はなく国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 対象は牛の狂犬病であり、人への感染例は報告されていない。感染農場の作業員には予防的にワクチン接種が行われているのみ。地方当局により局所的な封鎖・監視・予防接種対応がなされており、管理可能な事案と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Протести во Конго: здравствените работници кои се борат со еболата не зеле плати со месеци
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protests in Congo: Healthcare workers who are fighting Ebola have not been paid for months.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues, with 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths reported by the government. The vast majority of cases—about 90%—have occurred in Ituri Province, centered in Bunia. Health workers in the outbreak's epicenter conducted protests over months of unpaid salaries, leaving several facilities and raising concerns that the virus will keep spreading at a dangerous pace. The protests come as humanitarian groups warn that aid is not reaching communities quickly enough to break transmission chains. The outbreak, declared mid-May in one of the most remote, vulnerable areas, is the second-largest in history after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (more than 28,000 cases and more than 11,000 deaths). WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged authorities to increase protection and support for frontline responders; MSF warned of ongoing alarming spread and insufficient assistance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの抗議活動:エボラと闘う医療従事者が数か月間給料を受け取っていない
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は3,973例・1,801人死亡と史上2番目の規模で拡大が続いており、医療従事者のストライキや資金不足によりさらなる感染拡大リスクが高く、WHO・MSFが懸念を表明している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC（特にIturi州Bunia周辺）のみが感染拡大の舞台として言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura Virus: Centre Deploys National Response Team to Gujarat
article.articleSummary: CHPV outbreak in Gujarat with spread to Rajasthan prompts deployment of a National Joint Outbreak Response Team (NJORT) to intensify investigation. The team, from NCDC, ICMR, and the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, collaborates with state health departments on outbreak investigation, clinical management, laboratory coordination, and vector surveillance under a One Health approach. CHPV, identified in 1965 in Chandipur, Maharashtra, is a bullet-shaped enveloped virus causing acute encephalitis in children under 15; outbreaks recur in Gujarat every four to five years, with the current surge the largest in two decades. Onset is rapid: high fever, vomiting, altered consciousness, progressing to seizures or coma within 24–30 hours. No licensed vaccine or antiviral exists; care is supportive. Transmission is mainly sandfly-borne; other arthropods are under study; no human-to-human transmission. Diagnostics include IgM ELISA and RT-PCR; ~70 domestic-animal blood samples are collected; whole-genome sequencing at Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre investigates viral evolution; serosurveys estimate undetected infections. Early recognition and rapid referral are critical.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルス：中央政府がグジャラート州に国家対応チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: グジャラート州でのCHPV（チャンディプラウイルス）流行がラージャスターン州にも拡大し、過去20年間で最大規模となっており、国家対応チームが派遣されるなど政府の対応レベルが高い。IHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBangladeshが含まれているが、記事サマリーには言及がなく除外した。Maharashtra（チャンディプル）は1965年の初発見地としての言及のみで現在の流行地ではないため、現流行地はGujaratとRajasthanのみ（両方ともIndia国内）。CHPVは砂バエ媒介でヒト-ヒト感染はないとされるが、小児の急性脳炎で致死率が高いことが知られ、ワクチン・特異的治療法がない点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: RDC intercepta un barco de camino a la capital tras detectar un caso sospechoso de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC intercepts a boat on the way to the capital after detecting a suspected case of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts containment actions after a suspected case on a boat near Kinshasa, with over 200 passengers intercepted 65 km from the capital. The patient, from Mongala’s Pimbu health zone, boarded the vessel, fell ill after disembarking, and died. A mobile laboratory was deployed to test all passengers, who came from Tshopo province, one of five affected by the outbreak alongside Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, and Haut-Uélé. The National Institute of Public Health says there is no confirmed link yet. Government data put deaths at 1,801 and confirmed cases at 3,973. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain drives the outbreak, with a case fatality rate of 30–50%; no approved vaccine or specific treatment. In Uganda, Ebola-free status was declared July 28 after 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and 2 deaths. This is the second-largest outbreak by cases in DRC history.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、首都に向かう船を拿捕 エボラ疑い例を検出
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行が継続中で、首都キンシャサに向かう船から疑い例が検出され200人以上が隔離された。死者1801人・確定例3973人という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的拡大リスクも高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）の継続と首都圏への拡大懸念について報告。ウガンダは既にエボラフリー宣言済み（対象国外）、ナイジェリアは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事内で主題として言及されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo: Washington allocates an additional $242 million to fight Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak resurgence in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompts a fresh U.S. funding package of more than $242 million, announced on 2026-08-06. Direct U.S. Ebola assistance now exceeds $512 million, part of a broader commitment up to $500 million for the global response made at the G7 summit. The new funds will enable partner organizations to expand on-the-ground operations across Africa and strengthen coordination among governments, humanitarian groups and private-sector partners. This adds to $350 million already earmarked for emergency humanitarian aid in the DRC, South Sudan and Uganda under a May $1.8 billion OCHA package. The United States remains the largest international donor to Ebola relief and urges others to increase funding. Uganda’s swift response is praised for helping contain spread; travel restrictions remain for travelers from the DRC, Uganda and South Sudan, and U.S. citizens in the DRC cannot return directly to the United States.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：米国がエボラ対策に追加で2億4200万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで再燃し、国際的な資金投入・渡航制限が既に実施されており、IHR基準の複数（重大性、国際的拡大、渡航制限）に該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ再燃と米国の追加資金拠出が主題。ウガンダ・南スーダンへの言及もあるが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。米国・アフリカ大陸(Continent)も対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola Deaths Continue to Grow (Over 1,800 Deaths)
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to escalate, with more than 1,800 deaths among confirmed and suspected cases as of August 2026. The epicenter is Ituri Province, notably Bunia, accounting for about 90% of all confirmed infections; outbreak declared mid-May in a remote, rebel-affected area. Transmission chains remain unknown in roughly 80% of recent infections, complicating containment efforts. Widespread conflict and displacement escalate healthcare access challenges. Frontline healthcare workers strike over unpaid wages since outbreak declaration, threatening response capacity. WFP reports acute food insecurity affecting 2.65 million people in the 48 Ebola-affected health zones, with 628,000 in IPC Phase 4; nearly 10 million in eastern DRC facing crisis or worse hunger, Ituri with 1.9 million in crisis-level hunger. Ongoing clashes with armed groups (ADF) and regional tensions (M23-Rwanda) compound the crisis.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ死者数増加続く（死者1,800人超）
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で死者1,800人超、感染経路不明80%、医療従事者ストライキ、紛争・食料危機が複合し、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを有するため、フルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ルワンダ（49518）は発生地域に含まれるが対象国リスト対象外のため除外。イトゥリ州・ブニアはDRC国内の地域情報のため国レベルではDRCのみ計上。紛争（ADF、M23-ルワンダ緊張）や医療従事者ストライキ、食料危機など複合的リスク要因が多く、越境拡大の懸念も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Madagascar: Santé- Éventuelle fermeture des frontières aux pays foyers d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Madagascar: Health - Possible border closures to Ebola-affected countries
article.articleSummary: Madagascar is considering tighter border controls to prevent Ebola importation. After the August 4 cabinet meeting, authorities proposed restricting entry of people from Ebola-affected countries, notably the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, at all entry points. For those who must enter (students or UN personnel), a 21-day isolation would be required, with quarantine sites to be defined—likely a hotel near airports—following an urgent meeting to finalize locations. The plan also envisions banning missions to high-transmission countries. The government emphasizes prevention to avoid introduction of Ebola, given risks of rapid spread with poor hygiene and crowding. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola mortality is high; WHO reported 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (crude CFR ~44%) as of 30 July 2026, with transmission described as at an unprecedented pace. In Madagascar, introduction could spread quickly via contact with blood or bodily fluids or contaminated surfaces, and corpses may remain infectious after death. Airport drills have been conducted, but questions about health-system capacity remain.

triage.headline_ja: マダガスカル:保健 - エボラ発生国からの入国制限（国境封鎖の可能性）
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は致死率約44%、症例3,605例・死亡1,587例と深刻で、前例のない速さで拡大しており、近隣国マダガスカルが渡航制限・国境封鎖を検討するなど国際的波及・渡航貿易制限のリスクが顕在化しているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで進行中のエボラ流行とそれに対するマダガスカルの水際対策検討。ウガンダも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれず、マダガスカル自体も対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: התפשטות מהירה של אבולה: מעל 1,800 מתו בקונגו
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapid spread of Ebola: more than 1,800 have died in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the fastest in the world. As of 2026-08-06, laboratory-confirmed cases reach 3,973 with 1,801 deaths. Almost three months since the outbreak began, new infections have doubled in the hardest-hit areas. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Kinshasa, called for an urgent, intensified, and joint response with all partners. Health workers in Bunia, Ituri Province, continue protests over unpaid salaries, the latest group to withdraw labor since wage grievances emerged weeks ago. The response centers on expanding operations and preventing transmission, with laboratory confirmation of cases noted; no specific infection source or imported/exported case details are provided. Key locations: Kinshasa (capital), Bunia in Ituri Province; ongoing multi-agency efforts against Ebola in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの急速な拡大：コンゴで1,800人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が緊急対応を要請するエボラ大規模アウトブレイクで、致死率が高く、感染拡大が加速している深刻な公衆衛生事象であるため。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長のキンシャサ訪問、医療従事者の賃金未払いによる抗議活動が対応能力に影響を与えている点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Campanha leva testagem de Hepatite C ao Calçadão de Canoas neste sábado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campaign brings Hepatitis C testing to Canoas' boardwalk this Saturday.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, Brazil's National Multivaccination Strategy aims to update vaccination records for children and adolescents under 15 from 3 August to 1 September 2026, checking the vaccination card and administering any due doses in a single visit, free via the SUS. The effort seeks to raise overall vaccine coverage and prevent diseases such as measles and poliomyelitis by maintaining timely immunization. In Rio Grande do Sul, 2025 coverage was 91% for pentavalent and polio, 96% for pneumococcal, and 95% for MMR. The campaign also prioritizes HPV and measles vaccination; the HPV program for ages 15-19 was extended to 31 December 2026 for those not yet vaccinated. Following July measles cases in São Paulo linked to importation, authorities urge checking vaccination status for 12 months to 59 years and completing schedules per the vaccination calendar. A D-Day mobilization is planned for 22 August.

triage.headline_ja: 土曜日、カノアスの遊歩道でC型肝炎の無料検査キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主眼はブラジルにおけるルーティンの予防接種キャンペーン（多価ワクチン戦略）の案内であり、サンパウロでの輸入麻疹症例への言及があるものの詳細情報（症例数・重症度・拡大状況）が不足しているため。
triage.notes: 記事本体はワクチン接種キャンペーンの広報であり、感染症アウトブレイクの直接報告ではない。サンパウロでの輸入麻疹症例について続報があれば要確認。

article.articleHeadline: У Конго медики, які борються зі спалахом Еболи, вийшли на протест через невиплату зарплат
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, medics fighting the Ebola outbreak staged a protest over unpaid salaries.
article.articleSummary: Dozens of healthcare workers battling the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo staged a protest over unpaid salaries, abandoning posts at several facilities. The action occurred near the governor's office in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province, which accounts for about 90% of the country’s Ebola cases. Since the outbreak was officially declared in mid-May, these frontline nurses and other staff have not received salaries or hazard pay, hindering care during the world’s largest ongoing Ebola outbreak. The protest underscores financial strains threatening the outbreak response and patient care in the epicenter region. No specific case or death counts are provided in the report. The situation highlights ongoing challenges in sustaining frontline workforce and funding for outbreak response in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ流行と闘う医療従事者が未払い給与に抗議しストライキ
triage.triage_reason: 世界最大規模とされる進行中のエボラ流行の震源地で、給与未払いにより医療従事者がストライキを行い対応能力が損なわれているとの報告であり、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクを有するため。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な症例数・死亡数を報告していないが、既に宣言されている大規模エボラ流行の対応が給与未払いによるストライキで阻害されている点が重要な懸念事項。フルリスク評価による最新の症例動向確認が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго медики, борющиеся со вспышкой Эболы, вышли на протест из-за невыплаты зарплат
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, medics fighting the Ebola outbreak went on strike over unpaid salaries.
article.articleSummary: Dozens of clinicians and nurses working at Ebola treatment sites in the Democratic Republic of Congo went on strike over unpaid salaries, leaving their posts and disrupting care during the world's largest current Ebola outbreak. The protests occurred near the governor’s office in Bunia, the administrative capital of Ituri Province, which accounts for about 90% of Congo’s Ebola cases. Medical staff said they had not received salaries or hazard allowances since the outbreak was officially declared in mid-May, hindering frontline response and patient support in the epicenter. The stoppage highlights ongoing staffing and funding challenges amid the outbreak, with the strike adding strain to response efforts and potentially affecting case management, isolation, and supportive care at facilities in Ituri and surrounding areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ対応にあたる医療従事者が未払い賃金を巡りストライキを実施
triage.triage_reason: 世界最大規模で進行中のエボラ流行の対応拠点で医療従事者がストライキを起こし、患者管理や隔離体制に支障が出ている可能性があり、アウトブレイク対応能力の低下という重大な公衆衛生上の懸念事項である。
triage.notes: 既に進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク(イトゥリ州が全体の約90%を占める)における医療従事者の未払い賃金を巡るストライキが、治療・隔離体制に影響を与える可能性がある。資金・人員体制の課題が対応の持続性に直結するため継続的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi records 1,179 dengue cases, H1N1 tally reaches 1,344; no deaths reported - India TV News
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, Delhi has 1,179 dengue cases; another 210 patients from outside the capital are being treated in city hospitals, bringing total dengue patients in Delhi hospitals to 1,389. Separately, 1,344 H1N1 cases have been reported in Delhi, with no deaths recorded from either disease. The figures indicate ongoing dengue activity and cross-border patient flow, with residents of Delhi and people from neighbouring areas seeking hospital care. No deaths have been reported in connection with dengue or H1N1. The report reflects hospital-based tallies and provides no details on laboratory confirmation or infection sources. Data underscore current management of dengue and H1N1 cases in Delhi as of 2026-08-06, with no fatalities to date.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでデング熱1,179例、H1N1は1,344例に到達 - 死亡例なし
triage.triage_reason: デリーでのデング熱・H1N1の季節的な症例増加を報告しているが、死亡例なく重症度・異常性は低い。例年発生する季節性疾患であり継続的な監視で十分と判断。
triage.notes: デング熱・H1N1ともにインドで季節的に毎年発生する疾患であり、死亡例が報告されていないため深刻度は低い。周辺地域からの患者流入があるが、国際的な拡大リスクは示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Praktisi Kesehatan: Warga Perlu Waspadai Flu dan Batuk Meningkat saat Kemarau
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health professionals: The public should beware influenza and increased coughing during the dry season.
article.articleSummary: Jakarta health professionals report a rise in cough, fever, and runny nose during the dry season, caused by circulating influenza, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and SARS-CoV-2 (lower activity). Symptoms: fever, cough, runny nose, sore throat, muscle aches, fatigue. Dr. Suci Nurika Haviza cites seasonal changes and close contact in schools and offices as drivers; poor rest, stress, and inadequate nutrition raise infection risk. High-risk groups: infants, toddlers, elderly, pregnant women, and people with chronic conditions such as asthma, diabetes, heart disease, and COPD. Prevention emphasizes handwashing, masks when sick, adequate rest, nutrition, and hydration; children should follow vaccination schedules, and adults at risk may consider influenza vaccination. Global week 29, 2026 shows seasonal patterns with influenza positivity below 10% and low SARS-CoV-2 activity; southern hemisphere reports around 15% influenza positivity in some areas; RSV remains low. WHO calls for strengthened surveillance for influenza, RSV, and SARS-CoV-2.

triage.headline_ja: 医療専門家:乾季にインフルエンザと咳の増加に注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器感染症増加に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、異常性・重症度・国際的拡大リスクなど特段の懸念は見られない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ・RSV・SARS-CoV-2に関する一般的な健康啓発記事。特定のアウトブレイクや異常な増加は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: W.H.O. Seeks Volunteers for Ebola Vaccine Trial as Death Rate Soars
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the largest on record, with 3,748 cases and 1,657 deaths (708 recoveries) as of August 1. Trials for potential vaccines are underway in Canada and the United Kingdom; the first of four UK candidates, developed by Moderna, Public Health Vaccines, IAVI, and the University of Oxford, has entered clinical testing. The WHO is seeking more volunteers to enroll across expanding sites under strict safety monitoring. A post-exposure prophylaxis trial in Ituri province, led by the DRC’s National Institute for Biomedical Research with international partners, has enrolled over 25 high-risk contacts to test a 10-day oral preventive. Lab work for Bundibugyo therapeutics is conducted in ferrets and monkeys ahead of first-in-human trials. This is the 17th major Ebola outbreak since 1976, and the third Bundibugyo outbreak with no licensed vaccine or approved treatment."

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラワクチン治験のボランティアを募集 ― 死亡率が急上昇
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける過去最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクで致死率が高く、承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在しないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 英国・カナダはワクチン治験実施国であり、感染発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。致死率は約44%(1657/3748)と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : dans l'enfer des équipes engagées dans la lutte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: In the Hell of the Teams Engaged in the Fight Against Ebola
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, health workers fighting the 17th Ebola outbreak report unpaid salaries and dangerous field conditions while continuing frontline work. Wiza Bondele, who previously battled Ebola in 2018, is back supervising disinfection and community outreach, but three months went unpaid; salaries were only 380 of the promised 510, with duties such as cleaning up blood from suspected cases. In July, teams staged a strike demanding timely pay and safer conditions. The outbreak—DRC's most severe yet—has recorded at least 3,800 cases and 1,751 deaths across five provinces, prompting calls for medicines and stronger measures. Frontline staff remain on duty seven days a week, risking infection and potential transmission to families. Some workers contemplate leaving due to dangers. The United States has released an additional 242 million dollars to bolster the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラとの闘いに従事するチームの地獄のような現状
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における第17次エボラ流行は最重症規模（3,800症例、1,751死亡）で5州に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 米国からの2億4,200万ドルの追加支援は、発生地ではなく資金拠出国としての関与のため、米国は verified_locations に含めない。医療従事者の未払い賃金・危険な労働環境がストライキを招いており、対応能力に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola health workers protest unpaid wages as deaths surpass 1,800
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) centered in Ituri province’s Bunia. As of August 6, 2026, the outbreak has 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths, making it the second-largest on record after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (more than 28,000 cases and over 11,000 deaths). Health workers in Bunia protested unpaid wages and bonuses since mid-May, highlighting frontline welfare concerns as the response intensifies but struggles to reach communities quickly. There are 674 patients in isolation, with about 75% of contacts traced. Notably, 60–70% of new cases originate from outside traced contacts, concentrated in remote localities affected by rebel conflict and mining-related movements. WHO Director-General Tedros urged prioritizing care for responders during his DRC visit, while MSF says transmission remains rapid and the response is not enough to break chains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者数1,800人を超える中、医療従事者が未払い賃金に抗議
triage.triage_reason: 史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行（3,973症例、1,801死亡）が継続中で、追跡不能な感染経路が多く紛争地域での対応も困難なため、国際的拡大リスクと社会的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC（特にIturi州Bunia）のみが主題であり、Angolaへの言及はないため除外した。WHO事務局長やMSFの声明から国際的な懸念・支援必要性が明確に示されている。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : les États-Unis mobilisent 242 millions USD supplémentaires pour la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: United States mobilize an additional $242 million for the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: United States allocates an additional $242 million to the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and several regional countries, lifting total U.S. support to more than $512 million. The funding backs immediate outbreak response operations, preparedness activities, and humanitarian assistance. It will strengthen epidemiological surveillance, expand patient treatment capacity, bolster border health security, and enhance community engagement and risk communication. Washington stresses close collaboration with national governments, international organizations, and regional partners to limit cross-border spread and to bolster health-system resilience for future health emergencies. The contribution underscores renewed international cooperation to contain the current Ebola outbreak and protect affected populations, reinforcing global health security in central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：米国がエボラ対応に追加で2億4200万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR上重篤な公衆衛生事象であり、DRCからウガンダなど周辺国への越境拡大リスクが明示されているため、IHR基準を2つ満たしフルRRAが必要と判断した。
triage.notes: ウガンダも資金対象国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de raiva são diagnosticados em zona rural do Jaguaribe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies cases are diagnosed in the rural area of Jaguaribe.
article.articleSummary: Rabies diagnosed in cattle in Jaguaribe's rural area, Brazil. A rural producer reported suspected animals, with the alert disseminated via a social-media post by the municipal mayor, Alexandre Diógenes. The notification mobilized the municipal Health Secretariat and veterinarians to the site for investigation, and a positive rabies diagnosis in cattle was confirmed; the exact number of infected bovines was not disclosed. Following confirmation, the Health Secretariat conducted rabies vaccination for exposed rural property owners, in accordance with the Ministry of Health protocol to prevent rabies in humans. The report underscores the zoonotic risk in livestock-rearing regions and the public health response to curb transmission. No information is provided on any human cases or fatalities linked to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州ジャグアリベの農村部で狂犬病症例が診断される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル農村部の牛における狂犬病発症で、地元当局が予防的ワクチン接種を実施済み。人への感染は確認されておらず、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 牛における狂犬病はブラジルの一部農村地域では風土病的に発生することがあり、今回は自治体レベルで迅速に対応（獣医師派遣、暴露者へのワクチン接種）が行われている。人的被害の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: ZDA bodo Afriki zagotovile dodatnih 242 milijonov dolarjev za boj proti eboli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States will provide Africa with an additional $242 million to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: The United States will provide Africa with an additional $242 million to combat Ebola, with funds still under congressional consultation to support outbreak response, regional preparedness, and humanitarian relief, bringing U.S. Ebola assistance to over $510 million. Separately, about $350 million in humanitarian aid will be directed to DR Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda as part of an earlier $1.8 billion package coordinated by the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs. The DR Congo outbreak is described by WHO as the largest in the country’s history; MSF notes the Bundibugyo strain is still spreading rapidly. Kinshasa reports 1,801 deaths and 3,973 cases (case fatality 45.3%), with Ituri province near Uganda most affected. The Africa CDC warns rapid spread challenges contact tracing; no approved vaccine or treatment exists yet for Bundibugyo, though a vaccine is under trial. Transmission occurs via contact and bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ対策のためアフリカに追加2億4200万ドルを提供へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は同国史上最大規模とWHOが認定し、致死率45.3%と極めて高く、ウガンダ国境地域への拡大や承認済みワクチン・治療法の不在など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（キンシャサ、イトゥリ州）を中心としたエボラ流行への米国及び国連の資金支援について報じている。ウガンダ・南スーダンも支援対象だが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。史上最大規模の流行、高致死率、承認ワクチン・治療薬の不在という点で緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Suspeita de Ébola em barco com mais de 200 pessoas rumo a Kinshasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola on a boat carrying more than 200 people bound for Kinshasa
article.articleSummary: Ebola suspected on a boat carrying over 200 passengers en route to Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). A passenger from Tshopo province died in Mongala; a mobile lab tests all passengers and a security team isolates the vessel 65 km from Kinshasa. The case is unconfirmed. The DRC declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15, now an epidemic spanning eastern and northeastern provinces. Since the start, 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths have been reported. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or treatment, with health infrastructure strained in the affected areas. Five provinces – Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé and Tshopo – are affected. WHO emphasizes urgent intensification of response; Ebola is transmitted via body fluids causing hemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサに向かう200人以上を乗せた船内でエボラ出血熱の疑い
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行（確定3,973例、死亡1,801例、致死率約45%）の中、首都キンシャサへ向かう船内で疑い患者が発生。ワクチン・治療法のないBundibugyo株であり、大都市への拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 船内の疑い例は未確認だが、既存の大規模流行（5州、致死率高、ワクチン・治療法なし）と首都近郊（65km地点）での発生疑いという点で緊急性が高い。続報でPCR確定結果を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RD Congo: une "intensification" de la riposte s'organise, mieux financée par les États-Unis et avec un nouveau vaccin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: an 'intensification' of the response is being organized, better funded by the United States and with a new vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies as the Bundibugyo variant drives ongoing transmission across five eastern/northeastern provinces (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo) with 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths since May 15. In Mongbwalu, Ituri, Ebola treatment center staff protested unpaid salaries (7–12 USD/day), later dispersed by police. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged a massive intensification of the response and better protection for frontline workers, noting no vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo. A first vaccine dose was administered to a volunteer in late July; a second candidate, rVSV Bundibugyo, is under development by Hilleman Laboratories. Canada has authorized Moderna trials; antivirals remdesivir and obeldesivir and monoclonal MBP134 are under testing. The United States added over 242 million USD in funding, bringing total U.S. direct support to over 500 million USD, with travel restrictions for travelers from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：対応の「強化」が組織される、米国による資金拡充と新ワクチンにより
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が5州にまたがり拡大し、3,874症例・1,751死亡と重大な公衆衛生影響があり、ワクチン・治療法未確立で渡航制限も発生していることからIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンは渡航制限の対象国として言及されているが、発生地域としては記載されていないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Escalates Ebola Response as Record Outbreak Spreads
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo escalates its response to the country’s largest Ebola outbreak as new cases continue to spike in the eastern provinces. In a government-led move to curb transmission, authorities plan to provide free healthcare across Ebola-affected eastern districts and are coordinating trials of experimental vaccines against the outbreak. The announcement signals a sweeping overhaul of the national outbreak response, with an emphasis on broader care access and on accelerating vaccination research. As of 2026-08-06, the record outbreak persists in the eastern regions, prompting intensified public health measures and a clear pivot toward containment within affected communities amid ongoing vaccine testing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、記録的なエボラ流行拡大を受け対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模とされるエボラ流行が拡大しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAに進むべき事案と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は『記録的な規模』の流行拡大と政府による大規模な対応強化（無料医療提供、ワクチン治験調整）を報じており、詳細な症例数・死亡率等のデータは本文に含まれないため一部項目は推定を避けた。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تحذر تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو يتجاوز جهود الاحتواء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is surpassing containment efforts.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating at a pace that surpasses containment efforts, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. In a post on X after meetings with officials in Kinshasa, he warned that the outbreak is advancing more rapidly than the response can keep up and urged an urgent scale-up of containment and treatment efforts. The assessment comes as the country confronts mounting operational challenges, notably a health workers’ strike over delayed salary payments, which threatens response capacity. The report highlights the need for intensified resources, coordination, and interventions to stem transmission, although the article does not provide specific case or death counts. The situation emphasizes the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the imperative for accelerated international and national action as of August 6, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が封じ込め努力を上回っていると警告
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が公式に流行の急拡大と対応能力不足を警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡数は記事中に記載なし。医療従事者のストライキが対応能力に影響していることも懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: जबलपुर में टीबी के खिलाफ बड़ा एक्शन... 7 माह में मिले 3800 मरीज, 2800 संपर्कों की जांच कर दी गई पहली डोज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Major action against TB in Jabalpur... 3,800 patients identified in 7 months, first dose administered after screening 2,800 contacts.
article.articleSummary: Jabalpur district, Madhya Pradesh, India, reports significant progress in its TB-free campaign. Over seven months, health authorities identified 3,800 individuals with TB symptoms, enabling earlier intervention. To curb transmission, 2,800 contacts of these individuals were screened and given the first dose of anti-tuberculosis medication after screening. The initiative emphasizes early identification and prompt treatment to prevent disease progression and further spread within the community. The article does not specify counts of laboratory-confirmed TB cases, but highlights rapid symptom-based detection and immediate therapy for exposed contacts as key strategy in controlling TB locally.

triage.headline_ja: ジャバルプールでTBに対する大規模対策...7ヶ月で3800人の患者を発見、2800人の接触者を検査し初回投与
triage.triage_reason: 既存のTB対策プログラムの進捗報告であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 地方の保健当局によるTB撲滅キャンペーンの定期報告であり、通常の公衆衛生活動の一環。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تحذر: تفشي "إيبولا" في الكونغو يتجاوز جهود الاحتواء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns: An Ebola outbreak in the Congo is beyond containment efforts.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed containment efforts. Government data released on August 5 show 3,973 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 1,801 deaths. The outbreak is centered in Ituri province, with Bunia as its capital, reflecting sustained transmission and escalating fatalities. Amid the health crisis, healthcare workers in Bunia continued protests outside the governor’s office over delayed salary payments, as more medical staff joined a weeks-long strike that authorities say could undermine outbreak response and containment. No specific laboratory confirmation details or infection sources are provided, but the figures indicate a wide spread requiring ongoing public-health measures, surveillance, and support for frontline workers.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、警告：コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が封じ込め努力を超えている
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が封じ込め能力を超えたと警告し、症例3,973件・死亡1,801件という高い致死率を記録、医療従事者のストライキも対応を阻害しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約45%と非常に高く、医療従事者の賃金未払いによるストライキが対応能力をさらに低下させている点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Crise sanitaire en RDC : l'OMS alerte sur une hausse incontrôlable d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public health crisis in the DRC: WHO warns of an uncontrollable surge in Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: In Kinshasa, the WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns of an uncontrollable Ebola surge in the Democratic Republic of Congo and calls for immediate international mobilization. The outbreak’s trajectory has accelerated, with spread outpacing current response capacities amid a fragile local health system and widespread healthcare worker protests over pay. Nearly 90 days after the first official reports, new infections have doubled in the most active transmission foci. Epidemiological briefings from the Congolese Ministry of Health show about 4,000 laboratory-confirmed cases and over 1,700 deaths. Faced with high mortality and expanding transmission, the international community is urged to inject emergency resources to stabilize medical facilities and contain a threat that risks crossing regional borders.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の公衆衛生危機：WHOがエボラの制御不能な増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が制御不能な感染拡大を警告し、4000例以上の確定症例と1700人超の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く（約42.5%）、医療従事者のストライキにより対応能力がさらに低下している点も懸念材料。国境を越える拡大リスクが明示的に指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: El Congo enfrenta el brote de ébola más rápido de su historia que ya deja 1.800 fallecidos y los casos rozan los 4.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo is facing the fastest Ebola outbreak in its history, which has already claimed 1,800 lives and is nearing 4,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) declared in May is the fastest-growing in the country’s history. As of August 4, 1,801 deaths and 3,973 confirmed cases (case fatality 45.3%) are reported. 674 patients are isolated or hospitalized; 776 have recovered; contact tracing covers about 75.3% of at-risk contacts. The outbreak affects five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo, with sustained transmission and high viral circulation. The virus is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment, unlike Zaire ebolavirus. The crisis has surpassed 2018–2020 totals (2,299 deaths, 3,481 infections) but remains below Africa’s 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (>11,000 deaths). Uganda reported 20 cases (mostly imports) and was declared Ebola-free on July 28.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがその歴史上最速のエボラ流行に直面、死者はすでに1,800人、感染者数は4,000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速のエボラ流行が進行中で、致死率45%超、複数州に拡大しウガンダへの越境感染も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例（主に輸入例）は7月28日にエボラ終息宣言済みのため、DRCのみを主要発生国として検証。Bundibugyoエボラウイルスにはワクチン・特効薬がなく、致死率45.3%と極めて深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Convidado - RDC eleva para 1.801 número de mortes por Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guest - DRC raises the Ebola death toll to 1,801.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola death toll rises to 1,801 with 3,973 confirmed cases as of August 6, 2026, a 45.3% case fatality rate. Five eastern provinces are affected: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo. Declared May 15, the outbreak is expanding faster than response; new-case growth doubling in some hotspots per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghe breyesus. Prolonged control challenges stem from ongoing conflict, particularly in Ituri, where health workers have threatened or gone on strike for safety after attacks, and ambulances have been burned. Uganda reported July 28 as Ebola-free after 20 cases, all imported from the DRC, with no sustained local transmission. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the fastest-growing since declaration, though early growth is exponential and dependent on response and security conditions; transmission occurs via direct contact, not airborne.

triage.headline_ja: ゲスト出演：コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱による死者数を1,801人に上方修正
triage.triage_reason: DRCで感染者数・死者数が急増中(致死率45.3%)、紛争地域での対応困難、ウガンダへの越境感染例もあり、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは輸入例のみで持続的な現地感染はなく、対象国リストにも含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHO事務局長が言及するなど国際的関心が非常に高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: En RDC, Ebola s'invite dans les camps de déplacés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, Ebola invades the camps for the displaced.
article.articleSummary: Ebola caused by Bundibugyo virus has reached displacement camps in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 19 internally displaced people infected and 5 deaths, signaling potential rapid spread among millions uprooted by conflict. In Ituri province, five of 69 camps have confirmed cases as overcrowding, limited water and sanitation, and distrust hinder surveillance and safe burials. Across Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo, 3,874 cases and over 1,750 deaths were reported by 3 August 2026, with Ituri accounting for about 87% of infections. WHO calls for urgent, massive scale-up of care access, epidemiological surveillance, and safe burials amid insecurity and attacks on health workers. UNICEF reports 743 pediatric cases and 330 child deaths; essential health services and routine vaccinations have fallen sharply, including a 69% drop in measles first doses in Mongbwalu. Approximately 4.4 million people are displaced nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラが避難民キャンプに侵入
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクが避難民キャンプに拡大し、3,874症例・1,750人以上の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、WHO・UNICEFが緊急対応を呼びかけている。
triage.notes: 紛争による440万人の国内避難民、麻疹ワクチン接種率の急落（Mongbwaluで初回接種69%減）も報告されており、エボラに加え麻疹再興リスクも高い複合的公衆衛生危機。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Escalates Ebola Response as Record Outbreak Spreads
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo escalates its Ebola response amid the country's largest outbreak, with new cases continuing to spike in eastern provinces. The government plans free healthcare in Ebola-affected eastern areas, tests experimental vaccines against the Bundibugyo strain, and shifts to a village-led response model to curb transmission. Measures were agreed at a Kinshasa-chaired meeting led by President Felix Tshisekedi after a joint mission earlier this week, with guidance from the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention. No exact case counts or deaths are provided in the report, but the move signals intensified public-health action, including vaccination trials and community-led intervention, to contain the ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、記録的規模のエボラ流行拡大を受け対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ史上最大規模の流行となっており、政府が緊急対応を強化し国際的な支援（アフリカCDC）も関与していることから、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあると判断される。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事中に記載なし。エボラはブンディブギョ株との記載あり。ワクチン試験や村落主導型対応モデルへの移行など、対応強化が進行中。
