article.articleHeadline: WHO Calls for More Volunteers as Bundibugyo Ebola Vaccine Trials Expand - [your]NEWS
article.articleSummary: Bundibugy Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the largest on record, with WHO reporting 3,748 cases and 1,657 deaths (and 708 recoveries) as of Aug 1, 2026. It marks the 17th major Ebola event since 1976 and the third known Bundibugyo outbreak; no licensed vaccine or approved treatment exists for this strain. WHO is calling for more volunteers to expand clinical trials of experimental vaccines and post-exposure measures as cases and deaths rise. Trials are under way in Canada and the United Kingdom, with the first of four vaccine candidates entering human testing; products are from Moderna and Public Health Vaccines, the nonprofit International AIDS Vaccine Initiative, and the University of Oxford. Animal studies in ferrets and monkeys underpin these efforts. In Ituri province, a separate post-exposure prophylaxis trial led by the DRC’s National Institute for Biomedical Research and international partners has enrolled over 25 high-risk contacts for a 10-day oral regimen.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、バンディブギョ型エボラワクチン治験拡大に伴いボランティアの追加募集を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ（バンディブギョ株）流行が継続しており、致死率が高く、承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在しないためWHOが国際的な治験拡大・支援を呼びかけている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事に含まれるカナダ・英国は臨床試験の実施国であり、実際の感染発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ウガンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文で具体的な感染確認の記述はなく、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Απλήρωτοι υγειονομικοί εγκαταλείπουν τα νοσοκομεία - Πάνω από 1.700 νεκροί από Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: unpaid healthcare workers abandon hospitals - Over 1,700 dead from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Eastern DRC faces its largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak, driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain with no approved vaccines. Since re-emerging in mid-May, confirmed cases total 3,874 and deaths 1,751, with Bunia, capital of Ituri Province, accounting for over 90% of infections. Uganda has contained transmission, but eastern DRC continues rapid spread. The outbreak ranks as the second-largest in Ebola history after West Africa 2014–2016 (over 11,000 deaths). Health workers have not been paid for months, prompting warnings of widespread absenteeism and undermining response efforts. At the Elikia Ebola Treatment Center in Bunia, a 90-bed isolation ward runs at full capacity, with only two or three nurses caring for many severely ill patients. Attacks on at least 12 health facilities, community distrust, and security threats further compromise control. Officials say salaries are being processed, but humanitarian groups warn time is running out if staff depart.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:未払いの医療従事者が病院を放棄 - エボラで1,700人以上死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行で既に国境を越えた伝播が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの伝播は記事中で言及されているが「containedされている」とあり、対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Angolaは記事本文中に言及なし。承認済みワクチンがない稀なBundibugyo株による流行で、医療従事者の未払い賃金による離脱リスクが対応をさらに困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : Bunia reste le principal foyer de l'épidémie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Bunia remains the main epicenter of the epidemic - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of August 5, 2026, Bunia health zone in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, is the epidemic’s main hotspot with 950 confirmed Ebola cases and 289 deaths. New infections are concentrated in Bunia (25), Nizi (21), and Rwampara (18), with additional cases in Lita (9), Fataki (5), Mongbwalu (5), and Mangala (2). In the prior 24 hours, 85 new cases and 47 deaths were recorded (35 community deaths, 12 in Ebola treatment centers). Ituri totals reach 3,460 confirmed cases and 1,464 deaths, CFR 42.3%. Ituri accounts for 87.1% of national confirmed cases and 81.3% of deaths. Other heavily affected zones include Rwampara (692), Mongbwalu (558), and Nizi (431). Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu, Nizi, Lita, and Nyankunde together concentrate 83.7% of Ituri’s cases and 72.9% of deaths, confirming their epicenter status.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州のエボラ流行：ブニアが依然として主要な感染拠点 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で確定症例950件・死亡289件（致死率42.3%）に及ぶ大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはルーマニア、オーストラリア、ルワンダ等が含まれているが、記事本文の主題はコンゴ民主共和国イツリ州のエボラ流行のみであり、これら他国は除外した。致死率42.3%と極めて高く、既知の大規模流行の継続として引き続き注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Un caz suspect pe un vas care navighează spre Kinshasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: A suspected case aboard a vessel en route to Kinshasa.
article.articleSummary: A suspected Ebola case aboard a vessel on the Congo River toward Kinshasa has been reported by Congolese authorities. The Democratic Republic of Congo (RDC) declared on May 15 its 17th Ebola outbreak, in the eastern and northeastern provinces. Since the start of the epidemic, authorities have logged 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths. The current strain is Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. A suspected case died in Mongala after the passenger, originating from Tshopo province, traveled on the vessel. A mobile laboratory was deployed to test all passengers, and the vessel has been isolated around 65 kilometers from Kinshasa; no other deaths on board. The outbreak has affected Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. The WHO calls for intensified response; Ebola spreads via contact with infected bodily fluids and has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa in fifty years.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：キンシャサへ向かう船舶内で疑い例
triage.triage_reason: 既知の第17次エボラ流行（3,973症例・1,801死亡）に加え、首都キンシャサへ向かう船内での疑い死亡例が報告され、国内拡散リスクとWHOの対応強化要請があるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 既に進行中の第17次エボラ流行（Bundibugyo株、ワクチン・治療法なし）の続報。首都キンシャサへの拡大懸念があり、船舶隔離・移動制限などの対応が取られている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Zentralafrika: Warum die DR Kongo Ebola nicht in den Griff bekommt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Africa: Why the DRC can't get Ebola under control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is back and raging with extreme intensity in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) in Central Africa. The outbreak is linked to roughly 300 deaths per week, with more than 60% of fatalities occurring at home as patients cannot reach treatment centers, raising the risk of further spread. The article questions how the outbreak began, why the DRC is so heavily affected, and what is being done in a country long scarred by conflict. It also notes discussions about the hopeful role of new vaccines and increased international support. The piece comes from taz’s foreign affairs podcast Fernverbindung, featuring Tanja Tricarico and Simone Schlindwein. The episode was recorded on August 5, 2026 at 11:00 CET and published on August 6, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカ：なぜコンゴ民主共和国はエボラを抑え込めないのか
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で週約300人の死者が出る大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が続いており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツの報道機関taz(フォーリンアフェアーズポッドキャスト)によるもので、致死率の高さと医療アクセスの困難、紛争地域での対応の難しさ、新規ワクチンと国際支援の役割について論じている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola is spreading faster than response - WHO chief -- RT Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DR Congo) is spreading faster than response, prompting WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus to call for urgent, massive expansion of containment. From July 31 to August 4, confirmed cases rose from 3,674 to 3,973 and deaths from 1,621 to 1,801 (case fatality rate 44.1% to 45.3%). Health zones reporting cases increased from 49 to 51 across five provinces, with Ituri as the epicenter. Insecurity and mass displacement hinder outreach, requiring stronger leadership, protection for health workers, and faster access to treatment, surveillance, and safe burials. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or targeted therapy. US pledged $242 million for response and preparedness, bringing total outbreak-related aid to over $512 million; Russia has supplied regional support. Uganda’s earlier outbreak was declared over last week.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは対応より速く拡大している - WHO事務局長
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行で致死率45%超、症例・死亡ともに急増しWHO事務局長が緊急対応拡大を要請しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 米国・ロシアは資金・支援提供国であり発生国ではないため除外。ウガンダの過去のアウトブレイクは既に終息宣言済みで本イベントとは別事象のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola is spreading faster than response WHO chief
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, driven by Bundibugyo strain with no approved vaccine or targeted treatment, is spreading faster than response efforts. WHO reports rapid growth: confirmed cases rose from 3,674 (Jul 31) to 3,973 (Aug 4) and deaths from 1,621 to 1,801, with the case fatality rate up from 44.1% to 45.3%. The outbreak expanded to 51 health zones across five provinces, with Ituri remaining the epicenter. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged urgent, massive expansion of containment, warning insecurity and mass displacement hinder responses. Calls include stronger Congolese government leadership, protection for health workers, faster access to treatment, disease surveillance, and safe burials. International support includes the US adding $242 million for Ebola response and preparedness (total >$512 million); Russia has deployed diagnostic capacity and supplies. Uganda’s earlier linked outbreak was declared over last week.

triage.headline_ja: エボラはWHO事務局長が指摘する通り、対応より速いスピードで拡大している
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が急速に拡大し、致死率45%超・複数州51保健区に拡大するなど深刻かつ異常な状況であり、WHOが緊急対応拡大を要請し国際支援も動員されているためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 米国・ロシアは支援国として言及されているが発生国ではないため除外。ウガンダは関連流行が既に終息宣言されており、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Vạch trần thủ đoạn che giấu gần 1 tấn thịt lợn nghi nhiễm dịch tả châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Exposing the schemes to conceal nearly 1 metric ton of pork suspected of being infected with African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: In Hung Yen Province, Vietnam, authorities on 27 July uncovered a slaughter/processing facility run by Nguyen Trong Khoang? (Nguyễn Trọng Khương, born 1994) in Mỹ Hào Ward, Lỗ Xá, that handled pigs from multiple sources with non-fixed receiving points, processing off-site before storage in a home cold room. Khương allegedly disabled surveillance cameras and concealed the area to evade detection. A total of 977.8 kg of live animals and products were seized, with equipment used for slaughter and processing. Laboratory tests confirmed African swine fever virus in 7 of 9 samples. By 29 July the case was referred to the Hung Yen Provincial Police for prosecution under Article 317 (food safety violations). By 4 August, all animals and products tested positive for ASF and were destroyed in line with veterinary, food safety, and environmental protections. As of 6 August 2026, authorities continue action against the scheme.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱感染疑いの豚肉約1トンを隠蔽した手口を暴露
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（アフリカ豚熱）であり人への直接健康影響はないが、違法流通・隠蔽事案として食品安全・畜産管理上のリスクがあり継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾患でヒトへの感染性はないが、違法流通による食品安全リスクと畜産業への経済的影響があるため、動物衛生当局の対応状況を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Tedros se reúne con Tshisekedi para reforzar la respuesta al ébola en la RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros meets with Tshisekedi to bolster the Ebola response in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 4, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) infection count stands at 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and DRC President Félix Tshisekedi met in Kinshasa to urgently strengthen and broaden the response, aligning with the RDC government and a shared strategy among partners. The plan emphasizes adapting to the outbreak’s velocity, ensuring community engagement and trust, and preventing patients from dying at home by directing them to health facilities. It also calls for protection and adequate remuneration of frontline health workers with proper personal protective equipment. Africa CDC and WHO reaffirm technical and operational support. Uganda was declared Ebola-free on July 28 after 20 cases (15 imported from the DRC) and 2 deaths. This is the second-largest outbreak by cases and the largest in the DRC history.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応強化のためチセケディ大統領と会談
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ流行（3,973例、死亡1,801人）が継続しており、WHO事務局長が現地首脳と対応強化を協議するなど国際的関心・介入が明確であるためPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既に7月28日にエボラ終息宣言済み（15例が輸入例）のため対象国リストに含まれないウガンダは除外。DRCが主要な発生地であり、史上最大規模のアウトブレイクとされる。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果客船驚現疑似伊波拉死者　逼近1700萬人口首都 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congolese passenger ship finds a suspected Ebola victim; Kinshasa, a capital with a population nearing 17 million
article.articleSummary: An Ebola death is suspected aboard a passenger vessel bound for Kinshasa, as the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) battles its 17th Ebola outbreak. The ship, departing from Tshopo in the northeast, was intercepted 65 km from Kinshasa and quarantined after a passenger died about 1,200 km from the capital; a mobile laboratory is testing all aboard, with authorities reporting no additional deaths on the vessel. Ebola virus transmission occurs via body fluids, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, hemorrhage, and organ failure. Since the outbreak began on May 15, five eastern and northeastern provinces have been affected, with nearly 4,000 infections and at least 1,800 deaths; cases have reached neighboring Uganda. The strain identified is Bundibugyo, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment, complicating containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの旅客船で疑いのあるエボラ死者発見、人口1700万人の首都キンシャサに接近
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行（約4000感染、1800人死亡）が首都キンシャサ近郊まで拡大する懸念があり、隣国ウガンダにも波及。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。原因株はBundibugyoで承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在しない点がリスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola death on boat heading for DR Congo capital
article.articleSummary: A suspected Ebola death was reported on a vessel headed for Kinshasa from the northeastern province of Tshopo, about 1,200 km from the capital, prompting a mobile laboratory to test all passengers and the vessel to be isolated 65 km from Kinshasa. Kinshasa, home to about 17 million people, has so far been spared the outbreak that has hit five eastern and northeastern provinces in the Democratic Republic of Congo and crossed into Uganda. Since the outbreak was officially declared on May 15, at least 1,800 people have died among roughly 4,000 confirmed infections. The epicentre is Ituri, with spread to Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu and Haut-Uele and Tshopo. The current epidemic is caused by Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. WHO notes the outbreak is spreading faster than response; call to scale up urgently. First known suspected case dates to April 24.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴの首都に向かう船上でエボラ死亡疑い
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（4000人感染、1800人死亡）が続く中、ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株が首都キンシャサに拡大する恐れがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 既にウガンダへの越境が報告されており、ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株であること、WHOが対応の遅れを指摘している点は重大なリスク要因。首都キンシャサ（人口約1700万人）への到達リスクが高まっている。

article.articleHeadline: InfoGripe: número de casos de SRAG mantém queda na maior parte do país | Portal Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: InfoGripe: number of SARI cases continues to fall in most of the country | Fiocruz Portal
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin (Week 30: Jul 26–Aug 1, 2026) reports a national decline in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARI) cases in Brazil, though 14 states remain at alert or high risk: Acre, Amazonas, Bahia, Goiás, Maranhão, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, Rio de Janeiro, Roraima, Santa Catarina, and Sergipe. Two capitals, Belém (PA) and Porto Velho (RO), show SARI activity at alert/high risk with a long-term growth signal; 15 other capitals have alert/high risk without long-term growth signals (Aracaju, Belo Horizonte, Boa Vista, Brasília, Campo Grande, Cuiabá, Curitiba, Florianópolis, Macapá, Manaus, Porto Alegre, Rio Branco, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador, São Luís). Nationally, 130,054 SARI cases in 2026, with 69,895 positive for a respiratory virus, 44,877 negative, 7,626 pending. Positives: influenza A 18.9%, influenza B 5.1%, RSV 42.1%, rhinovirus 30.0%, SARS-CoV-2 4.1%. Deaths among positives: A 23.8%, B 16.9%, RSV 30.3%, rhinovirus 25.2%, COVID-19 4.5%. RSV drives pediatric burden; influenza A higher incidence in under-2s and mortality in 65+, while COVID-19 remains low. Seasonal influenza A largely ended, but severe cases persist in Minas Gerais and Roraima. Vaccination remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: インフォグリペ：SARI（重症急性呼吸器症候群）症例数は国内大部分で減少傾向を維持
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器感染症（RSV・インフルエンザ・COVID-19）に関する定例サーベイランス報告であり、全国的には減少傾向。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性は低く、通常の季節的サーベイランスの範囲内。
triage.notes: 毎週定例のInfoGripe(Fiocruz)サーベイランス速報。一部州で警戒/高リスク継続も全国的には減少傾向であり、通常の季節性呼吸器疾患モニタリング情報。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in DR Congo: River boat under quarantine after five deaths
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, Ebola outbreak in DR Congo continues with a river-boat quarantine after five deaths. The Yingfeng 2, a vessel operated by a Chinese company, was halted near Bende Bende port about 65 km upstream from Kinshasa after a passenger with fever and diarrhoea who disembarked earlier died in hospital; two more adults, a three-year-old, and a newborn have died. Health ministry and WHO teams screened all 255 passengers for Ebola and cholera and set up a mobile lab aboard; no positives have been confirmed, with officials noting the 21-day incubation window. The boat left Kisangani about two weeks ago, traveling roughly 1,700 km downstream toward Kinshasa. The 17th Ebola outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus; there is no vaccine yet, though first human trials are under way in the UK. Official counts: 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths; 17,000+ contacts monitored; 674 in isolation; 776 recoveries; Kinshasa reinforcing Maluku surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：5人死亡後、川船が検疫隔離に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（確認例3,973人、死亡1,801人）に加え、感染者を乗せた船がキンシャサに向けて移動していたことが判明し、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限（検疫）が既に発生しているため。
triage.notes: 英国は新規ワクチンの臨床試験実施国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。船はキサンガニからキンシャサ方向へ約1,700km移動しており、首都圏への拡大リスクが特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Rio distribui 273 novos kits que ajudam no diagnóstico da hanseníase
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro distributes 273 new kits that aid in the diagnosis of Hansen's disease.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro State Health Secretariat distributed 273 new esthesiometer kits to Basic Health teams across Rio de Janeiro state's municipalities, bringing total to 726 kits delivered to Primary Care in two years. The initiative, part of the State Hansen's Disease Awareness, Mobilization and Combat Campaign, aims to improve early diagnosis of leprosy (Mycobacterium leprae), which affects the skin, mucous membranes, and nerves and is contagious. Symptoms include skin patches and loss of skin sensation; treatment is freely available through Brazil's SUS. Distribution followed epidemiological and operational criteria, prioritizing areas with higher case numbers and diagnostic difficulty; kits paired with training to conduct neurological assessments, active contact tracing, case finding, and evaluation of contacts. The program, supported by Fiocruz specialists, began in 2018 to address equipment gaps. Reported outcomes: prior disability at diagnosis averaged 14%, now about 10%.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州、ハンセン病診断支援の新規キット273個を配布
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病であるハンセン病に対する診断機器配布という通常の公衆衛生プログラムの報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ハンセン病は既知の慢性感染症であり、本記事は診断キット配布という行政的な取り組みの報告。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in DR Congo: River boat under quarantine after five deaths
article.articleSummary: Ebola in DR Congo: River boat Yingfeng 2 was halted near Bende Bende port, 65 km upstream from Kinshasa, with 255 passengers screened for Ebola and cholera as a precaution after a passenger with fever and diarrhoea who disembarked earlier died in hospital. A further two adults, a three-year-old, and a newborn have died, bringing total fatalities to five. Health Minister Roger Kamba said mobile lab testing is under way with WHO teams aboard. For now, no one has tested positive, and officials say the 21-day incubation window makes a positive result unlikely in the near term. The Yingfeng 2 departed Kisangani about two weeks ago.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱疑い：5人死亡後、河川船が検疫隔離
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の疑いで河川船が検疫対象となり5人が死亡、保健相・WHOチームが対応中であり、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 現時点で陽性者は確認されていないが、エボラの潜伏期間（21日）を考慮し経過観察が必要。コレラも同時にスクリーニング対象となっている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Crisis por ébola en el Congo: aumenta a 1.801 la cifra de muertos y persisten los impagos al personal de salud
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola crisis in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: death toll has risen to 1,801, and health workers' salaries remain unpaid.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues with 1,801 deaths and 3,973 confirmed cases. The World Health Organization warns transmission is outpacing response as Director-General Tedros visits to urge intensified action. The Bundibugyo strain is involved, a rare variant with no vaccine or approved treatment. Early symptoms mimic malaria or typhoid, hampering detection. In Ituri province's Bunia, isolation centers see mass exits; at least 30 people fled since June 4. Only 43% of direct contacts are monitored, far below the 95% target. Cross-border risk to South Sudan, Uganda, and Rwanda increases. Health workers are striking over unpaid salaries since mid-May, disrupting care. Although international funding exceeds $200 million, logistics and insecurity hinder rapid containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ危機：死者数が1,801人に増加、医療従事者への未払い給与問題が継続
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ満たし（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な変異株、国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準も全て該当する重大な進行中のエボラ流行であり、WHO事務局長の現地訪問など社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 隣国（南スーダン、ウガンダ、ルワンダ）への越境リスクが指摘されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・承認治療薬がなく、隔離施設からの逃亡や接触者追跡率の低さ（43%）が拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmado caso de raiva herbívora em bovino no município de Crissiumal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed case of herbivorous rabies in cattle in the municipality of Crissiumal.
article.articleSummary: On August 5, 2026, the state official laboratory confirmed herbivorous rabies in a cow in Barra do Buricá, Crissiumal municipality, in the northwest of the state. The confirmation brings the region to five herbivorous rabies cases, after four previously detected in the neighboring Doutor Maurício Cardoso. Crissiumal’s Veterinary Inspection reinforced cattle vaccination, especially for farms near Barra do Buricá. State Secretariat for Agriculture, Livestock, Sustainable Production and Irrigation (Seapi) field teams remain mobilized to locate roosts of the hematophagous bat, the main vector, and to implement population control. Producers should report potential bat shelters (such as caves, hollow logs, abandoned houses, or bridges) to the Inspection at (55) 3524-2320 and should not handle cattle or other animals showing neurological symptoms or suspected disease.

triage.headline_ja: クリシウマル市の牛で草食動物型狂犬病の感染が確認
triage.triage_reason: 牛の草食動物型狂犬病（吸血コウモリ媒介）であり、ヒトへの感染や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は報告されておらず、対象国（ブラジル）内の動物衛生事案として通常の対応が取られている。
triage.notes: 本事案は家畜（牛）の狂犬病で、吸血コウモリを媒介とする動物衛生上の問題。ヒト感染例の報告はなく、地域の畜産当局が通常の予防対応（ワクチン接種、ねぐら調査）を実施している段階。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns DR Congo Ebola outbreak is outpacing response efforts
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, is spreading faster than response efforts can contain, with new cases doubling in some hotspots as of 2026-08-06. The outbreak has infected 3,874 people and killed 1,751, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record after 2014–2016 West Africa. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Kinshasa, urged urgent, scaled-up action across all response pillars. Frontline health workers have interrupted operations over unpaid salaries, disrupting care in areas including Bunia, amid a weakened healthcare system near borders with South Sudan, Uganda and Rwanda. Officials say the virus circulated in remote communities long before the May 15 declaration. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no approved vaccine or treatment. The United States has added $242 million in funding, pushing total U.S. support to over $512 million.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が対応能力を上回っていると警告
triage.triage_reason: 感染者3,874人・死者1,751人と史上2番目の規模に達し、ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブギョ株が拡大中で、WHO事務局長が緊急対応強化を要請するなど国際的関心・支援が高い。
triage.notes: 南スーダン・ウガンダ・ルワンダなど国境地域への波及リスクが指摘されているが、現時点で発生が確認されているのはDRCのみ。米国は資金支援国であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: "Новите случаи се удвоиха". Заразените с ебола в Демократична република Конго доближиха 4000 - Свободна точка
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "The new cases have doubled." Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo neared 4,000 - Free Point.
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 6, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths, concentrated in Ituri province near Uganda, South Sudan, and Rwanda, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. WHO says the outbreak is spreading faster than response efforts, with new cases doubling in hotspots last week. Access to care is hampered by strikes among health workers and weak health systems; 60–70% of new infections are not detected through contact tracing, contributing to a ~45% case fatality. For Bundibugyo, there is no approved vaccine or treatment; two antibody therapies exist, while ERVEBO targets the Zaire species and does not protect Bundibugyo. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, not airborne; fruit bat reservoirs and traditional burial practices facilitate spread. US funds amount to $242 million. Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths; France reports 1 case (no deaths) as of Aug 4. This outbreak is the second-largest in history, after 2014–2016 West Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 「新規症例が倍増」コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が4,000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクは死亡率約45%、対応能力を上回る拡大速度、承認済みワクチン不在、周辺国（ウガンダ、フランス）への越境拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・フランス・米国等が発生地域として付与されているが、記事の主題はDRC（イツリ州）でのアウトブレイクであり、ウガンダ・フランスは越境症例、米国は資金拠出国として言及されているのみ。対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS alerta: el ébola avanza más rápido que la capacidad de respuesta en este país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Warns: Ebola Is Outpacing the Response Capacity in This Country
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is outpacing the country’s response, per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus on X. As of 2026-08-06, 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths have been reported, with new cases doubling in some foci over the past week after nearly three months since the start. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain driving the outbreak has no approved vaccine or treatment. The event is described as the second-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak to date. The United States announced an additional $242 million to help contain transmission, bolster regional preparedness, and provide humanitarian aid, bringing total U.S. direct assistance to over $512 million. The brief provides limited details on laboratory confirmation or infection sources.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告：エボラ出血熱がこの国で対応能力を上回るスピードで拡大
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が公に警告するエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行で、確定症例3,874例・死亡1,751例、ワクチン・治療法未承認、症例が急増しており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: 米国は資金支援国であり発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。ワクチン・治療法が未承認のブンディブギョ株による流行で、致死率・拡大速度ともに極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, nella Repubblica democratica del Congo la peggior epidemia di sempre: 743 casi tra i bambini, 330 morti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the worst outbreak ever — 743 cases among children, 330 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is the worst and fastest-growing Ebola epidemic documented in the country. As of 2 August 2026, 743 confirmed pediatric cases (0–17) and 330 child deaths have been reported. Children account for about a quarter of cases and over 60% of fatalities; mortality among those under five exceeds adult rates. The outbreak coincides with severe disruptions to essential health services: April–June 2026 shows a 42% drop in care-seeking in Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nizi and Rwampara, and a 13% decline province-wide. Routine infant vaccines fell sharply (measles first dose −69% in Mongbwalu; pentavalent third dose −22%; measles second dose −18%), with 23,000 fewer doses May–June than April. Facility births fell 13% overall (38% in Bunia, 30% in Rwampara, 70% in Nizi); prenatal visits down ~28%. UNICEF mobilized 13,000 community workers, reached over 2.4 million people with prevention messages, conducted 505,000 home visits, and equipped 45 facilities. The UNICEF appeal is 113.45 million USD; 23.5 million mobilized; 89.9 million remaining; urgent donor support requested.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪の流行 — 子ども743症例、330人死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で同国史上最悪・最速拡大のエボラ流行が発生し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が確認されるためIHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにルワンダ(Kigali Province等)が含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCイツリ州のみが流行地として言及されており、ルワンダでの症例は確認されていないため verified_locations には含めなかった。また、麻疹ワクチン接種率の急落も報告されており、二次的な麻疹アウトブレイクリスクにも注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: What is Chandipura virus? Symptoms, outbreaks, treatment and prevention explained
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus (CHPV), a sandfly-borne member of the Rhabdoviridae, was first identified in Chandipura village near Nagpur, Maharashtra, in 1965. Most infections are mild, but CHPV can trigger acute encephalitis syndrome (AES) in children with rapid deterioration and high mortality. A recent surge in Gujarat and Rajasthan reported 24 child deaths. In 2024, India recorded 245 AES cases from June to mid-August with 82 deaths; CHPV infection was laboratory-confirmed in 64 patients, marking the country’s largest AES outbreak in nearly two decades. No antiviral or vaccine exists; treatment is supportive. Serology indicates prior exposure among adults in central India. Outbreaks typically occur in hot summers and the monsoon when sandflies surge. Early surveillance, diagnostics capacity, and public health measures are essential. The genome/structure are known, but vaccine development has stalled due to infrequent outbreaks; sustained investment could enable vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルスとは何か？症状、アウトブレイク、治療と予防を解説
triage.triage_reason: チャンディプラウイルスに関する解説記事で、過去（2024年）の大規模AES流行データが中心。『最近の急増』という24名の小児死亡の記述があるが時期や規模の詳細が不明確なため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は解説（explainer）形式であり、2024年の大規模AES流行（245例、82死亡、64例でCHPV確認）を背景に説明。『最近の急増』（グジャラート・ラジャスタンで24人の小児死亡）の時期が不明確で、2026年配信時点での新規発生かどうか判断できない。ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬は存在せず、サシチョウバエ媒介で毎年夏季・モンスーン期に発生する季節性疾患。

article.articleHeadline: Congo escalates Ebola response as record outbreak spreads
article.articleSummary: {"description":"Democratic Republic of Congo escalates Ebola response as almost 4,000 cases and more than 1,800 deaths have been recorded since mid‑May. Insecurity, displacement, and delayed detection have spread the virus across five provinces, notably Ituri and North Kivu. The six‑month plan offers free healthcare in Ituri and North Kivu across public, private, and faith‑based facilities, with essential medicines, PPE, and salaries/risk allowances for frontline workers. It shifts to a village‑centered model engaging leaders, community health workers, women, youth, and Ebola survivors to identify suspects, trace contacts, promote safe burials, and encourage early care. Trials will test Bundibugyo vaccines and assess cross‑protection from Merck’s Ervebo; remdesivir with MBP134 will be expanded. Donors have pledged over $420 million, plus $242 million from the US. Measures start immediately, with a progress review in October 2026."}

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、記録的規模で拡大するエボラ流行への対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: 約4,000症例・1,800人超の死亡という記録的規模の流行が5州に拡大しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的な資金支援・懸念が確認されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 紛争・避難民による治安不安が検知・対応を遅らせており、ワクチン治験（Bundibugyo、Ervebo交差防御）や新規治療薬（remdesivir+MBP134）の展開、420百万ドル超の国際的資金拠出（うち米国242百万ドル）が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: RT-Engels: Ebola is spreading faster than response WHO chief
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or targeted treatment, is accelerating. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that cases are doubling in some hotspots over the past week and urged urgent, massive expansion of containment efforts across all fronts. DR Congo Ministry of Health data show confirmed cases rising from 3,674 to 3,973 between July 31 and August 4, with deaths increasing from 1,621 to 1,801 (case fatality rate 44.1% to 45.3%). The affected health zones grew from 49 to 51 across five provinces, with Ituri still the epicenter. Described as the largest Ebola epidemic in DR Congo to date, the outbreak faces major challenges, including insecurity and mass displacement, complicating response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: RTエンゲルス：エボラはWHO事務局長が示す対応速度より速く拡大している
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が公式に警告するDRCでの過去最大規模のエボラ流行であり、致死率45%超、承認ワクチン・治療薬がなく、症例が急増しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyo株による流行で、DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行とされる。治安不安・住民避難が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Amapá registra mais de cinco mil casos e 117 mortes por hepatites virais - Diário do Amapá
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amapá records more than five thousand cases and 117 deaths due to viral hepatitis - Diário do Amapá.
article.articleSummary: Amapá state in Brazil recorded 5,438 viral hepatitis cases and 117 deaths from 2000 to 2024. Nationally, Brazil logged over 826,000 confirmed hepatitis cases in the same period, with hepatitis C 342,328 (41.5%), hepatitis B 302,351 (36.6%), and hepatitis A 174,977 (21.2%); hepatitis D and E together account for less than 1%. In Amapá, hepatitis A leads notifications, underscoring the need for earlier diagnosis and expanded access to testing—free via SUS. To boost detection, the Health Ministry expanded rapid tests, and by May 2026 Amapá had received 29,500 hepatitis C tests. Transmission varies by type: hepatitis A via contaminated water/food; hepatitis B and D via blood, unprotected sex, and mother-to-child transmission; hepatitis C mainly via blood exposure, including shared needles and non-sterile cosmetic tools. The Global Hepatitis Report 2026 cites about 1.3 million deaths from HBV and HCV in 2024 worldwide, highlighting ongoing elimination challenges.

triage.headline_ja: アマパ州、ウイルス性肝炎による5,000件超の症例と117人の死亡を記録 - Diário do Amapá
triage.triage_reason: 2000年から2024年までの長期累積統計を報告する内容であり、急性の異常発生や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は2000-2024年の累積統計データおよび公衆衛生対策（検査拡充等）に関する報告であり、突発的なアウトブレイクではない。ブラジル保健省が既に対策（迅速検査拡充、SUSでの無料アクセス）を実施していることから管理可能性は問題なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: У ДР Конго вже понад 1800 смертей від Еболи, медики протестують через невиплату зарплат
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, over 1,800 deaths from Ebola; medics protest over unpaid salaries.
article.articleSummary: During the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, medical personnel protest unpaid salaries as fatalities exceed 1,800. In Ituri province, Bunia hosts protests; Ituri accounts for roughly 90% of cases. As of August 6, 2026, the government reports 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths, with 674 patients in isolation, most in Ituri. This is the second-largest Ebola epidemic on record, after West Africa 2014–2016. WHO Chief Tedros Ghebreyesus visited Congo, urging authorities to support health workers. MSF says the outbreak is spreading at unprecedented speed and that responses are not reaching communities quickly enough to break transmission. About 60–70% of new cases come from remote, conflict-affected areas with limited access due to clashes and mining-related displacement. The outbreak had been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ死者数が1800人を超える中、医療従事者が給与未払いに抗議
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行で、死者1800人超・確定症例3973例と過去2番目の規模。医療体制崩壊・国際的関心の高さからフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文では言及がなくDRC（特にIturi州）が主題であるため除外した。既にPHEIC宣言済みであり、西アフリカ2014-2016に次ぐ規模の流行である点、医療従事者の給与未払いによる対応能力低下、紛争地域でのアクセス制限がリスクを増大させている。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Screens 255 Boat Passengers Over Ebola, Cholera Fears
article.articleSummary: DR Congo began screening all 255 passengers aboard the Yingfeng 2 after the boat was intercepted on the Congo River near Bende Bende port, about 65 km upstream from Kinshasa, amid fears of Ebola and cholera. The precaution followed the death of a passenger who developed fever and diarrhoea after disembarking at an earlier stop; authorities also confirmed four additional deaths: two adults, a three-year-old, and a newborn. Health ministry teams and WHO established a mobile laboratory on the vessel, conducting tests; no passenger has tested positive to date, with vigilance continuing through the 21-day Ebola incubation period. The ship left Kisangani roughly two weeks ago, covering more than 1,700 km toward Kinshasa, and remains quarantined offshore under WHO protocols. DR Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak since May 15 involves the Bundibugyo strain, with about 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths; over 17,000 people are under monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラとコレラの懸念でボートの乗客255人をスクリーニング
triage.triage_reason: 進行中の大規模エボラ流行（第17波、確認症例約3,973件・死亡1,801人）に関連し、感染拡大の疑いがある船舶乗客のスクリーニングと隔離が行われており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株、17回目のアウトブレイク）に加え、コレラ疑いの死亡例も報告されており、WHOが船上に移動検査室を設置して対応中。乗客の検査結果は現時点で陰性だが、21日間の潜伏期間中の経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 양성률 20% 넘었는데..."약이 없어요" 코로나19 확산에도 약국 판매 막힌 중국
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Positive rate over 20%... 'There is no medicine'—China blocks pharmacy sales despite the spread of COVID-19
article.articleSummary: China's COVID-19 resurgence shows a 20.3% positivity rate among respiratory samples from influenza-like illness nationwide, up from 16.3% the prior week, signaling rising infections and possible increases over the next 1–2 weeks as of 2026-08-06. Beijing reports difficulty obtaining treatment; a worker could not find COVID-19 drugs at multiple pharmacies. In China, COVID-19 antivirals require hospital prescriptions or purchase via official online pharmacies, with delivery typically 1–2 days and up to 5 days in some areas. Although oral antivirals are approved, most regions still do not allow sales in ordinary pharmacies due to lingering 2022 Zero-COVID-era regulations. Some pharmacies offer influenza drugs instead, but experts warn they are not interchangeable. Industry sources note that even after policy loosening, millions may experience annual infections, underscoring the need to improve timely access and appropriate use of treatments.

triage.headline_ja: 陽性率20%超えなのに「薬がない」…新型コロナ拡大でも薬局販売が制限される中国
triage.triage_reason: 中国全土で呼吸器検体の陽性率が20%を超え上昇傾向にあり、薬局での抗ウイルス薬入手困難という社会的関心を伴う医療アクセス問題が生じているため、フルリスク評価への移行を検討する。
triage.notes: 感染者数の重症度・死亡数に関する情報は記事に含まれておらず不明。抗ウイルス薬の薬局販売制限という規制上の問題が主な焦点であり、感染拡大そのものよりも医療アクセスの課題が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Experts call for advanced diagnostics, AI and stronger UDST to accelerate India's TB elimination drive
article.articleSummary: Two-day National Conclave and Policy Dialogue on Tuberculosis in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, urged strengthening Universal Drug Susceptibility Testing (UDST) and adopting advanced diagnostics—molecular tests, genotypic testing, targeted next-generation sequencing (tNGS)—and artificial intelligence to accelerate India’s TB elimination. Experts stressed early detection of drug-resistant TB, streamlined patient care pathways, digital systems and real-time monitoring as essential. Inaugurated by Dr. Digambar Behera, the forum highlighted India’s status as possessing the world’s highest TB burden, with challenges in selecting effective regimens and ensuring diagnostic accuracy before treatment. The gathering focused on field-level challenges in remote, tribal and hard-to-reach areas, calling for actionable measures to improve sample collection, transport, reporting, treatment initiation and follow-up. Official data show a 21% decline in TB cases and 28% in TB deaths from 2015–2024; the TB-Mukt Bharat drive has screened over 200 million people since Dec 7, 2024, and AI-enabled programs have aided diagnosis of over 2.8 million TB patients nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家、インドの結核撲滅推進のため高度診断技術・AI・UDST強化を提言
triage.triage_reason: 政策会議・啓発活動に関する記事であり、新規異常事態や急性の公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。既存の結核対策の進捗報告であり、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 結核症例数・死亡数はむしろ減少傾向にあり、既存対策の強化を議論する政策会議の記事。急性のアウトブレイクや異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Behörde in Afrika will mögliche Ebola-Mutation abklären
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An agency in Africa wants to clarify a possible Ebola mutation.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies as Africa CDC and WHO examine whether a mutation of the Bundibugyo Ebola virus may be driving rapid spread. With more than 3,900 confirmed cases reported, authorities estimate the tally could approach 4,000, a figure roughly eight times higher than West Africa’s 2014 outbreak and with deaths more than six times higher in the same period. Africa CDC Africa Director-General Jean Kaseya said investigations are being launched to determine if a mutation occurred and how to respond. The response includes expanding laboratory capacity and building new treatment centers, but Kaseya warned that stopping transmission at the community level is essential; otherwise increased capacity may have little impact. The outbreak’s severity is described as unprecedented for the region, prompting a race against time to contain it.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの機関、エボラの変異の可能性を調査へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が急拡大し、症例数が2014年西アフリカ流行の約8倍に達しており、ウイルス変異の可能性をWHO・Africa CDCが調査中であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文で具体的言及がなくDRCが主題であるため除外した。ウイルス変異の可能性は調査段階であり、確定情報ではない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: ES registra avanço de casos graves de influenza B
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Espírito Santo reports a surge in severe influenza B cases.
article.articleSummary: Espírito Santo, Brazil, reports a surge in severe influenza B cases, per Fiocruz InfoGripe Week 30 (26 July–1 August 2026). While national SRAG trends decline, Espírito Santo is among states with rising influenza B, alongside Minas Gerais and Rio Grande do Sul. In total, 14 states remain at alert or higher SRAG levels. The Central-South region shows ongoing influenza B growth, with Rio de Janeiro and Santa Catarina slowing; Ceará, Distrito Federal, Goiás, Maranhão, Mato Grosso do Sul, Paraná and São Paulo are already decreasing. Influenza A has largely ended its peak, though severe A persists in Minas Gerais and Roraima. RSV-related severe illness is falling nationwide but remains elevated in MG, PR, RJ, RR, SP, SC, Sergipe and RS, with children and the elderly most at risk of hospitalization and death. In 2026, SRAG totals reach 130,054 with 69,895 lab-confirmed; RSV 42.1%, rhinovirus 30%, influenza A 18.9%, influenza B 5.1%, COVID-19 4.1%.

triage.headline_ja: エスピリトサント州でインフルエンザB重症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ・RSVに関するブラジルの定例サーベイランス報告（Fiocruz InfoGripe）であり、異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 毎週のFiocruz InfoGripeサーベイランスレポートに基づく季節性呼吸器感染症（インフルエンザA/B、RSV、COVID-19）の動向報告。全国的には減少傾向で、一部州（ES、MG、RS）で増加が見られるが、季節性の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo begins Ebola and cholera screening for 255 passengers after Congo River boat incident
article.articleSummary: DR Congo begins Ebola and cholera screening for 255 passengers aboard the Yingfeng 2 after a Congo River interception near Bende Bende port, roughly 65 km upstream of Kinshasa. A passenger with fever and diarrhoea who disembarked earlier died in hospital; a further two adults, a three-year-old child and a newborn have also died. Health ministry teams and WHO set up a mobile lab on board and plan offshore quarantine to prevent spread to Kinshasa. The country’s 17th Ebola outbreak since May 15 is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no vaccine yet; first human trials for a vaccine are under way in the UK. Kinshasa has intensified surveillance at Maluku as cases rise elsewhere. Official counts: 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths; over 17,000 contacts under monitoring, 674 in isolation or treatment, and 776 recoveries across five provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ川ボート事件を受け、DRコンゴが255人の乗客に対しエボラ・コレラのスクリーニングを開始
triage.triage_reason: 既に確認例3,973件・死亡1,801人に達しているDRCの第17次エボラ流行（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス、ワクチン未承認）に加え、コレラ疑い例も併発しており、キンシャサ近郊での川船検疫という異例の対応が取られているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 英国は稀少株ワクチンの臨床試験実施国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。死亡者数・確認例数はエボラとコレラを合算した可能性があり、内訳は記事から不明。

article.articleHeadline: В Китае ребенок заболел после того, как поел из пакета с летучей мышью внутри
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In China, a child fell ill after eating from a bag containing a bat.
article.articleSummary: China: In the city of Ninde, a child fell ill after eating from a bag containing a bat inside a meat dish bought at a local restaurant. The child developed nausea and was hospitalized; authorities have acknowledged the incident, visited the restaurant, and sent a sample to a laboratory for testing to determine exposure source. The report notes bat-associated infection risk arising from the incident. The piece also references a separate Canadian rabies case where an 11-year-old contracted rabies after a bat landed on his face, with no bite or skin wound; 19 days later the child experienced tingling and numbness on one side of the face and vomiting. Survival and safety expert Eduard Halilov offered general guidance for bat encounters, recommending moving children to safety if a bat flies into a room.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で、コウモリが入った袋の中身を食べた子供が発病
triage.triage_reason: 単一の散発症例で検査結果待ちであり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大の根拠は現時点でないが、異常な曝露経路であるため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは『中国・Ninde市』と明記されているが、Bluedotの地理座標はチャド共和国Tandjile州のNindéと一致しており、地名の混同・誤記の可能性がある。検査結果や続報が出るまで詳細不明。カナダの狂犬病症例は別事例で参考情報として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Behörde in Afrika will mögliche Ebola-Mutation abklären
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agency in Africa to investigate possible Ebola mutation.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is under investigation by Africa CDC and the World Health Organization for a possible viral mutation. Africa CDC Africa Director General Jean Kaseya says the outbreak’s severity is unprecedented and investigations are underway to determine if a mutation occurred and how to respond. As of August 6, 2026, about 4,000 total cases have been reported, with more than 3,900 laboratory-confirmed. Fatalities are more than six times higher than during the 2014 West Africa outbreak, while case counts are about eight times higher. Authorities are expanding capacity with new laboratories and treatment centers, but Kaseya warns that without stopping transmission at the community level, these measures will have limited impact. The mutation assessment and outbreak trajectory are being coordinated by Africa CDC and WHO.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの機関、エボラウイルスの変異の可能性を調査へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が過去に例のない重症度・致死率を示し、ウイルス変異の可能性がAfrica CDCとWHOにより調査されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではAngolaでの発生に関する具体的言及がないため除外。約4,000症例、致死率は2014年西アフリカ流行の6倍超と報告されており、変異の有無を含め継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: आपका वायरल फीवर कहीं स्वाइन फ्लू तो नहीं? दिल्ली-NCR में बढ़ रहे मामले, समझें मानसून से इसका कनेक्शन - is your viral fever actually swine flu why h1n1 cases are spiking across delhi ncr this monsoon
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is your viral fever actually swine flu? Why are H1N1 cases spiking across Delhi-NCR this monsoon?
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) infections are rising in Delhi-NCR during the monsoon, with more patients presenting with fever, cough, sore throat and body pains. Monsoon conditions—fluctuating temperatures, humidity, and crowded indoor spaces—facilitate transmission, especially among those with weaker immunity. Common symptoms include high fever, persistent cough, sore throat, nasal congestion, body aches, fatigue, and headache; children may experience nausea, vomiting or diarrhea. High-risk groups: children under 5, adults over 65, pregnant women, and people with diabetes, heart disease, asthma, COPD, kidney disease, cancer, or compromised immunity. Seek urgent care for difficulty breathing, chest pain, fever ≥102°F for >3 days, blue lips/fingers, severe drowsiness, or dehydration. Preventive actions: frequent hand hygiene, masks in crowds, cover coughs, maintain distance from the sick, stay home with fever, stay hydrated and rest; early antiviral treatment can reduce complications in high-risk individuals. Dr. Anil Gomber of Yatharth Super Specialty Hospital, Delhi, emphasizes timely diagnosis and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: あなたのウイルス性発熱は実は豚インフルエンザではないか？デリー・NCRでH1N1症例が急増、モンスーンとの関連を理解する
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1（豚インフルエンザ）流行に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大の懸念は見られない。既知の季節性疾患であり、公衆衛生上の重大な脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は医療専門家による季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の症状・予防に関する一般的な健康情報記事であり、突発的なアウトブレイクの報告ではない。モンスーン期における毎年恒例の増加傾向についての注意喚起記事。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola im Kongo: Behörde in Afrika will mögliche Ebola-Mutation abklären
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: Authorities in Africa want to clarify a possible Ebola mutation.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is drawing intensified scrutiny as Africa CDC and WHO review a possible mutation in the Bundibugyo outbreak. Africa CDC Africa Director Jean Kaseya said the outbreak’s severity is unprecedented and that investigations are underway to determine whether a mutation has occurred and how to address it. The outbreak nears 4,000 cases, with more than 3,900 confirmed the previous day, figures eight times higher than the 2014 West Africa outbreak and with deaths more than six times higher. Authorities are expanding capacity, building new laboratories and treatment centers, but Kaseya cautioned that unless transmission is stopped at the community level, these efforts may be insufficient. The emphasis remains on containment, surveillance, rapid laboratory confirmation, and adaptive public health response to this intensified Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱：アフリカの当局がエボラ変異の可能性を調査へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）が2014年西アフリカ流行の8倍の症例数・6倍以上の死者数に達し、変異の可能性も調査中でAfrica CDC/WHOが関与しており、深刻かつ異常な事象としてフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行に焦点を当てており、アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるがサマリー中で言及されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola se acelera en el Congo; OMS advierte que respuesta es insuficiente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola accelerates in the Congo; WHO warns that the response is inadequate.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak is accelerating, with the WHO warning that the response is lagging behind transmission. After nearly three months since the outbreak began, new infections have surged in multiple hotspots, reflecting rapid spread. Latest figures report 1,801 deaths and 3,973 confirmed cases, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak ever documented in the country and the fastest-moving to date. The epidemic is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is currently no licensed vaccine or approved treatment, hindering containment and heightening community risk. In response, the United States announced an additional $242 million to strengthen response efforts, boost preparedness in neighboring countries, and expand humanitarian assistance, bringing Washington's direct support for the emergency to more than $512 million.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが加速；WHOは対応が不十分だと警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が急速に拡大し、致死者1,801人・症例3,973人と過去2番目の規模かつ最速の流行となっており、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認で公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: 米国の資金支援拡大は国際的関心の高さを示すが、発生地域としてUnited Statesは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブギョ株であり管理困難性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: buscas pela doença no Google saltam 910% no Brasil; veja as respostas para as 10 principais dúvidas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Google searches for the disease jump 910% in Brazil; see the answers to the 10 most common questions.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in Brazil prompt intensified vaccination in São Paulo, with cases in São Paulo city, São Bernardo do Campo, and Guarulhos. Measles is highly contagious; in unvaccinated settings, an infected person can generate up to 18 secondary cases. Transmission is airborne, contagious from six days before to four days after rash onset. Brazil’s immunization program uses MMR (triple viral) at 12 and 15 months, and MMRV (tetra viral) adds varicella; vaccination is free for anyone up to 59 years who is unvaccinated. Because of local cases, a dose-zero is advised for infants 6–11 months, and a revaccination campaign for residents 6 months–59 years in the three cities until September 1. Symptoms include fever and a red rash spreading from the face and behind the ears. Vaccination is safe; contraindications include pregnancy, severe immunosuppression, or allergy to neomycin. Travel from Peru, Bolivia, the US, Mexico, and Canada raises import risk.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：ブラジルでの疾患検索がGoogleで910%急増；よくある10の質問への回答
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹アウトブレイクが発生し、ワクチン再接種キャンペーンが実施されるなど社会的関心と行政対応が高まっているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はサンパウロ州（サンパウロ市、サンベルナルド・ド・カンポ、グアルーリョス）での麻疹症例増加とワクチン接種キャンペーンに関するもの。ペルー・ボリビア・米国・メキシコ・カナダは輸入リスクの言及のみで、実際の発生国ではないため対象国リストからは除外。重症度・死亡等の詳細情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : plus de 300 enfants déjà décédés en Ituri, l'Unicef tire la sonnette d'alarme sur l'effondrement du système sanitaire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: more than 300 children have already died in Ituri; UNICEF sounds the alarm over the collapse of the healthcare system.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province is causing severe child mortality and systemic health collapse. As of Aug. 2, 2026, UNICEF reports 330 child deaths and 743 confirmed pediatric Ebola cases (ages 0–17), with children under five disproportionately affected. The broader outbreak spans five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo, totaling 3,973 confirmed cases, 1,801 deaths, and 776 recoveries; 674 patients remain in isolation. The health system collapse has slashed access to primary care by 42%, infant vaccination by 69%, and facility births by 12.6% province-wide, fueling fears of seeking care. UNICEF notes over 2.4 million people reached with prevention and early warning messages and more than 505,000 household visits to rebuild trust. A six-month appeal seeks $113.45 million to bolster 21 health zones, including Mongbwalu, Bunia, Rwampara, and Nizi.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: イトゥリ州で既に300人以上の子どもが死亡、ユニセフが保健システム崩壊への警鐘を鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ流行が5州に拡大し、死者1,801人・確定症例3,973人に達しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-Direktor in Kongo: "Ebola breitet sich schneller aus, als wir reagieren können
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director in Congo: "Ebola is spreading faster than we can respond."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating beyond response capacity, with WHO Director-General Tedros warning it could be out of control. As of August 6, 2026, 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths have been reported; 717 patients are in isolation and 749 have recovered. About 90% of cases are in the eastern Ituri province, bordering Uganda, driven by the Bundibugyo strain—the second-deadliest outbreak and the first with no licensed treatments. The first case appeared mid-May in Ituri, and on May 17 the outbreak was declared a public health emergency of international concern. Contact tracing is breaking down, partly due to overcrowded Congo River transport. Doctors Without Borders reports MSF-run seven treatment centers and 15 isolation wards across Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, and Tshopo (capacity >480 beds); 1,362+ admissions, 554 confirmed, 282 recovered. The United States announced an additional $242 million, aligning with G7 commitments up to $500 million.

triage.headline_ja: WHOディレクター、コンゴにて:「エボラは我々の対応能力を超える速さで拡大している」
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ流行が制御不能に近づいており、致死率が高く国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限の可能性がある重大事案のため。
triage.notes: 既にPHEIC宣言済みで、致死率約45%、治療薬未承認のBundibugyo株による流行。米国・G7が資金支援を表明しており、国際的関心・支援ニーズが極めて高い。ウガンダ国境地域での拡大が懸念されるが、記事本文ではウガンダでの発生は明記されていないため対象国外。

article.articleHeadline: Tedros se reúne con Tshisekedi para reforzar la respuesta al ébola en la RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros meets with Tshisekedi to bolster the Ebola response in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has reached 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths (as of August 4). In Kinshasa, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and President Félix Tshisekedi agreed to urgently broaden and accelerate the response, tailoring actions to the outbreak's speed and trajectory and strengthening government-led coordination with partners. The plan prioritizes community engagement, building trust, and respecting burial customs to halt transmission, while ensuring patients access care and avoiding deaths at home. Frontline health and community workers should receive adequate PPE and pay. Africa CDC and WHO pledged technical and operational support. This is Tedros' second visit since the May 15 declaration. Uganda reported 20 Ebola cases (15 imported from DRC) and 2 deaths, and was declared Ebola-free on July 28.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応強化のためチセケディ大統領と会談
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は確定症例3,973例・死亡1,801例に達し、ウガンダへの越境感染も発生。WHO事務局長が大統領と対応強化を協議するなど国際的関心・対応が高まっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ウガンダは輸入例含む20例・死亡2例を報告後、7月28日にエボラ終息宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Behörde in Afrika will mögliche Ebola-Mutation abklären | Kleine Zeitung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Authorities in Africa will clarify a possible Ebola mutation | Kleine Zeitung
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, Ebola cases are spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompting Africa CDC and the World Health Organization to examine whether the virus has mutated. The focus is on the Bundibugyo strain, with authorities seeking to determine if a genetic change could explain the unusually severe transmission. Jean Kaseya, Director-General of Africa CDC Africa, described this Bundibugyo outbreak as unprecedented in severity and said investigations are being launched to establish whether a mutation occurred. The joint effort reflects concern about potential changes in the virus that could affect outbreak dynamics and control measures.

triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の感染が急速に拡大し、Africa CDCが「前例のない重症度」と述べ変異調査を開始しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響・異常性・国際拡大リスクの複数のIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: Africa CDCとWHOが共同でブンディブギョ株の変異の可能性を調査中。異例の重症度が報告されており、続報でのゲノム解析結果の確認が重要。

article.articleHeadline: With monsoon uptick, Delhi logs 1,349 swine flu, 1,379 dengue cases this year
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, Delhi reports 1,349 confirmed H1N1 (swine flu) cases this year, with no deaths, while dengue cases total 1,379, including about 200 patients from outside Delhi. Health authorities say hospitals are fully prepared to manage both illnesses, with separate wards and dedicated rooms for H1N1 and dengue. Regular testing for H1N1 is ongoing, and cases have risen during the monsoon season, prompting close monitoring of hotspot areas. Officials state all patients are receiving treatment, and many have recovered and been discharged; there have been no mishaps to date. The government has directed government hospitals to ensure adequate treatment facilities and to watch affected areas, advising the public to seek timely care if symptoms appear.

triage.notes: 季節性の感染症増加であり、死亡例なし。政府はホットスポットの監視と病院の準備を指示しているが、国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Monyet Buat Kekacauan di Inhil Riau, Total 18 Warga Jadi Korban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkey Causes Chaos in Indragiri Hilir Regency, Riau; 18 Residents Become Victims.
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, a wild long-tailed macaque has been terrorizing residents of Kota Tembilahan, Indragiri Hilir Regency, Riau, Indonesia, since July 25, 2026. Eighteen people were attacked, with injuries reported; all recipients received medical treatment and were vaccinated to prevent rabies, free of charge. After a broad response by the Inhil Fire and Rescue Department (DPKP) and wildlife authorities, the macaque believed to be responsible was captured in a fruit-bait trap and then transported to Pekanbaru for identification by BBKSDA Riau to confirm its role. Authorities including police, the Indonesian National Armed Forces (TNI), BBKSDA, and community members helped manage the incident. Residents are urged to remain vigilant as the investigation continues; no fatalities were reported in this article.

article.articleHeadline: Na RD Congo, chefe da OMS pede ampliação urgente e massiva da resposta ao ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the WHO chief calls for urgent and massive expansion of the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola is spreading faster than response capacity. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus, visiting Kinshasa, called for urgent and massive expansion of all response pillars to reach every affected community despite insecurity and displacement. He urged strengthened government-led coordination, protection and support for health workers, training, and fair remuneration. In meetings with President Félix Tshisekedi, leadership and community engagement were highlighted as crucial; priorities include faster access to care, surveillance, and safe, dignified burials. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant; incubation is 2–21 days, with transmission typically after symptoms begin. Early symptoms include fever, fatigue, sore throat, and body pains, progressing to gastrointestinal issues, organ failure, and sometimes bleeding. There are no approved vaccines or specific treatments for Bundibugyo, so control hinges on rapid isolation, contact tracing, safe burials, and community cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:WHO事務局長がエボラ対応の緊急かつ大規模な拡大を要請

triage.notes: ワクチンや特異的治療薬が承認されていないブンディブギョ株による流行で、治安不安・住民避難が対応を困難にしている。WHOトップが直接現地入りし対応拡大を要請するなど、国際的関心と支援必要性が極めて高い事例。

article.articleHeadline: Би Би Си: Плавателен съд в ДР Конго е поставен под карантина след пет смъртни случая сред пътниците и опасения за ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BBC: A vessel in DR Congo has been placed under quarantine after five deaths among the passengers and concerns about Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo is contending with its 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Authorities quarantined the vessel Yingfeng-2 near Bendé Bendé port, about 65 km upstream of Kinshasa, after five passenger deaths raised Ebola concerns. A mobile lab was deployed and all 255 passengers were tested for Ebola and cholera as a precaution following the death of a traveler with fever and diarrhea who had disembarked at a prior stop. On board, two more adults, a three-year-old, and a newborn died. No positive results have been reported yet, with officials citing the 21‑day incubation period. The ship had travelled over 1,700 km downstream from Kisangani to Kinshasa. The outbreak—declared May 15—exists with 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths, the second-deadliest in the country’s history; there is no specific treatment or approved vaccine yet, though early vaccine trials have begun in the UK.

triage.headline_ja: BBC:コンゴ民主共和国で5人の乗客死亡後、エボラ出血熱への懸念から船舶が検疫措置下に置かれる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラアウトブレイク（確定症例3,973人、死亡1,801人、史上2番目の致死的規模）に関連し、船舶隔離という新たな懸念事象が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 船舶検疫事例自体はエボラ陽性未確定（21日間の潜伏期間観察中）だが、既存の大規模アウトブレイク（3,973症例・1,801死亡）の一環として重大な関心事項。UKは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: KDC'de Ebola: Vaka Sayısı 3973, Ölü Sayısı 1801
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Case count 3,973, Death toll 1,801.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths, a case fatality rate of 45.3%, with 75.3% of contacts traced. The outbreak has spread across five provinces—Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo—covering 51 districts. In the past 24 hours, no new regions reported cases, while 87.1% of infections have occurred in Ituri, the outbreak’s epicenter. The DRC Health Ministry notes the outbreak began May 15 in a village near the Ebola River; Ituri had 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths prior to declaration. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant has no approved treatment or vaccine.

article.articleHeadline: La population de Butembo sensibilisée à la prise de conscience face à Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butembo's population sensitized to Ebola awareness - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola has reached Butembo in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, after beginning in Ituri. On 06 August 2026, Muhindo Nzangi, the Minister of State for Agriculture and Food Security, led a population sensitization on Ebola awareness, urging strict adherence to barrier measures and directing any suspected cases to health facilities for proper management. He warned that several cases are now present and cautioned against rumour-driven delays, stating the disease is dangerous and could trigger embargo and isolation. The outreach emphasizes not ignoring illness and avoiding rumors. The briefing follows a recent incident in Bulengera where youths handled a deceased Ebola patient’s body; contact cases remain untraceable, keeping response teams concerned about ongoing outbreaks and vigilance.

triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州ブテンボにエボラが到達し、複数の症例が確認され、接触者追跡不能な事例も発生しているため、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: イツリ州で始まったエボラが北キブ州ブテンボまで拡大。ブレンゲラでは遺体を扱った若者の接触者が追跡不能となっており、感染拡大の懸念が継続。ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文では言及されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: African health agency, WHO want probe into possible Ebola mutation
article.articleSummary: Africa CDC and WHO will jointly probe a possible mutation of the Ebola virus amid the rapid spread of the Bundibugyo variant in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of 2026-08-06, authorities estimate about 4,000 cases, with more than 3,900 confirmed the previous day, and a death toll more than six times higher than during the 2014 West Africa outbreak, while case numbers are more than eight times higher for the same period. This is the largest Bundibugyo outbreak the Congo has seen to date; there is still no approved vaccine, though a newly developed vaccine is in trials. Ebola transmits through contact with bodily fluids. Background context: the 2014-2015 West Africa outbreak killed over 11,000, and the 2018-2020 eastern Congo outbreak caused about 2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ疾病対策センターとWHO、エボラウイルスの変異の可能性について調査を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ・ブンディブギョ株の過去最大規模の流行が発生し、致死率・症例数が過去の流行を大幅に上回っており、ウイルス変異の可能性についてWHOとAfrica CDCが合同調査を行うなど、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念と国際的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRCのみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。ウイルス変異の可能性、承認ワクチン未整備、過去最大規模の流行という点で緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: buscas pela doença no Google saltam 910% no Brasil; veja respostas para as dúvidas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Google searches for the disease rise by 910% in Brazil; see answers to common questions.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Brazil has driven a 910% surge in Google searches over the past week, with Brazil leading global interest ahead of Guatemala, Yemen, El Salvador and Honduras. In São Paulo, 16 confirmed cases have prompted revaccination efforts and a 'dose zero' for infants 6–11 months old. Authorities in São Paulo, São Bernardo do Campo and Guarulhos have declared unconditional revaccination through Sept 1 for residents aged 6 months to 59 years, regardless of prior immunization. Brazil’s immunization program uses the MMR (triple viral) vaccine in two doses (first at 12 months, second at 15 months); the tetra-viral vaccine also protects against varicella and is used for subsequent doses. All individuals 12 months to 59 years are advised to be vaccinated. Measles is highly contagious, transmitted via airborne spread; in non‑vaccinated settings an infected person can generate up to 18 secondary cases. Dose zero is not a substitute for routine doses.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：ブラジルでのGoogle検索が910%急増、よくある質問への回答
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹16例確認され、複数自治体が無条件再接種キャンペーンを実施。排除認定国での再興という異常性があり、社会的関心（検索急増）と行政の積極対応が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事はGoogle検索動向を主軸としているが、実際の麻疹症例（サンパウロ16例）とワクチン接種義務化の行政対応が確認できる。他国（グアテマラ、イエメン、エルサルバドル、ホンジュラス）は検索関心の比較対象であり、感染発生国としての言及ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak spreading faster than efforts to fight it: WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the largest on record, with 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths as of July 30, concentrated in DRC. Bundibugyo strain cases have doubled in hotspot areas over the past week. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the outbreak is spreading faster than the response scale-up and urged rapid action across pillars, stronger cooperation, health-worker protections, and expanded access to care. Armed conflict and mistrust hinder efforts; Ghebreyesus urged ceasefires to allow life-saving care. Africa CDC Director Dr. Jean Kaseya argued funding is not the issue, noting over $1.4 million in international support but stressing listening to communities. In Ituri province, village-centered responses, free healthcare, and September school reopenings are under way, with tighter cross-border coordination. The State Department will provide an additional $242 million; total humanitarian funding cited at $350 million, with renewed 30-day travel ban for affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、対応の取り組みより速いペースで拡大：WHO
triage.triage_reason: 史上最大規模のエボラ流行がDRCで拡大しており、死者1,587人、対応能力を上回るペースで感染拡大、渡航制限も発動されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 米国務省が追加2.42億ドルの支援を表明、人道支援総額3.5億ドル、影響国への30日間の渡航禁止が更新されるなど、国際的な関心・対応が非常に高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола в Конго: медики вийшли на протести через невиплату зарплат- Новини bigmir)net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: Medical workers took to the streets to protest over unpaid salaries - News bigmir.net
article.articleSummary: Medical workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo protested unpaid salaries amid one of the largest Ebola outbreaks in history. In Bunia, capital of Ituri Province, dozens of frontline staff gathered outside the governor’s office, saying pay has been withheld since mid-May when the outbreak was officially declared. They warned that lack of pay could hinder the response to the dangerous virus. Government data as of 6 August 2026 show nearly 4,000 Ebola cases nationwide with about 1,801 deaths; hundreds remain in isolation, most in Ituri. The outbreak ranks second only to West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic, complicated by ongoing conflict and inaccessibility of remote areas that seed transmission. Earlier in the outbreak, a first patient recovered.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱：医療従事者が未払い賃金を巡り抗議デモ
triage.triage_reason: 史上2番目の規模とされるDRCのエボラ流行（約4000症例、1801死亡）が継続中で、医療従事者の賃金未払いによる対応能力低下のリスクが顕在化しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC（特にIturi州Bunia）のみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。既存の大規模流行に対する医療体制の脆弱性（賃金未払いによるストライキ）が新たな懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : près de 4 000 cas confirmés, l'Ituri demeure l'épicentre de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: nearly 4,000 confirmed cases, Ituri remains the epicenter of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains centered in Ituri, with 3,973 confirmed cases across 51 health zones in five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. As of August 4, 2026 (report published August 5), 1,801 deaths (case fatality 45.3%) and 776 recoveries have been recorded; 674 patients are in isolation or hospitalized. Ituri accounts for 87.1% of cumulative cases. In the last 24 hours, 876 alerts were investigated and 27 new recoveries; Haut-Uele reported its first recovery. The contact follow-up rate is 75.3%. A 120-bed Ebola Treatment Center was opened in Rwankole, Ituri; upgrades continue at Musienene, Beni, and Isiro. Community outreach includes over 12,000 educated, 36 radios, 16 rumors clarified, and 96.6% of travelers screened. No new health zones were affected in the past 24 hours.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：確定症例約4,000件、イトゥリ州が依然として流行の震源地
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例3,973件、死亡1,801件（致死率45.3%）に達する大規模エボラ流行が5州51保健地区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率45.3%と非常に高く、複数州にまたがる大規模流行が継続中。既存の対応中エボラ流行として継続監視・評価が必要。
