article.articleHeadline: Властите в Конго поставиха под карантина кораб с 255 души заради съмнения за ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Authorities in Congo placed a ship carrying 255 people under quarantine due to suspected Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 6 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo quarantined the passenger ship Yingfeng 2 (255 aboard) after several deaths with Ebola- and cholera-like symptoms. All crew and passengers are undergoing medical exams and lab tests, with a mobile lab deployed. The vessel, operated by a Chinese company, was halted on the Congo River near Bende-Bende, about 65 km northeast of Kinshasa, after a passenger who had disembarked earlier with high fever and severe diarrhea died in hospital; two more adults, a three-year-old, and a newborn also died. The ship had traveled roughly 1,700 km downstream from Kisangani, where new Ebola cases were reported. DR Congo is in its 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with no approved treatment or licensed vaccine; UK is conducting early trials of an experimental vaccine. Kinshasa is tightening entry controls; over 17,000 people are under medical observation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ当局、エボラ疑いで255人乗船の船を検疫隔離
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ第17波流行に加え、船上での複数死亡・検疫措置・17,000人規模の観察対象という重大な公衆衛生事象であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 船はKisangani発でKinshasa方面へ約1700km移動しており、既存のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）第17波流行と関連。UKでのワクチン治験は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めず。コレラ様症状も報告されており、確定診断結果の続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 18 Organisasi Profesi Kolaborasi Tangani TB di Sleman
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eighteen professional organizations collaborate to tackle TB in Sleman.
article.articleSummary: In Sleman, Indonesia, 18 professional organizations have formed KOPI TB Sleman to accelerate tuberculosis control, targeting TB elimination by 2030. The inauguration, attended by Regent Harda Kiswaya at Ramada by Wyndham Sleman, introduces a pentahelix coalition—government, society, professional associations, academia, and media—to speed case finding, treatment, and patient support. The Sleman Health Office (Dinkes) will coordinate intensified detection and integrated care across agencies; social services will provide livelihood support for patients who must pause work, and nutrition assistance (PMT) will be supplied. RTLH housing improvements aim to create healthier living environments. TB stigma reduction and patient reintegration are emphasized, with the message that TB is curable and transmission must be prevented while the program aligns with national elimination goals for 2030.

triage.headline_ja: 18の専門団体が連携し、スレマンで結核対策に取り組む
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムに関する行政的取り組みの発表であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 結核撲滅に向けた地域連携イニシアチブの発足を報じる内容であり、突発的な感染症イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Empresas devem facilitar vacinação de trabalhadores contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Companies must facilitate vaccination of workers against measles.
article.articleSummary: 16 measles cases confirmed in São Paulo state trigger alarm from the National Association of Occupational Medicine (ANAMT). The association urges employers to facilitate workers’ vaccination and to run science-based educational campaigns to prevent workplace transmission and protect communities. Measles is highly contagious; though Brazil eliminated endemic circulation in 2024, imported cases and isolated clusters have yielded 19 confirmations in Brazil this year. Workers should verify vaccination status and seek a health post if unsure or lacking proof. Occupational health physicians should verify immunization during routine, onboarding and demobilization exams, with emphasis on healthcare workers. The measles vaccine—the live trivalent MMR—is free at Basic Health Units. Schedule: first dose at 12 months; second dose (tetra viral) at 15 months. Doses: 1–29 years two; 30–59 years at least one; health professionals two. Contraindications: pregnancy, infants under 6 months, severe immunosuppression, or history of severe allergic reactions.

triage.headline_ja: 企業は労働者の麻疹ワクチン接種を促進すべき
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹16例（国内累計19例）が確認され、労城環境における感染拡大への懸念が職業医学会から表明されているが、規模は限定的で公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や渡航制限等の要件は満たしていない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは2024年に麻疹の風土病的流行を排除済みだが、輸入例による散発的クラスターが継続している。今回の記事は職業医学会による予防啓発・ワクチン接種呼びかけが主旨であり、緊急性の高いアウトブレイクの兆候は明記されていない。続報で症例数の増加や地理的拡大の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: quais são os sintomas e quem deve tomar a vacina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: What Are the Symptoms and Who Should Receive the Vaccine
article.articleSummary: Sixteen measles cases in São Paulo state, Brazil, prompt alerts as authorities monitor an ongoing outbreak. Measles is highly contagious and can cause pneumonia, otitis, and encephalitis; risk is highest for young children, pregnant women, and immunocompromised individuals. Transmission is airborne, with surges in areas of low vaccination coverage. The measles vaccine, the MMR (measles, mumps, rubella), is provided by the SUS and is part of National Vaccination Schedule. In São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, people aged 6 months to 59 years should receive a vaccine dose regardless of prior status. Schedule: children first dose at 12 months and second at 15 months, preferably with tetraviral including varicella. Ages 5–29: two MMR doses 30+ days apart; ages 30–59: at least one dose; healthcare workers: two doses. Dose zero exists for 6–11 months in high-risk settings. If suspected, seek care, avoid contact, and report exposure and vaccination history.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：症状とワクチン接種対象者について
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹16例の発生が報告されているが、記事は主にワクチン接種啓発を目的とした内容であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響や国際的拡大の兆候は明記されていない。感染力の強さとワクチン未接種者への継続的曝露リスクから経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン接種の呼びかけを主目的とした啓発記事で、症例数（16例）は限定的。重症度・国際的拡大に関する具体的情報は不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Diarrhoea outbreak hits Mayurbhanj girls' hostel, over 19 students hospitalised
article.articleSummary: Diarrhoea outbreak at SSD Girls' High School hostel in Badasimulia, Mayurbhanj district, Odisha. About 275 students live in the hostel. After dinner of fish and rice last night, several students experienced stomach pain; by this morning, vomiting and diarrhoea were reported, with some cases serious. More than 19 inmates are hospitalised at Kaptipada hospital. A medical team from Kaptipada has reached the school to examine all residents. Authorities have not yet determined the outbreak's cause; an investigation is underway to establish whether food irregularities or other factors triggered the illness. No laboratory confirmation is reported in the article. The situation is ongoing as of 2026-08-06.

triage.headline_ja: オリッサ州マユルバンジの女子寮で下痢の集団発生、19人以上が入院
triage.triage_reason: 学校寮での下痢集団発生で食中毒の可能性が高く、現時点では国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは考えにくいが、原因未特定のため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 食事（魚と米）摂取後の発症であり食中毒の可能性が高いが、原因は調査中でラボ確認の報告なし。局地的な学校寮での事案で人-人感染の可能性は低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Preocupa la situación con el ébola en la RD Congo: más de 1.800 muertos con un "nivel elevado de circulación del virus"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola situation in DR Congo is worrying: more than 1,800 dead with a high level of virus circulation.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is escalating with 1,801 deaths and 3,973 confirmed cases, a case fatality rate of 45.3%. The current outbreak, the seventeenth to affect the DRC, ranks as the second-highest in total infections and the largest on record within the country, surpassing the 2018–2020 East Congo outbreak (2,299 deaths, 3,481 cases). While no new geographic spread has been recorded, transmission remains at unprecedented levels. The World Health Organization and the DRC government are adapting the response to the outbreak’s speed and trajectory, strengthening coordination under government leadership, and urging shared action by partners. Emphasis is on preventing deaths at home, protecting frontline health and community workers with adequate PPE and compensation, and reinforcing safe and dignified burials to reach affected communities. The worst Ebola outbreak occurred in West Africa (2014–2016) with ~11,000 deaths and 28,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の状況が懸念される：死者1,800人超、ウイルスの循環レベルは依然高水準
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が進行中で、死者1,801人・症例3,973件・致死率45.3%と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、WHOと政府が対応を強化していることから、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRCのみが主題として扱われているため除外した。地理的拡大は現時点で報告されていないが、感染レベルは過去最高水準で推移しており継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Конго: више од 1.800 смртних случајева од еболе од почетка епидемије
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: more than 1,800 deaths from Ebola since the start of the epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has escalated to 3,973 cases, including 1,801 deaths, with a reported case-fatality rate of 43.9%. The epidemic began in late April 2026, and nearly 90% of cases are in Ituri province in the northeast, near the borders with Uganda and South Sudan. Government sources, citing the World Health Organization, provide these figures as of August 6, 2026. Context notes that during the 2014–2016 Ebola outbreak in DRC, about 28,000 people were infected and more than 11,000 died. The article does not detail clinical symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection source, or explicit imported/exported case information beyond the provincial concentration of cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ流行開始以来、死者1,800人以上
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が3,973症例・死者1,801人（致死率43.9%）に拡大しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつウガンダ・南スーダン国境地帯に近いため国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ・南スーダン国境付近での症例集中に言及しているが、両国での発生自体は報告されていないため verified_locations には含めていない。過去(2014-2016年)の大規模流行との比較が言及されており、既に高い致死率と症例数から重大なアウトブレイクと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: У Конго Ебола забрала вже понад 1800 життів: медики протестують через невиплату зарплат
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has already claimed over 1,800 lives in Congo: doctors protest over unpaid salaries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has killed over 1,800 people. As of August 5, 2026, DR Congo reported 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths, with Bunia in Ituri Province accounting for nearly 90% of cases. About 674 patients are in isolation. While health authorities trace at least 75% of contacts, 60–70% of new infections occur among people not on contact lists, complicating containment. The outbreak’s epicenter is in Bunia, amid regional conflict and mining-driven displacement that hinder access to remote areas. Frontline medics have protested unpaid salaries and allowances since mid-May, threatening response capacity; WHO and MSF warn that transmission is accelerating. Notably, Bundibugyo ebolavirus has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, marking a particularly severe transmission scenario. WHO Director-General Tedros urged government support for health workers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラによる死者が1800人超に：医療従事者が給与未払いに抗議
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）による大規模流行が継続し、死者1800人超・症例3973件と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、ワクチン未承認かつ医療体制の崩壊リスクも高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認ワクチン・特異的治療法がなく、紛争地域における接触者追跡の困難さや医療従事者の給与未払いによる対応能力低下が懸念材料。WHO・MSFも感染拡大の加速を警告している。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática del Congo supera barrera de los mil 800 muertos por ébola; casos se aproximan a los 4 mil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses the 1,800-death toll from Ebola; cases near 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Data collected through August 4 show 1,801 Ebola deaths and 3,973 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with a case fatality rate of 45.3%. About 674 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, 776 have recovered, and contact tracing stands at 75.3%. Five eastern to central provinces are affected: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. The outbreak has not geographically expanded in the prior 24 hours, but transmission remains sustained with a high level of virus circulation. The Bundibugyo strain has caused this outbreak; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment, CFR 30-50%. This is the largest outbreak in the DRC and the second-highest in infections globally, surpassing 2018-2020. Uganda declared Ebola-free on July 28 after 20 cases, 15 imported from DRC, with two deaths. Healthcare workers protested payment delays at the epicenter, warning of ongoing spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者数1,800人の壁を突破、感染者数は4,000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続し、死者1,801人・感染者3,973人と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、ウガンダへの越境例も確認されるなど国際的拡大リスクが認められるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既にエボラフリー宣言済み（7月28日）であり、現時点で活動的な感染発生地はDRCのみ。ワクチン・特異的治療法が未確立で、致死率30-50%と高く、医療従事者の給与未払いによる抗議活動が対応の持続可能性に懸念を投げかけている。

article.articleHeadline: Outbreak News Roundup: Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths as of August 4, across 51 health zones in five provinces. The outbreak, ongoing since May 2026 and centered in Ituri, is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccine or treatment is approved—the largest Ebola epidemic recorded in the DRC. Mpox in Madagascar: through the first seven months of 2026, 4,798 notified cases (3,146 laboratory-confirmed) and 22 deaths since mid-December 2025; vaccination prioritized for close contacts, frontline health workers, and high-risk groups, including sex workers in dense urban and port areas; Clade 1b identified in sequences. Somalia diphtheria: 273 suspected cases and 10 deaths in the last two weeks of July; year-to-date 2,934 suspected cases and 86 deaths across all six states. Chikungunya in Mauritius: 107 new confirmed cases in the last two weeks of July; total since January 6,782 confirmed cases with no deaths—Mauritius Island 6,686 and Rodrigues Island 96.

triage.headline_ja: アウトブレイクニュースまとめ：アフリカ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは同国史上最大規模（確定症例3,973例、死亡1,801例）であり、承認されたワクチン・治療法がない点で深刻かつ異常であり、国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限のリスクも高い。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカ複数国（DRCのエボラ、マダガスカルのMpox、ソマリアのジフテリア、モーリシャスのチクングニア熱）のまとめ記事だが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。DRCのエボラ流行は同国史上最大規模で承認ワクチン・治療法がなく、極めて深刻なシグナルと判断。他国の情報（マダガスカル・ソマリア・モーリシャス）は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: SADC battles cash crunch as DRC conflict, Ebola test region's resilience
article.articleSummary: Financial pressure and waning donor support shadow SADC as conflict in the Democratic Republic of Congo and public health emergencies strain the bloc. On 6 August 2026, South Africa formally assumed the chair of the Standing Committee of Senior Officials ahead of the 46th Ordinary SADC Summit in Durban. Chairperson Ambassador Tebogo Seokolo warned of a complex regional landscape marked by geopolitical instability, economic volatility, climate shocks, and security threats, with ongoing instability in eastern DRC and a recent Ebola outbreak testing regional resilience. He stressed peace and security as top preoccupations. He urged accelerated industrialisation and greater investment in infrastructure, trade, food and nutrition security, energy, climate resilience, healthcare, gender equality and youth empowerment. Finance remains under serious pressure as donor funding declines. Delegates will review implementation of prior decisions, sustainable financing, reforms, and measures to boost SADC effectiveness.

triage.headline_ja: SADCはDRCの紛争とエボラ流行が地域の耐久力を試す中、資金難と闘う
triage.triage_reason: 記事はDRCにおける『最近のエボラ流行』が地域の安定性を脅かしていると明言しており、Ebolaは本質的に重篤・異常な公衆衛生事象であるためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はSADC首脳会議に関する政治・財政的文脈が主題であり、エボラ流行そのものの詳細（症例数、地域、致死率等）は記載がないため、続報での具体的疫学情報の確認が必要。南アフリカ（ダーバン）は会議開催地であり、疾病発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola na ƙara yaɗuwa ma'aiktan lafiya sun shiga yajin aiki a Congo - Aminiya
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, Ebola cases are increasing rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with WHO reporting that new infections outpace the capacity to respond. Hospital workers have gone on strike due to unpaid salaries, further undermining patient care and outbreak containment. The World Health Organization warns that without urgent action, the Ebola outbreak could continue to spread, exacerbating strain on the country’s health system. The agency urges authorities and partners to reinforce the health system, resolve the salary-driven industrial action, and intensify efforts to halt transmission. Key needs include restoring remuneration, maintaining essential services, and scaling up surveillance and response activities to address ongoing transmission in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染拡大、医療従事者がストライキ突入
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の急速な感染拡大に加え、医療従事者のストライキにより対応能力が著しく低下しており、WHOが緊急対応を呼びかけている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: WHOが公式に感染拡大と対応能力不足を警告しており、医療スト解消と国際支援が急務とされている。フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Behörden wollen mögliche Ebola-Mutation in Afrika abklären
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Authorities want to investigate a potential Ebola mutation in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo triggers a joint investigation by Africa CDC and the WHO into a possible viral mutation. In a weekly briefing, Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya described the outbreak as unprecedented in severity and said investigations are underway to determine whether a mutation occurred and how to respond. Official counts exceed 4,000 cases, with more than 3,900 confirmed; fatalities are more than six times higher than during West Africa’s 2014 Ebola outbreak. While new laboratories and treatment centers are being built, health officials warn the outbreak is outpacing response capacity and stopping transmission at the community level remains essential. The article highlights the urgency of confirming mutation status and expanding public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでのエボラ変異の可能性を当局が調査へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブジョ・エボラ流行が前例のない重症度とされ、ウイルス変異の可能性についてWHOとAfrica CDCが共同調査を実施しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ・アンゴラが含まれるが、記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（ブンディブジョ）のみが実際の発生地として言及されている。致死率が2014年西アフリカ流行の6倍超との報告があり、ウイルス変異の有無が調査中。

article.articleHeadline: 伤口结痂不代表痊愈，女子被自家猫抓伤，十余天后确诊坏死性筋膜炎险截肢__新快网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A scab on a wound doesn't mean it's healed; a woman scratched by her own cat was diagnosed with necrotizing fasciitis more than ten days later, nearly leading to amputation
article.articleSummary: Necrotizing fasciitis following a cat scratch in Xi’an, Shaanxi Province, China. A woman (pseudonym Zhao) sustained deep scratches on the foot and ankle from her pet cat. After initial wound cleaning, suturing, routine dressing, and rabies vaccination, she did not pursue follow-up; about ten days later she developed rapid swelling, warmth, and severe pain, diagnosed with necrotizing fasciitis of the left lower leg and left Achilles tendon injury. Necrotizing fasciitis can rapidly erode deep fascia and soft tissue, risking sepsis and limb loss if treatment is delayed. To save the limb, the plastic surgery and burn reconstruction team performed staged surgeries under general anesthesia: first debridement with drainage and negative-pressure wound therapy, followed by a second-stage Achilles tendon repair, plus antibiotics and wound irrigation. After nearly a month, infection was controlled and discharge occurred; she is in rehabilitation. Clinicians urge timely management of animal bite/scratch wounds and strict follow-up to prevent fatal outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 傷跡のかさぶたは治癒を意味しない――自宅の猫に引っかかれた女性、10日余り後に壊死性筋膜炎と診断され、切断寸前に
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の個人的な医療事例であり、公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 個別の猫による引っかき傷から二次感染で壊死性筋膜炎を発症した単一症例報告。感染症のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生イベントには該当しない。狂犬病ワクチン接種歴があるが、狂犬病そのものの発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RD Congo: un cas suspect identifié sur un bateau en direction de Kinshasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: a suspected case identified on a boat bound for Kinshasa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola persists in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), spreading across five eastern and northeastern provinces—Ituri (about 90% of cases), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo—with Kinshasa still spared. On 6 August, a suspected Ebola case was reported aboard a boat from Tshopo to Kinshasa; a death of a suspected case occurred in Mongala. A mobile laboratory was deployed to test passengers, and the boat was isolated on the river about 65 km from Kinshasa. The government reports 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths since mid-May, all in the eastern regions. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is currently no vaccine or treatment. Health workers in Ituri protested unpaid wages since the outbreak began. WHO Director-General Tedros urged intensified support for responders, while MSF warned that transmission remains alarmingly rapid, with many new cases not linked to tracked contacts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：キンシャサ行きの船内で疑い症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模エボラ流行（確定3,973例、死亡1,801例）が継続中、ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株が原因で、首都キンシャサへの拡大懸念（船内疑い症例）が生じており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率約45%と高く、感染源不明な新規症例が多いとMSFが警告。医療従事者の賃金未払いによる対応能力低下も懸念材料。首都キンシャサへの拡大リスクがあり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: "Der Schweregrad dieses Ausbruchs ist beispiellos" - Behörde will mögliche Virus-Mutation abklären
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: "The severity of this outbreak is unprecedented" - Authorities to assess possible virus mutation.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is approaching 4,000 cases, with more than 3,900 confirmed the day prior, and deaths more than six times those recorded during the 2014 West Africa outbreak. Authorities warn the outbreak is unprecedented in scale, and containment hinges on stopping transmission at the community level despite expanding laboratories and treatment centers. After a meeting with President Félix Tshisekedi, Health official Kaseya announced a shift to village-specific responses, mobilizing about $420 million. Healthcare workers in Ituri Province briefly walked off the job to demand unpaid salaries and bonuses outside Bunia, the provincial capital. Ituri accounts for roughly 90% of all confirmed cases, with protests having occurred in July as well.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：「この流行の深刻度は前例がない」―当局はウイルス変異の可能性を調査へ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、DRCで前例のない規模のエボラ流行が進行中であるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及なし（隣接国として地理的関連の可能性はあるが検証不能）。DRCイトゥリ州が症例の約90%を占め、医療従事者の未払い給与によるストライキも発生し対応能力に懸念あり。ウイルス変異の可能性も調査中で警戒レベルが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Health workers in Ebola outbreak protest over lack of payment
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province with Bunia the provincial capital, remains the fastest-growing, with 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths. It is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record after 2014–2016 West Africa. Ituri accounts for nearly 90% of cases. Frontline health workers protested in Bunia over unpaid wages and bonuses since mid-May, with several facilities abandoned. Officials cite logistical issues for payment delays. About 674 patients are in isolation; 75% of contacts are traced, but 60–70% of new cases originate from outside known contacts, often in remote areas where rebel conflict and mining-related movements hinder access. WHO chief Tedros urged authorities to prioritize care for responders; Doctors Without Borders warns the outbreak is spreading at an alarming rate and the response is not reaching communities quickly enough.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行下、医療従事者が未払い賃金に抗議
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目の規模のエボラアウトブレイクが継続しており、感染拡大・医療対応の機能不全・国際機関の懸念表明が確認されるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域として記載されているが、記事本文で主題として扱われていないため除外。DRC・イトゥリ州が主要な発生地域であり、致死率・感染拡大速度・接触追跡の失敗率（60-70%が既知接触者外）から国際的拡大リスクが高い。WHO・MSFが強い懸念を表明しており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Akui Penyebaran Ebola di Kongo Lebih Cepat dari Respons Wabah, Terhambat Nakes Mogok Kerja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO acknowledges Ebola spread in Kongo is faster than the outbreak response, hampered by healthcare workers' strike.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Kongo progresses with 3,875 laboratory-confirmed cases and at least 1,751 deaths as of 6 August 2026, according to the Kongo Health Ministry. The outbreak, declared on 15 May 2026, is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rarer strain for which there is currently no vaccine or treatment. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Kinshasa to press for a massive, multilevel response; he noted transmission is outpacing control efforts in the hardest-hit regions, with new cases in the third month since declaration doubling in those areas. Conflict, community distrust, and a healthcare worker strike over pay further hamper containment. The Ituri Province, including Bunia, is an epicenter; strikes there block access to care. Families report fatal delays in treatment due to workforce shortages. Anicet Baluku urged government action to prevent further tragedies.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ感染拡大が対応より速いことを認める、医療従事者のストライキが障害に
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・治療法なし）が急拡大しており、死者1,751人・症例3,875人と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、WHO事務局長も対応の遅れを認めているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株による流行で、医療従事者ストライキや紛争、コミュニティの不信感が対応を阻害。WHO事務局長が直接介入するなど国際的関心が非常に高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Здравните власти в Конго блокираха кораб с над 250 пътници след смъртни случаи и съмнения за ебола и холера
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health authorities in Congo blocked a ship carrying more than 250 passengers after deaths and suspicions of Ebola and cholera.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo authorities blocked the Yingfeng 2, a Chinese-operated passenger vessel, on the Congo River near Bende Bende port, about 65 km upstream from Kinshasa, to test all 255 aboard for Ebola and cholera as a precaution after a passenger with fever and diarrhea who had disembarked earlier died in hospital. Four additional fatalities followed—two adults, a three-year-old child, and a newborn—bringing the total deaths linked to the incident to five. Health Ministry teams and WHO mounted a mobile laboratory aboard the ship to conduct tests. No positive results had been reported so far, and officials cautioned that the 21-day incubation period may delay definitive conclusions. The vessel had departed Kisangani, DR Congo’s third-largest city, about two weeks ago.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ保健当局、死者発生とエボラ・コレラ疑いを受け250人超が乗船する船をブロック
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ河の客船で5名が死亡し、エボラ・コレラ双方の疑いでWHOが移動検査室を展開、船が隔離されるなど公衆衛生上重大かつ異常な事態であり、渡航制限も発生しているためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ・コレラともに検査結果は未確定（陰性/陽性不明）。21日間の潜伏期間があるため、続報での検査結果確認が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Tchad | Une épidémie de choléra fait 13 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chad | A cholera outbreak has killed 13 people.
article.articleSummary: Chad's cholera outbreak, affecting Hadjer-Lamis in the north and the capital N'Djaména, has killed 13 people and sickened 239 cases as of August 3, according to the health ministry. The outbreak was officially declared July 24, after first deaths were reported June 13. A vaccination campaign is under way, with 50,799 people vaccinated to date. Chad, a landlocked Central African nation of about 21 million people, continues to face limited access to safe drinking water and sanitation, a key challenge in curbing cholera. The article notes that several African countries are experiencing cholera outbreaks in recent months, including the Central African Republic, Nigeria, and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Cholera is an acute diarrheal infection caused by ingesting water or food contaminated with Vibrio cholerae; it is treatable with rehydration and, for severe cases, antibiotics, but can be fatal within hours without treatment.

triage.headline_ja: チャド | コレラ流行で13人死亡
triage.triage_reason: コレラ流行の主体はチャドであり、対象国リストに含まれない。DRCやナイジェリア等は「近年アウトブレイクを経験している国」として言及されているのみで、記事の主題ではないため対象外。
triage.notes: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国、対象国ID:203312）は記事中で『近年コレラ流行を経験しているアフリカ諸国』の一つとして名前が挙がっているのみで、具体的な発生状況の記述はなく、記事の主題はチャドの流行である。したがってverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo monitors nearly 200 boat passengers after a traveler dies with Ebola-like symptoms
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, declared in mid-May as the fastest-spreading on record, has reached about 4,000 confirmed cases and more than 1,800 deaths, according to Africa CDC Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya. A passenger who died with Ebola-like symptoms disembarked near Kinshasa after traveling from Pimu in Mongala province, more than 1,000 kilometers away; Kinshasa currently has no confirmed cases. A nearly 3-week Congo River voyage carried about 200 passengers who were tested for Ebola and quarantined while awaiting results. Ebola is transmitted via bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces. Ituri province remains the epicenter, accounting for roughly 90% of Congo’s cases; 674 patients are in isolation. Officials say 60–70% of new cases arise outside monitored contacts, and transmission is accelerating. Health workers protested for wages, disrupting care; WHO Director-General Tedros urged increased support for responders. The outbreak’s scale is compared to the 2014-2016 West Africa surge.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ様症状で死亡した旅行者の後、船の乗客約200人を監視
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速の拡大とされるDRCのエボラ流行が約4000例・1800人超の死者に達し、感染拡大が加速しているため、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念がありフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事サマリーでは言及なし、除外。イトゥリ州が流行の中心地（全体の約90%）、キンシャサでは確認例なし（監視中の旅行者のみ）。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू ने ली 3 साल की बच्ची की जान, 3 दिन पहले बड़ी बहन की भी हुई थी मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu claimed the life of a 3-year-old girl; three days earlier, her elder sister had also died.
article.articleSummary: A 3-year 11-month-old girl from Sonipat, Delhi-NCR, died from H1N1 influenza (swine flu) after confirmed Influenza A/H1N1 infection. The child, admitted to BLK Max Hospital on 3 August in severe condition, had brain MRI findings consistent with acute necrotizing encephalopathy (ANE), a rare, potentially fatal neurological complication linked to H1N1. Microbiological testing on 4 August confirmed H1N1 and Influenza A. Despite multidisciplinary, aggressive care, she died on 5 August at 5:10 am. The family reports an elder sister died three days earlier with similar symptoms; hospital has not officially confirmed swine flu in that case, though suspected. Delhi health authorities were alerted per protocol. Experts warn swine flu in children can present with fever, runny nose or congestion, cough, headache, fatigue, abdominal pain, and vomiting, with severe cases leading to pneumonia or CNS involvement. Delhi recorded 2025: 229 cases; 2024: 3151; 2019: 3627 cases and 31 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: スワインフルー（豚インフルエンザ）が3歳の女児の命を奪う、3日前には姉も死亡
triage.triage_reason: デリー近郊で姉妹2名がH1N1関連で相次いで死亡し、稀な合併症（急性壊死性脳症）を伴う重症例が確認されたが、季節性インフルエンザという既知病原体による家族内クラスターであり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。姉の死因が未確定など情報不足のため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA/H1N1による家族内クラスター（姉妹2名死亡）。稀な合併症ANE（急性壊死性脳症）を伴う重症例として注視に値するが、既知の病原体であり公衆衛生システム全体への深刻な影響や国際拡大の兆候は現時点で確認されていない。姉の死因は未確定（疑い例）。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : stratégie revue contre Ebola sur fond de tensions
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Revised strategy to combat Ebola amid tensions
article.articleSummary: DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, the largest yet, has recorded over 3,900 cases and 1,801 confirmed deaths across Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. Africa CDC revises its response strategy, prioritizing village engagement, accelerated access to vaccines and therapeutics, humanitarian considerations including school re-entry, universal free care, and enhanced coordination and contact tracing. A potential spread is under watch after a passenger died in Mongala province aboard a boat from Tshopo; the vessel is quarantined about 65 kilometers from Kinshasa, and travellers are being tested with results sent to INRB. The United States has pledged more than $242 million in additional Ebola aid, boosting total U.S. funding to over $500 million. Health worker protests in Ituri over two months of back pay disrupt surveillance, tracing, and patient care. To date, 776 recoveries are reported, underscoring benefit of early treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：緊張の中でエボラ対策戦略を見直し
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模となる第17次エボラ流行（症例3,900件超、死亡1,801人）が継続中で、首都キンシャサ近郊への拡大懸念や医療従事者のストライキによる対応体制の混乱があり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 米国からの2億4200万ドル超の追加支援表明や、モンガラ州での船内感染死亡例によるキンシャサ方面への拡大懸念、イトゥリ州での医療従事者の給与未払いによる抗議活動がサーベイランスに影響している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: Mỹ tăng viện trợ ngăn tình hình diễn biến nghiêm trọng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: the U.S. increases aid to prevent the situation from worsening.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC (Bundibugyo ebolavirus). The U.S. Department of State provides a $242 million addition for outbreak response, raising direct U.S. aid to $512 million and funding six months of urgent activities. U.S. support sustains more than 180 health facilities and delivers nearly 300 metric tons of medical supplies for treatment, surveillance, and infection prevention. This Bundibugyo outbreak is the second-largest in history and the fastest-spreading on record for this strain. Challenges include delayed case detection, weak surveillance, ongoing eastern DRC conflict, and illegal mining increasing transmission risk; no vaccine or licensed treatment exists specifically for Bundibugyo. On August 5, authorities halted a passenger ship within about 65 km of Kinshasa after a traveler from Tshopo died with Ebola-like symptoms; a Mongala passenger also died. A meeting chaired by President Tshisekedi with WHO and Africa CDC leaders stressed protecting health workers and early detection to reduce community deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:米国が事態悪化防止のため援助を増額
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行は史上2番目の規模かつ史上最速の拡大速度であり、キンシャサ近郊への感染拡大疑い事例も発生しており、国際的拡大リスクと重症度が高い。
triage.notes: 米国務省による大規模な追加支援（2.42億ドル）、大統領主催の会議、船舶の停止措置など複数の兆候から社会的・政治的関心も高いと判断。ワクチン・治療薬未承認である点も重症度・管理困難性を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada, Dua dari Tiga Kasus Gigitan Anjing di Wilayah Padang Batung HSS Dipastikan Positif Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: Two of the Three Dog Bite Cases in the Padang Batung Area, HSS, Confirmed Positive for Rabies.
article.articleSummary: Three dog-bite incidents occurred in Padang Batung District, Hulu Sungai Selatan Regency, South Kalimantan, Indonesia. Two bites were laboratory-confirmed rabies cases; victims were in Pahampangan and Pandulangan villages. An elderly resident from Pandulangan received medical care at RSUD Brigjend Hasan Basry Kandangan per bite SOP. The attacking dog, a stray, had previously been part of a group of six; its head was sent to Balai Veteriner Banjarbaru for testing and returned positive for rabies. The Batu Bini case could not be confirmed since the dog was not located, though treatment was provided at Puskesmas and a hospital. Authorities urge vigilance and reporting of dogs showing rabies signs to prevent further cases.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：南カリマンタン州フル・スンガイ・セラタン県パダンバトゥン地区での3件の犬咬傷事故のうち2件が狂犬病陽性と確定
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの一地域で発生した限定的な犬咬傷による狂犬病確定事例であり、地方レベルの対応で管理可能とみられるが、野良犬集団による感染リスクの継続が懸念されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はインドネシアで地域的に流行している疾患であり、本事例は局地的な犬咬傷による感染例。人-人感染はなく、国際的拡大リスクは低いが、野良犬集団（6頭）の存在から動物間感染の継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola virus behind massive outbreak in DRC could be mutating, officials say
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, may be mutating as confirmed cases exceed 4,000 with 1,801 deaths (3,973 cases, 1,801 deaths as of 4 August). It is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, eight times the cases at the same stage of the 2014–18 West Africa epidemic. The outbreak centers on Ituri’s Mongbwalu and has spread to Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo; Uganda reported 20 cases before control. Africa CDC plans rapid scale-up, including door-to-door active case finding and community-centered response; contact tracing averages about 10 contacts per case, far short of the ~40 expected. MSF reports 90% of admissions are not on lists of contacts. Authorities consider compassionate remdesivir and evaluating Ervebo for this strain. A suspected death on a boat to Kinshasa prompts quarantine/testing; UNICEF warns of disrupted healthcare and a 69% drop in first-dose measles vaccines in Mongbwalu.

triage.headline_ja: DRCで拡大中のエボラウイルスが変異している可能性、当局が指摘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行が発生し、ウイルス変異の懸念、複数州・国境を越えた拡大、医療体制への深刻な影響が報告されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの感染例（20例）も報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。麻疹ワクチン接種率の急落など間接的な公衆衛生影響も懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Public hospitals told: Set up 'lepto' fast lanes
article.articleSummary: DoH coordinates emergency response with local government units and tightens sanitation in evacuation centers across Metro Manila and Luzon amid seasonal WILD diseases—waterborne illnesses, influenza-like illnesses, leptospirosis and dengue. Public advised to avoid wading or swimming in floodwaters, which can be contaminated with animal urine from rats carrying leptospira bacteria. If entry into flooded areas is unavoidable, wear protective gear (e.g., rubber boots) and wash thoroughly with soap and clean water immediately after exposure. Individuals with open wounds exposed to floodwaters should seek immediate medical consultation. Preventive medication must be prescribed by a doctor and is not a substitute for avoiding floodwater exposure. To limit waterborne disease risk, residents in affected areas should boil drinking water if local sources are compromised by flood infiltration.

triage.headline_ja: 公立病院に「レプト(レプトスピラ症)」専用ファストレーンの設置を指示
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで毎年雨季に発生する季節性のレプトスピラ症・水系感染症・インフル様疾患・デング熱への予防的対応を報じたもので、異常な感染拡大や重症例急増の具体的データはないが、洪水期の継続的曝露リスクがあるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性の雨季関連公衆衛生アドバイザリーであり、具体的な症例数・死亡者数・急増傾向の記載はない。DoHによる予防的措置の呼びかけが主内容。

article.articleHeadline: Число умерших в ДР Конго от Эболы превысило 1 800
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of deaths in DR Congo from Ebola has surpassed 1,800.
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has 3,973 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths (case-fatality ~45%). Currently, 717 patients are in hospitals or medical isolation, and 80% of identified contacts have been traced. The outbreak began May 15 in eastern DRC and Uganda, with the epicenter in Ituri Province, DRC. Uganda announced on July 28 that its outbreak had ended. Ongoing transmission remains centered in eastern DRC, with continued isolation, patient care, and contact tracing to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでのエボラ死者数、1,800人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで致死率約45%、死者1,800人超と深刻な公衆衛生への影響があり、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境事例）も確認されているためIHR基準に複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダでの流行は7月28日に終息宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Panic in major city as nearly 200 boat passengers forced into quarantine
article.articleSummary: An Ebola-related panic erupted in Kinshasa as authorities quarantined about 200 boat passengers after a person died with symptoms matching Ebola. Congolese health officials monitored travelers aboard a vessel near Kinshasa amid an ongoing Ebola outbreak in Congo. Since May, the outbreak has been described as the fastest in history in terms of transmission, with Africa CDC Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya reporting about 4,000 confirmed cases and more than 1,800 deaths. The incident underscores the outbreak's high transmission level and the public health response in Congo. No laboratory confirmation details or infection source are provided in this report. As of Aug 6, 2026, authorities continue surveillance of travelers and vessels near Kinshasa to prevent further spread, including potential imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 主要都市で200人近くの船舶乗客が検疫隔離、パニック発生
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で「史上最速の伝播」とされるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中で、首都キンシャサでの検疫措置とパニックが報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 約4,000例の確定症例、1,800人以上の死者が報告されており、首都キンシャサでの船舶乗客検疫という新たな展開は国際的拡大リスクを示唆する。ラボ確認結果や感染源の詳細は本報告に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Balasore: Over 70, including 30 children fall ill with diarrhoea after feast, 50 critical
article.articleSummary: Balasore district, Odisha: In Kharida village, Jaleswar block, more than 70 people fell ill with diarrhoea after attending a griha pratistha (housewarming) ceremony. Victims developed vomiting and loose motions after consuming food served at the feast. About 50 are in serious condition, with more than 30 children among the affected. All patients have been admitted to Jaleswar hospital; a medical team has been deployed to the hospital and to the village to monitor the situation. District health authorities have collected samples of food and water; the exact cause of the outbreak is not yet known and an investigation is underway. The incident indicates a diarrhoeal outbreak linked to a communal feast, with ongoing surveillance and lab testing expected to identify a source and guide control measures.

triage.headline_ja: バラソール:祝宴後、子ども30人を含む70人以上が下痢を発症、50人が重体
triage.triage_reason: 単一の村落での宴会後の集団下痢症で規模はやや大きいが、原因未特定かつ国際的拡大の兆候はなく、続報（検査結果）を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 食品または水系による集団食中毒の疑い。原因検査結果待ち。単発の宴会イベントであり、地域内で完結する可能性が高いが、重症者数が多いため経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de sarampo em SP levou à recomendação de revacinação e "dose zero" | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles outbreak in São Paulo led to the recommendation for revaccination and 'dose zero'
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in São Paulo state prompts expanded vaccination and a 'dose zero' strategy. Brazil's Health Ministry now recommends vaccinating all individuals aged 6 months to 59 years in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo during August–September 2026 as part of the Multivacinação Campaign. The measure follows confirmed cases indicating an importation-linked transmission chain in these cities. By end-July 2026, Brazil had 17 measles cases; 14 remain under active surveillance in São Paulo: 11 in the city of São Paulo, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos. Investigations point to a highly mobile region with international travel facilitating importation, though 2025 saw 38 imported cases with local transmission halted by surveillance and vaccination. Dose zero provides an extra MMR vaccine for 6–11 month-olds, not substituting D1 at 12 months or D2 at 15 months. Vaccination is free via SUS; coverage remains a public health priority.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州の麻疹アウトブレイクを受け、再接種と『ゼロ回目接種』が推奨される
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で輸入関連の麻疹伝播チェーンが確認され、保健省が広範なワクチン接種強化策（ゼロ回目接種を含む）を打ち出しており、行政的関心が高く続報監視が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 感染者数は17例（うち14例が経過観察中）で重症例・死亡報告はないが、国際的な人の移動による輸入例の連鎖と当局の積極的なワクチン接種対応が確認されており、経過を注視すべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo outpacing the response: WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the world’s fastest-growing, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus during a Kinshasa visit. Nearly three months in, new cases are doubling in hot spots. As of Monday, DR Congo’s Ministry of Health reports 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths. The epicenter is Ituri Province, where frontline workers have struck over pay, limiting access to care amid rebel conflict in the remote east near borders with South Sudan, Uganda and Rwanda. WHO calls for urgent, massive scaling-up of all response pillars with partners. Some health workers have begun receiving pay in the past week, but strikes persist. The United States announced an additional $242 million to support immediate Ebola response and preparedness in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行、対応が追いつかず：WHO
triage.triage_reason: WHOが「世界最速の拡大」と表明したエボラ流行で、致死率も高く（死亡1,751/感染3,874）、紛争地域でのアクセス制限や国境地帯での拡大リスクがあり、米国が2億4200万ドルの追加支援を発表するなど国際的関心・支援ニーズが極めて高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUnited States, Sudan, Rwanda, Ugandaが含まれるが、これらは近隣国・支援国としての言及であり、実際の流行発生地はDRC（特にIturi州）のみ。国境地帯での紛争や医療従事者ストライキが対応を阻害しており、WHOが全対応の大規模強化を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: Panic in Kinshasa as nearly 200 boat passengers forced into quarantine after Ebola death - AOL
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) persists with 4,000 confirmed cases and over 1,800 deaths since May. Kinshasa experiences panic as nearly 200 passengers aboard a Congo River boat are quarantined after a traveler died with Ebola-like symptoms in Pimu, Mongala province, about 621 miles from the capital. The boat, on nearly three weeks of travel with ~200 people onboard, has all passengers tested and quarantined while awaiting results; Kinshasa currently has no confirmed Ebola case. The outbreak is the second-largest on record after 2014–2016 West Africa, with transmission accelerating; 60–70% of new cases occur outside monitored contacts. In isolation, 674 patients are confined, most in Ituri. About 75% of contacts are traced; many new cases arise from sources not monitored due to rebel conflict and mining-related movements limiting access.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサでパニック発生、エボラ死亡例後に船の乗客約200人が隔離措置に - AOL
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4000症例・1800人超の死者を出す史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行が継続中で、感染経路の60-70%が監視外という制御困難な状況にあり、首都キンシャサでも渡航者隔離とパニックが生じている。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリー上で実際の症例発生国として言及されていないため verified_locations から除外した。感染は主にイトゥリ州・モンガラ州で発生し、反乱軍紛争や鉱山関連の人の移動が接触者追跡を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: DR of Congo monitors boat passengers after traveller dies with Ebola symptoms
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports an ongoing Ebola virus disease outbreak; a traveller died with Ebola symptoms after disembarking from a Congo River boat near Kinshasa, prompting monitoring of nearly 200 passengers aboard the vessel. All on board are tested and quarantined while results are awaited. The outbreak, declared in May, is described as the fastest in history for transmission, with 4,000 confirmed cases and more than 1,800 deaths, per Africa CDC. The deceased had fallen ill in Pimu, Mongala province, about 1,000 km from Kinshasa, where no confirmed case exists so far. In Ituri province, the epicenter, 674 patients remain in isolation and 75% of contacts are being traced, though many new cases stem from unmonitored sources amid rebel conflict and mining movement. Separately, health workers protested unpaid wages in Bunia; WHO and Doctors Without Borders warn transmission remains alarmingly fast.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ症状で死亡した旅行者の後、船の乗客を監視
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラアウトブレイクは4,000症例・1,800人以上の死亡と史上最速の感染拡大とされ、Kinshasa近郊での新規死亡例や紛争地域での接触者追跡困難など、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 2026年5月に宣言されたエボラアウトブレイクは史上最速の感染拡大とされ、Ituri州が震源地。紛争や鉱山活動による未監視の感染源が拡大を助長。Kinshasa近郊での死亡例発生により首都圏への波及リスクが高まっている。WHOおよびMSFが警戒を表明しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Број оболелих од еболе у Конгу повећан на 3.973, 1.801 смртни случај
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in Congo has risen to 3,973, with 1,801 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 3,973 cases with 1,801 deaths, according to the government. The outbreak began in late April this year, and the current case fatality rate stands at 43.9%. World Health Organization data show nearly 90% of cases are in Ituri province in the northeast, near the borders with Uganda and South Sudan. By comparison, the 2014–2016 Ebola outbreak in Congo involved about 28,000 cases and more than 11,000 deaths, with the death toll reaching 1,000 after eight months. The latest figures indicate ongoing transmission in Ituri amid cross-border movement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が3,973人に増加、死者1,801人
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約44%の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、国境地域での越境移動を伴う国際拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda, Sudanが含まれているが、記事本文ではコンゴ（イトゥリ州）のみが感染発生地として明記されており、両国は国境近接地域として言及されているのみのため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: WHO, partners agree on shared strategy to stop Ebola in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths as per the latest Health Ministry report, across 51 health zones in Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu and Tshopo; Ituri is the epicenter with about 87.1% of cases. The outbreak is the world’s second-largest by infections. WHO and partners agreed on a shared strategy to stop transmission, emphasizing a speed-adjusted response, stronger coordination under the government, and unified action across responders. The Africa CDC-led plan requires about $1.4 billion, with more than $420 million mobilized to date. Measures include early detection, contact tracing, access to quality care, protection and compensation for frontline workers, and community engagement. Separately, a boat of ~200 people from Tshopo toward Kinshasa was intercepted 65 km from the capital amid a suspected Ebola-linked death; passengers were screened by mobile labs.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとパートナー機関、DRCでのエボラ流行阻止に向けた共同戦略に合意
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（3,973症例、1,801死亡）が複数州にわたり継続し、国際的な資金・対応支援が必要な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: キンシャサ方面への感染者移動疑いも報告されており、都市部への拡大リスクが懸念される。世界第2位の規模のエボラ流行として国際的注目度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Trabajadores sanitarios en RD Congo enfrentan demoras en pagos en medio de brote de Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Healthcare workers in DR Congo face delays in payments amid an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Healthcare workers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo face salary delays amid an Ebola outbreak. Wiza Bondele, part of the infection prevention and control team combating Ebola in the DRC, has not received a salary since mid-May. In July he joined a healthcare worker strike over pay. That month, the Health Minister acknowledged delays caused by organizational issues and pledged a quick resolution; since then some workers have received partial payments, while others have received none. The Ebola outbreak in the DRC has already surpassed the number of cases from the 2018 outbreak. The report highlights strain on frontline responders and potential impacts on outbreak control and morale, with no total case or death figures provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の医療従事者、エボラ流行の最中に給与支払いの遅延に直面
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が2018年の流行規模を上回っており、医療従事者のストライキによる対応体制の弱体化が懸念されるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は給与遅延による医療従事者のストライキが流行対応に及ぼす影響に焦点を当てており、症例数・死亡者数の具体的な数値は記載されていないが、2018年流行を上回る規模である旨言及あり。

article.articleHeadline: États-Unis : 1,8 milliard de dollars d'aide à l'OCHA, dont 350 millions pour la riposte contre Ebola en Afrique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United States: $1.8 billion in aid to OCHA, including $350 million for the Ebola response in Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in Africa remains centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with the Bundibugyo strain—identified in May 2026 and lacking a vaccine or treatment. Uganda and South Sudan are affected amid insecurity in eastern DRC, which WHO has urged to pause hostilities to aid interventions. The United States announced $1.8 billion in multisectoral humanitarian aid to OCHA, including $350 million for the DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda; the package was disclosed May 14, 2026. Of the emergency funding, $512 million supports urgent interventions. Reported outcomes include 292 tonnes of humanitarian supplies delivered; 8.6 million screening tests; over 1 million people educated on contamination risks; 184,000 units of equipment delivered; and 12 Ebola treatment centers established in affected regions. The U.S. called on partners to ramp up coordination, noting coordination with G7, Egypt, India, Kenya, and South Korea on June 16.

triage.headline_ja: 米国：OCHAに18億ドルの支援、うちアフリカのエボラ対応に3億5000万ドル
triage.triage_reason: DRCで治療法・ワクチンのないBundibugyo株によるエボラ流行が継続し、ウガンダ・南スーダンにも影響、米国が18億ドルの人道支援を発表するなど国際的関心・対応が高まっているため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンも影響を受けているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インド・ケニア・韓国・エジプトはG7等との調整パートナーとして言及されているのみで発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Hugo Pizzi: "Las condiciones sociales en Ituri agravan la crisis por el brote de Ébola"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hugo Pizzi: "The social conditions in Ituri worsen the crisis caused by the Ebola outbreak."
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri, has reached 1,801 deaths, marking it as the second-largest outbreak on record with a case-fatality rate around 50%. The World Health Organization has urged intensified response efforts, but progress is hampered by scarce health resources. The interview features Hugo Pizzi, infectious disease specialist and epidemiologist, who discusses how social conditions in Ituri amplify transmission and complicate containment. The article notes the ongoing outbreak status as of 2026-08-06, with no details on laboratory confirmation, specific infection sources, or imported/exported cases provided. Public health implications underscore the need for enhanced resources, surveillance, and community interventions to address the severe mortality and the broader social determinants driving the crisis.

triage.headline_ja: ウーゴ・ピッツィ:「イトゥリの社会的状況がエボラ流行の危機を悪化させている」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリでのエボラ出血熱流行が1,801人の死者を出し史上2番目の規模に達しており、致死率約50%と深刻。WHOも対応強化を求めており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行、死者1,801人、致死率約50%。WHOが対応強化を要請しているが医療資源不足が課題。継続的なモニタリングとフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu: quarante pairs éducateurs commerçants transfrontaliers formés à la prévention contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Forty pairs of cross-border trader-educators trained in Ebola prevention - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, forty pairs of cross-border trader-educators were trained in Ebola prevention in Kasindi, North Kivu, on the DRC-Uganda border. The two-day training, part of the Project for Facilitation of Trade and Integration in the Great Lakes (PFCIGL) in partnership with the coordination of associations and cooperatives of small cross-border traders, aims to strengthen prevention among small traders and border communities. The program emphasizes strict adherence to barrier measures despite Kasindi not yet recording a suspected or confirmed Ebola case since the outbreak began in mid-May. Uganda has closed the border to non-transit traffic, allowing only transit traders. While Uganda has declared the outbreak over, Congolese-Ugandan authorities keep prevention at a high level to protect border populations.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：国境を越える小規模商人教育者40名がエボラ予防研修を受講 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 記事は既知のDRCエボラアウトブレイク（5月中旬発生）に関する予防研修活動の報告であり、Kasindiでは疑い・確定症例は未報告。新規感染事例の発生ではないため、進行中の状況として継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRC北キブ州（コンゴ・ウガンダ国境）における既存のエボラアウトブレイク対策としての予防研修活動を報じたもの。Kasindiでは症例未確認、ウガンダ側は終息宣言済み。新規シグナルというより既存アウトブレイクの経過観察情報。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : onze nouveaux cas confirmés d'Ebola notifiés - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Eleven new confirmed Ebola cases reported - ACP.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, reported 11 new confirmed Ebola cases on August 5, raising the 17th outbreak total to 447. Infections were recorded in Katwa (6), Butembo (2), Musienene (2), and Beni (1). The update notes 307 deaths among confirmed cases (case fatality rate 68.6%), 59 recoveries, 67 active cases, and 14 displaced or escaped individuals. The epidemic now affects 12 of the province’s 34 health zones, with 74 of 684 health areas affected. There are 105 suspected cases, including 37 deaths; 105 samples were submitted for laboratory confirmation. About 6,352 contacts are under surveillance, with 4,556 followed that day (72%). Katwa remains the epicenter (208 confirmed cases, 140 deaths, 35 active), followed by Butembo (92) and Beni (65); two probable cases are recorded in Kyondo and Beni. Data collected Aug 5 and published Aug 6, 2026 by the provincial response coordination.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州:エボラ出血熱の新規確認症例11件が報告-ACP通信
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の第17次アウトブレイクが継続中で、致死率68.6%と高く、感染地域が拡大しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 北キブ州における第17次エボラ流行の継続。12/34保健区に拡大、致死率68.6%、逃亡・行方不明の接触者14名の存在は感染拡大リスクを示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Meningococcal outbreak: Doc says do not panic, be vigilant
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, a localized meningococcal outbreak in Peren district, Nagaland, involves 7 pediatric cases admitted to CIHSR; one suspected death awaiting laboratory confirmation; six other cases discharged. All cases are from Peren district. Neisseria meningitidis is the causative agent, with serotype A being most common in India. Transmission occurs person-to-person via respiratory droplets and saliva, amplified by crowding; sneezing or coughing without masks and sharing utensils or cigarettes facilitate spread. Symptoms include high fever, severe headache, vomiting, photophobia, and stiff neck; in advanced stages, red petechial rashes or purpura with thrombocytopenia, leading to bleeding, hypotension, and shock may occur. Third-generation antibiotics can effectively treat the infection. Prevention emphasizes vaccination (9 months to 55 years), use of masks, good hygiene, and rapid medical consultation; close contacts may receive prophylaxis. Public messaging stresses vigilance, not panic.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌感染症の流行：医師は「パニックにならず、警戒を」と呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インド・ナガランド州の一地区（Peren）で小児7例（うち疑い死亡1例）の局地的な髄膜炎菌感染症クラスターが報告されているが、規模は小さく地理的に限定的であり、現時点で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。ヒト-ヒト感染性があり続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: Bluedotの疾患名タグは『SFTS Virus』となっているが、記事内容はNeisseria meningitidisによる髄膜炎菌感染症のアウトブレイクであり、タグ付けの誤りと考えられる。感染は現時点でPeren地区に限定的。

article.articleHeadline: USP em Bauru promove simpósio sobre ebolavírus, virologia e evolução viral
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: USP in Bauru hosts symposium on Ebola virus, virology, and viral evolution.
article.articleSummary: Sept 16, 2026, Bauru, Brazil—The University of São Paulo's FOB hosts 'Ebola Virus in Focus – Clinical Virology and Evolution,' a free, enrollment-limited symposium addressing clinical, virological, and evolutionary aspects of filoviruses, especially Ebola and Marburg viruses. The event runs 14:00–17:00 at the FOB Library Auditorium. Attendees include students, researchers, and health professionals; registration details are provided via the event link. Three talks: Filovirology by Kaique Cesar de Paula Silva (viral structure, genomics, replication, host interactions, immune evasion); Evolution of Filoviruses by Thiago Silva Messias (taxonomy, origins, phylogeny, reservoirs, emergence); Clinical Diseases of Filoviruses by Edson Carvalho de Melo (clinical manifestations, differential diagnosis, clinical management, prognosis). A closing roundtable will revisit themes and discuss current challenges in research and clinical practice. Organized by Ana Carolina Magalhães; co-coordinator Murilo Priori Alcalde; Narciso Almeida Vieira.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ大学バウルー校がエボラウイルスに関するシンポジウム「ウイルス学と進化」を開催
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生ではなく、エボラ・マールブルグウイルスに関する学術シンポジウムの案内記事であり、公衆衛生上の懸念や社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・バウルーで開催される学術シンポジウムの告知であり、実際のエボラ／マールブルグ病の発生事例ではない。発生地域としてBrazilが付与されているが、疾病発生と無関係のため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Τσαντ: Δεκατρείς νεκροί από επιδημία χολέρας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chad: Thirteen dead from a cholera outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Chad reports 13 deaths and 239 cholera cases since July, confined to Hadjer-Lamis in the north and the capital N'Djamena. As of August 3, 239 cases have been recorded in Chad, a central African country of about 21 million people. A vaccination campaign is under way, with 50,799 people vaccinated to date. The first cholera death was recorded on June 13. In recent months several African countries have faced cholera outbreaks, including the Central African Republic, Nigeria, and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Cholera is an acute bacterial infection from contaminated water or food; it is treatable with rehydration and, in severe cases, antibiotics. The Health Ministry emphasizes that limited access to potable water and sanitation remains a major challenge in Chad.

triage.headline_ja: チャド：コレラ流行で13人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはチャドが主体であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン等）のいずれにも該当しない。DRC等は流行に言及されているのみで記事の主題ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はチャドにおけるコレラ流行が主題。DRC、中央アフリカ共和国、ナイジェリアは近隣諸国での流行事例として言及されているのみで、記事の主要な発生地域ではないため対象国リストから除外。

article.articleHeadline: وكالة الصحة الإفريقية ومنظمة الصحة العالمية تطلبان التحقيق في احتمال تحور فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The African Health Agency and the World Health Organization call for an investigation into the possibility of Ebola virus mutation.
article.articleSummary: Joint inquiry by Africa CDC and the World Health Organization into a possible mutation of Bundibugyo ebolavirus amid a Congo outbreak described as unprecedented in Africa. Nairobi-hosted press briefing quoted Africa CDC Director-General, noting the outbreak’s severity and that studies will start to determine whether viral mutation has occurred. Officials estimate around 4,000 cases, with over 3,900 confirmed as of the previous day; deaths are more than six times higher than in the same period of the 2014 West Africa Ebola outbreak, which this outbreak surpasses eightfold in case counts. Bundibugyo ebolavirus is highly contagious, crossing from wildlife to humans and spreading via contact with body fluids (vomit, blood, semen) and contaminated surfaces. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pains, and sometimes internal or external bleeding. The report focuses on outbreak dynamics, laboratory considerations, and the potential need for enhanced public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ疾病予防管理センター(Africa CDC)とWHO、エボラウイルスの変異可能性について調査を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス感染症が「アフリカ史上前例のない」規模とされ、症例数約4000、死亡率が2014年西アフリカ流行の6倍超と極めて深刻。Africa CDCとWHOがウイルス変異の可能性を共同調査しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイロビ(ケニア)は記者会見の開催地であり、アウトブレイクの発生国はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが本文中に言及がないため除外。ウイルス変異の有無は調査開始段階であり未確定。

article.articleHeadline: First domestic typhoid case of this year reported
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports the first domestic typhoid fever case this year. A woman in her 70s from central Taiwan developed fever and diarrhea in mid-July 2026; stool testing confirmed Salmonella typhi in late July, and she has recovered and been discharged. She has no travel history, and the infection source is under investigation. Health authorities traced 45 contacts; one developed diarrhea, four tested negative, and no additional cases have been found. Taiwan has four typhoid cases so far this year—one domestic and three imported. Since 2022, Taiwan has recorded 40 cases (11 domestic, 29 imported), with most imported infections (22) from Indonesia. Typhoid incubation ranges 3–60 days (typically 8–14), transmitted via contaminated food or water from infected people or carriers. Symptoms include fever, headache, fatigue, loss of appetite, abdominal pain, and diarrhea; prevention emphasizes hand/food hygiene, avoiding untreated water, thorough cooking, and separate prep surfaces.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾で今年初の国内感染腸チフス症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 台湾国内で1例の腸チフス症例が確認されたが、患者は回復・退院済みで接触者調査でも追加感染なし。台湾は対象国リストに含まれず、規模も小さいため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域に台湾とインドネシアが挙げられているが、記事の主題は台湾国内での単発症例。インドネシアは輸入症例の由来国として言及されているのみで、インドネシア国内での発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めない。台湾はGeoNames対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός στο Τσαντ: Στους 13 οι νεκροί από τη χολέρα - Σχεδόν 240 τα επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm in Chad: 13 dead from cholera - Almost 240 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Chad: As of August 6, 2026, the Ministry of Health reports 239 national cholera cases and 13 deaths (case fatality rate 5.4%). The epidemic is affecting northern Hadjer-Lamis and the capital N'Djamena, with 11 of the 13 deaths occurring in N'Djamena during August. Since the outbreak was declared on July 24, about 50,800 people have received vaccination. The first deaths were recorded on June 13. The article notes ongoing regional activity, with neighboring African countries including the Central African Republic, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Nigeria reporting cholera outbreaks in recent months. Cholera, an acute diarrheal illness caused by contaminated food or water, can be effectively treated with oral rehydration and antibiotics, but may be fatal within hours if untreated. Limited access to safe water and sanitation remains a major challenge in Chad.

triage.headline_ja: チャドで警報:コレラによる死者13人に - 確定症例は約240件
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はチャドの流行であり、対象国であるDRC(コンゴ民主共和国)は近隣諸国の一つとして流行報告に言及されているのみで、具体的な症例数・死者数などの詳細情報が欠如しているため、続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な報告対象はチャド（対象国外）の流行状況であり、DRCについては『近隣諸国でもコレラ流行が報告されている』という文脈的言及に留まる。DRC国内の具体的な症例数・死亡者数・発生地域などの情報は記事内に記載されていないため、追加情報の収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: بیش از ۱۷۰۰ مرگ بر اثر سریع‌ترین شیوع ابولا در جهان
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,700 deaths from the world's fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading at an unprecedented rate in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths reported by the Ministry of Health as the latest tally. The outbreak centers in Ituri Province, a remote area near borders with South Sudan, Uganda and Rwanda, where health workers’ strikes have strained access to care. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, after visiting Kinshasa, warned that transmission is outpacing response efforts and that case numbers in some hotspots have doubled since the crisis began nearly three months ago. In the latest 24 hours, 77 cases and 44 deaths were recorded; 717 patients remain in isolation and 749 have recovered. The death rate is about 45%, largely attributed to late diagnosis, while 60–70% of new cases have not been linked to contact tracing. The 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak is cited for context, with over 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 世界最速のエボラ流行で死者1,700人超
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率約45%のエボラ大規模流行が急拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、WHO事務局長も懸念表明していることから社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSudan, Angola, Rwanda, Ugandaが含まれるが記事本文はDRCのイツリ州が主題であり、国境近接の言及のみのため対象国リストにも該当なしとして除外。対象国リストにSudan等は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Tunisie: Crise sanitaire au pays - L'OMS alerte sur une hausse incontrôlable d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tunisia: Health crisis in the country — WHO warns of an uncontrollable surge in Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with cases rapidly accelerating; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, in Kinshasa, urged immediate international mobilization as the outbreak surpasses existing response capacity. About 90 days after the first official reports, new infections have doubled in the most active transmission foci. Laboratory-confirmed diagnoses approach 4,000, with more than 1,700 deaths, highlighting high mortality and severity. The crisis unfolds amid a local healthcare staffing crisis, marked by widespread strikes over pay precarity, complicating containment efforts. Authorities and partners agree on the urgent need for a large-scale logistical and financial surge to reinforce contingency strategies and stabilize medical structures to prevent cross-border spillover.

triage.headline_ja: チュニジア：国内で保健危機 － WHOがエボラの制御不能な増加について警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染が急拡大し、確定症例約4000人・死亡者1700人超と高い致死率を示し、WHO事務局長が国際的な緊急動員を要請しており、越境拡大のリスクも指摘されているため。
triage.notes: 見出し原文はチュニジアに言及しているが、記事本文・サマリーの内容は一貫してコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ流行に関するものであり、見出しの国名表記に誤りがある可能性が高い。実際の発生地はDRC（キンシャサ含む）と判断した。医療従事者のストライキによる対応能力低下や国際支援の必要性が強調されており、severe outbreakとしてフルリスク評価が必要。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली में बढे डेंगू और स्वाइन फ्लू के मामले, डॉक्टर से जानें शरीर में दिखते हैं कौन
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Delhi sees rising dengue and swine flu cases; find out from the doctor which symptoms appear in the body.
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports rising dengue and swine flu cases during the monsoon. As of 2026-08-06, dengue in Delhi totals 1,179 cases with 210 residents outside the city and 1,389 dengue patients in Delhi hospitals; swine flu (H1N1) stands at 1,344 cases with no deaths reported. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; swine flu spreads via close contact and respiratory droplets. Symptoms: dengue—high fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, body aches, vomiting, rash; warning signs include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, mucosal bleeding, extreme weakness, rapid breathing. Swine flu—fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, headache, body aches, fatigue; severe signs include breathing difficulty, chest pain, low oxygen. Preventive measures: eliminate standing water, cover containers, wear long sleeves, use repellents, masks, hygiene, and avoid crowded places. Delhi government issued a dengue control advisory.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでデング熱と豚インフルエンザの症例が増加、医師が症状について解説
triage.triage_reason: デリーにおける季節性（モンスーン期）のデング熱・豚インフルエンザ症例増加であり、インドで毎年見られる既知の流行パターン。死亡例の報告もなく、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デリー政府がデング対策の勧告を発表しているが、これは毎年のモンスーン期に発生する季節性・地域内対応事案であり、外部支援の必要性や国際的懸念は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: OMS urge intensificar respuesta contra el ébola en Congo Democrático
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO urges intensified response to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: WHO urges intensified response to Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of 6 August 2026, the National Institute of Public Health reports 3,874 confirmed Ebola cases, with 717 patients in isolation or hospitalized, 749 recovered, and 1,751 deaths (case fatality rate 45.1%). Tedros Adhanom warns the outbreak is spreading faster than response capacity, with new cases doubling in some clusters in the past week. The outbreak, the deadliest in the DRC to date, was declared on 15 May and involves Bundibugyo virus, for which no approved vaccine exists. WHO calls for reaching all affected communities amid insecurity and displacement, protecting health workers, and accelerating access to care, surveillance, and safe/dignified burials. Transmission occurs from close contact with blood, secretions, or bodily fluids of infected animals (notably fruit bats) to humans, who become infectious with symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱への対応強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪規模のエボラ流行(確定3,874例、死亡1,751例、致死率45.1%)で、承認ワクチンがなく感染拡大速度が対応能力を上回っており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で承認ワクチンが存在しない点、治安不安・住民避難により対応が困難な点が特筆される。WHO事務局長が直接介入を要請しており、国際的関心・支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Autoritățile sanitare din Africa și OMS solicită o anchetă privind o posibilă mutație a virusului Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health authorities in Africa and the WHO call for an investigation into a possible mutation of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Africa CDC and WHO call for a joint investigation into a potential mutation of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, amid rapid spread of a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. The outbreak is described as unprecedented in severity, with confirmed cases surpassing 3,900 and estimates approaching 4,000 as of the report. There is no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo yet, though a clinical vaccine trial is underway. Transmission occurs via close contact and exposure to body fluids. The current outbreak is noted as the largest the country has faced in Africa, prompting studies to determine if viral mutation has occurred. For context, the 2014–2015 West Africa epidemic killed over 11,000, while the 2018–2020 eastern Congo outbreak caused about 2,300 deaths. The report emphasizes the ongoing, severe nature of this outbreak and public health response.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの保健当局とWHO、エボラウイルスの変異の可能性について調査を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyoエボラウイルスの前例のない規模の流行（症例数約3,900〜4,000）が発生し、ウイルス変異の可能性についてAfrica CDCとWHOが合同調査を要請しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRCでの発生のみに言及しており、Angolaは対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。承認済みワクチンがなく、ウイルス変異の可能性が懸念されている点が特に重大。

article.articleHeadline: Urgent Action Needed: WHO Chief Tedros Warns Of Rapidly Worsening Ebola Outbreak In DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak in eastern Ituri is the fastest-spreading and second-deadliest of the 17th outbreak in the country, with 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths as of Monday; about 717 in isolation and 749 recovered. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Kinshasa, urged rapid, widespread scale-up across all response pillars, prioritizing community engagement, protection of health workers, faster access to care, surveillance, and safe, dignified burials amid insecurity. The outbreak began mid-March; the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no approved treatment or vaccine. Health worker strikes and pay disputes hinder access; early deaths were misdiagnosed as peritonitis, and open-coffin funeral practices aided spread. A Maluku, Kinshasa health scare involved a ship passenger who died with Ebola-like symptoms; ~200 aboard, the deceased not yet tested. The US pledged $242 million for response and preparedness; Travel Advisory Level 4 remains for DRC, Uganda, South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: 緊急対応が必要:WHO事務局長テドロス氏、コンゴ民主共和国で急速に悪化するエボラ出血熱の流行に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当する大規模エボラ流行（確定3,874例、死亡1,751例）で、WHO事務局長が緊急対応を要請し、渡航制限も継続しているため、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダン・米国は記事に言及されるが対象国リストに含まれず除外。船舶乗客の疑い例は未確定（未検査）のため国際拡大リスクの評価に含めたが、確定情報ではない点に留意。
