article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് പകർച്ചവ്യാധി മരണങ്ങള്‍ കൂടുന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the state, deaths from infectious diseases are increasing.
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, Kerala faces a flood-linked surge in infectious diseases. In six days, 22 deaths across dengue, measles, malaria, influenza, chickenpox, and amoebic meningitis, with five H1N1 deaths in the past week. Government hospitals have treated over 150,000 people, with Malappuram district reporting the highest fever burden (2,710 treated yesterday). This month records 478 dengue confirmations, 77 measles, 145 malaria, 427 chickenpox, and 479 influenza cases; amoebic meningitis hits 4 cases (1 death). Seven influenza deaths; one dengue; seven measles; one malaria; one amoebic meningitis death. H1N1 spread is a concern. Heavy rains and resulting waterlogging heighten transmission risks, while relief camps and rescue workers lack timely access to vaccines and essential medicines.

triage.headline_ja: 州内で感染症による死亡者が増加
triage.triage_reason: 洪水を契機に複数の感染症（デング熱、麻疹、マラリア、インフルエンザ、H1N1、水痘、アメーバ性髄膜炎）が同時多発し、6日間で22人が死亡するなど公衆衛生への深刻な影響が確認され、IHR基準を2つ以上満たすためフルリスク評価に進める。
triage.notes: 洪水による衛生環境悪化が複数感染症の同時流行を招いている状況。ワクチンや医薬品の供給不足が指摘されており、今後の拡大や管理状況を注視する必要がある。国際的拡大や渡航制限の情報は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola case on packed Congo river boat sparks testing rush
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case on a packed Congo river boat triggered a rapid testing operation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 2026-08-06. Congolese health authorities intercepted and detained the vessel after a passenger or crew member developed symptoms and testing was initiated for all aboard. The report indicates the case remains unconfirmed publicly, with authorities moving to screen travelers and assess potential spread along the boat's route. The incident underscores ongoing Ebola vigilance in the region and the swift public health response used to contain suspected cases on mobile transport. No further details on the infection source, laboratory confirmation, or outcome are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ川の満員の船でエボラ疑い症例、検査急増を招く
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤な疾患であり、密閉された船内で多数の乗客が曝露した可能性があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 症例は公式には未確認。船の乗客全員に検査が実施されている段階であり、続報で確定診断結果を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: veja sintomas e quando buscar ajuda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: See the Symptoms and When to Seek Help.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in São Paulo state have risen to 16 by early August 2026, prompting intensified vaccination campaigns for individuals aged 6 months to 59 years. The new strategy also covers people who have previously received doses, following health authorities’ guidance. Measles remains highly contagious; initial symptoms typically appear several days after infection and include fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes, and malaise, followed by red skin rashes that start on the face and behind the ears and spread body-wide. A fever with rash and respiratory symptoms should prompt medical evaluation, especially with high fever, widespread rash, or recent contact with a diagnosed case. In severe complications or rapid deterioration, seek urgent care. Vaccination is the primary preventive measure to curb transmission and protect vulnerable groups such as young children, pregnant women, and immunocompromised individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹:症状と受診すべきタイミングについて
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹症例が16例に増加し、ワクチン接種キャンペーンが強化されているが、深刻な国際的影響や渡航制限に至るレベルの情報はなく、規模も限定的。
triage.notes: 症例数16例と限定的だが、麻疹は感染力が非常に強く継続的なワクチン接種対応が行われているため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: MPRO denuncia dentista por suposta transmissão de HIV em Porto Velho
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MPRO denounces dentist for alleged HIV transmission in Porto Velho.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, Rondônia: The Public Prosecutor's Office (MPRO) denounces a dentist for allegedly infecting women with HIV after knowingly refusing antiretroviral therapy. Investigations suggest a deliberate non-treatment intended to transmit the virus to women with whom he had relationships. Four women have confirmed HIV infection. The case is advancing in the State Judiciary, with a hearing already held for one victim. The dentist has been held in preventive detention since 11 June 2026. NAVIT provides victims with support and referrals, and new statements indicate the dentist maintained an active sex life, suggesting additional potential victims. Possible charges include rape, danger of contagion of a serious disease, and grievous bodily harm, with penalties from 2 to 10 years in prison plus fines, depending on case progression. Victims can contact NAVIT via (69) 99906-6411 or (69) 98408-9931, or visit MPRO in Porto Velho.

triage.headline_ja: MPRO、ポルトベーリョでHIV感染を故意に広めた疑いで歯科医を告発
triage.triage_reason: 個別の刑事事件であり、公衆衛生上の集団感染や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はない。既知の感染経路(性的接触)による個人間伝播事案であり、公衆衛生緊急事態としての基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本件は刑事事件（意図的なHIV感染）に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生・アウトブレイクではないため、感染症危機管理上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Tedros y Tshisekedi refuerzan respuesta al ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros and Tshisekedi bolster the Ebola response in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has caused 1,801 deaths. On August 6, 2026, World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and DRC President Félix Tshisekedi held a constructive meeting in Kinshasa to accelerate and broaden the response. They agreed to tailor the response to the outbreak’s speed and trajectory, strengthen coordination under the RDC government’s leadership, and ensure all partners implement a shared strategy. The gathering, chaired by Tshisekedi, also included DRC Prime Minister Judith Suminwa, other government ministers involved in the response, and the head of the African Union’s health agency, Jean Kaseya, along with other health and humanitarian officials. The aim is intensified international–national collaboration to contain the epidemic and adapt actions as the outbreak evolves.

triage.headline_ja: テドロスWHO事務局長とチセケディ大統領、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応強化へ会談
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）流行により1,801人が死亡する大規模な公衆衛生危機であり、WHO事務局長が大統領と直接会談するなど国際的関心・対応強化が確認されているため。
triage.notes: 1,801人という高い死亡者数と、WHO事務局長・DRC大統領・AU保健機関トップらによるハイレベル会合が行われている点から、既に大規模かつ深刻な流行であり緊急のリスク評価が必要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: دعوات للتحقيق في احتمال تحور فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Calls for investigation into the possible mutation of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Africa CDC and the World Health Organization urge an investigation into a possible mutation of the Ebola Bundibugyo virus amid a rapid outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Jean Kasia, Africa CDC director-general, described the outbreak’s severity as unprecedented and said studies will begin to assess mutations. Health authorities now estimate about 4,000 cases, up from over 3,900 the previous day, with deaths more than sixfold higher than earlier periods. The outbreak’s caseload is over eightfold higher than during the West Africa 2014 epidemic, the continent’s most severe to date. Ebola is highly contagious; it spreads from wildlife to humans and then between people through contact with bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pain, and sometimes internal and external bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの変異可能性について調査を求める声
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の急速な流行が発生し、症例数約4,000人、死亡数が大幅増加、変異の可能性も指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストになく、記事本文でも主題として言及されていないため除外。西アフリカ2014年流行の8倍以上の症例数という記述は流行の深刻度を裏付ける重要情報。

article.articleHeadline: WHO wants probe into possible Ebola mutation
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak with more than 4,000 cases (over 3,900 confirmed yesterday), the largest and most severe in Central Africa, eightfold higher in cases and sixfold higher in deaths than the 2014 West Africa epidemic. Africa CDC and WHO plan joint studies to determine whether the virus has mutated. Transmission remains via contact with bodily fluids; no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo, though a newly developed vaccine is in trials. Kinshasa reports no confirmed cases, but authorities monitor nearly 200 passengers on a Congo River boat after a passenger in Pimu, Mongala province, over 1,000 km from Kinshasa, died with Ebola-like symptoms; the boat’s passengers are tested and quarantined. The outbreak’s scale and rapid spread drive urgent investigations and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラウイルスの変異可能性について調査を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が4000例超と中央アフリカ史上最大規模かつ2014年西アフリカ流行を大幅に上回る致死率を示し、WHO/Africa CDCがウイルス変異の可能性を調査するなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行に関するもの。アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事サマリー上で言及がなく、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。承認済みワクチンがない点、ウイルス変異調査の実施が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: فيروس إيبولا يتحور وأفريقيا تكثف إجراءات الطوارئ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus mutates and Africa steps up emergency measures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows a possible mutation of Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with Africa CDC and WHO planning studies to verify changes and enhance response. May 15 saw the first cases, though transmission may have started in January. As of August 4, INSP reports 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths; officials say infections now exceed 4,000. This is the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history, surpassing the 2014–2018 West Africa outbreak (11,000 deaths). Transmission appears widespread: two-thirds of deaths occur in communities, and only about ten contacts per patient are traced versus a recommended 40. The response shifts to active case finding with door-to-door teams; Remdesivir is considered for humanitarian use, and Ervebo vaccine is being studied for potential benefit. Uganda reports 20 cases. A suspected Ebola death on a boat to Kinshasa triggers quarantine and testing of all passengers. UNICEF warns of disrupted health services, including measles vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが変異、アフリカが緊急対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目の規模となるエボラ出血熱の流行が発生し、ウイルス変異の疑いや国境を越えた拡大（ウガンダへの伝播、キンシャサ行き船舶での感染疑い）が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの20症例報告があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ウイルス変異の可能性についてはAfrica CDCとWHOが検証研究を計画中で、確定情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dozens of health workers in Congo protest over lack of payment during Ebola crisis
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, dozens of health workers in Congo's Ebola outbreak protested at the governor's office in Bunia, Ituri province, demanding unpaid wages and bonuses since the outbreak was declared in mid-May 2026. Ituri accounts for nearly 90% of Congo's Ebola cases, underscoring the outbreak's concentration in this remote region, described as the second-largest in history. Frontline staff, including critical-care nurses, reported not receiving pay for their Ebola response, fueling continued walkouts despite officials attributing delays to logistical issues. The protests come amid persistent risks to health workers and facilities, including attacks by rebels and angry mobs. Authorities did not respond to inquiries on Thursday. The demonstration highlights ongoing challenges in retaining frontline workers and financing outbreak response in Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ危機下、数十人の医療従事者が未払い賃金を巡り抗議
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目の規模とされるエボラ出血熱の流行が継続中であり、医療従事者への未払い賃金による抗議行動が対応能力を損なうリスクがあるため、公衆衛生上の影響が深刻でフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事自体は医療従事者への未払い賃金を巡る抗議に焦点を当てているが、背景にあるエボラ流行はイトゥリ州で全国症例の約9割を占める史上2番目規模の大規模流行であり、対応体制の維持に懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : l'Unicef alerte sur les effets collatéraux de l'épidémie d'Ebola sur les enfants - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: UNICEF Warns About the Collateral Effects of the Ebola Outbreak on Children - ACP.
article.articleSummary: UNICEF warns collateral effects of the Ebola outbreak in Ituri, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, on children. Data for April–June 2026 show fear of infection and outbreak disruptions reducing attendance at health facilities in epicenters Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nizi, and Rwampara. As of August 2, 2026, 743 confirmed Ebola cases and 330 deaths occurred among 0–17-year-olds, with under-5 fatalities more than twice those of adults, marking the worst Ebola epidemic in DRC to date. The crisis coincides with declines in measles vaccination and in prenatal care and assisted deliveries due to weakened essential health services. UNICEF has raised its appeal to $113.45 million, with only $23.5 million mobilized so far. Five provinces are affected: Haut-Uele, Tshopo, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ：ユニセフ、エボラ流行が子どもに及ぼす副次的影響について警鐘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪とされるエボラ流行が進行中で、子ども743例確認・330人死亡という深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC北東部イトゥリ州を中心とするエボラ流行（史上最悪規模）とその子どもへの副次的影響（麻疹ワクチン接種率低下、産前ケア減少等）に焦点。ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及なく、感染確認情報もないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde de Iracemápolis alerta população sobre febre maculosa | Rápido no Ar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Iracemápolis Health Department alerts the public about Brazilian spotted fever | Rápido no Ar.
article.articleSummary: Iracemápolis Municipal Health Department, São Paulo state, alerts the public to Brazilian spotted fever (Rickettsia rickettsii) transmitted by Amblyomma ticks (star tick), as Brazil experiences a notable rise in cases this season. The disease can be severe and fatal if untreated. Incubation is 2–14 days after a tick bite; early signs include high fever, severe headache, muscle pains, chills, and malaise, followed by a red skin patch that does not blanch with pressure. Immediate healthcare should be sought for evaluation and diagnosis. Prevention emphasizes avoiding vegetation-rich areas, wearing long sleeves and pants, light-colored clothing, using insect repellents, and regularly inspecting and removing ticks. Domestic animals should receive veterinary treatment to control ticks. Health Secretary Ralf Silva stresses early detection for successful treatment. Exposed individuals should visit Family Health Units (USFs) or urgent care if fever and symptoms arise after forest or rural exposure. For more information, contact local health units.

triage.headline_ja: イラセマポリス保健局が住民にブラジル紅斑熱（斑点熱）について注意喚起 | Rápido no Ar
triage.triage_reason: ダニ媒介性のロッキー山紅斑熱（ブラジル紅斑熱）に関する自治体レベルの啓発情報であり、症例増加が指摘されているが、ヒト-ヒト感染はなく国際的拡大リスクは低い。続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州イラセマポリス市の保健局による季節性の予防啓発であり、具体的な症例数や集団発生の規模は記載されていない。ダニ媒介性疾患でヒト-ヒト感染はなく、国際的拡大の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 印度紧急派遣医疗队，应对罕见病毒暴发_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India Urgently Dispatches a Medical Team to Tackle a Rare Virus Outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-06, India has urgently dispatched a multidisciplinary medical team to Gujarat and Rajasthan to tackle an outbreak of Gandipura virus. The team, comprising epidemiologists, virologists, and veterinary specialists, will strengthen local authorities’ work on disease research, patient care, and vector monitoring, while examining viral samples for potential genetic mutations. Sandflies are believed to be the primary transmission vector. Gandipura virus is a rare pathogen first identified in India in 1965, mainly infecting children under 15 and causing acute encephalitis with a high fatality rate. Outbreaks have occurred mainly in central and western India during the monsoon season. In 2024, an outbreak in Gujarat led to dozens of child deaths. The current effort prioritizes rapid field investigation, laboratory confirmation, and monitoring of the infection source to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: インド、まれなウイルスの流行対応のため緊急医療チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「異常性」の2つに該当し、小児の急性脳炎で高い致死率を伴う稀少ウイルス（チャンディプラウイルス）の流行に対しインド政府が緊急対応を行っている。
triage.notes: Chandipura virus（サンドフライ媒介、小児の急性脳炎、高致死率）は過去にも2024年グジャラート州で複数の小児死亡例あり。ヒト-ヒト感染は確認されておらず国際的拡大リスクは低いが、モンスーン季における継続的な媒介動物曝露と重症度から経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Un dispositif de contrôle sanitaire pour freiner Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A public health surveillance system to curb Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 5 August, a boat from Yakata in Bumba Territory arrived at Bende-Bende port in Kinshasa and was placed under health surveillance after a passenger with Ebola-symptom-compatible illness died after disembarking in Kisangani; the patient has not been tested yet. The vessel remains offshore and passengers are not allowed to disembark. Mireille Lembwadio of the National Program for Border Hygiene describes rapid multisectoral screening deployed within 48 hours, including hand washing, temperature checks, and a traveller health form detailing identity, age, sex, origin, transit, and final destination to enable follow-up if needed. Kinshasa reports no confirmed Ebola cases to date. For the Mongala-bound boat with over 200 people, comprehensive screening will be conducted, with potential on-site or designated-location quarantine decisions, and decontamination of the vessel and wood logs if necessary, per authorities’ guidance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ拡大を食い止めるための公衆衛生監視体制
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疑い症例による死亡が報告され、船舶隔離や検疫等の渡航制限措置が既に実施されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 死亡例はエボラ未確定（検査未実施）であり、キンシャサでは確認例なしと報告されている点に留意。続報でPCR検査結果の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tedros se reúne con Tshisekedi para reforzar la respuesta al ébola en la RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros meets with Tshisekedi to bolster the Ebola response in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has killed 1,801 people. On 6 August 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and DRC President Félix Tshisekedi agreed to urgently strengthen and broaden the response, tailoring it to the outbreak's speed and trajectory. They stressed government-led coordination and unity among partners to implement a shared strategy. The discussions, described as very constructive by Tedros on X, followed a Wednesday meeting in Kinshasa. The gathering was chaired by Tshisekedi and attended by Prime Minister Judith Suminwa, other government officials involved in the response, AU Public Health Agency chief Jean Kaseya, and other health and humanitarian leaders.

triage.headline_ja: テドロスがチセケディ大統領と会談、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応強化へ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)による死者1,801人という重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、WHO事務局長とDRC大統領が直接対応強化を協議するなど国際的関心・政治的関与が高いため。
triage.notes: 死者数1,801人という規模から既に大規模流行が進行中であり、フルRRAでの評価が必要。国際的拡大の有無や渡航制限措置については記事内に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola case on packed Congo river boat sparks testing rush
article.articleSummary: On a river boat en route from Kisangani to Kinshasa, authorities detained the vessel near Maluku after a 32-year-old passenger disembarked in Pimu, Mongala province, developed symptoms and died; a mobile clinic was set up to test more than 200 passengers. The Democratic Republic of Congo is amid its worst Ebola outbreak, with nearly 4,000 cases and about 1,801 deaths reported in latest government figures, across five provinces, though over 90% of cases have been in Ituri. No other traveller deaths have been reported. Health workers, unpaid and protesting, have halted wages and abandoned facilities, complicating response. Ebola spreads by contact with bodily fluids; those treating patients or burying the dead are at high risk, and rumors have fueled hostility toward health workers. The case remains suspected, not confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの満員川船でエボラ疑い例、検査が急がれる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の過去最大規模のエボラ流行下、200人以上が乗船する川船で疑い例が発生し死亡しており、人的往来を介した拡大リスクと医療従事者の対応能力低下が重なっているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 現時点では疑い例であり確定診断は未了。DRCでは既に約4000症例・1801人死亡という過去最悪規模のエボラ流行が進行中で、医療従事者の未払い賃金による抗議・離職が対応を複雑化させている。川船という人口密集・移動性の高い環境での疑い例発生は感染拡大リスクを高める要因。

article.articleHeadline: Congo intercepts passenger boat over Ebola fears
article.articleSummary: On 6 August 2026, Congolese health authorities intercepted a boat carrying about 200 people from Kisangani to Kinshasa after a passenger who had disembarked earlier died on 25 July with Ebola-like symptoms. The vessel was stopped at Maluku, a river port about 65 km from Kinshasa, raising concerns of transmission to the capital’s population of over 17 million. A mobile laboratory was deployed to test all onboard. The 32-year-old man who died had disembarked in Mongala province roughly 550 km downstream before symptom onset; Mongala officials reported no sample was collected due to kit shortages. No other deaths were reported among travellers. The outbreak spans five provinces, including Tshopo, with seven confirmed cases. Overall, 3,973 infections and 1,801 deaths have been reported, per government data released on Wednesday.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ感染懸念により旅客船を拿捕
triage.triage_reason: DRCで既に3,973例・1,801死亡という大規模なエボラアウトブレイクが継続中であり、首都キンシャサへの拡大懸念から旅客船が拿捕されるなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い事案。
triage.notes: 致死率約45%（1801/3973）と非常に高く、5州にまたがる大規模流行。検体採取キット不足など対応能力の限界も示唆されており、国際支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: تحذيرات من تحور إيبولا في الكونغو - Lebanese Forces Official Website
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warnings about an Ebola mutation in Congo
article.articleSummary: DRC faces one of its deadliest Ebola outbreaks, amid concerns the Bundibugyo strain may be mutating. WHO-assisted studies will examine genetic changes in the current virus. By Aug 4, 2026, laboratory-confirmed cases reached 3,973 with 1,801 deaths; Africa CDC later cited over 4,000 cases, ranking it the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. Transmission began in January and was publicly announced May 15. More than two-thirds of deaths occur in communities rather than treatment centers, signaling widespread transmission; contact tracing averages about 10 contacts per case, far below the target 40. Authorities shift to active case finding via mobile teams; Remdesivir is considered under compassionate use, Ervebo evaluated for potential use. The outbreak extends across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo; Uganda reports 20 cases. A separate probe investigates a suspected Ebola death aboard a boat to Kinshasa; passengers quarantined. UNICEF warns of indirect health impacts, including reduced measles vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ変異に関する警告
triage.triage_reason: 史上2番目の規模とされるDRCエボラ流行で、変異の懸念、致死率の高さ、ウガンダへの越境拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでの20例確認にも言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ボンディブギョ株の変異調査結果は続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo tests passengers after boat that carried suspected Ebola case intercepted near Kinshasa
article.articleSummary: Congo authorities intercepted a river boat near Kinshasa, screening over 300 passengers after a 32-year-old man who died on July 25 was suspected of Ebola. A mobile laboratory was deployed at Maluku (about 65 km upstream from Kinshasa); four symptomatic passengers (fever) were sampled and sent for testing, with results due Friday. Authorities give conflicting accounts of the man’s origin: Kisangani in Tshopo province has been cited, while Africa CDC says the vessel originated from Mongala province, where no Ebola cases have been recorded. The case prompted expanded use of the Zaire ebolavirus vaccine due to data suggesting partial protection against Bundibugyo, which is driving the current outbreak, and plans to broaden remdesivir use in affected areas. Imported/export-related details remain pending as laboratory results come in. Keywords: Ebola, Congo, Kinshasa, Kisangani, Mongala, Bundibugyo, vaccination, remdesivir.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、キンシャサ近郊で拿捕されたエボラ疑い患者搭乗の船の乗客を検査
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の疑い例がコンゴの首都キンシャサに接近した船で発生し、ヒトーヒト感染リスクと国際的拡大の懸念があり、既存のBundibugyo株アウトブレイクとの関連が疑われるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既存のBundibugyoエボラアウトブレイクとの関連が疑われる新規疑い例。感染者の出発地に関する情報が矛盾しており（キサンガニ vs モンガラ）、検査結果待ちの段階。首都キンシャサへの接近という点で拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Worsening Rapidly in DR Congo, Warns WHO Chief Tedros
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, concentrated in eastern Ituri province, has reached 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths, with 717 in isolation and 749 recovered. The rare Bundibugyo strain, for which no licensed vaccine or treatment exists, is driving the surge, and emergency trials are underway. Began mid-March 2026, it is the fastest-spreading and second-deadliest outbreak in the DRC’s history. About 90% of infections are in Ituri near the Uganda border; limited cases have appeared elsewhere. Health authorities report infections doubling in some hotspots over the past week. WHO Chief Tedros Ghebreyesus urged massive scale-up across response pillars, community engagement, health-worker protection, and improved surveillance and safe burials, despite insecurity and worker strikes delaying tracing. A Maluku (Kinshasa) incident—a barge passenger from Kisangani with Ebola-like symptoms—triggered precautionary isolation but was not confirmed Ebola. US pledged $242 million; Level 4 travel advisory remains for DRC, Uganda, South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、コンゴ民主共和国で急速に悪化―WHO事務局長テドロス氏が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当し、致死率の高い稀な株（Bundibugyo）による急速拡大、ウガンダ国境付近での感染拡大、渡航制限（Level4）も発令されており、フルリスク評価が必要な重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境リスクが指摘されているが、記事の主題はDRC国内（特にイトゥリ州）での流行であり、これら周辺国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。キンシャサ（マルク）での疑い例は未確定のため参考情報として扱った。

article.articleHeadline: وكالة صحية أفريقية ومنظمة الصحة العالمية تطلبان التحقيق في احتمال تحور فيروس "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An African health agency and the World Health Organization call for an investigation into the possibility of the Ebola virus mutating.
article.articleSummary: Africa CDC director-general John Kasia and the World Health Organization call for a joint investigation into a possible mutation of the Ebola virus amid a rapidly spreading outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Kasia says the severity of this Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak is unprecedented, with studies planned to determine whether there has been a mutation. He notes authorities should assume about 4,000 cases, as the current confirmed total surpasses 3,900 the previous day. The outbreak is more than eight times larger than the same stage of West Africa’s 2014 outbreak, and deaths are more than sixfold higher. Ebola is highly transmissible, spreading from wildlife to humans and then person-to-person via bodily fluids (vomiting, blood, semen) and contaminated surfaces. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pain, and sometimes internal/external bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの保健機関とWHO、エボラウイルスの変異の可能性について調査を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で前例のない規模のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が急拡大しており、ウイルス変異の可能性も指摘されるなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態であり、国際的拡大リスクも高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国のブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱の急拡大とウイルス変異可能性に関する調査要請が主題。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが本文では言及なく対象国リストにも該当しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC and WHO call for urgent, community-led action to contain Ebola in the DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompts Africa CDC and WHO to urge urgent, community-led scale-up. As of 4 August 2026, DRC reports 3,973 confirmed cases, 1,801 deaths and 776 recoveries across 51 health zones in five provinces; 99 new cases and 52 deaths were recorded in the latest 24 hours. Contact follow-up stands at 75%, below the 95% target; 674 people are under care, and North Kivu treatment centres are operating at 139% occupancy. Ituri Province accounts for nearly 90% of cases, with Bunia, Rwampara and Mongbwalu among the hardest hit. Uganda’s outbreak ended on 28 July 2026 after 20 cases and 2 deaths, with all contacts followed up. The mission calls for earlier case detection, 95% daily contact follow-up, closer testing and treatment access, expanded capacity, frontline worker support, safe and dignified burials, trusted community engagement, cross-border surveillance, and timely financing.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCとWHO、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の封じ込めに向け、地域社会主導の緊急対応を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで3,973例・1,801人死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続し、治療センターが過剰稼働、接触者追跡率も目標未達であり、国際機関が緊急対応を要請していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの関連流行は2026年7月28日に終息済みと報告されているため、対象国リストに含まれないウガンダ・ルワンダは verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Posibilă mutație a virusului Ebola în Congo. OMS investighează "virusul mutant" responsabil de epidemia severă - Știrile ProTV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Possible mutation of the Ebola virus in the Congo. WHO investigates the 'mutant virus' responsible for the severe outbreak - ProTV News.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo variant, is the largest yet seen in the country. Confirmed cases exceed 3,900, with estimates up to 4,000, eightfold higher at this stage than the West Africa 2014 outbreak, and deaths are reported as sixfold higher than the same interval. The Bundibugyo variant is among the rare Ebola strains, and there is no approved vaccine yet. A clinical trial for a new Bundibugyo-targeted vaccine is underway, while authorities rely on isolation and meticulous contact tracing to limit spread. The ongoing outbreak is the most extensive Congo has faced, surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic (roughly 2,300 deaths). A joint Africa CDC–WHO investigation aims to determine whether a mutation underlies the rapid transmission and to adapt response strategies in a race to save lives.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスの変異の可能性。WHOが重症流行の原因となった「変異ウイルス」を調査
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が発生し、死者・症例数が急増、ワクチン未承認で国際機関が調査に乗り出しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及なしのため除外。ウイルス変異の有無はWHO・Africa CDCが調査中で未確定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola virus reaches displacement camps in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached displacement camps in Ituri. In Ituri, 19 internally displaced people are infected and 5 have died; at least five of the 69 displacement camps report Ebola cases. Across the outbreak, nearly 4,000 cases and more than 1,800 deaths have been recorded since it was declared on 15 May. UNHCR says no cases have been reported among refugees or asylum-seekers, reducing immediate cross-border spread risk. Provinces affected are Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo, hosting about 4.4 million internally displaced people. Response efforts are overwhelmed; surveillance, laboratory testing, treatment, and community engagement are expanding, with Ebola Treatment Centres supported and CERF allocating up to $60 million. Tedros urged intensified countermeasures, including protecting health workers and safe burials, and stronger coordination with the government and Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス、コンゴ民主共和国の国内避難民キャンプに到達
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが拡大し、約4,000症例・1,800人以上の死者を記録、国内避難民キャンプにも到達しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際支援が必要な状況であるため。
triage.notes: UNHCRは難民・庇護希望者への感染例はないとしており越境リスクはやや低減しているが、440万人のIDPが集中する複数州で拡大が続いており、既存の大規模アウトブレイクとして継続的な監視・支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in DR Congo: 330 Children Dead, UNICEF Warns
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed 330 children and recorded 743 confirmed cases among those 17 and under as of Aug 2, UNICEF said. Children account for nearly one in four confirmed cases but almost one in three deaths; under-five case fatality rate is more than double that of adults. The outbreak disrupts essential health services, with declines in immunisation and maternal care, driving increases in malaria, diarrhoea and other treatable illnesses. As of Aug 2, the DRC reported 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths since May 15. Doctors Without Borders warns the situation in eastern DRC is critical and accelerating. Health authorities intercepted a passenger boat near Kinshasa from Tshopo province after a former passenger died with Ebola-suspected symptoms; the vessel was halted 65 km from central Kinshasa, with a mobile lab testing all aboard and a security/health cordon in place.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでエボラ流行:子ども330人死亡、ユニセフが警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行が継続中(3,973例、1,801死亡)であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスク（キンシャサへの拡散懸念）が確認されるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: キンシャサ近郊で疑い患者を乗せた船舶が拘束されるなど、首都への拡散リスクが高まっている点に注意。マラリア等基礎医療サービスの機能不全も二次的リスクとして言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo monitors nearly 200 boat passengers after a traveler dies with Ebola-like symptoms
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, Congo authorities monitor nearly 200 passengers aboard a Congo River boat near Kinshasa after a traveler died with Ebola-like symptoms. The outbreak, declared in May, has reached about 4,000 confirmed cases and more than 1,800 deaths. The deceased fell ill in Pimu, Mongala province, more than 1,000 km from Kinshasa; the boat's passengers are tested and quarantined while awaiting results. Kinshasa has no confirmed cases. Ebola spreads via bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces. Ituri province remains the epicenter, with roughly 674 patients in isolation; about 75% of contacts are being traced, yet many new infections arise from sources not monitored in remote areas where conflict and mining hinder access. Protests by health workers over unpaid wages disrupt care, and WHO's Tedros warned of the urgent need to protect responders, as MSF notes alarming, rapid spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ様症状で死亡した旅行者の後、船の乗客約200人を監視
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行が拡大し（約4000症例、1800人超死亡）、キンシャサ近郊への拡散懸念（船の乗客監視）があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: エボラ流行はイトゥリ州を震源地に拡大中で、キンシャサ近郊への感染拡大懸念（船の乗客監視）が新たなリスク要因。医療従事者のストライキや紛争・鉱山地帯でのアクセス困難が対応を阻害しており、WHO・MSFも警戒を強めている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : l'UNICEF alerte sur une crise sanitaire aggravée, les enfants en première ligne - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: UNICEF warns of a worsening health crisis, children on the front lines - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, is described as the most severe outbreak on record in the country. As of August 2, 2026, health authorities reported 743 confirmed Ebola cases among children aged 0–17, with 330 related deaths. UNICEF warns that indirect effects are eroding essential health services: health facility utilization fell 42% in April–June 2026 in outbreak hubs Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nizi, and Rwampara, driven by fear of infection and disrupted healthcare. Vaccination programs suffer, including a 69% drop in measles immunization in Mongbwalu, and maternal health services show markedly reduced prenatal visits and assisted deliveries. The extended outbreak is straining routine child health care, threatening additional preventable deaths from other diseases. UNICEF raised its emergency appeal to $113.45 million, but only $23.5 million has been mobilized, creating a significant funding gap that could compromise ongoing interventions and child protection efforts.

triage.headline_ja: イツリでのエボラ:ユニセフが悪化する保健危機を警告、子どもたちが最前線に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で史上最悪規模とされるエボラ流行が継続し、743例・330死亡という深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、保健システム崩壊や国際支援不足も報告されているため。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国イツリ州（ブニア、マングバルワロ、ニジ等）でのエボラ流行に焦点。ルワンダ（キガリ州）は発生地域リストに含まれるがサマリー本文では言及されておらず、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。麻疹ワクチン接種率低下（69%減）も間接的影響として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de raiva em morcegos urbanos e rebanhos bovinos disparam em SP e SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies cases in urban bats and cattle herds surge in São Paulo and Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Rabies cases surge in urban bats and cattle herds in São Paulo and Santa Catarina, Brazil. In 2026, Santa Catarina confirms 27 cattle deaths from rabies, including a recent case in Itapiranga; São Paulo records at least 9 rabies-positive urban bats in the first months of 2026, with a case in Piracicaba’s São Dimas district. Surveillance shows bat circulation in Piracicaba, Cotia, Sorocaba, and São José do Rio Preto; Ceará, Minas Gerais, and Mato Grosso do Sul have also reported positive detections in insectivorous and frugivorous bats. Rabies is a near-100% fatal encephalitis transmitted mainly via saliva from the hematophagous Desmodus rotundus bite, risking humans and domestic animals. Preventive measures include vaccinating cattle and pets, installing barriers, keeping homes lit and sealed, and reporting bat sightings. If exposure occurs, wash wounds for 15 minutes, seek urgent care, and start post-exposure prophylaxis.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州とサンタカタリーナ州で都市部コウモリと牛群の狂犬病症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: 動物（コウモリ・牛）での狂犬病症例急増が報告されているが、ヒト症例は確認されておらず、社会的関心の程度も不明なため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率がほぼ100%の疾患だが、現時点ではヒト感染症例の報告はなく動物（コウモリ・牛）における感染拡大の段階。人への曝露リスク増大の可能性があり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Περισσότεροι από 1.700 οι νεκροί από τον ιό Έμπολα στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,700 dead from the Ebola virus in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo faces the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak recorded there, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no licensed vaccines exist. Since mid-May 2026, confirmed cases total 3,874 with 1,751 deaths, with Bunia, capital of Ituri Province, accounting for over 90% of infections. Uganda has contained its outbreak, but transmission in eastern DRC is accelerating, making this the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history after West Africa’s 2014–2016 surge. The response is hampered by armed conflict, population displacement, and collapsing water and sanitation infrastructure. At least 12 health facilities have been attacked. In Bunia’s Elikya Ebola Treatment Center, the 90-bed isolation ward runs at full capacity, cared for by only two to three nurses among dozens of severely ill patients. Government delays in paying health workers raise fears that absenteeism could collapse the health system and worsen spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスにより1,700人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行が進行中で、死者数が急増し、治安悪化・医療崩壊のリスクも高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの流行は封じ込められたと記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アンゴラも記事本文上の言及がなく除外。武力紛争・医療従事者への攻撃・給与未払い等、対応をさらに困難にする要因が多数存在。
