article.articleHeadline: City sees sharp H1N1 spike with 1,344 cases this season | Delhi News
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 1,344 H1N1 cases this season, up from 229 last year to Sept; this season H1N1 is the dominant influenza A subtype (last year ~4,000 total influenza cases, mostly H3N2). H1N1 spreads via respiratory droplets; most cases are mild but pose higher risk to older adults, pregnant women, young children, and those with chronic illness or weakened immunity; 1–2% may require hospitalization. DDU Hospital screens suspected cases; Safdarjung Hospital reported at least 11 confirmed H1N1 in July and five by Aug 5. Private hospitals across Delhi-NCR report rises (Sarvodaya Hospital Faridabad; Paras Health Gurgaon; Indraprastha Apollo Hospital). Govt is expediting screening, testing, admission and treatment; antivirals should be taken only on physician’s advice. Symptoms: influenza-like illness, fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, breathlessness. Protect with vaccination, hand hygiene and cough etiquette; some patients progress to severe viral pneumonia needing ICU care.

triage.headline_ja: デリー市、今シーズンH1N1感染者急増で1,344件に | デリーニュース
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)の症例数が前年比で大幅増加しており、WPRO基準の複数項目（異常性、重症化リスク、感染拡大の可能性）に該当し、政府・メディアの関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: デリーにおける季節性H1N1インフルエンザの症例増加。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないが、前年比大幅増と重症化例（ICU収容含む）があり、地域内での経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo tests over 300 passengers after suspected Ebola death on boat
article.articleSummary: DR Congo health authorities screened more than 300 passengers aboard a river boat intercepted near Kinshasa in Maluku, about 65 km upstream, after the death of a passenger suspected of Ebola raised concerns the virus may have spread on board. A mobile laboratory was deployed, and all passengers underwent temperature checks and clinical screening. Samples from four symptomatic passengers, including fever, were collected and sent for testing, with results expected on Friday (as of 2026-08-07). The operation followed the July 25 death of a 32-year-old man suspected of Ebola who was believed to have traveled on the vessel. Officials have given differing accounts of the man’s movements and where he may have contracted the virus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、ボート内でのエボラ疑い死亡後に300人以上の乗客を検査
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の疑い症例がボート内で発生し、多数の乗客への曝露と拡散の可能性があるため、IHR基準の複数該当およびWPRO基準の該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 感染源となった死亡者の行動履歴について当局の説明に矛盾があり、感染経路の特定が未確定。検査結果（8月7日以降予定）待ちの段階であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Alto Tietê reforça vacinação após confirmação de diversos casos de sarampo no estado; confira onde se imunizar em Suzano, Mogi das Cruzes, Itaquaquecetuba e região
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alto Tietê steps up vaccination after confirmation of several measles cases in the state; see where to get vaccinated in Suzano, Mogi das Cruzes, Itaquaquecetuba and the surrounding region.
article.articleSummary: 16 measles cases confirmed in São Paulo state in 2026 prompt Alto Tietê health authorities to boost vaccination, though the region currently has no confirmed cases. Free measles-mumps-rubella vaccine is available at Basic Health Units as part of a multivaccination campaign running through September 1, with a National Day of Mobilization on August 22. Vaccination schedule follows the National Immunization Schedule: 12-month-olds first MMR dose; 15-month-olds second dose (preferably tetraviral); ages 5–29 two doses; ages 30–59 one dose; health workers two doses; dose-zero for 6–11 months. The multivaccination effort also includes polio, meningitis, hepatitis A and B, influenza, Covid-19, HPV, yellow fever, varicella, rotavirus, pneumococcal and meningococcal vaccines. In Suzano, 24 UBSs operate with over 85,000 doses; Day D on August 22. Mogi das Cruzes has no measles since 2012; Itaquaquecetuba, Poá, Ferraz de Vasconcelos also participating. Check local health portals for UBS addresses.

triage.headline_ja: アルト・チエテ地域、州内でのはしか複数症例確認を受けワクチン接種を強化。スザノ、モジ・ダス・クルーゼス、イタクアクエセトゥーバ及び周辺地域での接種場所を確認
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹16例確認との報道だが、対象地域（アルト・チエテ）では確認例なく、行政の予防的ワクチン接種強化の告知が主旨であり緊急性は低いが、麻疹の発生動向として経過観察の価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事は主にワクチン接種キャンペーンの広報が目的であり、麻疹症例数（16例）の詳細な疫学情報（発症日、重症度、感染経路など）は記載されていない。州全体での発生状況の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Campinas utiliza drones para eliminar criadouros do mosquito da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas City Hall uses drones to eliminate dengue mosquito breeding grounds.
article.articleSummary: Campinas’ Unified Response Group (GRU) used drones to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites in seven properties across Vila Boa Vista, Vila União, Jardim Morumbi, Jardim Melina I, Parque Dom Pedro II, Jardim do Lago and Parque da Figueira on 6 August 2026. The operation, aimed at preventing dengue, chikungunya and Zika transmission, involved staff from Health, Public Works, Climate, Environment and Sustainability, Urbanism, Municipal Guard, Civil Defense, Procon and Setec, with judicial access after prior attempts. Since March 2024, GRU has conducted 30 inspections of 266 properties. On the same day, Campinas issued the 32nd Arboviroses Alert for 2026, noting 22 bairros at high transmission risk across East, Northwest, North, Southwest, South and Southeast regions. From 1 January to 3 August 2026, 3,658 dengue cases were confirmed; 1,043,650 property visits and 53,382 fogging operations were recorded. Residents are urged to remove indoor breeding sites, refresh plant water every two days, clean saucers weekly, seal water tanks, and keep unused toilets closed (noting 80% of breeding sites are inside homes).

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナス市役所、ドローンを使ってデング熱媒介蚊の発生源を駆除
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の症例数は多いが、これは既存の恒常的な対策活動を報じる内容であり、突発的な異常事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はカンピーナス市の日常的な蚊媒介感染症対策（ドローン活用、警報発令、症例数報告）に関するもので、地方自治体による定例的な公衆衛生活動の報告。年間3,658例のデング熱症例は季節的流行の範囲内と考えられ、重症度や国際的懸念の情報は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Congo testa passageiros após interceptação de embarcação com suspeita de caso de Ebola perto de Kinshasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo tests passengers after interception of a vessel with a suspected Ebola case near Kinshasa.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a river vessel intercepted near Kinshasa prompted health authorities to screen nearly 300 passengers after the death of a traveler suspected of having Ebola, raising concerns of onboard transmission. A mobile laboratory was dispatched to the Maluku waypoint, about 65 km upstream from Kinshasa, on Wednesday. As of 6 August 2026, all passengers are undergoing temperature checks and clinical examinations to identify potential Ebola infection. The precautionary measures reflect heightened vigilance for Ebola in the DRC amid ongoing concerns about spillover in riverine transport routes. The article notes only a suspected case and ongoing tests; laboratory confirmation results were not reported at the time.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、キンシャサ近郊でエボラ疑い例のある船舶を拿捕後、乗客を検査
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤な疾患の疑い例が首都キンシャサ近郊の河川交通で発生し、約300人が曝露した可能性があるため、ヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクと社会的関心の観点からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 疑い例であり検査結果は未確定。確定診断結果や感染源、他地域への拡大有無について続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: V KDR po podozrení na ebolu dali do karantény plavidlo s vyše 200 ľuďmi - Svet SME
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, on suspicion of Ebola, a vessel carrying more than 200 people was quarantined - World SME.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, authorities quarantined the cargo vessel Yingfeng 2, carrying more than 200 people, after a passenger died with Ebola-like symptoms. The Chinese-operated ship was halted near the Bende Bende port about 65 km upstream of Kinshasa along the Congo River. A mobile laboratory was set up by the DRC Ministry of Health and the WHO, and security forces ordered quarantine to prevent potential spread to the capital, while Kinshasa boosts outbreak readiness. As of testing, none of the more than 200 aboard had Ebola-positive results, and officials cautioned the infection might not be confirmed within the 21-day incubation. The deceased disembarked in Mongala province and died in hospital; two more adults, a 3-year-old, and a newborn also died, cause unclear. The ongoing outbreak, the 17th in DRC since May 15, is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which no treatment or approved vaccine exists, with 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ疑いで200人以上を乗せた船舶を検疫隔離 - World SME
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当し、進行中のエボラ流行（第17次流行、ブンディブギョ株）で首都キンシャサ近郊での船舶検疫という異例の事態が発生しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事中の累計症例数（3,973例）・死亡数（1,801例）は現行の第17次流行としては非常に大きく、過去の複数流行の累積値である可能性がある。数値の正確性は続報で確認が必要。船内の検査では陽性者は確認されていないが、潜伏期間内であるため経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo health workers protest unpaid wages as WHO warns Ebola spreading faster than response scale-up
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, health workers in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, protested unpaid wages since May as Ebola spreads faster than the scale-up of the response. Protests outside the governor’s office in Bunia reflect strain on healthcare amid ongoing conflict. Ituri remains the outbreak’s epicenter; official data report 3,973 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,801 deaths, with 674 patients in isolation, mostly in Ituri. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that new cases are doubling in some hotspots over the past week and urged urgent, massive scaling up across all response pillars. The outbreak was declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. The United States announced an additional $242 million donation, bringing America’s total contribution to tackling the Ebola outbreak in DRC to over $500 million.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の医療従事者、未払い賃金に抗議 WHOはエボラが対応の拡大速度を上回って拡散していると警告
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ流行が加速し、死者数・症例数が増加、WHOが緊急対応拡大を要請しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 米国が5億ドル超の資金拠出を表明するなど国際的関与が拡大しており、PHEIC継続中の重大イベントとして即時フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: Πάνω από 4.000 κρούσματα - Φόβοι για μετάλλαξη του ιού
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: Over 4,000 cases - Fears of virus mutation.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) driven by the Bundibugyo strain. First detected May 15, with transmission possibly starting in January. By August 4, 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths; Africa CDC later reported over 4,000 cases. It is the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history, with approximately eight times more cases and six times more deaths than the early West Africa outbreak (2014–2018). Investigations into potential mutations are underway, with WHO and Africa CDC collaborating on studies. More than two-thirds of deaths occur outside treatment centers; MSF’s Bunia unit reports 90% of admissions are not in known-contact lists, indicating hidden transmission. Authorities shift to active, community-based case finding, including door-to-door visits and digital tools, across ITURI and expanding to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. Uganda reports 20 cases but containment achieved. Remdesivir and Ervebo vaccine are being explored; preliminary data show milder disease among vaccinated individuals.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ流行:症例4,000人超―ウイルス変異への懸念
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目規模のエボラ流行が発生し、死亡者1,800人超、コミュニティ内での隠れ感染や変異懸念があり、ウガンダへの越境例も報告されているためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRC国内複数州(Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo)での拡大が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo realiza pruebas a pasajeros tras interceptar embarcación con un presunto caso de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo conducts tests on passengers after intercepting a vessel with a suspected case of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola tests are underway in the Democratic Republic of the Congo after authorities intercepted a river vessel near Kinshasa, screening more than 300 passengers following a death from suspected Ebola. A mobile laboratory was deployed to Maluku, about 65 km upriver, after the boat was detained on August 5, 2026. Four feverish passengers had samples collected and sent for analysis, with results expected Friday. The investigation centers on a 32-year-old man who died July 25 and is believed to have traveled on the boat. Origin remains disputed: Africa CDC says the vessel came from Mongala, where no Ebola cases have been reported, rather than from Tshopo, where an outbreak has occurred; Kisangani—capital of Tshopo—has also been cited as a prior origin. Congo’s health minister says symptoms appeared after disembarking, while Africa CDC notes illness on board.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ疑い症例を乗せた船舶を拿捕後、乗客の検査を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による死亡例と、それに関連する船舶乗客300人以上への検査という国際的拡散リスクが認められ、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 感染源（Tshopo州かMongala州か）について保健省とAfrica CDCの見解が対立しており、情報が錯綜している点に留意が必要。既存のエボラ流行（Tshopo州）との関連性も含め、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Virusul Ebola, în centrul unei anchete internaționale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus at the center of an international investigation.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo variant has triggered an international investigation by Africa CDC and the World Health Organization into a possible viral mutation as of 6 August 2026. Official counts exceed 3,900 laboratory-confirmed infections, with authorities warning the total could approach 4,000. The scale is eightfold that of the same stage in the 2014 West Africa outbreak, and deaths are reportedly six times higher. Ebola spreads via direct contact with an infected person or their bodily fluids. The Bundibugyo variant is among the least studied and has no approved vaccine; a clinical trial for a new vaccine is already underway. This is the largest Bundibugyo outbreak recorded in the DRC, underscoring concerns given past Ebola spikes in 2014–2015 (West Africa, >11,000 deaths) and 2018–2020 (DRC, ~2,300 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス、国際調査の中心に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の症例が3,900人を超え過去最大規模となり、変異の可能性についてWHO・Africa CDCが国際調査を実施していることから、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクの複数のIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文はDRCでの発生のみを主題としており、Angolaは対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला का बढ़ता खतरा, 330 बच्चों की मौत यूनिसेफ | Ituri: Health workers respond to Ebola outbreak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising threat of Ebola in Congo; UNICEF: 330 children dead | Ituri: Health workers respond to Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has caused 330 child deaths among 743 confirmed cases in people under 18 as of August 2, 2026, with Ituri Province hardest hit and eroding essential health services. UNICEF notes declines in routine vaccination, maternal health and other critical care as fear and access barriers limit care-seeking. Among confirmed cases, about one in four are children, while deaths in this group account for roughly one‑third; under‑five mortality is more than double that of adults. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, the DRC has reported 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths. Doctors Without Borders warns eastern DRC is in a more severe phase, with rapid spread and no signs of slowing. Separately, a passenger boat from Ebola-affected Tshopo Province near Kinshasa was halted after a traveler developed fever and diarrhea and later died; a mobile lab tested all aboard, with no confirmed case yet.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラの脅威拡大、ユニセフ発表:子ども330人死亡 | イトゥリ州:保健従事者がエボラ流行に対応
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラアウトブレイクが継続し、確定例3,973人・死亡1,801人（うち子ども330人死亡）に達しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも顕在化しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: UNICEFおよび国境なき医師団（MSF）が深刻な段階にあると警告しており、拡大が続いている。キンシャサ近郊での旅客船内の疑い例（後に死亡）は、感染拡大が首都圏に及ぶリスクを示唆しており、国際的監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo interceptó un barco para aislar a 200 pasajeros tras la muerte de un hombre con síntomas de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo intercepted a ship to quarantine 200 passengers after the death of a man with Ebola symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo intercepted a passenger boat near Kinshasa after a man died with symptoms compatible with Ebola, triggering preventive quarantine for about 200 passengers. The vessel, departing Kisangani, was detained at Maluku, 65 km from Kinshasa. Health authorities conducted diagnostic tests for all occupants; the deceased had disembarked at Pimbu in Mongala before dying, after seeking medical care. A mobile laboratory tested passengers and crew; no confirmed Ebola cases in Kinshasa or among those on board. The Congo Ebola outbreak began in May and has nearly 4,000 confirmed cases and more than 1,800 deaths. The epicenter is Ituri, with spread to Tshopo, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Haut-Uélé. About 75% of close contacts are under follow-up; most new cases occur outside known transmission chains. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo, with fatality 30–50%. Challenges include surveillance delays, logistics, security issues, and health-worker shortages; WHO warns of unprecedented spread, while aid cuts strain response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ症状で死亡した男性の後、乗客200人を隔離するため船を拿捕
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべて該当（死者1,800人超・致死率30-50%・WHOが前例のない拡大を警告）し、社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ移行すべき事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にNigeria（Kaduna State）が含まれるが、記事本文では言及なくコンゴ国内の事例のみが主題のため除外。既存のエボラ流行（2026年5月発生、約4,000症例・1,800人超死亡、Ituri震源、複数州へ拡大）に関連する船舶隔離事案。

article.articleHeadline: Τσαντ: Στους 13 είναι οι νεκροί από χολέρα - 239 κρούσματα καταγράφηκαν
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chad: 13 dead from cholera - 239 cases recorded
article.articleSummary: Chad reports a cholera outbreak with 239 confirmed cases and 13 deaths as of 3 August 2026, per the Ministry of Health. The epidemic is centered in Hadjer-Lamis prefecture in the north and in the N'Djamena region. A vaccination campaign is underway, with 50,799 people immunized to date. The first cholera death occurred on 13 June, and authorities continue measures to limit spread. Cholera is an acute bacterial infection transmitted via contaminated water or food; prompt hydration is key, and without timely treatment can be fatal within hours. Chad faces persistent water and sanitation challenges, with limited access to safe drinking water and basic hygiene facilities that facilitate transmission. In the broader African context, outbreaks are reported in the Central African Republic, Nigeria, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: チャド：コレラによる死者13人、239件の感染確認
triage.triage_reason: 本記事の主題はチャドにおけるコレラ流行であり、対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは広域アフリカの文脈で一言触れられているのみで、具体的な発生詳細がなく主題とは言えないため除外。
triage.notes: 主要な発生国であるチャドは対象国リストに含まれない。DRC・中央アフリカ・ナイジェリアは『広域アフリカの文脈』として名前が挙がるのみで、具体的な症例数や発生詳細の記載がなく、記事の主題としては扱われていないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Karanténa čínskej lode na rieke Kongo po smrti pasažiera s príznakmi eboly
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quarantine of a Chinese ship on the Congo River after the death of a passenger with Ebola-like symptoms.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-06, the Chinese-operated cargo vessel Yingfeng 2 was quarantined on the Congo River in the Democratic Republic of the Congo after a passenger died with Ebola-like symptoms. Authorities tested over 200 aboard in a mobile laboratory established with WHO and the DRC Ministry of Health; all Ebola tests to date are negative, though the death causes remain unclear. The ship, bound for Kinshasa, was halted at Bende Bende about 65 km downstream from the capital; it had departed Mongala Province, travelling over 1,700 km downstream toward Kinshasa. This incident occurs against the backdrop of the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, driven by the rare Bundibugyo variant with no approved vaccine or targeted therapy. Cumulative outbreak totals: 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths. Kinshasa is bolstering rapid-response capacity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ川で発症者死亡後、エボラ疑いで中国船を隔離
triage.triage_reason: 本件自体はエボラ陰性だが、背景にあるDRC第17次エボラ流行（希少なブンディブギョ株、確定症例3,973人、死亡1,801人）は深刻かつ継続中であり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 船上での死亡例はエボラ検査陰性だが、原因不明のまま。DRCの第17次エボラ流行は承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョ株が原因で、致死率が高く継続中。河川交通を介した拡大リスクにも留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: المركزية | مخاوف من تحور فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو وتفش غير مسبوق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Al-Markazia | Fears of a mutation of the Ebola virus in the Congo and an unprecedented outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with health authorities fearing a mutation in the Bundibugyo strain as of Aug 4, reaching over 4,000 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths (3,973 cases, 1,801 deaths reported by INSP). The outbreak is the second-largest in history, likely circulating since January after first cases were reported May 15. Transmission is highly driven by communities, with most deaths occurring outside treatment centers and contact tracing capturing only about ten contacts per patient instead of the expected forty. Responders are shifting from contact tracing to active case finding via door-to-door teams, and plan to use Remdesivir and consider the Ervebo vaccine, amid early data suggesting milder illness in vaccinated individuals. The outbreak spans Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo; Uganda has reported 20 cases. Separately, a suspected Ebola death on a boat to Kinshasa prompts quarantining and testing of all passengers.

triage.headline_ja: アルマルカジーヤ｜コンゴでのエボラウイルス変異への懸念と前例のない流行
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目の規模となるエボラ流行が進行中で、4000例超・1800人超の死亡、ウガンダへの越境拡大、ウイルス変異の懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ブンディブギョ株の変異懸念、地域社会主導の伝播、接触者追跡の不備など、深刻な流行拡大の兆候が複数見られる。

article.articleHeadline: OMS suspectează o posibilă mutație a virusului Ebola în R.D. Congo. Epidemia atinge un nivel fără precedent
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO suspects a possible mutation of the Ebola virus in the DRC. The epidemic has reached an unprecedented level.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus, Bundibugyo strain, is driving a fast-spreading outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO and Africa CDC are investigating a possible mutation amid rising case numbers. RDC authorities report 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths, with estimates approaching 4,000 cases. The outbreak spans five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haute-Uele, and Tshopo—making it the largest Ebola episode in the country. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids. No vaccine for Bundibugyo is yet approved; several candidates are in development, including a rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine in trials via Moderna in Canada, and an Oxford-derived vaccine using AstraZeneca technology. Trials are also advancing for antivirals Remdesivir, Obeldesivir, and the MBP134 monoclonal antibody. Health authorities warn the epidemic is spreading faster than response capacities, underscoring the urgent need for enhanced international support.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスの変異の可能性を疑う。流行は前例のない水準に達している。
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が発生し、致死率が高く、ウイルス変異の疑いもあり、国際的な支援が急務とされているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: カナダはワクチン臨床試験（Moderna社によるrVSVブンディブギョ株ワクチン）の実施国として言及されているのみで、感染発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: OMS și Africa CDC investighează o posibilă mutație
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and Africa CDC are investigating a possible mutation.
article.articleSummary: August 6, 2026 — Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of Congo, prompting a joint assessment by the World Health Organization and Africa CDC to determine whether a mutation has occurred in the Bundibugyo variant. Authorities report over 3,900 confirmed cases, with estimates reaching about 4,000, and an alarmingly high transmission rate. The severity of this outbreak is described as unprecedented by Africa CDC's Jean Kaseya, noting that current infection and death levels exceed previous epidemics; infections are more than eightfold and deaths roughly sixfold higher than during the 2014–2015 West Africa Ebola outbreak. Transmission remains through direct contact and bodily fluids. There is no officially approved vaccine for Bundibugy​o yet, though a new vaccine candidate is in a clinical trial. Past outbreaks: 2014–2015 West Africa with >11,000 deaths; 2018–2020 eastern DRC about 2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとアフリカCDC、エボラウイルスの変異の可能性を調査
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で前例のない規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が発生し、変異の可能性についてWHOとアフリカCDCが共同調査を行っており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCのみが主題であり、Angolaへの言及がないため除外した。承認済みワクチンがない点、症例数が過去のアウトブレイクを大幅に上回る点は重大な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak, DRC and Region, Situation Report #11, August 6, 2026
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-strain Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) declared May 15; as of Aug 5, 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths in the DRC, with 20 cases and 2 deaths in Uganda. Outbreak concentrated in Ituri province with confirmed cases also in Haut-Uele, North Kivu, South Kivu and Tshopo; Uganda cases linked to transmission originating in the DRC; no confirmed cases in South Sudan, but cross-border risk remains high. International Medical Corps response includes case management, IPC, screening and triage, risk communication, and training; supporting 159 facilities for EVD screening and treatment. Across sites, 305,504 screenings and 988 patients treated (296 confirmed). 2,680 staff trained in EVD case management, response and transmission prevention in the DRC. Hub-and-spoke model with four Ebola Treatment Centers and four Ebola Transit Centers in the DRC (>200 beds). In Uganda, collaboration with a local partner for screening and training; in South Sudan, two infectious diseases units in Juba and Nimule, with a third IDU and four holding stations planned to isolate and manage suspected cases awaiting lab confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、コンゴ民主共和国および周辺地域、状況報告書第11号（2026年8月6日）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で3,973例・1,801死亡という大規模エボラ流行が継続し、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンでの越境リスクも報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC国内でイツリ州を中心に複数州（Haut-Uele, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo）に拡大している大規模流行。

article.articleHeadline: Raiva bovina acende alerta em Santa Catarina, mas casos seguem abaixo dos registrados nos últimos anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bovine Rabies Raises Alarm in Santa Catarina, but Cases Remain Below Those Recorded in Recent Years.
article.articleSummary: Santa Catarina, Brazil reports 27 confirmed bovine rabies cases in 2026, per Cidasc. The disease is present across northern, southern, western, and Vale do Itajaí regions, but this year’s total remains below 2024–2025 levels. Hematophagous bats are the main transmitters, though rabies circulates in wildlife including bats, foxes, saguis, quatis, and gambás. The presence of wildlife does not automatically imply immediate human risk. Captured bats have tested positive, illustrating ongoing circulation. Producers should vaccinate herds, report suspected cases immediately, and note the presence of hematophagous bats to Cidasc. Symptoms in cattle include isolation, behavioral changes, ataxia, excessive salivation, and progressive hind-limb paralysis. Vaccination is the primary prevention: in regions with virus circulation, administer initial dose, boost after 30 days, and revaccinate every 180 days; annual plans should move boosters to six months. Vaccination is advised for cattle, horses, sheep, and goats from three months old; reporting to Cidasc is free.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州で牛狂犬病への警戒高まるも、症例数は近年を下回る水準で推移
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州における牛（家畜）の狂犬病に関する通常の農業・畜産報道であり、症例数は過去数年より少なく、ヒトへの直接的な公衆衛生リスクは明記されていないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は牛（家畜）の狂犬病に関するもので、コウモリ等野生動物からの継続的な感染循環はあるものの、記事内でも野生動物の存在が直ちにヒトへのリスクを意味するものではないと明記されている。ヒト症例や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Awareness drive to curb malaria, dengue | Bhubaneswar News
article.articleSummary: Odisha remains a major malaria hotspot ahead of the monsoon, with 2025 malaria cases totaling 62,137 (about 26.6% of India’s 234,000) and 43,153 Plasmodium falciparum infections, while no malaria deaths were reported in 2026 so far. Long-term trends show Odisha malaria rising from 23,770 cases in 2022 to a peak of 68,693 in 2024, then easing to 62,137 in 2025; national cases rose from 1.76 lakh (2022) to 2.55 lakh (2024) and 2.33 lakh (2025). January–June 2026 data give some relief: Odisha 17,977 cases and 12,577 PF cases, with no malaria deaths to date; India 69,713 cases, with Odisha accounting for about 25.8% of the national caseload. The Bhubaneswar health department has directed district officers to intensify awareness programs for malaria prevention during the monsoon and to coordinate dengue control. Aedes aegypti breeding in clean water remains a concern; residents are urged to destroy containers that collect rainwater.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア・デング熱抑制のための啓発活動 | ブバネーシュワル・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: オディシャ州のマラリア・デング熱は例年見られる季節的傾向であり、2026年は死亡報告もなく前年より減少傾向にあるため、通常の予防啓発活動の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による定例的なモンスーン期の予防啓発活動の報道であり、異常な増加や重症化、死亡例の急増は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo isolates 200 river boat passengers as Ebola response intensifies
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola response intensified after a river boat intercepted in Kinshasa carried about 200 passengers who were tested and isolated following the death of a traveler from suspected Ebola. Africa CDC reports all aboard were tested, including asymptomatic individuals, with results pending from INRB; those passengers are barred from entering Kinshasa pending confirmation. The interception followed a man on the boat who died of suspected Ebola, raising concerns about Congo River–route transmission. Authorities are weighing broader vaccination strategies, including repurposing vaccines developed for the Zaire strain to combat the Bundibugyo-subtype causing the current outbreak; while prior Zaire vaccination may not prevent Bundibugyo infection, it is associated with milder illness and has shown no deaths among the vaccinated. Separately, health-care worker strikes in eastern Congo prompted assurances of salary payments to sustain surveillance, testing, vaccination and patient care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ対応強化のため川船の乗客200人を隔離
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行（Bundibugyo型）が河川交通を介してキンシャサへ拡大する懸念があり、乗客の隔離・入市制限などIHR基準に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 疑い死亡者が出た川船の乗客200人を隔離し、キンシャサへの流入を制限。既存のザイール株ワクチンをBundibugyo株に転用する戦略も検討中。東部での医療従事者ストライキも進行中で、サーベイランス継続に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Halálos kór gyanúja miatt állítottak le egy utasszállító hajót
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A passenger ship was halted due to suspicion of a deadly disease.
article.articleSummary: On August 6, 2026, Congo health authorities halted a passenger river vessel near Maluku, about 65 km from Kinshasa on the upper Congo River, after an Ebola-suspected death. More than 300 passengers were tested; mobile laboratories were deployed on board, and all passengers underwent fever checks and clinical screening. Samples were taken from four symptomatic, feverish passengers, with results expected on Friday (August 7, 2026). The trigger was the July 25 death of a 32-year-old man in Mongala Province with suspected Ebola linked to the ship's voyage; officials are still clarifying the timing of symptom onset and whether he boarded at Kisangani. Africa CDC said the ship originated from Mongala, where no Ebola cases had been registered, not from the active outbreak area in Tshopo Province. Authorities also plan to extend vaccination with the Zaire ebolavirus vaccine, which data indicate offers some protection against Bundibugyo strain, and to broaden remdesivir use in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: 死に至る疾病の疑いで旅客船が停止させられる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の疑いによる死亡例と旅客船での感染拡大懸念があり、IHR基準の複数該当およびWPRO基準の多数該当、社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラ流行（Tshopo州）とは異なる地域（Mongala州）での疑い例であり、船舶を介した拡散の可能性が懸念される。Africa CDCとの連携、ワクチン・remdesivir投与拡大の動きあり。続報（検査結果）の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Posibilă mutație a virusului Ebola. OMS investighează "virusul mutant" responsabil de epidemia severă
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Possible mutation of the Ebola virus. WHO investigates the 'mutant virus' responsible for the severe outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is linked to the Bundibugyo variant, one of the rarest strains, with over 3,900 confirmed cases and up to 4,000 people affected—about eight times higher than the same stage of the 2014 West Africa outbreak. Deaths are sixfold higher by comparison to that period. The World Health Organization and Africa CDC announce a joint investigation into a possible mutation that could explain the unprecedented rapid spread and severity. The current cluster is the largest the DRC has faced; there is no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo, though a clinical vaccine trial is underway. Until then, containment relies on isolation and rigorous contact tracing. Background notes include the 2018–2020 DRC outbreak, which caused about 2,300 deaths. The joint probe aims to characterize the outbreak and adapt response strategies to halt transmission and save lives.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの変異の可能性。WHOが深刻な流行の原因となった「変異ウイルス」を調査
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyo株による過去最大規模のエボラ流行が発生し、WHOとAfrica CDCが変異の可能性を共同調査していることから、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクの複数のIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCのみが主題として言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ao vivo na Globo, Ana Maria Braga não esconde reação ao descobrir surto de sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Live on Globo, Ana Maria Braga can't hide her reaction to learning of a measles outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak triggers targeted vaccination in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, Brazil. During a live segment on Globo’s Mais Você, reporter Fabricio Battaglini explained that vaccination is directed at people up to 59 years old, leaving those over 60 not prioritized due to assumed prior exposure and natural immunity. Presenters, including 77-year-old Ana Maria Braga, questioned the rationale, asking what happens to individuals who never contracted measles and lack protection. Health authorities emphasized that the current goal is to contain localized outbreaks, with vaccination blocks activated in the affected municipalities to prevent spread. Brazil remains free of endemic measles circulation, but immunization is restricted to the age group advised by experts in the affected regions under the alert. The program provides a detailed campaign table summarizing discussion points.

triage.headline_ja: 生放送のグローボ番組で、アナ・マリア・ブラガが麻疹アウトブレイクの発生を知り、驚きを隠せない反応
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹排除国であるブラジルの複数自治体（サンパウロ、グアルーリョス等）で局地的アウトブレイクが発生し、ワクチン接種ブロックが実施されるとともに、全国的な人気テレビ番組でも取り上げられ社会的関心が高まっているため。
triage.notes: 症例数・重症度・死亡者数などの詳細情報は記事に記載がなく不明。ブラジルは麻疹の風土病流行が排除された状態にあるため、今回の局地的アウトブレイクは公衆衛生上注視すべき事象である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola s-ar putea răspândi mai rapid de la mutații. OMS trage un semnal de alarmă asupra pericolului unui virus pentru care nu există vaccin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola could spread more rapidly due to mutations. WHO warns about the danger of a virus for which there is no vaccine.
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC are investigating a possible mutation of the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo as cases accelerate. The Bundibugyo variant outbreak is described as unprecedented in severity, with 4,000 confirmed cases reported on 6 August 2026, up from 3,900 the previous day, eight times higher than the 2014 West Africa Ebola epidemic. The death toll is stated to be six times higher in 2026 compared with 2014. Ebola transmission occurs via physical contact and bodily fluids. The Bundibugyo outbreak is reportedly not contained, and there is no approved vaccine, though a clinical trial is under way to develop the first vaccine. Officials say studies will determine if a mutation has occurred. The 2014–2015 outbreak had about 11,000 deaths in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは変異によりより急速に拡散する可能性。WHOはワクチンが存在しないウイルスの危険性について警鐘を鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが過去最大規模とされ、変異の可能性・ワクチン未承認・制御不能な状況が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行を主題としている。アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文中に具体的言及がないため除外。症例数(4000件)・死亡率が2014年流行を大幅に上回るとされ、変異の可能性とワクチン未承認が強調されている。続報および公式情報源（WHO DON等）での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus eboly v Konžskej demokratickej republike by mohol mutovať
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could mutate.
article.articleSummary: Over 4,000 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, marking the second-largest outbreak in history. The epicenter is Ituri province, including Bunia, where MSF centers report 90% of admitted patients were not on known contact lists, signaling gaps in tracing. Deaths exceed two-thirds outside treatment centers, underscoring weak surveillance. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, could be mutating, with Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya and WHO planning studies to assess whether viral changes drive severity. In response, Africa CDC shifts to active case finding door-to-door and expanded surveillance. Remdesivir is being considered for individual treatment, and Ervebo vaccine testing against this strain is planned; preliminary data hint that vaccinated individuals infected with Bundibugyo had milder illness and no deaths. Official declaration May 15; WHO suspects January start.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルスが変異する可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4000例超・史上2番目規模のエボラアウトブレイクが継続中で、接触者追跡が不十分（90%が未知の感染経路）、ウイルス変異の可能性も指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクで、Africa CDCとWHOがウイルス変異が重症度に影響しているか調査予定。ワクチン(Ervebo)接種者では軽症・死亡例なしとの予備データあり。

article.articleHeadline: MPRO denuncia dentista que teria contaminado intencionalmente mulheres pelo vírus HIV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MPRO files charges against dentist who allegedly intentionally infected women with HIV.
article.articleSummary: In Porto Velho, Rondônia, Brazil, the Public Prosecutor's Office (MPRO) has charged a dentist for allegedly infecting women with HIV intentionally. Investigations indicate the practitioner, aware of his diagnosis, refused antiretroviral therapy, and allegedly used the lack of treatment as a deliberate means to transmit the virus to partners. Four victims have been confirmed as infected; NAVIT (Victims' Assistance Unit) provides psychological support and referrals, with ongoing legal proceedings in the State Court. One hearing has occurred for a victim; prosecutors say the suspect remained sexually active and continued transmission even while under criminal action. The MPRO asks others who had relations with him to contact NAVIT. Possible charges include rape; danger of contagion of a serious disease; and grievous bodily harm, with penalties ranging from 2 to 10 years plus fines.

triage.headline_ja: MPRO、HIVウイルスを故意に女性に感染させたとされる歯科医を告発
triage.triage_reason: 個人による故意のHIV感染という刑事事件であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本件は個人の刑事事件（意図的なHIV感染）であり、感染症危機管理・公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC says will use Zaire Ebola vaccine in current outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, officially declared May 15, has caused about 1,800 deaths among nearly 4,000 confirmed cases as of 6 August 2026. The Bundibugyo variant has spread across five eastern and northeastern provinces, prompting Africa CDC to deploy a vaccine developed for the Zaire Ebola strain to all residents in Ituri and North Kivu. Officials report vaccinated individuals experience some symptoms but have reported zero deaths, indicating protection; dose availability was not disclosed. Africa CDC also plans to expand remdesivir use for treatment, citing Uganda's experience, where by mid-July there were no active Ebola cases, with 20 confirmed cases and two deaths. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids and causes haemorrhagic fever, with the outbreak ongoing in the specified DR Congo regions.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、現在のアウトブレイクにザイール株エボラワクチンを使用すると発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで約4000症例・1800人死亡の大規模エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが5州に拡大し、国際機関(Africa CDC)が緊急対応中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例報告があるが記事の主題はDRCでのアウトブレイクであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。致死率が約45%と非常に高く、致死性の高いブンディブギョ株の大規模流行として重大視すべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: OMS și Africa CDC, investigații urgente în RDC: epidemia de Ebola cu tulpina Bundibugyo se extinde într-un ritm fără precedent
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and Africa CDC, urgent investigations in the DRC: Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak spreading at an unprecedented pace.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Haute-Uele, Tshopo) is spreading at an unprecedented rate. As of now, 3,874 cases and 1,751 deaths are reported, with officials cautioning that real totals may be higher due to reporting gaps. The outbreak—the largest in the country to date—has no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo, though a new vaccine clinical trial is underway. Transmission occurs primarily via direct contact with the bodily fluids of infected individuals. The epidemic’s severity and geographic expansion surpass those of West Africa’s 2014–2015 outbreak by about eightfold in cases and sixfold in deaths for the same period. WHO and Africa CDC will jointly investigate a possible viral mutation to explain increased transmissibility and severity. Ituri accounts for about 90% of cases, and the health system faces severe strain amid a prolonged, multi-provincial spread. The WHO Director-General is in Kinshasa coordinating the response.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとアフリカCDC、DRCで緊急調査：ブンディブギョ株エボラの流行がかつてない速さで拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が発生し、致死率・拡大速度ともに深刻で、WHO/Africa CDCが緊急調査に乗り出しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチンがなく、ウイルス変異の可能性についてWHOとAfrica CDCが共同調査中。WHO事務局長がキンシャサで対応調整にあたっており、国際的な注目・支援ニーズが非常に高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola na RDC pode ter mutação do vírus; casos passam de 4.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC could involve a mutation of the virus; cases exceed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could involve a mutation of Bundibugyo ebolavirus; cases exceed 4,000. As of August 4, 2026, the National Institute of Public Health reported 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths, with officials saying cases had surpassed 4,000. The outbreak, centered in Ituri province including Bunia, is described as unprecedented. The Africa CDC and the World Health Organization plan studies to determine whether the virus is mutating or if other factors are at play. Response includes house-to-house active case finding, community health workers screening for vomiting and diarrhea, expanded digital tools, and intensified actions in IDP camps, a community-centered approach. Two-thirds of Ebola deaths occur outside treatment centers; at a MSF unit in Bunia, 90% of admitted patients were not on known contact lists, and tracing yields about 10 contacts per case vs. 40. Wessam Mankoula says the gradual measures phase is over.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、ウイルス変異の可能性；症例数4,000人超に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する大規模エボラ流行（症例4,000人超、死亡1,801人）であり、ウイルス変異の懸念や接触者追跡の困難さから国際的関心・支援の必要性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: Africa CDCとWHOがウイルス変異の可能性を調査中。接触者追跡率が大幅に低下（40件→10件/症例）しており、感染管理の困難さが増している。IDPキャンプでの対応強化も実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Smrtiaca ebola sa v Afrike šíri nevídaným tempom. V Kongu hrozia mutácie choroby, zdravotníci rozšíria zásah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly Ebola is spreading in Africa at an unprecedented pace. In Congo, the disease's mutations pose a threat, and health workers will broaden the intervention.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has exceeded 4,000 confirmed cases, the second-largest in history. The epicenter remains Ituri Province, with spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo, and spillover into neighboring Uganda. More than two-thirds of deaths occur outside care centers, highlighting weak tracing; at Bunia MSF center, 90% of admitted patients were not on known contact lists. Authorities and Africa CDC plan to shift from passive contact tracing to active case finding from door to door. They are considering using the antiviral remdesivir for individual patients and testing the Ervebo vaccine; preliminary data suggest better outcomes for those vaccinated, with no deaths among recipients. Investigations are also evaluating suspected Ebola deaths on a vessel bound for Kinshasa.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカで致死性エボラが未曾有の速度で拡大。コンゴでは変異の恐れがあり、医療従事者が対応を拡大へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目の規模となるエボラ流行（確認症例4000超）が拡大中で、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境流出が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。船舶での死亡疑い例調査など追加情報の継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola kills more than 300 children in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s eastern Ituri province has killed more than 300 children, with fatalities disproportionately high among those under 5. As of Aug. 2, 743 confirmed cases in children aged 17 and under include 330 deaths. Across the country, the outbreak has reached 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths since mid-May. The hardest-hit areas are Ituri hotspots Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nizi and Rwampara. UNICEF notes children account for about 25% of confirmed cases but nearly 33% of deaths, and warns that disruptions to essential health services are undermining care for malaria, diarrhea and other illnesses. From April to June, health-service use dropped 42% in hotspots and 13% province-wide. Children under five have a case fatality rate more than twice that of adults. Frontline teams warn the situation remains critical two and a half months after declaration, despite efforts by health workers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱により子供300人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部イトゥリ州で継続中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（累計3,973例、死亡1,801例）で、子供の致死率が特に高く、保健サービスへの深刻な影響も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola v Kongu může zmutovat, varují zdravotníci. Epidemie je prý druhá největší v historii
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo could mutate, health professionals warn. The outbreak is reportedly the second-largest in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could mutate, as experts plan expansion of containment, including house-to-house case finding. Confirmed cases have topped 4,000, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history. Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya, with WHO, says studies are being prepared to determine whether Bundibugyo virus mutations drive outbreak severity. Declared May 15, the outbreak may have begun in January. Over two-thirds of deaths occur outside treatment centers, indicating weak case finding; in Bunia, 90% of patients admitted to MSF’s center were not on known contact lists. Authorities aim to shift from tracing to active community surveillance and consider remdesivir and Ervebo vaccination for Bundibugyo cases, with data suggesting milder disease and no deaths among the vaccinated. The epidemic has spread from Ituri to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, and Uganda; suspected Ebola deaths are being investigated on a boat bound for Kinshasa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、変異の可能性あり—医療関係者が警告。史上2番目の規模の流行との報道
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例4000人超の史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行が複数州・ウガンダへ拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境拡大が示唆されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ウイルス変異の可能性・ワクチン効果に関する情報はフルRRAで詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு ஒழிப்பு விழிப்புணா்வு முகாம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Eradication Awareness Camp
article.articleSummary: Near Tiruppathur, in the Kandili area, a dengue eradication awareness camp was organized by Kandili Primary Health Centre under the guidance of Tiruppathur district administrator G. Ravikumar and district health officer Kalusivalingam, with medical officer A. Pugazhendi leading the effort. The drive focuses on removing old tires to prevent mosquito breeding during the monsoon, addressing dengue, chikungunya, and malaria. In Natham, Sevaththur, Perambattu, and Thoranampatti, weekly on Thursdays, they remove unnecessary tires, damaged flexible items, unused utensils, and broken containers that collect rainwater. This ongoing effort aims to reduce standing water and mosquito breeding, strengthening local vector-control and awareness as of 6 August 2026.

triage.notes: 記事はインド・タミルナードゥ州での日常的な予防啓発活動を報じたものであり、具体的な症例数や発生増加の情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: La UA combatirá el ébola aldea por aldea para frenar la epidemia en el este de la RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The AU will combat Ebola village by village to curb the epidemic in eastern DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-06, Africa CDC announced a village-by-village Ebola response in Ituri, DR Congo, with 1,801 deaths and 3,973 confirmed cases since May 15. The plan covers 6,542 villages to ensure safe burials, testing, and isolation, noting over 70% of new cases and more than 67% of deaths come from unlisted communities. Health-worker strikes are resolved; funds will provide free health services in Ituri and North Kivu, plus tools for community workers. Schools will reopen; plans support about 270,000 displaced in camps and 100,000 in host families. Cross-border coordination with CAR, South Sudan, and Uganda; Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths, Ebola-free since July 28. WHO cites Bundibugyo strain (30–50% fatal); no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Vaccination expansion for Zaire strain to Ituri/North Kivu; Remdesivir for all infected and contacts. US pledged $242M; international funding around $700M (with humanitarian aid). Second-largest outbreak by cases and largest in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合、コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ流行阻止のため村ごとの対応を実施
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で大規模なエボラ流行（死者1,801人、感染者3,973人）が継続し、国際的な資金支援・越境協力が行われているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。主要な発生地はDRC東部Ituri州および北キブ州。

article.articleHeadline: La UA combatirá el ébola aldea por aldea para frenar la epidemia en el este del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The AU will fight Ebola village by village to curb the epidemic in eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo's Ituri outbreak prompts Africa CDC to implement a village-by-village response across 6,542 villages after 1,801 deaths and 3,973 confirmed cases since May 15, 2026. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, with a 30–50% fatality rate and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment, underpins the effort. The traditional model has collapsed, with over 70% of new cases and 67% of deaths arising from untracked communities. The plan prioritizes safe burials, testing, isolation, and community engagement; it will fund free health care in Ituri and North Kivu, deploy digital information via mobile devices and satellite internet, and prepare 270,000 displaced in camps and 100,000 in host families. Vaccination campaigns against Zaire ebolavirus will expand; antivirals like Remdesivir will be used for all infected and contacts, following Uganda’s model that cut mortality to about 10%. US pledges $242M; total international funding around $700M ($1B with humanitarian aid). Cross-border coordination aims to prevent spread to CAR, South Sudan, and Uganda, which was declared Ebola-free on July 28 after 20 cases (15 imported).

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合、コンゴ東部でのエボラ流行を抑えるため村ごとの対応戦略を展開
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で致死率30-50%のブンディブギョ型エボラが大規模流行（死者1801人、症例3973件）し、周辺国への越境拡大リスクと国際的資金・介入が発生しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事では中央アフリカ共和国、南スーダン、ウガンダへの越境拡大防止も言及されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。米国は資金拠出国として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: République démocratique du Congo: le virus Ebola a fait plus de 300 victimes parmi les enfants
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: the Ebola virus has killed more than 300 people, including children.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 300 children in the current outbreak. UNICEF reports that as of 2 August 2026, 743 confirmed cases are in children aged 17 years and younger, including 330 deaths, with children accounting for roughly a quarter of confirmed cases but about a third of fatalities. Health services in Ituri province, the epicenter, have been severely disrupted, with essential health service use down 42% April–June in major outbreak hubs (Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nizi, Rwampara) and 13% province-wide. Under-5 children face the highest fatality rate, more than twice that of adults. The outbreak has strained the health system, jeopardizing malaria, diarrhea and other treatable diseases. Congo’s Ministry of Health reports 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths since mid-May. MSF warns the situation remains “more critical than ever.”

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラウイルスが子供を含む300人以上の死者を出す
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクが継続しており、死者数・症例数が甚大で医療システムが崩壊寸前であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州、ブニア、マングバルなど）でのエボラ流行を主題としている。ルワンダ（キガリ州）は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及がなく、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。MSFが「かつてないほど深刻」と警告し、国際支援の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Reporte del CDC de África alerta por el avance del Ébola y refuerza su estrategia en el Congo - HSB NOTICIAS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC report warns of the spread of Ebola and reinforces its strategy in the Congo - HSB News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri with confirmed cases elsewhere, continues to spread as Africa CDC assesses response strategies. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo variant, for which no fully approved vaccine exists; authorities are evaluating expanded use of vaccines against other Ebola strains and antivirals such as remdesivir. Africa CDC emphasizes enhanced epidemiological surveillance, improved contact tracing, deployment of mobile diagnostic laboratories, stronger clinical management, and community engagement to curb transmission. Coordination remains essential among the Congolese government, WHO, humanitarian groups, and neighboring countries to prevent regional or international spread. A recent suspected case linked to a deceased passenger on a boat near Kinshasa prompted mass testing and mobile labs. Security challenges, community distrust, logistical constraints, and limited international funding continue to hinder containment as of 2026-08-06.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCの報告、エボラ拡大を警告しコンゴでの対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株、承認済みワクチンなし）の流行が継続・拡大しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチンがないブンディブギョ株での流行であり、キンシャサ近郊での疑い例も報告されているため、国内拡大及び国際的拡散のリスクに注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: У ДР Конго вже понад 1800 смертей від Еболи, медики протестують через невиплату зарплат
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, there have already been more than 1,800 Ebola deaths; medical workers protest over unpaid salaries.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 1,800 people and infected nearly 4,000, with 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths reported by government data. The center of transmission remains Ituri Province, especially Bunia, accounting for about 90% of cases, with 674 patients in isolation, most in Ituri. Medical workers protesting unpaid salaries and bonuses since mid-May paused work near the Bunia governor's office, demanding timely pay. This is the second-largest Ebola outbreak after West Africa's 2014-2016 epidemic. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Congo and urged authorities to prioritize support for healthcare workers. Doctors Without Borders says the outbreak spreads at an alarming rate and responses are not reaching communities quickly enough to interrupt transmission. Officials note 60-70% of new cases come from remote settlements where access is hindered by conflict with insurgents and mining-driven displacement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ死者数1800人超、給与未払いで医療従事者が抗議
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（死者1800人超、感染者4000人近く）で公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあり、医療体制の逼迫（給与未払い抗議）や紛争地帯でのアクセス困難など管理可能性にも重大な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 西アフリカ2014-2016年流行に次ぐ史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行。WHO事務局長が現地訪問。医療従事者の給与未払いによるストライキや紛争地域でのアクセス困難が対応を阻害している。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文で言及なく除外。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в ДР Конго распространилась на лагеря для перемещенных лиц
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo has spread to internally displaced persons camps.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak of Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spread, with 19 internally displaced persons infected and five deaths confirmed in Ituri province’s IDP camps. Since the outbreak was officially declared on 15 May, nearly 4,000 cases and more than 1,800 deaths have been reported, with Ituri remaining the epicenter. Cases have been confirmed in at least five of 69 camps across Ituri, while no cases have been detected among refugees or asylum seekers. Regions affected include Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Chopo, where about 4.4 million internally displaced people live. UN agencies warn of dire risk due to limited water and sanitation in camps and distrust of medical services. Response efforts include enhanced surveillance, laboratory testing, treatment, and community engagement; with CERF providing $60 million, and WHO-led initiatives to expand treatment centers and protect health workers. Tedros urged intensified anti-epidemic measures and safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、国内避難民キャンプに拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで宣言から継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが約4,000症例・1,800人以上の死亡に達し、国内避難民キャンプにも拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的な支援も動員されている。
triage.notes: 致死率が非常に高く（約45%）、避難民キャンプでの衛生状態悪化と医療不信が感染拡大リスクを高めている。CERFやWHOによる大規模支援が既に動員されており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Virus eboly v Kongu by mohl mutovat, varují zdravotníci
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus in Congo could mutate, health professionals warn.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, Ebola virus activity in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could mutate, health professionals warn, prompting expanded containment efforts. Experts plan a major increase in response, including door-to-door outreach and active search for infected patients. The report provides no specific case counts or mutation details, but underscores a strengthened public health push to curb transmission. In a separate item, Moroccan authorities are investigating about 90 people in connection with events in Ceuta, Spain, where authorities say roughly 72,000 people crossed illegally from Morocco last week. AMDH, a Moroccan rights group, cited the investigations, while officials have not disclosed exact numbers.

triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤な疾患の変異可能性と拡大封じ込め強化の報道であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが懸念されるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
