article.articleHeadline: 中疾控：新冠陽性率上升趨緩　南方顯著高於北方 - 香港文匯報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC: The COVID-19 positivity rate is rising more slowly; the South is significantly higher than the North - Wen Wei Po (Hong Kong).
article.articleSummary: China CDC reports for July 27–August 2 that COVID-19 positivity is rising more slowly and remains at mid-epidemic levels. In outpatient influenza‑like illness, positivity is 4.5%, higher in the South (5.7%) than the North (2.9%). The most common pathogens detected in outpatient samples are SARS‑CoV‑2 (22.3%), influenza (13.3%), and enteroviruses (4.1%); among hospitalized SARI cases, SARS‑CoV‑2 (8.2%), influenza (5.8%), and human metapneumovirus (5.5%). The NB.1.8.1 lineage remains the dominant SARS‑CoV‑2 variant. Southern provinces show significantly higher positivity; the 15–59 age group has the highest positivity. Influenza activity is at a low level, with B/Victoria and A(H3N2) co-circulating. No novel pathogens or major public health disruptions detected; no new variants of concern. COVID-19 remains a common, usually mild disease; preventive measures include masking, hygiene, healthy lifestyle, and vaccination for vulnerable groups.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防コントロールセンター：新型コロナ陽性率の上昇は鈍化、南方が北方より顕著に高い－香港文匯報
triage.triage_reason: 既知の病原体（COVID-19、インフルエンザ等）の定例サーベイランス報告であり、新規変異株や重大な公衆衛生上の異常は検出されていないため。
triage.notes: 定例の呼吸器系病原体サーベイランス報告であり、新規変異株（Variant of Concern）は検出されていない。COVID-19は中程度の流行レベルにあり軽症が中心とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya keeps vigil to keep Ebola at bay
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in DR Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo) since mid-May: 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths (case fatality >45%). No approved vaccine or targeted treatment for this strain. Kenya maintains round-the-clock surveillance at Malaba One Stop Border Post on the Kenya–Uganda border, screening ~1,500 travelers daily; over 50,000 travelers screened since enhanced surveillance began ~two months ago. Cross-border movement from DR Congo and neighboring countries drives vigilance. At Malaba, travelers undergo handwashing and temperature checks with overhead and handheld thermometers; those with fever are isolated, monitored, and samples may be sent to labs, with possible transfer to the Alupe subcounty hospital isolation center in Busia County. Busia County reports three suspected Ebola cases since late May (one in Malaba, two in Busia town), all negative. Challenges include bypass routes and misinformation; ongoing public-health awareness campaigns are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ流入阻止へ警戒態勢を継続
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ株エボラ大規模流行（症例3,973件、死亡1,801件、致死率45%超）が継続しており、国境を越えた拡大リスクが高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ流行とその越境拡大対策（ケニア国境での検疫）。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在しない株であり、国際的な支援・監視の継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الكوليرا تضرب عدة دول إفريقية.. وفاة 13 وإصابة 240 شخصا في تشاد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera hits several African countries... 13 dead and 240 people infected in Chad.
article.articleSummary: Chad reports 239 cholera cases and 13 deaths since the outbreak was officially declared in July (case fatality ~5.4%), with 11 deaths in N'Djamena in August. First fatalities occurred on June 13. The northern Hadjer-Lamis region and the capital N’Djamena are affected; about 50,800 people have been vaccinated since July 24. The country notes multiple African nations reporting outbreaks recently, including the Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of Congo, and Nigeria. Cholera spreads through contaminated food or water. While rehydration and antibiotics can treat the disease, it can be fatal within hours if untreated. Chad emphasizes that modern wastewater treatment has reduced cholera in wealthy countries, but limited access to safe drinking water and sanitation remains a ongoing challenge.

triage.headline_ja: コレラが複数のアフリカ諸国を襲う…チャドで13人死亡、240人感染
triage.triage_reason: チャドでのコレラ流行に加え、コンゴ民主共和国など複数のアフリカ諸国での発生が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大リスク）が2項目該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はチャドでの流行だが、対象国ではないため除外。DRCは複数国での流行報告の一つとして名指しされているため含めた。CAR・Nigeriaは対象国リスト外のため除外。詳細な症例数等はDRCについて記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt kèm co giật, bé gái 7 tháng tuổi bất ngờ mắc viêm não Nhật Bản
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 7-month-old girl with fever and seizures unexpectedly contracts Japanese encephalitis.
article.articleSummary: Seven-month-old girl in Ninh Bình, Vietnam, diagnosed with Japanese encephalitis after a febrile seizure. She presented with high fever and a generalized seizure lasting about 20 minutes; seizures persisted en route to care. At Bach Mai Hospital’s Pediatric Center in Ninh Bình, she was stabilized, and physicians pursued etiologic testing. A lumbar puncture revealed pleocytosis after the family initially hesitated, and brain MRI showed lesions consistent with encephalitis. Subsequent testing confirmed infection with Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV). Intensive care included seizure control, management of intracranial pressure, continuous neurological monitoring, fluid-electrolyte optimization, and nutritional support. After 24 days of active treatment, she became afebrile, seizure-free, alert, and feeding well, and was discharged with follow-up plans to detect potential neurological sequelae. The case highlights that fever with prolonged seizures in infants warrants prompt evaluation and timely lumbar puncture for accurate diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱とけいれんを伴う生後7ヶ月の女児が突然日本脳炎を発症
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個別症例報告であり、日本脳炎はベトナムで既知の風土病であるため異常性や国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 日本脳炎はベクター媒介性で人-人感染しない既知の風土病。単一症例で、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي الكوليرا في تشاد.. 240 إصابة و13 حالة وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera outbreak in Chad: 240 cases and 13 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Cholera is spreading in Chad, with 13 deaths and about 239–240 cases reported since July, concentrated in the Hadjer-Lamis region in the north and the capital N'Djamena. The Chadian Ministry of Health notes a case fatality rate of 5.4% across the country, including 11 deaths in N'Djamena during August. Since July 24, roughly 50,800 people have received a cholera vaccine. The first fatalities occurred on June 13, more than a month before the official outbreak declaration. The report situates Chad within a broader West and Central Africa context, noting concurrent cholera outbreaks in neighboring or nearby countries such as the Central African Republic, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: チャドでコレラ流行:240例、13人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 主題国はチャド（対象国リスト外）であり、DRC等は近隣国として言及されているのみで具体的な症例情報がないため、対象国での直接発生とは確認できない。地域的拡大の可能性はあり継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチャドのコレラ流行であり、DRC・中央アフリカ共和国・ナイジェリアは近隣国の同時流行事例として言及されているのみで、具体的な発生データが示されていないため対象国として計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا تتجاوز 4000 في الكونغو الديمقراطية.. وتسجيل 1850 حالة وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases exceed 4,000 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 1,850 deaths recorded.
article.articleSummary: 4053 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 1850 deaths, according to the latest health update. Of these, 694 patients remain in isolation or receiving hospital care, and 793 have recovered. Médecins Sans Frontières warns that the eastern DRC outbreak is more dangerous than ever, spreading at an alarming pace with no clear sign of abatement. Separately, authorities intercepted a boat carrying about 200 people toward Kinshasa after a prior death on July 25 suspected to be Ebola-related. The vessel, from Kisangani in the northeast, was stopped at the Maluku River Port about 65 km from Kinshasa, where a mobile lab was deployed to test all passengers and crew. The 32-year-old man suspected to have died from Ebola left the boat in Mongala Province around 550 km upstream; no samples were collected there due to limited facilities. No additional deaths among passengers have been reported.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者数が4000人を超える…死者1850人を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でエボラ感染者4000人超・死者1850人と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、MSFが拡大の加速と収束の兆しなしと警告。船舶での感染疑い患者の移動によりキンシャサへの国際的拡大リスクも生じており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: エボラ疑い患者を乗せた船舶がキンシャサ近郊で検疫されるなど、国内での感染拡大防止対応が進行中。致死率(約46%)が高く、MSFが警戒を強めている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en la RDC roza los 1.800 fallecidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC nears 1,800 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reaches 1,801 deaths and 3,973 confirmed cases, with a case‑fatality rate of 45.3%. Five eastern provinces are affected: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo, with sustained transmission and high virus circulation. About 674 patients remain isolated or hospitalized; 776 have recovered; contact tracing stands at 75.3%. This is the second-largest outbreak by cases in RDC history, after 2018–2020, and the fastest-growing since records began, yet far from the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (11,000 deaths, 28,000 cases). The strain is Bundibugyo; CFR estimated at 30–50%. There is no licensed vaccine or specific antiviral treatment. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals; symptoms include severe hemorrhagic fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding. Uganda has declared Ebola-free after 20 infections (15 imported from DRC) and 2 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、死者数1,800人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去2番目の規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中で、致死率45%超、複数州に拡大しウガンダへの越境感染も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダはDRCからの輸入症例で終息宣言済みだが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・特効薬が未承認である点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Bác sĩ Quân y khuyến cáo cách nhận biết và phòng ngừa Covid-19 trước các biến thể mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Military doctor advises on how to recognize and prevent COVID-19 in the face of new variants.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, rising Covid-19 cases across Vietnam are linked to SARS-CoV-2 variants NB.1.8.1, XFG.1.1, and BA.3.2 (Omicron), nicknamed the cicada variant. BA.3.2 is highly transmissible; current data show no evidence of greater severity than prior Omicron strains, though immune evasion may cause reinfection in those previously infected or vaccinated. Early signs include sore throat and hoarseness; other symptoms include fever, cough, fatigue, headache, nasal congestion, loss of smell or taste, and sometimes nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. Covid-19 is a multi-system disease; lungs are most affected, but heart, liver, and kidneys can be involved. High-risk groups—elderly, cardiovascular disease, diabetes, immunodeficiency, chronic lung disease—require closer monitoring. Preventive measures: vaccination, hand hygiene, masking in crowded or poorly ventilated spaces. Seek medical care for severe symptoms; avoid self-medication with antivirals or antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: 軍医、新変異株を前にCOVID-19の見分け方と予防法を助言
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでCOVID-19新変異株（BA.3.2等）による感染増加が報じられているが、重症度上昇の証拠はなく、一般的な予防啓発記事の域を出ないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は主に予防啓発の医療アドバイス記事であり、感染者数の具体的統計や重症度の急増データは含まれていない。新変異株の伝播性は高いとされるが重症度上昇の証拠はないと明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Gurugram: Dengue tally now 13 with three fresh cases
article.articleSummary: Gurugram, 7 August 2026 — Dengue tally reaches 13 this year after three new cases, with no dengue deaths reported. The city also has four active malaria cases. In a rapid fever mass survey on Thursday, officials surveyed 14,537 houses and collected 93 samples from suspected dengue patients, taking total samples tested this year to 4,404. Authority issued 1,073 notices under Section 214 of the Haryana Municipal Act to premises with mosquito-breeding conditions. Heavy rainfall and waterlogging have created breeding grounds, with stagnant water in drains, construction sites, discarded containers, and waterlogged areas cited. Dengue is primarily spread by Aedes mosquitoes; malaria by Anopheles. Officials say they are monitoring vector-borne disease cases citywide and urge residents to prevent water accumulation, maintain sanitation, and use mosquito protection during the monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: グルガオン:デング熱の累計が13人に、新たに3例確認
triage.triage_reason: デング熱13例・マラリア4例は季節性の通常範囲内で、死亡例もなく、当局が通常の予防対策を実施している状況であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: モンスーン期の蚊媒介性感染症の季節的発生であり、地方自治体レベルで通常の対応（家屋調査、通知発行等）が行われている。死亡例なし、症例数も少数で、国際的な懸念要因は見当たらない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : plus de 4.000 cas confirmés, la riposte élargie (PAPIER GENERAL)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: More than 4,000 confirmed cases, the expanded response (General Paper)
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo strain) reports 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths, with 793 recoveries across 53 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. Ituri accounts for 86.9% of cases, making this the second-largest outbreak globally and the worst in the DRC since 1976. Authorities are studying potential viral mutation and other factors driving rapid progression, while accelerating trials of vaccines and treatments. No vaccine or therapy is approved for Bundibugyo; Ervebo is being deployed more widely in Ituri and North Kivu. A mobile lab supports testing after a boat on the Congo River upstream of Kinshasa prompted quarantine of all aboard; the deceased passenger’s Ebola status is not yet lab-confirmed, and the vessel’s origin (Mongala vs Tshopo) remains disputed. Manifest lists 250 passengers, but at least 300 were aboard; all aboard are being tested and observed.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ出血熱：確認症例4,000人超、対応拡大（総合記事）
triage.triage_reason: 1976年以来最悪規模となるDRCのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確認症例4,053例、死者1,850人）で、ウイルス変異の可能性や河川船舶での感染疑い事例による拡大リスクもあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 承認されたBundibugyo株用ワクチン・治療薬が存在しない中、コンゴ川の船舶での死亡者のエボラ感染疑いなど新たな拡大経路の可能性があり、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Một chi tiết giúp bác sĩ chẩn đoán bé 7 tháng mắc bệnh nguy hiểm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A detail helps doctors diagnose a 7-month-old baby with a dangerous disease.
article.articleSummary: Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV) encephalitis diagnosed in a 7-month-old girl at Bac Mai Pediatric Center, Ninh Binh, Vietnam. She was admitted with fever and a prolonged generalized seizure lasting about 20 minutes, with seizures persisting during transport. The emergency team secured airway and circulation and closely monitored neurologic status. Given the infant’s age and persistent seizures, clinicians suspected CNS involvement beyond simple febrile seizures. Lumbar puncture was performed after counseling, revealing CSF leukocytosis suggestive of CNS inflammation. MRI of the brain showed lesions compatible with encephalitis. Subsequent tests confirmed JEV positivity. Critical care included seizure control, management of cerebral edema, continuous neuro monitoring, fluid-electrolyte adjustment, and nutritional support. After 24 days, the child’s fever resolved, seizures ceased, she was alert and feeding well, with stable vital signs and discharge planned. The article underlines LP’s diagnostic value in suspected meningitis/encephalitis and urges timely care for fever with prolonged seizures.

triage.headline_ja: 医師が7か月児の危険な病気を診断する手がかりとなった一つの所見
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで日本脳炎(JEV)は既知の流行地域病であり、本記事は単一症例の臨床診断・治療経過の報告であって、異常な集積や公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 単一の乳児症例に関する臨床報告であり、アウトブレイクやクラスターを示す情報はない。日本脳炎はベトナムの既知の流行病であり、ワクチンも存在する。豚コレラ(Classical Swine Fever)や原因不明脳炎への言及はメタデータ上のみで記事本文には含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo tests passengers after suspected Ebola death on boat
article.articleSummary: Ebola scare in the Democratic Republic of Congo as Kinshasa-area authorities intercept a passenger river boat at Maluku, 65 km upstream, prompting screening of more than 300 travellers after the July 25 death of a 32-year-old man suspected of Ebola who reportedly travelled on the vessel. A mobile laboratory was deployed; four feverish passengers were sampled with results due today (2026-08-07). Conflicting accounts place the man’s infection timeline: some say illness on board, others after disembarking; origins cited include Mongala province (no confirmed cases there) versus Kisangani, with officials differing on where he boarded. Separately, authorities plan to expand vaccination against Zaire ebolavirus and widen remdesivir use in affected areas, noting the current outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The incident underscores ongoing transmission risks and cross-provincial tracing efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、船上でのエボラ疑い死亡後に乗客を検査
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに関連し、河川船での複数州にまたがる感染拡大懸念と300人規模のスクリーニングが行われており、国際的拡大リスクと重症度の観点からIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 現在進行中のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクの一環。感染者の乗船経路・発症時期について当局間で情報が錯綜しており、複数州（モンガラ州、キサンガニ、キンシャサ近郊）にまたがる伝播経路の追跡が課題。ザイールエボラウイルス用ワクチンの拡大接種とレムデシビル使用拡大も計画されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO dan Mitra Sepakati Strategi Bersama untuk Menghentikan Ebola di Republik Demokratik Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and Partners Agree on a Joint Strategy to Stop Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has prompted WHO and partners to adopt a joint strategy to halt the spread. The current outbreak is the second-largest globally by case count, with 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths since mid-May. It spans 51 health zones across Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo, with Ituri as the epicenter, accounting for 87.1% of cumulative cases. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus and Africa CDC leaders met Kinshasa officials to align response, stressing protection and support for frontline health workers through PPE provision and compensation. Africa CDC estimates a continental funding need of $1.4 billion, with more than $420 million already mobilized. Measures emphasize early detection, contact tracing, access to quality health services, and community engagement. Separately, authorities intercepted a boat carrying about 200 people from Tshopo toward Kinshasa after a suspicious Ebola-related death; a mobile lab was dispatched for screening.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとパートナー団体、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ流行阻止に向けた共同戦略に合意
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で世界第2位規模のエボラ流行（3,973症例、1,801死亡）が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的な資金・支援要請も行われているためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 感染は複数州（Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo）に拡大し、キンシャサへの人の移動（船舶での200人接触）も報告されており、国内でのさらなる拡散リスクが高い。国際的な渡航制限の有無については記事内で言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Response Turns to Merck Vaccine, Gilead Drug as Congo Outbreak Worsens
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues to worsen, described as the fastest-growing outbreak on record. The response pivots to expanding use of Merck’s Ebola vaccine and Gilead Sciences’ antiviral drug to blunt transmission. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, together with Congolese officials, plan broader access to the vaccine and antiviral treatment in affected eastern Congo. The move signals a shift toward wider immunization and therapeutic coverage as case numbers rise, though the excerpt does not provide specific counts of cases or deaths. The strategy emphasizes accelerating vaccination campaigns and antiviral deployment to curb spread amid ongoing transmission in the region, reflecting intensified international and national public health efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行悪化を受け、対応はメルクのワクチンとギリアドの薬に転換
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部で記録上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ流行が悪化しており、ワクチンと抗ウイルス薬の拡大展開が計画されるなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的対応が必要な状況であるためPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事中に明記されていないが、「記録上最速の拡大」との表現から深刻度が高いと判断。Africa CDCと国際的なワクチン・治療薬展開の動きが示されている。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Outbreak Tops 4,000 Cases Amid Mutation Fears
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases as of 7 August 2026, one of the largest in the nation’s history. Authorities fear the virus may be mutating; investigations are underway to determine if any changes affect transmissibility or severity. The surge strains the healthcare system, prompting intensified surveillance, treatment, and vaccination efforts in affected regions, along with ongoing contact tracing and community awareness campaigns. Experts are monitoring genetic changes for potential impacts on vaccines, treatments, and diagnostic tools. The outbreak has renewed concerns about containment amid humanitarian and security challenges, and health authorities urge continued vigilance and international support to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、変異の懸念の中で4,000症例を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が4,000症例を超え国内史上最大級の流行となっており、変異による感染性・重症度への影響が懸念されるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ウイルス変異の有無や国際的拡大の可能性については続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控：新冠阳性率上升趋缓，总体处于中流行水平，南方显著高于北方
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC: The rise in COVID-19 positivity rate is slowing; overall transmission is at a moderate level, with the south significantly higher than the north.
article.articleSummary: On August 6, 2026, the China CDC released the July 27–August 2 national sentinel surveillance for acute respiratory infections. The SARS-CoV-2 positivity rate is rising but slowing, with overall transmission at a moderate level; the main circulating lineage remains NB.1.8.1. Positivity is notably higher in southern provinces than in northern ones. The influenza-like illness (ILI) proportion among total outpatient and emergency visits is 4.5% nationwide, 5.7% in the south and 2.9% in the north. Among outpatient/ED ILI samples, the top pathogens are SARS-CoV-2 22.3%, influenza virus 13.3%, and enterovirus 4.1%. Among hospitalized SARI patients, the top pathogens are SARS-CoV-2 8.2%, influenza virus 5.8%, and human metapneumovirus 5.5%.

triage.headline_ja: 中疾控：新型コロナ陽性率の上昇は鈍化、全体として中程度の流行レベル、南部が北部より顕著に高い
triage.triage_reason: 中国CDCによる定例のサーベイランス報告であり、季節性の呼吸器感染症（COVID-19、インフルエンザ、エンテロウイルス等）の流行状況を示すルーティンデータで、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 定例のサーベイランスレポートであり、既知の病原体（SARS-CoV-2、インフルエンザ、ヒトメタニューモウイルス、エンテロウイルス）の季節的変動を示すもの。新規性・異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉确诊病例超4000例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 4,053 confirmed cases, with 1,850 deaths and 793 recoveries as of Aug. 5, 2026, per the DRC health ministry. Africa CDC director Kasaye warned that actual infections may be higher than reported, noting unprecedented outbreak severity and planned studies to check for possible viral mutation. The main challenge cited is not funding but mobilizing affected communities, including local leaders, women, and youth organizations. The WHO and Africa CDC urged intensified, community-led responses: early case finding, contact tracing, accessible healthcare, support for frontline workers, and faster aid delivery. Separately, Kinshasa authorities intercepted a riverboat about 65 km from Kinshasa after a passenger developed symptoms and died post-disembarkation; the manifest lists 250 passengers, possibly 300 aboard, with ongoing verification to prevent spread into the capital.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確定症例が4,000例を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで4,000例超・死者1,850人に達し、ウイルス変異の懸念や首都キンシャサへの拡散リスク（感染疑いのある船舶乗客）も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: Africa CDCがウイルス変異の可能性を調査中であり、首都キンシャサへの流入リスク（症状発症後死亡した乗客を乗せた船舶の拿捕）が報告されている点は特に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak spreading at 'unprecedented speed', says WHO boss
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading at unprecedented speed, with nearly 3,900 confirmed infections and more than 1,700 deaths across five provinces, led by Ituri as the epicenter. The World Health Organization warns the true case load could be several times higher, with many infections undetected as contact tracing misses transmission chains; 80% of community deaths occur outside the listed contacts. Frontline responders work in dangerous conditions, while some staff strike over unpaid allowances even as teams disinfect homes of Ebola victims. Insecurity and attacks on treatment centers slow the response. Authorities intercepted a river boat carrying about 200 passengers after a traveler showed Ebola symptoms, highlighting the risk of spread toward Kinshasa. WHO Director-General Tedros says the outbreak can be stopped if the response outruns the virus.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、「前例のない速度」で拡大とWHOトップが警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC5州で急拡大し約3900人感染・1700人超死亡、WHOが未曾有の速度と警告、キンシャサへの拡散リスクもあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が直接発言する国際的に注目度の高いエボラ流行。渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事内に明記なし。キンシャサへの拡大リスクが指摘されており、今後の続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: 食腦蟲｜男子泰國狂食生醃海鮮染「食腦蟲」腸道嚴重潰爛 反覆大出血休克險死
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brain-Eating Worm (Angiostrongylus cantonensis): Thai Man's Binge on Raw, Brined Seafood Causes Severe Intestinal Ulceration, Recurrent Massive Bleeding and Shock, Nearly Died
article.articleSummary: One Shanghai man, Xu (pseudonym), contracted Entamoeba histolytica after extensive consumption of raw and brined seafood during a business trip to Thailand. Upon return, he developed fulminant amebic enteritis with widespread intestinal ulcers, recurrent massive bleeding, and septic shock. Despite multiple surgeries, he remained critically ill, with severe inflammation, coagulation dysfunction, and hemoglobin dropping below 6 g/dL, risking intestinal perforation and death. He was transferred to Shanghai Public Health Clinical Center for emergency care, where a personalized, multidisciplinary treatment plan over more than 30 days controlled bleeding and infection, ultimately achieving survival. Entamoeba histolytica infections are common in tropical/subtropical regions; foodborne exposure through raw seafood is a notable risk. Travelers are advised to enforce strict food and water hygiene and seek urgent care for severe abdominal pain, diarrhea, or vomiting, especially in hot weather. The report also notes parasitic risks associated with seafood consumption.

triage.headline_ja: 食脳虫｜男性がタイで生腌海鮮を暴食し「赤痢アメーバ」感染、腸管に重度潰瘍、大出血と敗血症性ショックを繰り返し危篤
triage.triage_reason: 個人の輸入症例（タイ渡航中に赤痢アメーバに感染した中国人男性1名）であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 赤痢アメーバ症は熱帯・亜熱帯地域で一般的な感染症であり、本件は個人の重症例報告（中国人男性がタイ渡航中に生の海鮮を摂取し感染、上海で治療）。集団感染やアウトブレイクを示唆する情報はなく、対象国での公衆衛生上の懸念事象には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola salgını büyüyor: Virüs mutasyona uğramış olabilir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is growing: The virus may have mutated.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) linked to the Bundibugyo strain exceeds 4,000 confirmed cases, with 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths reported as of August 4, 2026; Africa CDC director confirms the total surpassed 4,000. The January-present outbreak, first reported May 15, is the second-largest on record, with mutation investigations planned by Africa CDC and WHO as authorities escalate the response. Contact tracing is weak (expected 40 contacts per patient, only about 10 identified), prompting a shift to active case finding with door-to-door visits by community health workers in Ituri (Bunia) and across North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo; Uganda reports 20 cases linked to the outbreak. Remdesivir will be used for humanitarian reasons; Ervebo vaccine’s applicability against Bundibugyo is being tested. A suspected Ebola death on a boat near Kinshasa triggers investigations. UNICEF warns of service disruptions and measles vaccination drop to 69% in Mongbwalu.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が拡大：ウイルスが変異した可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行が4,000例・死者1,801人を超え史上2番目の規模となり、変異の可能性やウガンダへの拡大も報告されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
